original: indrāvatāramiti svarūpakathanam | arjunabodhane kā prāptirityata āha || nārāyaṇeti || bāndhavādinigrahasyādharmatvāt kimucyate'dharmatvenāśaṅkyetyata etannigrahasya kaimutyena dharmatvamāha || kṣatriyāṇāmiti || bhāgavatamātrasyaitādṛśanigrahaḥ paramadharmaḥ | atraiva niyuktānāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ tu viśeṣato'pi paramadharma ityarthaḥ |

original: bāndhavādinigrahaḥ kathaṃ paramadharma ityato bāndhavādīti vaktavye nārāyaṇadviṭ‌tadanubandhītyuktam | bāndhavāditve'pi keṣāñcinnārāyaṇadveṣitvāt keṣāñcittatsambandhitvāt tannigraho dharma eveti bhāvaḥ |

original: nanvayaṃ dharmaścecchāstrodita eva bhavet | tathā ca na śāstraviduṣā'dharmatvenā'śaṅkyeta | śaṅkyate ca | ato na dharma ityata āha || bandhusnehāditi || na śāstramukheneyaṃ śaṅkā | api tu snehamātranibandhanaiveti bhāvaḥ | jñāninaḥ snehamātreṇa sañjātayā śaṅkayā kathaṃ svakīyaparamadharmanivṛttirityata uktam || nivṛttaprāyamiti ||

original: evamāśaṅkayā nivṛttaprāyaścedetadyuddhakaraṇameva bodhanīyaṃ, bhagavanmahimādike kimarthamucyata ityato bodhyārthamāha || sveti || na kevalaṃ yuddhādisvavihitavṛttimātraṃ paramo dharmaḥ | yena tadeva bodhyaṃ syāt | api tu bhaktyādikamapi | tatrārjunasya dharmaikadeśe'dharmaśaṅkāyāmapi prāptalokopakārāya pamagradharmo bhagavatā bodhyate |

original: tatra bhagavanmahimādyuktistu bhaktyutpādanāyeti bhāvaḥ |

original: nanu yuddhādisvavihitavṛttinivṛtto'pyarjuno na paramadharmanivṛttaḥ | bhaktyādimattvāt | ataḥ kiṃ bodhyata ityata āha || taditi || na bhaktyādikaṃ pratyekaṃ paramadharmaḥ | yena tāvatā tasya na paramadharmanivṛttiḥ | kintu militameva | ate'nyatamābhāve'pi paramadharmanivṛtteryuktaṃ tadbodhanamiti bhāvaḥ |

original: tarhi prakṛtyādivarṇanaṃ kvopayujyuta ityato'stu svavihitavṛtterdhakmatvaṃ, tadviruddhasyādharmatvaṃ ca | bhagavadbhaktyā tadārādhanasya dharmatvaṃ tadviruddhasyādharmatvaṃ ca kuta ityāśaṅkānivārāṇāya sarvasya bhagavadadhīnatvahetuṃ vaktuṃ sarvanirūpaṇamiti bhāvenāha || bhagavaditi ||

analyzed: sarvasya bhagavat adhīna tvena dharma adharma tayā bhagavat niyatayoḥ eva tathābhāvāt tasya ca evam vidhayoḥ eva tathā niyamana upapatteḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanvarjunasya devatvādi kutaḥ | svavihitetyādergītātātparyārthatvaṃ ca kuta ityata āha || sarvañceti || arjuno deva ityādyetacca sarvaṃ gītāyāṃmevāvagamyate | na ca pramāṇāntaraṃ tatrānveṣaṇīyam | svavihitetyādikaṃ ca sarvaṃ gītāyāmavagamyata eva | na tu tadarthatayā balāducyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: nanu arjunasya deva tva ādi kutas sva vihita ityādeḥ gītā tātparya artha tvam ca kutas iti atas āha sarvam ca iti arjunaḥ devaḥ ityādi etat ca sarvam gītāyām eva avagamyate na ca pramāṇa antaram tatra anveṣaṇīyam sva vihita ityādikam ca sarvam gītāyām avagamyate eva na tu tad arthatayā balāt ucyate iti arthaḥ

original: mā'stu bhramaviṣayasyānirvācyatā'trocyata iti | viśvasya tu bhaviṣyati | tatrāsadvailakṣaṇyasya saṅgatatvāt | sadvailakṣaṣyaṃ tu bādhānyathā'nupapattyā siddhyatītyataḥśrutivirodhānneti bhāvenāha || viśvamiti || viśvasya sadasadvilakṣaṇatvaṃ viruddhaṃ ceti bhāvenāha || viśvamiti || yaśasvināvindrabṛhaspatī yuvayorviśvaṃ satyameva |
analyzed: mā astu bhrama viṣayasya anirvācya tā atra ucyate iti viśvasya tu bhaviṣyati tatra asat vailakṣaṇyasya saṅga tatvāt sat vailakṣaṣyam tu bādhā anyathā anupapattyā siddhi ati iti atas śruti virodhāt na iti bhāvena āha viśvam iti viśvasya sat asat vilakṣaṇa tvam viruddham ca iti bhāvena āha viśvam iti yaśasvinau indra bṛhaspatī yuvayoḥ viśvam satyam eva

original: kutaḥ? yuvayoḥ satyajagatsṛṣṭyādikarma sarvadevatā api jānanti yata ityāhetyarthaḥ | balyādibhyaḥ spṛhaṇīyaṃ vasu jetā indrādibhyo dātā | īśvaro yadviśvaṃ cakāra tatsatyameva na mithyetyarthaḥ | sarvajño manaḥprerakaḥ sarvato varaḥ svatantraḥ parameśvaraḥ padārthānanantakāle'pyabādhitatayaivākarodityarthaḥ || 16 ||
analyzed: kutas yuvayoḥ satya jagat sṛṣṭi ādi karma sarva devatāḥ api jānanti yatas iti āha iti arthaḥ bali ādibhyaḥ spṛhaṇīyam vasu jetā indra ādibhyaḥ dātā īśvaraḥ yat viśvam cakāra tat satyam eva na mithyā iti arthaḥ sarvajñaḥ manaḥ prerakaḥ sarvatas varaḥ svatantraḥ parameśvaraḥ padārthān ananta kāla īpya bādhita tayā eva akarot iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃ yuddhākaraṇe kāraṇābhāvamuktvā tatkartavyaṃ, tacca bhagavatpūjātvena kāryamiti vakṣyati | tatrobhayorapi nityatvena īśvarasyātiśayābhāvātkiṃ tatpūjayetyatroktamavināśīti | tatrāpi kasyacidavināśitvamevocyate, na jīvādīśvarasyātiśayaḥ | tajjñāpakāśravaṇādityata āha || yadyapīti || iti jīvādīśvarasyātiśayaṃ tuśabdo jñāpayatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: evam yuddha akaraṇe kāraṇa abhāvam uktvā tat kartavyam tat ca bhagavat pūjā tvena kāryam iti vakṣyati tatra ubhayoḥ api nitya tvena īśvarasya atiśaya abhāvāt kim tat pūjayā iti atra uktam avināśi iti tatra api kasyacid avināśi tvam eva ucyate na jīvāt īśvarasya atiśayaḥ tad jñāpaka aśravaṇāt iti atas āha yadi api iti iti jīvāt īśvarasya atiśayam tuśabdaḥ jñāpayati iti arthaḥ

original: nāśasyānekavidhatvaṃ katham? kutaśceśvarasya tadabhāva ityata āha || anityatvamiti || anityatvaṃ svarūpanāśaḥ | atra viṣṇuvācakābhāvātkathamucyate viṣṇorityato yena sarvamidaṃ tatamityetadeva tadvācakamiti bhāvenaitacchrutyaiva vyācaṣṭe || deśata iti || 17 ||
analyzed: nāśasya anekavidha tvam katham kutas ca īśvarasya tad abhāvaḥ iti atas āha anitya tvam iti anitya tvam svarūpa nāśaḥ atra viṣṇu vācaka abhāvāt katham ucyate viṣṇoḥ iti atas yena sarvam idam tatam iti etat eva tad vācakam iti bhāvena etat śrutyā eva vyācaṣṭe deśataḥ iti

original: astu hareḥ sarvaprakāreṇāvināśitvam | tathāpi kathaṃ tasya jīvādatiśaya ityāśaṅ‌kāparihārāyacyata antavanta iti | tatraikasya śarīriṇo dehanāśamātramucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāya vyācaṣṭe || śarīriṇāmiti || īśvaraḥ sarvaprakāreṇāvināśī | śarīriṇāṃ tu nityatvamātramevāsti | na tu sarvaprakāreṇāvināśitvam | dehahānyādisadbhāvāt |
analyzed: astu hareḥ sarva prakāreṇa avināśi tvam tathā api katham tasya jīvāt atiśayaḥ iti āśaṅkā parihārāya acyata antavantaḥ iti tatra ekasya śarīriṇaḥ deha nāśa mātram ucyate iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya vyācaṣṭe śarīriṇām iti īśvaraḥ sarva prakāreṇa avināśī śarīriṇām tu nitya tva mātram eva asti na tu sarva prakāreṇa avināśi tvam deha hāni ādi sadbhāvāt

original: ato'sti jīvādīśvarasyātiśaya iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: atas sti jīvāt īśvarasya atiśayaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: astvavināśīti śloke bhagavadvācakasadbhāvaḥ | tathāpi yena sarvamidaṃ tataṃ tadavināśīti vyāptirūpeṇokteḥ kathaṃ viṣṇorevetyadhāryata ityata āha || yeneti || yadyapi vyāptirūpeṇedamucyate | tathāpi sarvatatatvasya viṣṇulakṣaṇatvena tatraiva paryavasānādyuktamavadhāraṇamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: astu avināśi iti śloke bhagavat vācaka sadbhāvaḥ tathā api yena sarvam idam tatam tat avināśi iti vyāpti rūpeṇa ukteḥ katham viṣṇoḥ eva iti adhāryataḥ iti atas āha yena iti yadi api vyāpti rūpeṇa idam ucyate tathā api sarva tata tvasya viṣṇu lakṣaṇa tvena tatra eva paryavasānāt yuktam avadhāraṇam iti bhāvaḥ

original: kathamidamīśvarasya lakṣaṇam ? jīvānāmapi kālatastatatvena tatrātivyāpterityata āha || neti|| na kevalamātra kālatastatirucyate1 | api tu deśato guṇataśca | na ca sā jīvānāmastīti bhāvaḥ | atra jīvasya pratipādyatāniṣedhaparaṃ bhāṣyamamukhyārthaparaṃ cānumatamiti na tadvirodhaḥ | tatra jīvebhyo'pi taterādhikyāt | na tvevāhamiti punarukteśceti |
analyzed: katham idam īśvarasya lakṣaṇam jīvānām api kālataḥ tata tvena tatra ativyāpteḥ iti atas āha na iti na kevalam ātra kālataḥ tatiḥ ucyate api tu deśataḥ guṇataḥ ca na ca sā jīvānām asti iti bhāvaḥ atra jīvasya pratipādya tā niṣedha param bhāṣyam amukhya artha param ca anumatam iti na tad virodhaḥ tatra jīvebhyaḥ api tateḥ ādhikyāt na tu eva aham iti punarukteḥ ca iti

original: nanvantavanta ityatra jīvasya dehahānirevocyate | na tu nāśāntaram | ataḥ kathamādipadaprakṣepeṇa vyākhyānamityata āha || anicchayeti || satyaṃ dehahānirevātrokteti | tathāpi duḥkhaprāptihānyoraniṣṭatvena tadvato duḥkhaprāptiniyamāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: nanu antavantaḥ iti atra jīvasya deha hāniḥ eva ucyate na tu nāśa antaram atas katham ādi pada prakṣepeṇa vyākhyānam iti atas āha anicchayā iti satyam deha hāniḥ eva atra uktā iti tathā api duḥkha prāpti hānyoḥ aniṣṭa tvena tadvataḥ duḥkha prāpti niyamāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: astvevaṃ jīvādīśvarasyātiśayaḥ | tataḥ ca kimityāśaṃkāparihārāyottarārdhaṃ vyācaṣṭe || tasmāditi || sarvaprakāreṇāvināśitvena sātiśayatvādityarthaḥ | sātiśayatve'pi kutastatpūjā kāryetyata āha || taditi || na kvalaṃ sarvaprakāreṇāvināśitvāttatpūjā'tra kartavyetyucyate | api tu rasvaprakāreṇāvināśitvātsa eva svatantraḥ |
analyzed: astu evam jīvāt īśvarasya atiśayaḥ tatas ca kim iti āśaṃkā parihārāya uttara ardham vyācaṣṭe tasmāt iti sarva prakāreṇa avināśi tvena sātiśaya tvāt iti arthaḥ sātiśaya tve pi kutas tad pūjā kāryā iti atas āha tat iti na kvalam sarva prakāreṇa avināśi tvāt tad pūjā atra kartavyā iti ucyate api tu saḥ eva svatantraḥ

original: tataśca tadadhīnatvaṃ mukteḥ | yuddhādisvakarmaṇā''rādhitaśceśvaro mokṣaṃ dadāti | atastatpūjā kartavyetyevābhipretamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tatas ca tad adhīna tvam mukteḥ yuddha ādi sva karmaṇā ārādhitaḥ ca īśvaraḥ mokṣam dadāti atas tad pūjā kartavyā iti eva abhipretam iti bhāvaḥ

original: astvīśvarasya sātiśayatvānmokṣapradānaśaktiḥ | tathāpi svakarmaṇā''rādhito harirmokṣaṃ dadātītyetadgītābhimatamityetatkutaḥ | mukterjñānabhaktisādhyatāyā gītābhimatatvādityata āha || ye tviti || kevalakarmaṇā mokṣasiddheḥ gītānabhimatatve'pi bhaktijñānasahitena sābhimataiva | "ye tu sarvāṇi" iti tathoktatvāt |
analyzed: astu īśvarasya sātiśaya tvāt mokṣa pradāna śaktiḥ tathā api sva karmaṇā ārādhitaḥ hariḥ mokṣam dadāti iti etat gīta abhimatam iti etat kutas mukteḥ jñāna bhakti sādhya tāyāḥ gīta abhimata tvāt iti atas āha ye tu iti kevala karmaṇā mokṣa siddheḥ gīta anabhimata tve pi bhakti jñāna sahitena sā abhimatā eva ye tu sarvāṇi iti tathā ukta tvāt

original: tādṛśaṃ ca karmātrābhipretamiti bhāvaḥ | "matparā" ityanena bhagavajjñānamucyate | ananyayogaḥ ananyabhaktiḥ |
analyzed: tādṛśam ca karma atra abhipretam iti bhāvaḥ mad parāḥ iti anena bhagavat jñānam ucyate ananya yogaḥ ananya bhaktiḥ

original: "anāśino'prameyasya" iti prakṛtaśarīriviṣayaṃ kiṃ na syādityata āha || jīveti || jīvapakṣe'nāśino'prameyasyetyatra jīvo vācya iti pakṣe | īśvaragrahaṇapakṣe sphuṭamarthabhedasambhavāt tadvihāya kathañcidarthabhedakathanaṃ na yuktamityatrocyate | bhāṣye tu mukhyārthe siddhe gauṇamapyarthāntaramucyata ityavirodhaḥ |
analyzed: anāśinā uprameyasya iti prakṛta śarīri viṣayam kim na syāt iti atas āha jīva iti jīva pakṣena āśinā uprameyasya iti atra jīvaḥ vācyaḥ iti pakṣe īśvara grahaṇa pakṣe sphuṭam artha bheda sambhavāt tat vihāya kathañcid artha bheda kathanam na yuktam iti atra ucyate bhāṣye tu mukhya arthe siddhe gauṇam api artha antaram ucyate iti avirodhaḥ

original: na kevalaṃ jīvapakṣe punarukterīśvaraparatvaṃ1 api tu tajjñāpakasadbhāvāccetyāha || avināśīti || avināśītyatra bhagavatā tāvadīśvara eva pratipādya iti samarthitam | yaduktamavināśitvaṃ tadevātra pratyabhijñāyate anāśina iti | yadapi sarvatatatvamuktaṃ tadevāprameyasyeti pratyabhijñāyate | ato'pyatreśvara evocyata iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: na kevalam jīva pakṣe punarukteḥ īśvara paratvam api tu tad jñāpaka sadbhāvāt ca iti āha avināśi iti avināśi iti atra bhagavatā tāvat īśvaraḥ eva pratipādyaḥ iti samarthitam yat uktam avināśi tvam tat eva atra pratyabhijñāyate anāśinaḥ iti yat api sarva tata tvam uktam tat eva aprameyasya iti pratyabhijñāyate atas upi atra īśvaraḥ eva ucyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: jīvasya dehahānisadbhāvādīśvaradehasya nityatvādīśvarasya jīvādatiśaya iti yadvyākhyānaṃ na tadgītā'bhimataṃ bhavitumarhati | dehasyānityatvaniyamādityato gītāyāmeva iti viśeṣaṇānmuktadehasyāpi nityatvamanujñāyate | kimu hareḥ | anyathā tadviśeṣaṇavaiyarthyāt | ato yuktameva vyākhyānamiti bhāvenāha || ima iti ||
analyzed: jīvasya deha hāni sadbhāvāt īśvara dehasya nitya tvāt īśvarasya jīvāt atiśayaḥ iti yat vyākhyānam na tat gītā abhimatam bhavitum arhati dehasya anitya tva niyamāt iti atas gītāyām eva iti viśeṣaṇāt mukta dehasya api nitya tvam anujñāyate kimu hareḥ anyathā tad viśeṣaṇa vaiyarthyāt atas yuktam eva vyākhyānam iti bhāvena āha ime iti

original: nanu muktadehasyāpi kathaṃ nityatvam? dehasyāntyatvaniyamādityata āha || ciditi || jaḍaśarīratvamevānityatve prayojakam | tacca muktadehasya cidānandātmakatvena tato vyāvartamānamanityatvamapi vyāvartayatīti bhāvaḥ | cidānandātmakatvaṃ dehasya kathamityata āha || svarūpeti || svarūpaṃ1 cidānandātmakamiti bhāvaḥ | muktānāṃ deha eva nāsti |
analyzed: nanu mukta dehasya api katham nitya tvam dehasya antya tva niyamāt iti atas āha cit iti jaḍa śarīra tvam eva anitya tve prayojakam tat ca mukta dehasya cidānanda ātmaka tvena tatas vyāvartamānam anitya tvam api vyāvartayati iti bhāvaḥ cidānanda ātmaka tvam dehasya katham iti atas āha svarūpa iti sva rūpam cidānanda ātmakam iti bhāvaḥ muktānām dehaḥ eva na asti

original: "aśarīraṃ vāva santam" ityāderityato āha || ciditi || jaḍadehābhāvaparāśrutiriti bhāvaḥ | bhinnadehābhāvaparā ceti bhāvenāha || svarūpeti ||
analyzed: aśarīram vāva santam ityādeḥ iti atas āha cit iti jaḍa deha abhāva parā śrutiḥ iti bhāvaḥ bhinna deha abhāva parā ca iti bhāvena āha svarūpa iti

original: nanu muktānāṃ nityācidānandātmakadehasadbhāva eva kuta ityata āha || na vartata iti || apare doṣāḥ | supeśasaḥ surūpāḥ | unmiṣanmaṇipraveśaniṣkābharaṇāḥ sphuradratnapravarahārābharaṇaāḥ | suvarcasaḥ sukāntimantaḥ | atra jaḍābhāvamuktvā teṣāṃ śarīrokterarthāccidānandātmakadehavattvaṃ jñāyate |
analyzed: nanu muktānām nitya acit ānanda ātmaka deha sadbhāvaḥ eva kutas iti atas āha na vartate iti apare doṣāḥ supeśasaḥ surūpāḥ unmiṣat maṇi praveśa niṣka ābharaṇāḥ sphurat ratna pravara hāra ābharaṇāḥ suvarcasaḥ su kāntimantaḥ atra jaḍa abhāvam uktvā teṣām śarīra ukteḥ arthāt cidānanda ātmaka dehavattvam jñāyate

original: nanvetāni vākyāni gauṇamokṣaparāṇyeva mukhyamuktau jīveśvasayoraikyenaitadanupapatterityata āha || na ceti || kuto netyato mukhyamokṣānantaramapi bhedasiya śrutismṛtisiddhatvādityāha || idamiti || atrāpunarāvṛttiśravaṇānmukhyamokṣatvaṃ jñāyate |
analyzed: nanu etāni vākyāni gauṇa mokṣa parāṇi eva mukhya muktau jīva īśvasayoḥ aikyena etad anupapatteḥ iti atas āha na ca iti kutas na iti atas mukhya mokṣa anantaram api śruti smṛti siddha tvāt iti āha idam iti atra apunarāvṛtti śravaṇāt mukhya mokṣa tvam jñāyate

original: na kevalaṃ muktānāmīśvarādbhinnatayā vyathādyabhāvamātramapi tu bhinnatayaiva paramānandanubhavo'pyastīti bhāvenāha || yo vedeti || etadvākyayoḥ parabrahmaprakaraṇagatatvānmukhyamokṣaparatvam | anyonyaṃ sakhāyaste sarve muktāḥ | svavagatena yaśorūpeṇa brahmādisabhāṃ sahamāneneśvareṇa nimittena nandati |
analyzed: na kevalam muktānām īśvarāt bhinnatayā vyathā ādi abhāva mātram api tu bhinnatayā eva paramānanda anubhavaḥ api asti iti bhāvena āha yaḥ veda iti etad vākyayoḥ para brahma prakaraṇa gata tvāt mukhya mokṣa paratvam anyonyam sakhāyaḥ te sarve muktāḥ svavagatena yaśaḥ rūpeṇa brahma ādi sabhām sahamānena īśvareṇa nimittena nandati

original: katham? yato'sau eṣāmaniṣṭaspardhī divyānnadātā sannindriyāya hito bhavatītyarthaḥ | atrāpyaniṣṭābhāvaśrayaṇānmukhyamokṣaviṣayatvam |
analyzed: katham yatas asau eṣām aniṣṭa spardhī divya anna dātā san indriyāya hitaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ atra api aniṣṭa abhāva śrayaṇāt mukhya mokṣa viṣaya tvam

original: kaścidbrahmā ṛcāṃ samyaguccāraṇaṃ kurvannāste | svayaṃ cātipuṣṭimān kaścidbrahmā śakkarīṣu chandomatīṣu ṛkṣu gāyatraṃ sāma gāyati | kaścidbrahmā purāṇavidyāṃ vadati | kaścidbrahmā | viṣṇormūrti dhyāyatītyarthaḥ | asya ca
analyzed: kaścid brahmā ṛcām samyak uccāraṇam kurvan āste svayam ca ati puṣṭimān kaścid brahmā śakkarīṣu chandomatīṣu ṛkṣu gāyatram sāma gāyati kaścid brahmā purāṇa vidyām vadati kaścid brahmā viṣṇoḥ mūrti dhyāyati iti arthaḥ asya ca

original: brahmabāhulyapratipādakatvānmukhyamokṣaviṣayatvam | jakṣan bhakṣayan hasaṃśca ramamāṇo ratiṃ prāpnuvan |
analyzed: brahma bāhulya pratipādaka tvāt mukhya mokṣa viṣaya tvam jakṣan bhakṣayan hasan ca ramamāṇaḥ ratim prāpnuvan

original: paramasāmyaṃ nāma yogyānandapūrvatvameva | na uta sarvanāmyamiti bhāvena muktatāratamye ca mānamāha || muktā iti || devā devagandharvāḥ | tattvarūpāḥ tattvābhimānino bṛhaspatyādayaḥ | uktebhyo'nye ye manuṣyottamāste bhūpācchatāṃśonā ityarthaḥ | tāratamyasadbhāve parasparaṃ virodhaḥ syādityata āha || akṣaṇvanta iti ||
analyzed: paramasāmyam nāma yogi ānanda pūrvatvam eva na uta sarvanāmyam iti bhāvena mukta tāratamye ca mānam āha muktāḥ iti devāḥ deva gandharvāḥ tattva rūpāḥ tattva abhimāninaḥ bṛhaspati ādayaḥ uktebhyaḥ nye ye manuṣya uttamāḥ te bhūpāt śatāṃśa ūnāḥ iti arthaḥ tāratamya sadbhāve parasparam virodhaḥ syāt iti atas āha akṣaṇvantaḥ iti

original: prāptākṣikarṇaphalāḥ parasparavirodhaśūnyā muktāḥ jñānādiguṇeṣvasamā babhūvuḥ | tatra kecitkṣīrasāgaramagnāḥ | tecidaśvatthavanamupavartamānāḥ | kecitsnātavyahṛdā iva gambhīrā bhagavantaṃ dadṛśurityarthaḥ | idaṃ vākyaṃ "śrutvā viṣṇuṃ" ityāgamena mukhyamuktiviṣayatayā vyākhyātam | ata eva ṛcāṃ tva ityasya ṛtvigviṣayatvavarṇanaṃ parāstam |
analyzed: prāpta akṣi karṇa phalāḥ paraspara virodha śūnyāḥ muktāḥ jñāna ādi guṇeṣu asamāḥ babhūvuḥ tatra kecid kṣīrasāgara magnāḥ te cit aśvattha vanam upavartamānāḥ kecid snātavya hṛdāḥ iva gambhīrāḥ bhagavantam dadṛśuḥ iti arthaḥ idam vākyam śrutvā viṣṇum iti āgamena mukhya mukti viṣaya tayā vyākhyātam atas eva ṛcām tvaḥ iti asya ṛtvij viṣaya tva varṇanam parāstam

original: evamajñātasyāpi jagato jñānādinā phalaṃ kiṃ na syādityataḥ kā phalapratyāśā pratyutānartha eva bhavatītyāha || svātantryeṇeti || uktarītyā bhagavajjñānādyabhāve jagataḥ svātantryeṇaiva jñānādi prāpyate | tacca mithyājñānatvādanarthakṛdityarthaḥ |
analyzed: evam ajñātasya api jagataḥ jñāna ādinā phalam kim na syāt iti atas kā phala pratyāśā pratyuta anarthaḥ eva bhavati iti āha svātantryeṇa iti ukta rītyā bhagavat jñāna ādi abhāve jagataḥ svātantryeṇa eva jñāna ādi prāpyate tat ca mithyājñāna tvāt anartha kṛt iti arthaḥ

original: sādṛśyādebhagavajjñānādau satyanyajjñātādivadbhavatītyatroktaṃ "yathā somyekena mṛtpiṇḍena sarvaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ vijñātaṃ syāt" iti dṛṣṭāntaṃ vyācaṣṭe || yathā ceti || jñātaṃ jñātādi |

original: prādhānyādbhagavajjñānādimātreṇājñātāderapyanyasya jñānādiphalaṃ bhavati, bhagavajjñānādau satyeva jñātasyāpyanyasya jñānādeḥ phalaṃ bhavatītyubhayatroktaṃ "vācārambhaṇaṃ vikāro nāmadheyaṃ mṛttiketyeva satyam" iti dṛṣṭāntaṃ vyācaṣṭe || yatheti || yasmātsāṃketikanāmadheyasya vācā''rambhaṇaṃ kriyate atastadvikāro'ta evāpradhānam |
analyzed: prādhānyāt bhagavat jñāna ādi mātreṇa ajñāta ādeḥ api anyasya jñāna ādi phalam bhavati bhagavat jñāna ādau sati eva jñātasya api anyasya jñāna ādeḥ phalam bhavati iti ubhayatra uktam vācā ārambhaṇam vikāraḥ nāmadheyam mṛttikā iti eva satyam iti dṛṣṭāntam vyācaṣṭe yathā iti yasmāt sāṃketika nāmadheyasya vācā ārambhaṇam kriyate atas tad vikāra ūtaḥ eva apradhānam

original: mṛttiketyādisaṃskṛtajñānamātreṇa sāṃketikājñānādāvapi tatphalaṃ vidvāniti vyavahāraviṣayatvādikaṃ bhavati | saṃskṛtanāmajñāna eva ca sāṃketikānāmajñānaṃ saphalaṃ bhavati | tanmātreṇa vidvāniti vyavahāraviṣayatvādyabhāvādityarthaḥ || tanmūlamiti || tatpradhānakatvādityarthaḥ |

original: "evaṃ somya sa ādeśo bhavati" iti dārṣṭāntikavākyaṃ vyācaṣṭe || evamiti|| pradhāno'tastajjñānādinoktaprakāradvayenānyajñānādisāphalyaṃ bhavatīti śeṣaḥ | evaṃ sadṛśaśceti draṣṭavyam | prādhānyameveśvarasya kuta ityataḥ sadeva somyetyādinā svātantryeṇa jagatkāraṇatvamuktam | tadevāha || svatantraḥ kāraṇabhūta iti ||
analyzed: evam somya saḥ ādeśaḥ bhavati iti dārṣṭāntika vākyam vyācaṣṭe evam iti pradhāna utas tad jñāna ādinā ukta prakāra dvayena anya jñāna ādi sāphalyam bhavati iti śeṣaḥ evam sadṛśaḥ ca iti draṣṭavyam prādhānyam eva īśvarasya kutas iti atas sat eva somya ityādinā svātantryeṇa jagat kāraṇatvam uktam tat eva āha svatantraḥ kāraṇa bhūtaḥ iti

original: īśvaro'hamiti bhāvākaraṇe hetutayeśvaramāhātmyamuktam | māhātmyāntaraṃ cocyate -- "sanmūlāḥ somyemāḥ sarvāḥ prajāḥ sadāyatanāḥ satpratiṣṭhāḥ" iti | tadarthamāha || tanmūlamiti || māhātmyānramuktvā abhedabuddhiṃ mā kurvityucyate -- "sa eṣo'ṇimaitadātmyamidaṃ sarvaṃ tatsatyaṃ sa ātmā tattvamasi śvetaketo"iti | tadvyācaṣṭe || sa iti ||

original: jīveśvarabhede "sa yathā śakuniḥ" ityādinoktadṛṣṭāntavākyāni vyācaṣṭe || yatheti || yadapi "jīvenātmanā'nupraviśya nāmarūpe vyākaravāṇi" iti, "sa eṣa jīvenātmanā'nuprabhūtaḥ" iti jīveśābhedābhidhāyakavatpratīyamānaṃ vākyadvayaṃ tat "ityādiśrutivirodha" ityādipadagṛhītaṃ vyākhyāyate || na iti || "jīvāpetaṃ vāva kiledaṃ mriyate |

original: ito'pi niṣedhāya tadaikṣatetyādau prapañco'nūdyata iti na yujyate | "yadidaṃ vadanti tanna yujyate" iti vākyena, niṣedhe viśeṣayuktyā ca hīnatvāt | tadvinā'nuvādasya kvāpyadṛṣṭatvādityāha || anuvādo'pīti || tādṛśavākyādyabhāve'pi niṣedhāyātrānuvādaḥ prapañcasyetyaṅgīkāre ko doṣa iti cet adṛṣṭakalpanetyekaṃ dūṣaṇam | aparaṃ cāha ||

original: atiprasaṅgaśceti || kathamityata āha || abhedeti || anyatheti sambadhyate | yadyetādṛśavākyādyabhāve'pyaitadātmyamityādau niṣeddhuṃ tadaikṣatetyādinā paramātmātiriktatayā prapañco'nūdyata iti kalpyate tarhi tadaikṣatetyādau prapañcasya paramātmātirekeṇābhāvaṃ niṣidhyātiriktatvena bhāvaṃ vidhātumaitadātmyamityādinā prapañcasya

original: paramātmātirekeṇābhāvo'nūdyata ityapi syādaviśeṣādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: paramātma atirekeṇa abhāvaḥ unūdyate iti api syāt aviśeṣāt iti arthaḥ

original: itaśca niṣedhāyāyaṃ prapañcasya paramātmātiriktatayā sadbhāvānuvādo na bhavatītyetadeva yuktamityāha || sarveti || anuvādo bhavan śākhādāveva bhavet | tadante tu niṣedhaḥ | na cātra tadasti | bhedasyaiva śākhānteṣūktatvāt | ato'pi na bhedasya niṣedhāya śrutāvanuvāda ityarthaḥ | śākhānteṣu kāstā bhedoktaya ityata āha || neti ||

original: yaduktamabhedānuvādena bhedopadeśaḥ syāditi na tadyujyate | abhedasya śrutiṃ vinā'prāptatvāt | kiṃ nāmeśeśitavyādiprapañcasya paramātmabhinnatayā'nuvādena tanniṣedha eva yuktaḥ | īśeśitavyādiprapañcasya paramātmabhinnatāyāḥ pratyakṣādipraptatvādityata āha || na ceti || atreśvarapadena paramātmocyate |

original: paramātmana eva pratyakṣādyasiddhatvena tatpratiyogikeśeśitavyādiprapañcasya bhedaḥ sutarāṃ pratyakṣādinā gṛhyata iti tanna | tathāsati prapañcabhinnatayā śrutāvapi paramātmanirūpaṇaprasaṅgāt | anyathā pratyakṣādinā'pi tadbhedasya viṣayīkartumaśkyatvāt | tathā conmattavākyameveti bhāvaḥ |

original: īśvarasyaiva pratyakṣādinā'siddherīśeśitavyasya ca tadākāreṇāsiddheḥ paramātmanaḥ sakāśādīśvarādirūpaprapañcasya bhedaḥ sutarāṃ tenāsiddha iti vā |
analyzed: īśvarasya eva pratyakṣa ādinā asiddheḥ īśa īśitavyasya ca tad ākāreṇa asiddheḥ paramātmanaḥ sakāśāt īśvara ādi rūpa prapañcasya bhedaḥ sutarām tena asiddhaḥ iti vā

original: ito'pi na paramātmātiriktaprapañcaniṣedho yujyata ityata āha || tatpakṣa iti || yadi paramātmātiriktaḥ sarvo'pi prapañco mithyā syāt tadā sarvaśrutīnāṃ vaiyarthyaṃ syāt | tathāhi | "ekamevādvitīyam" "yaḥ sarvajñaḥ" ityādiśrutiraikyādidharmapratipādikā uta ātmāsvarūpapratipādikā | ādye'pyaikyasārvajñādidharmāḥ kiṃ svarūpātiriktāḥ svarūpaṃ vā |
analyzed: itas api na paramātma atirikta prapañca niṣedhaḥ yujyate iti atas āha tad pakṣe iti yadi paramātma atiriktaḥ sarvaḥ api prapañcaḥ mithyā syāt tadā sarva śrutīnām vaiyarthyam syāt tathā hi ekam eva advitīyam yaḥ sarvajñaḥ ityādi śrutiḥ aikya ādi dharma pratipādikā uta ātma asvarūpa pratipādikā ādye api aikya sārvajña ādi dharmāḥ kim svarūpa atiriktāḥ svarūpam vā

original: nādyaḥ | tathātve mithyātvāpātāt | dvitīyastu tṛtīyo'ntarbhavati | nāpyasau yuktaḥ | svarūpasya svataḥ siddhatvena pratipādanabaiyarthyāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: na ādyaḥ tathātve mithyātva āpātāt dvitīyaḥ tu tṛtīyaḥ ntarbhavati nā api asau yuktaḥ svarūpasya svatas siddha tvena pratipādana baiyarthyāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: śuddhasvarūpasyāpratipādyatve'pi bhedābhāvasārvajñādyupalakṣitasvarūpasya pratipādyaratvānna śrutivaiyarthyamityata āha || lakṣiteti || lakṣitasyāpi śuddhādviśeṣābhāvena tadvadasyāpyapratipādyatvānna tatpratipādakatvaṃ śruteryuktamityarthaḥ | kutaḥ śuddhādviśeṣābhāvo lakṣitasyetyata āha || nirviśeṣatveti ||
analyzed: śuddha svarūpasya apratipādya tve api bheda abhāva sārvajña ādi upalakṣita svarūpasya na śruti vaiyarthyam iti atas āha lakṣita iti lakṣitasya api śuddhāt viśeṣa abhāvena tadvat asya api apratipādya tvāt na tad pratipādaka tvam śruteḥ yuktam iti arthaḥ kutas śuddhāt viśeṣa abhāvaḥ lakṣitasya iti atas āha nirviśeṣa tva iti

original: lakṣitamiti yadoktaṃ tadaiva tasya nirviśeṣatvamapyuktameva | anyathā viśiṣṭatvāpattyā mithyātvāpātāt | atastasya na śuddhādviśeṣa iti bhāvaḥ | nanu bhavatu dharmāṇāṃ mithyātvam | tathāpi śrutestatpratipādakatve ko doṣa ityata āha || mithyeti ||
analyzed: lakṣitam iti yadā uktam tadā eva tasya nirviśeṣa tvam api uktam eva anyathā viśiṣṭa tva āpattyā mithyātva āpātāt atas tasya na śuddhāt viśeṣaḥ iti bhāvaḥ nanu bhavatu dharmāṇām mithyātvam tathā api śruteḥ tad pratipādaka tve kaḥ doṣaḥ iti atas āha mithyā iti

original: ito'pi nā'tmātiriktasya sarvasya mithyātvaṃ yuktamityāha || mithyātvamiti || ātmātiriktasya sarvasya mithyātve tanmithyātvaṃ
analyzed: itas api na ātma atiriktasya sarvasya mithyātvam yuktam iti āha mithyātvam iti ātma atiriktasya sarvasya mithyātve tat mithyātvam

original: satyaṃ mithyā vā | nādyaḥ | ātmātiriktaṃ sarvaṃ mithyeti pakṣakṣateḥ | ato mithyetyevāṅgīkāryamiti bhāvaḥ | kimato yadyevamityata āha || ata iti || itaśca nātmaviśeṣāṇāṃ mithyātvamiti vā''ha || mithyeti ||
analyzed: satyam mithyā vā na ādyaḥ ātma atiriktam sarvam mithyā iti pakṣa kṣateḥ atas mithyā iti eva aṅgīkāryam iti bhāvaḥ kim atas yadi evam iti atas āha atas iti itas ca na ātma viśeṣāṇām mithyātvam iti vā āha mithyā iti

original: na sārvajñādiviśeṣā asanto yena śruteraprāmāṇyaṃ syāt | nāpi śuddhaṃ lakṣyaṃ jñānasvarūpaṃ śrutivedyamityucyate | yenoktadoṣaḥ syāt | kiṃ nāmaikasminnevātmani upādhibhedabhinnetannimittasārvajñādiviśeṣāśca bhavanti | tadupādhibhedabhinnamaupādhikaviśeṣaviśiṣṭasvarūpaṃ śrutipratipādyamiti cet, kimasāvupādhiḥ mithyā satyo vā || ādye doṣamāha ||
analyzed: na sārvajña ādi viśeṣāḥ asantaḥ yena śruteḥ aprāmāṇyam syāt na api śuddham lakṣyam jñāna svarūpam śruti vedyam iti ucyate yena ukta doṣaḥ syāt kim nāma ekasmin eva ātmani upādhi bheda bhinna itad nimitta sārvajña ādi viśeṣāḥ ca bhavanti tad upādhi bheda bhinnam aupādhika viśeṣa viśiṣṭa svarūpam śruti pratipādyam iti ced kim asau upādhiḥ mithyā satyaḥ vā ādye doṣam āha

original: upādhīti || upādhikṛta evātmani bhedo viśeṣāścetyaṅgīkṛtyopādhermithyātvāṅgīkāre tadbhinnasvarūpasya tannimittaviśeṣāṇāṃ ca mithyātvaṃ syāt | tathāca tadabhidhāyakaśruteraprāmāṇyaṃ syāt |
analyzed: upādhi iti upādhi kṛtaḥ eva ātmani bhedaḥ viśeṣāḥ ca iti aṅgīkṛtya upādheḥ mithyātva aṅgīkāre tad bhinna svarūpasya tad nimitta viśeṣāṇām ca mithyātvam syāt tathā ca tad abhidhāyaka śruteḥ aprāmāṇyam syāt

original: neha nānetyādau niṣedhāya mithyābhūtamapi taducyate śrutāviti cettarhi svayameva mithyābhūtamupādhibhedabhinnasvarūpaṃ tannimittaviśeṣāṃśca vidhāya punastanniṣedhe śruterunmattavākyatvameva syāt | niṣedhāya tadanūdyata iti cenna | upādhibhedabhinnasvarūpasya tannimittaviśeṣāṇāṃ ca pratyakṣādyaprāptatvenānuvādānupapatteriti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: na iha nānā ityādau niṣedhāya mithyābhūtam api tat ucyate śrutau iti ced tarhi svayam eva mithyābhūtam upādhi bheda bhinna svarūpam tad nimitta viśeṣān ca vidhāya punar tad niṣedhe śruteḥ unmatta vākya tvam eva syāt niṣedhāya tat anūdyate iti ced na upādhi bheda bhinna svarūpasya tad nimitta viśeṣāṇām ca pratyakṣa ādi aprāpta tvena anuvāda anupapatteḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: dvitīyaṃ dūṣayati | satyeti || yadyapyatrāpasiddhānto vaktuṃ śakyaḥ | tathāpi tasyātisphuṭatvena doṣāntaramevoktam | brahmātiriktasya satyatvamaṅgīkṛtyāpi brahmaṇyupādhibhedamaṅgīkurvatāṃ dūṣaṇāya ca | ādipadenopādherapyekadeśasambandha ityādivakṣyamāṇasaṅgrahaḥ | satyopādhipakṣe'pi doṣāḥ samā ityanena mithyopādhipakṣe'pyeti bhavantīti sūcayati |
analyzed: dvitīyam dūṣayati satya iti yadi api atra apasiddhāntaḥ vaktum śakyaḥ tathā api tasya ati sphuṭa tvena doṣa antaram eva uktam brahma atiriktasya satya tvam aṅgīkṛtya api brahmaṇi upādhi bhedam aṅgīkurvatām dūṣaṇāya ca ādi padena upādheḥ api eka deśa sambandhaḥ ityādi vakṣyamāṇa saṅgrahaḥ satya upādhi pakṣe api doṣāḥ samāḥ iti anena mithyā upādhi pakṣe pya iti bhavanti iti sūcayati

original: nanvekatve'pyākāśasya tathā mahānasākāśagadadhūmānubhavastasyaiva na sarvākāśasyopādhibhedāt | tathā'trāpi syādityata āha || acetanānāmiti || kiṃ mahānasākāśasambandhavattve'pi dhūmasya sarvākāśasambandhābhāvavadduḥkhāśrayatvābhāvo'stvityucyate uta tadanubhāvabhāvavadanubhāvabhāvaḥ | nādyaḥ | asmākamaniṣṭābhāvāt | na dvitīyaḥ |
analyzed: nanu ekatve pi ākāśasya tathā mahānasa ākāśa gada dhūma anubhavaḥ tasya eva na sarva ākāśasya upādhi bhedāt tathā atra api syāt iti atas āha acetanānām iti kim mahānasa ākāśa sambandhavat tve pi dhūmasya sarva ākāśa sambandha abhāvavat duḥkha āśraya tva abhāvaḥ ustu iti ucyate uta tad anubhāva bhāva vat anubhāva bhāvaḥ na ādyaḥ asmākam aniṣṭa abhāvāt na dvitīyaḥ

original: ākāśasyācetanatvena anubhavaprāpterevābhāvena dṛṣṭāntavaiṣamyāditi bhāvaḥ | ayaṃ cābhyupagamavādaḥ | ākāśasyāntarbhedavattvāt | upasaṃharati || ata iti || 18 ||
analyzed: ākāśasya acetana tvena anubhava prāpteḥ eva abhāvena dṛṣṭānta vaiṣamyāt iti bhāvaḥ ayam ca abhyupagama vādaḥ ākāśasya antar bhedavat tvāt upasaṃharati atas iti

original: yaduktaṃ sarvaprakāreṇāvināśitvādīśvaraḥ svatantra iti | tadayuktam | "ayamasya dehaviyogakartā", "anenāyaṃ dehādviyojitaḥ" iti jīvasyāpi svatantryapratīterityāśaṃkāparihārāyocyate "ya enamiti" | tatra jīvasya dehaviyogādau kathamapi kartṛtvaṃ nāstītyanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || ya enamiti ||
analyzed: yat uktam sarva prakāreṇa avināśi tvāt īśvaraḥ svatantraḥ iti tat ayuktam ayam asya deha viyoga kartā anena ayam dehāt viyojitaḥ iti jīvasya api svatantrya pratīteḥ iti āśaṃkā parihārāya ucyate yaḥ enam iti tatra jīvasya deha viyoga ādau katham api kartṛ tvam na asti iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya āha yaḥ enam iti

original: ya enaṃ jīvaṃ svātantryeṇa dehaviyogakartāraṃ paśyati, yaścainaṃ jīvaṃ jīvāntareṇa svātantryeṇa dehādviyojitaṃ paśyati tau na vijānīta ityevaṃ vyakhyāyam | na tu pāratantryeṇamāpi jīvasya hantṛtvādikaṃ paśyan na jānātītyarthaḥ | kuto'nyo'rtho na syādityata āha || anyatheti ||
analyzed: yaḥ enam jīvam svātantryeṇa deha viyoga kartāram paśyati yaḥ ca enam jīvam jīva antareṇa svātantryeṇa dehāt viyojitam paśyati tau na vijānītaḥ iti evam vyakhyāyam na tu jīvasya hantṛ tva ādikam paśyan na jānāti iti arthaḥ kutonyaḥ arthaḥ na syāt iti atas āha anyathā iti

original: jīvasya pāratantryeṇāpi hantṛtvābhāve "mayā hatāṃstvaṃ jahi" itīśvarādhīnatayā jīvasya hantṛtvoktivirodhaḥ syādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: jīvasya pāratantryeṇa api hantṛ tva abhāve mayā hatān tvam jahi iti īśvara adhīnatayā jīvasya hantṛ tva ukti virodhaḥ syāt iti arthaḥ

original: yaduktaṃ jīvo nitya iti na tadyuktam | "ayaṃ jīvasya hantā", "anenāyaṃ jīvo hataḥ" iti vyavahāreṇa cetanasyānityatvāvagamādityāśaṃkā parihārāyapyayameva ślokaḥ | tatra prathamapakṣe ya enamiti padaṃ jīvaviṣayatayā vyākhyātam | neśvaraviṣayatayā | tatra dehaviyogarūpahananasya vivakṣitatvāt | tatra jīvasyaiva svātantryābhāvādīśvarasya tadbhāvāt |
analyzed: yat uktam jīvaḥ nityaḥ iti na tat yuktam ayam jīvasya hantā anena ayam jīvaḥ hataḥ iti vyavahāreṇa cetanasya anitya tva avagamāt iti āśaṃkā ślokaḥ tatra prathama pakṣe yaḥ enam iti padam jīva viṣayatayā vyākhyātam na īśvara viṣayatayā tatra deha viyoga rūpa hananasya vivakṣita tvāt tatra jīvasya eva svātantrya abhāvāt īśvarasya tad bhāvāt

original: asmin pakṣe tu "ya enaṃ cetanaṃ hantāraṃ paśyati sa na jānāti" iti cetanaṃ prati hananasya vivakṣitatvāt | cetanahananasya jīvavadīśvareṇāpyakaraṇāt enamiti padamubhayorapi vācakamityāha || cetanamiti || 19 ||
analyzed: asmin pakṣe tu yaḥ enam cetanam hantāram paśyati sa na jānāti iti cetanam prati hananasya vivakṣita tvāt cetana hananasya jīva vat īśvareṇa api akaraṇāt enam iti padam ubhayoḥ api vācakam iti āha cetanam iti

original: nanu jīvanityatvādeḥ pūrvamevoktatvātkimuttaraślokenetyata āha || jīveti || nedaṃ bhagavadvākyaṃ, yena punaruktiḥ syāti |
analyzed: nanu jīva nitya tva ādeḥ pūrvam eva ukta tvāt kim uttaraślokena iti atas āha jīva iti na idam bhagavat vākyam yena punaruktiḥ syāti

original: kintu yaduktaṃ svayaṃ jīveśvarayorutpattivināśarāhityam, īśvarasya śarīrato'pyutpattyādyabhāvena svātantryaṃ, jīvasya svarūpato janmādiśūnyasyāpi dehotpattyādinā'svātantryaṃ tatra pramāṇatvena mantravarṇo'yamudāhriyata iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: kintu yat uktam svayam jīva īśvarayoḥ utpatti vināśa rāhityam īśvarasya svātantryam jīvasya svarūpataḥ janma ādi śūnyasya api deha utpatti ādinā asvātantryam tatra pramāṇa tvena mantravarṇaḥ ūyam udāhriyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: atreśvarapratipādanāpratīteḥ kathametadityato nāyaṃ bhūtvetyatra dehato'pyutpattirāhityaśravaṇāttasya ceśvaraliṅgatvāt pūrvārdhastatpratipādaka iti bhāvenāha || ayamiti || etena vā śabdādeva pūrvatra naño'nukarṣasambhavāt kiṃ tadantareṇeti parāstam | api cātra "na mriyate" iti dehaviyogābhāvaśca śrūyate |
analyzed: atra īśvara pratipādana apratīteḥ katham etat iti atas na ayam bhūtvā iti atra dehataḥ upyutpatti rāhitya śravaṇāt tasya ca īśvara liṅgatvāt pūrva ardhaḥ tad pratipādakaḥ iti bhāvena āha ayam iti etena vā śabdāt eva pūrvatra nañaḥ anukarṣa sambhavāt kim tad antareṇa iti parāstam api ca atra na mriyate iti deha viyoga abhāvaḥ ca śrūyate

original: maraṇaśabdasya dehaviyoga eva prasiddhatvāddehaviyogābhāvasya ceśvaraliṅgatvāt tatpratipādakaḥ pūrvārdha iti bhāvenāha || maraṇamiti || dehaviyoga iva svarūpanāśe'pi maraṇaśabdasya prasiddhatvāt so'rthaḥ kiṃ na syādityataḥ svarūpanāśe maraṇaśabdasya prasiddhireva nāstītyāha || na hīti ||
analyzed: maraṇa śabdasya deha viyoge eva prasiddha tvāt deha viyoga abhāvasya ca īśvara liṅga tvāt tad pratipādakaḥ pūrva ardhaḥ iti bhāvena āha maraṇam iti deha viyoge iva svarūpa nāśe api maraṇa śabdasya prasiddha tvāt saḥ ṛthaḥ kim na syāt iti atas svarūpa nāśe maraṇa śabdasya prasiddhiḥ eva na asti iti āha na hi iti

original: yadi maraṇaśabdasya na svarūpanāśo'rthaḥ tarhi īśvarasvarūpānāśe nāyaṃ mantraḥ pramāṇaṃ syāt | tadabhidhāyakaśabdāntarābhāvāt | tathā ca maraṇaśabdasya svarūpanāśe'rthe grāhye naitadbalāt pūrvārdhasyeśvaraparatvasiddhirityata āha || svarūpeti || nātreśvarasya svarūpānāśo vaktavyaḥ | yenaitatpadasya tatparatvaṃ kalpyate |
analyzed: yadi maraṇa śabdasya na svarūpa nāśa ṛthaḥ tarhi īśvara svarūpa anāśe na ayam mantraḥ pramāṇam syāt tad abhidhāyaka śabda antara abhāvāt tathā ca maraṇa śabdasya svarūpa nāśa ṛthe grāhye na etad balāt pūrva ardhasya īśvara para tva siddhiḥ iti atas āha sva rūpa iti na atra īśvarasya svarūpa anāśaḥ vaktavyaḥ yena etad padasya tad para tvam kalpyate

original: yasya dehanāśopi nāsti tasya svarūpānāśaḥ kimu vācya iti kaimutyenaiva siddhetityarthaḥ |
analyzed: yasya deha nāśaḥ api nā asti tasya svarūpa anāśaḥ kimu vācyaḥ iti kaimutyena eva siddhā iti iti arthaḥ

original: atra jīvasyotpattyādyabhāvādikathanaṃ na śrūyata ityuttarārdhastadviṣaya iti bhāvenāha || ayamiti || atrāpīśvara eva pratipādyaḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha || anyatheti || "na jāyate " "ajaḥ" iti paunaruktyam | nanu punaruktibhayena pūrvottarārdhayorviṣayabhedakalpane śāśvatopyanya eva prasajyate | nityapadena punarukterityata āha || neti ||
analyzed: atra jīvasya utpatti ādi abhāva ādi kathanam na śrūyate iti uttara ardhaḥ tad viṣayaḥ iti bhāvena āha ayam iti atra api īśvaraḥ eva pratipādyaḥ kim na syāt iti atas āha anyathā iti na jāyate ajaḥ iti paunaruktyam nanu punarukti bhayena pūrva uttara ardhayoḥ viṣaya bheda kalpane śāśvataḥ upi anyaḥ eva prasajyate nitya padena punarukteḥ iti atas āha na iti

original: na śāśvatapadena nityatvamucyate | yena punaruktiḥ syāt | api tu jīvopyajo nityaścettarhi īśvaravatsvātantryādimānapi syāt | tathā ca na tatpūjā kāryeti śaṃkānirāsāya
analyzed: na śāśvata padena nitya tvam ucyate yena punaruktiḥ syāt api tu jīvaḥ upi ajaḥ nityaḥ ced tarhi īśvara vat svātantrya ādimān api syāt tathā ca na tad pūjā kāryā iti śaṃkā nirāsāya

original: tasyāsvātantaryādyahānamevocyata iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tasya asvātantarya ādi a hānam eva ucyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: jīvasāyāsvātantryādikaṃ svarūpaṃ, tacca na jahāti, tena ca śāśvata ityucyata ityetatkuta ityata āha || alpeti || tathāpi purāṇa iti punaruktirityata āha || purāṇīti || nānena purāṇapadenānāditvamucyate | yena paunaruktyaṃ syāt |
analyzed: jīva sāya asvātantrya ādikam svarūpam tat ca na jahāti tena ca śāśvataḥ iti ucyate iti etat kutas iti atas āha alpa iti tathā api purāṇaḥ iti punaruktiḥ iti atas āha purāṇī iti na anena purāṇa padena anādi tvam ucyate yena paunaruktyam syāt

original: kintu jīvasyeśvaravadajatvādisadbhāve'pi kuto na svātantryādītyato dehotpattyādibhāvena tadvadajatvādyabhāva evocyata iti bhāvaḥ || 20 ||
analyzed: kintu jīvasya īśvara vat aja tva ādi sadbhāve api kutas na svātantrya ādi iti atas deha utpatti ādi bhāvena tadvat aja tva ādi abhāvaḥ eva ucyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: yaduktaṃ "jīve svātantryaṃ manyamāno na jānāti" iti tatra "nāyaṃ hanti" iti heturuktaḥ | atha jñānināṃ tādṛśābhimānābhāvaśca tatra heturucyate "vedeti" | tatrāvināśinityapadayoḥ paunaruktyaparihārāyārthabhedamāha || avināśinamiti || jīvasya samīpoktatvādenamityasya jīvaviṣayatvapratītinirāsāyāha || enamiti || samastaślokaṃ śrutyaiva vyācaṣṭe ||
analyzed: yat uktam jīve svātantryam manyamānaḥ na jānāti iti tatra na ayam hanti iti hetuḥ uktaḥ atha jñāninām tādṛśa abhimāna abhāvaḥ ca tatra hetuḥ ucyate veda iti tatra avināśi nitya padayoḥ paunaruktya parihārāya artha bhedam āha avināśinam iti jīvasya samīpa ukta tvāt enam ityasya jīva viṣayatva pratīti nirāsāya āha enam iti samasta ślokam śrutyā eva vyācaṣṭe

original: kartṛtvamiti || jānan avināśitvādihetuneti śeṣaḥ | kartā kartṛtvābhimānī | jīvasya samīpoktatvāttadviṣayo'yaṃ ślokaḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha || anyaśceti || īśvarasya śarīrāpāyarahitatvāt tatparatve śakyate punaruktiparihāraḥ | na tu jīvaparatve | tasya dehanāśasadbhāvāt |
analyzed: kartṛ tvam iti jānan avināśi tva ādi hetunā iti śeṣaḥ kartā kartṛ tva abhimānī jīvasya samīpa ukta tvāt tad viṣayaḥ yam ślokaḥ kim na syāt iti atas āha anyaḥ ca iti īśvarasya śarīra apāya rahita tvāt tad paratve śakyate punarukti parihāraḥ na tu jīva paratve tasya deha nāśa sadbhāvāt

original: ataḥ punaruktivirodhāte samīpoktamapi jīvaṃ vihāyeśvaragrahaṇaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ || 21 ||
analyzed: atas samīpa uktam api jīvam vihāya īśvara grahaṇam yuktam iti bhāvaḥ 21

original: nanvastvīśvaraviṣaye śokābhāvo, jīvaviṣayo tu bhaviṣyati | jīvo nityastasya dehayogaviyogau kaumārādivadityukte'pi sarvalokaprasiddhajanimṛtisadbhāvāt yuddhe ca tatprāpteriyāśaṃkāparihāratvena ślokamavatārayita || jīvasyeti ||
analyzed: nanu astu īśvara viṣaye śoka abhāvaḥ jīva viṣayaḥ tu bhaviṣyati jīvaḥ nityaḥ tasya deha yoga viyogau kaumāra ādi vat iti ukte api sarva loka prasiddha jani mṛti sadbhāvāt yuddhe ca tad prāpteḥ iya āśaṃkā parihāra tvena ślokam avatārayita jīvasya iti

original: śarīrayogaviyogayoḥ kaumarādivacchokakāraṇatvābhāvo'ṅgīkṛtaścettarhi janimṛtī api na śokakāraṇaṃ, yataḥ śarīrayogaviyogāveva janimṛtī ityarthaḥ || 22 ||
analyzed: śarīra yoga viyogayoḥ kaumara ādi vat śoka kāraṇatva abhāvaḥ ṅgīkṛtaḥ ced tarhi jani mṛtī api na śoka kāraṇam yatas śarīra yoga viyogau eva jani mṛtī iti arthaḥ 22

original: astyīśvarasya svato nāśābhāvaḥ | tathāpi yuddhagataśastrādikāraṇaviśeṣeṇa cchedādiprāpteḥ śoka ityāśaṃkāparihāratvena ślokamavatārayati || kāraṇata'pīti || anyathātvaṃ chedādi || 23 ||
analyzed: asti īśvarasya svatas nāśa abhāvaḥ tathā api yuddha gata śastra ādi kāraṇa viśeṣeṇa cheda ādi prāpteḥ śokaḥ iti āśaṃkā parihāra tvena ślokam avatārayati anyathātvam cheda ādi

original: jīvaviṣaye'pyetadāśaṃkāparihārāya ślokamavatārayati || acchedyatveti || nanu "nityaḥ sarvagataḥ" iti nityatvaṃ punaḥ kimarthamucyate | atra sarvagatavastupratipādanāt kathaṃ cāsya jīvaviṣayatvam? na cāyamardha īśvaraviṣayaḥ | jīvasya samīpoktatvādityata āha || nityamiti || nityaṃ sarvagatasthāṇurityarthaḥ |
analyzed: jīva viṣaye api etad āśaṃkā parihārāya ślokam avatārayati acchedya tva iti nanu nityaḥ sarva gataḥ iti nitya tvam punar kimartham ucyate atra sarva gata vastu pratipādanāt katham ca asya jīva viṣayatvam na ca ayam ardhaḥ īśvara viṣayaḥ jīvasya samīpa ukta tvāt iti atas āha nityam iti nityam sarva gata sthāṇuḥ iti arthaḥ

original: kaḥ sarvagataḥ? kiṃ ca tatsthatvamityata āha || sarvagata iti || nātra nityatvaṃ sarvagatatvaṃ cocyate | yena punaruktirīśvaraviṣayatvaṃ cāśaṃketa | kintu "jīvasyāpīśvaravadacchedyatvādisadbhāve sarvasāmyam, tathāca kiṃ tatpūjayā" ityato nityaṃ tadadhīnatvādyevocyata iti bhāvaḥ | sarvagatasthāṇutvoktyā vaiṣamyaheturdarśitaḥ |
analyzed: kaḥ sarvagataḥ kim ca tad sthatvam iti atas āha sarvagataḥ iti na atra nitya tvam sarvagata tvam ca ucyate yena punaruktiḥ īśvara viṣayatvam ca āśaṃketa kintu jīvasya api īśvara vat acchedya tva ādi sadbhāve sarva sāmyam tathāca kim tad pūjayā iti atas nityam tad adhīna tva ādi eva ucyate iti bhāvaḥ sarvagata sthāṇu tva uktyā vaiṣamya hetuḥ darśitaḥ

original: nanvatra sarvagata ityeva yuktam | na tu sarvagatastha it | sarvagatasayaivācalatvopapatteḥ | aṇau tadanupapatterityata āha || hetuto'pīti || nātrācalapadena kriyārāhityamucyate | yena sarvagata ityeva padavibhāgaśaṃkā | kintvastu jīvasyeśvarādhīnatvam | tadapi kadācinnaśyati | tataśca sarvasāmyam |
analyzed: nanu atra sarvagataḥ iti eva yuktam na tu sarvagata sthaḥ sarvagata sayā eva acala tva upapatteḥ aṇau tad anupapatteḥ iti atas āha hetutaḥ api iti na atra acala padena kriyā rāhityam ucyate yena sarvagataḥ iti eva pada vibhāga śaṃkā kintu astu jīvasya īśvara adhīna tvam tat api kadācid naśyati tatas ca sarva sāmyam

original: tathāca na tatpūjā kāryetyataḥ tadadhīnatvānāśa evocyata iti bhāvaḥ | nityapadenaivāsyārthasya siddheḥ kimannatyata uktaṃ hetuta iti | nityamapi sarvagatasthatvaṃ varādikāraṇaviśeṣeṇa naśyatviti śaṃ,ānirākaraṇānnaitadvaiyarthyamiti bhāvaḥ | tathāpi sanātana ita punaruktirityata āha || nādeneti || na sanātanapadena nityatvamucyate |
analyzed: tathāca na tad pūjā kāryā iti atas tad adhīna tva anāśaḥ eva ucyate iti bhāvaḥ nitya padena eva asya arthasya siddheḥ kim anna tyatas uktam hetutaḥ iti nityam api sarvagata sthatvam vara ādi kāraṇa viśeṣeṇa naśyatu iti śaṃā nirākaraṇāt na etat vaiyarthyam iti bhāvaḥ tathā api sanātanaḥ punaruktiḥ iti atas āha nādena iti na sanātana padena nitya tvam ucyate

original: yena punaruktiḥ syāt | api tu svātantryābhāve jīvasya vidhiniṣedhabaddhatvaṃ hetvantaramucyata iti bhāvaḥ ata evānūktahetūpanyāsātprāk asvātantryoktāvapyapaunaruktyam |
analyzed: yena punaruktiḥ syāt api tu svātantrya abhāve jīvasya vidhi niṣedha baddha tvam hetu antaram ucyate iti bhāvaḥ atas eva anūkta hetu upanyāsāt prāk asvātantrya uktau api apaunaruktyam

original: nanvacchedya iti ślokaḥ prakṛteśvaraviṣaya eva kiṃ na syāt | kimanena pratītapadavibhāgatyāgādinetyata āha || nityamiti || smṛtisamākhyānājjīvaviṣaya evāyaṃ śloka iti bhāvaḥ | ito'pi nāyaṃ śloka īśvaraviṣaya ityāha || acchedya iti ||
analyzed: nanu acchedyaḥ iti ślokaḥ prakṛta īśvara viṣayaḥ eva kim na syāt kim anena pratīta pada vibhāga tyāga ādinā iti atas āha nityam iti smṛti samākhyānāt jīva viṣayaḥ eva ayam ślokaḥ iti bhāvaḥ itas api na ayam ślokaḥ īśvara viṣayaḥ iti āha acchedyaḥ iti

original: "nainaṃ chindanti" itīśvarasyācchedyatvāderuktatvāt "acchedyo'yam" ityacchedyatvādeḥ punaruktiprasaṅgo'sya ślokasyeśvaraviṣayatāyām | ato nāyaṃ tatpara ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: na enam chindanti iti īśvarasya acchedya tva ādeḥ ukta tvāt acchedyaḥ yam iti acchedya tva ādeḥ punarukti prasaṅgaḥ usya ślokasya īśvara viṣaya tāyām atas na ayam tad paraḥ iti arthaḥ

original: jīvasya samīpoktatvāt "avyakto'yam" ityasyāpi tadviṣayatvapratītinirāsāyāha || yasminniti || yasminnayaṃ sthita ityuktyā sarvagatapadeneśvarasyāpi samīpoktatvaṃ sūcayati | yadyatreśvaraḥ pratipādyastarhitasmādityuttaravākyamanupapannaṃ syāt | na hīśvarasyālvaktatvādijñāne yuddhagataśokābhāvo bhavati |
analyzed: jīvasya samīpa ukta tvāt avyaktaḥ uyam iti asya api tad viṣayatva pratīti nirāsāya āha yasmin iti yasmin ayam sthitaḥ iti uktyā sarvagata padena īśvarasya api samīpa ukta tvam sūcayati yat yatra īśvaraḥ pratipādyaḥ tarhi tasmāt iti uttara vākyam anupapannam syāt na hi yuddha gata śoka abhāvaḥ bhavati

original: nāpyasmin pakṣe tasmāditi parāmarśaviṣayo'sti | yadi tasya jīvaviṣayatā tadā dūroktatvadeṣa ityata āha || evamiti || nātra yuddhagataśoko nivāryate | nāpi tasmāditi parāmarśaviṣayābhāvaḥ | yato'trācchedyatvādisāmyājjīvasyāpi svātantryeṇa kimīśvarapūjayetyataḥ sanātanatvādihetunā īśvarasyaiva svātantryamuktam |
analyzed: na api asmin pakṣe tasmāt iti parāmarśa viṣayaḥ usti yadi tasya jīva viṣaya tā tadā dūra ukta tva deṣaḥ iti atas āha evam iti na atra yuddha gata śokaḥ nivāryate na api tasmāt iti parāmarśa viṣaya abhāvaḥ yatas utra ācchedya tva ādi sāmyāt jīvasya api svātantryeṇa kim īśvara pūjayā iti atas sanātana tva ādi hetunā īśvarasya eva svātantryam uktam

original: astvīśvarasya svātantryaṃ, kiṃ tāvatā tatpūjayetyato yasmādīśvara eva svatantro'stasyaiva saṃsāraśokanāśakatvaṃ yujyate | sa ca svakarmaṇā'vyaktatvādiguṇayuktatvena jñāta eva sarvasaṃsāraduḥkhanāśaṃ saṃsāraśokaṃ pariharetyevocyata iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: astu īśvarasya svātantryam kim tāvatā tat pūjaya iti atas yasmāt īśvaraḥ eva svatantroḥ tasya eva saṃsāra śoka nāśaka tvam yujyate sa ca sva karmaṇā avyakta tva ādi guṇa yuktatvena jñātaḥ eva sarva saṃsāra duḥkha nāśam saṃsāra śokam parihara iti eva ucyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: bhavedayamatrārtho'bhipreto yadi svakarmaṇā bhagavajjñānaṃ, jñāto bhagavān sarvaduḥanāśaṃ karotīti gītābhimataṃ syāt | tadeva kuta ityata āha || teṣāmiti || atra māṃ dhyāyanta ityanenaiva jñānaṃ labhyate |
analyzed: bhavet ayam atra arthaḥ abhipretaḥ yadi sva karmaṇā bhagavat jñānam jñātaḥ bhagavān sarva duḥanāśam karoti iti gīta abhimatam syāt tat eva kutas iti atas āha teṣām iti atra mām dhyāyantaḥ iti anena eva jñānam labhyate

original: evametatprakaraṇaṃ jīveśvaraparatayā vyākhyāya athāsyobhayaparatve yuktiṃ cāha || na tveveti || teṣāmiti || atra māṃ dhyāyanta ityanenaiva jñānaṃ labhyate |
analyzed: evam etat prakaraṇam jīva īśvara para tayā vyākhyāya atha asya ubhaya paratve yuktim ca āha na tu eva iti teṣām iti atra mām dhyāyantaḥ iti anena eva jñānam labhyate

original: evametatprakaraṇaṃ jīveśvaraparatayā vyākhyāya athāsyobhayaparatve yuktiṃ cāha || na tveveti || nanvekaḥ prasaṅgādevopakrāntaḥ | prakaraṇaṃ tvekaviṣayameva kiṃ na syādityataḥ sarvatrobhayaliṅgasadbhāvādubhayaviṣayaṃ prakaraṇamityāha || dehina iti ||
analyzed: evam etat prakaraṇam jīveśvara para tayā vyākhyāya atha asya ubhaya paratve yuktim ca āha na tu eva iti nanu ekaḥ prasaṅgāt eva upakrāntaḥ prakaraṇam tu eka viṣayam eva kim na syāt iti atas sarvatra ubhaya liṅga sadbhāvāt ubhaya viṣayam prakaraṇam iti āha dehinaḥ iti

original: astūpakramavaśādubhayoḥ prākaraṇikatvaṃ tathāpi yadvākyaṃ yadviṣayatayā vyākhyātaṃ tasya tadviṣayatā kuta ityato yadvākyaṃ yadviṣayatayā vyākhyātaṃ tatra talliṅgasadbhāvāttasya tadviṣayatvaṃ yuktamiti vā'ha || dehina iti ||
analyzed: astu upakrama vaśāt ubhayoḥ prākaraṇika tvam tathā api yat vākyam yad viṣayatayā vyākhyātam tasya tad viṣayatā kutas iti atas yat vākyam yad viṣayatayā vyākhyātam tatra tad liṅga sadbhāvāt tasya tad viṣayatvam yuktam iti vā āha dehinaḥ iti

original: nanvastu tatra tatra jīvaḥ pratipādyaḥ | dehitvādiviśeṣaṇānāṃ jīvādanyatra niravakāśatvāt | avināśitvādīnāṃ tu jīve'pi sambhavāt kathaṃ tadvākyasyeśvaraviṣayatvaniścaya ityata āha || na hīti || īśvaro'pi tatsambhavaḥ kathamityata āha || paramātmana iti || na ca tatra tatra bhāṣyavirodhaḥ śaṃkanīyaḥ |
analyzed: nanu astu tatra tatra jīvaḥ pratipādyaḥ dehitva ādi viśeṣaṇānām jīvāt anyatra niravakāśa tvāt avināśi tva ādīnām tu jīve api sambhavāt katham tad vākyasya īśvara viṣaya tva niścayaḥ iti atas āha na hi iti īśvaraḥ api tad sambhavaḥ katham iti atas āha paramātmanaḥ iti na ca tatra tatra bhāṣya virodhaḥ śaṃkanīyaḥ

original: atra ca mukhyayaiva vṛttyārthamaṅgīkṛtya paunaruktyādiśaṃkonmūlanaṃ vinā kevalāmukhyārthagrahaṇe bādhakānāmuktatvāt | bhāṣye punarmukhyārthamaparityajyaivārthāntarasyoktatvāditi ||
analyzed: atra ca mukhyayā eva vṛttyā artham aṅgīkṛtya paunaruktya ādi śaṃkā unmūlanam vinā kevala amukhya artha grahaṇe bādhakānām ukta tvāt bhāṣye punar mukhya artham a parityajya eva artha antarasya ukta tvāt iti

original: tathāpi naiteṣāṃ vākyānāmuktārthatā yuktā | asaṅgatatvādityato "nāsataḥ" ityantānāṃ saṅgateruktatvāt " avināśi tu" ityādīnāṃ saṅgatiṃ darśayan "avināśi tu"ityasya ślokasya "nāsataḥ" ityanena saṅgatiṃ sākṣādasambhavādavatārakrameṇāha || yasmāditi || evambhūta iti || sarvaprakāreṇāvināśītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tathā api na eteṣām vākyānām ukta artha tā yuktā asaṅgata tvāt iti atas na asataḥ iti antānām saṅgateḥ ukta tvāt avināśi tu ityādīnām saṅgatim darśayan avināśi tu ityasya ślokasya na asataḥ iti anena saṅgatim sākṣāt asambhavāt avatāra krameṇa āha yasmāt iti evambhūtaḥ iti sarva prakāreṇa avināśi iti arthaḥ

original: asya ślokasyoktaprakāreṇa "anāśinaḥ" iti vakṣyamāṇenāpi saṅgatirityāha || atastadarthamiti || athavā "nāsataḥ" ityetaccheṣatvenāpi "anāśinaḥ" ityasya saṅgatirityanenoktam | "antavantaḥ" ityanenāpi saṅgatirityāha || anyeṣāmiti || prākṛtadehinaśca | jīvā iti śeṣaḥ | anena "śarīriṇaḥ" ityanyopayogamācaṣṭe | nityatvādityanena "nityasya" ityasya |
analyzed: asya ślokasya ukta prakāreṇa anāśinaḥ iti vakṣyamāṇena api saṅgatiḥ iti āha atas tad artham iti athavā na asataḥ iti etad śeṣatvena api anāśinaḥ ityasya saṅgatiḥ iti anena uktam antavantaḥ iti anena api saṅgatiḥ iti āha anyeṣām iti prākṛta dehinaḥ ca jīvāḥ iti śeṣaḥ anena śarīriṇaḥ iti anya upayogam ācaṣṭe nitya tvāt iti anena nityasya ityasya

original: ata evāsya "na tvevāham" , "dehino'smin" ityanena gatārthatā'pi parihṛtā bhavati | "nāyaṃ hanti" ityatra hetutayā prakṛtānuvādo'yamityāśrayaṇāt | ata evoktaṃ "nityasyoktāḥ" iti || "nāyaṃ hanti" ityasya "ya enam" ityanena saṅgatimāha || tasmāddhanteti || etena "nāyaṃ hanti" ityetatpunaruktam | jīvāsvātantryāderuktasvāt |
analyzed: atas eva asya na tu eva aham dehinā usmin iti anena gatārtha tā api parihṛtā bhavati na ayam hanti iti atra hetutayā prakṛta anuvādaḥ yam iti āśrayaṇāt atas eva uktam nityasya uktāḥ iti na ayam hanti ityasya yaḥ enam iti anena saṅgatim āha tasmāt hantā iti etena na ayam hanti iti etat punar uktam jīva asvātantrya ādeḥ ukta svāt

original: na ca "ya enam" ityanena saṅgatiṃ sākṣādasambhavādavatārakrameṇāha || yasmāditi || evambhūta iti || sarvaprakāreṇāvināśītyarthaḥ | asya ślokasyoktaprakāreṇa "anāśinaḥ" iti vakṣyamāṇenāpi saṅgatirityāha || atantadarthamiti || athavā "nāsataḥ " ityetaccheṣatvenāpi "anāśinaḥ" ityasya saṅgatirityanenoktam |
analyzed: na ca ye enam iti anena saṅgatim sākṣāt asambhavāt avatāra krameṇa āha yasmāt iti evambhūtaḥ iti sarva prakāreṇa avināśī iti arthaḥ asya ślokasya ukta prakāreṇa anāśinaḥ iti vakṣyamāṇena api saṅgatiḥ iti āha atantadartham iti athavā na asataḥ iti etad śeṣatvena api anāśinaḥ iti asya saṅgatiḥ iti anena uktam

original: "antavantaḥ" ityasyoktarītyā "anāśinaḥ"ityanena saṅgatau sddhāyāṃ "nāyaṃ hanti" ityanenāpi saṅgatirityāha || anyeṣāmiti || prākṛtadehinaśca | jīvā iti śeṣaḥ | anena "śarīriṇaḥ" ityasyopayogamācaṣṭe | nityatvādityanena "nityasya" ityasya | ata evāsya "na tvevāham", ityatra hetutayā prakṛtānuvādo'yamityāśrayaṇāt | ata evoktaṃ "nityasyoktāḥ" iti |
analyzed: antavantaḥ iti asya ukta rītyā anāśinaḥ iti anena saṅgatau sddhāyām na ayam hanti iti anena api saṅgatiḥ iti āha anyeṣām iti prākṛta dehinaḥ ca jīvāḥ iti śeṣaḥ anena śarīriṇaḥ iti asya upayogam ācaṣṭe nitya tvāt iti anena nityasya ityasya atas eva asya na tu eva aham iti atra hetutayā prakṛta anuvādaḥ yam iti āśrayaṇāt atas eva uktam nityasya uktāḥ iti

original: "nāyaṃ hanti" ityasya "ya enam"ityanena saṅgatimāha || tasmāddhanteti || etena "nāyaṃ hanti"ityetatpunaruktam | jīvāsvātantryāderuktatvāt | na ca "ya enam" ityetadupapādanāyaktānuvādo'yaṃ pramāṇānupanyāsenopapādanāyogādityetadapi parākṛtam | " nāyaṃ hanti" ityetatprakṛtam " antavantaḥ" ityapekṣya pravṛttamityuktatvāt |
analyzed: na ayam hanti iti asya yaḥ enam iti anena saṅgatim āha tasmāt hantā iti etena na ayam hanti iti etat punar uktam jīva asvātantrya ādeḥ ukta tvāt na ca yaḥ enam iti etad upapādana ayakta anuvādaḥ yam pramāṇa anupanyāsena upapādana ayogāt iti etat api parākṛtam na ayam hanti iti etat prakṛtam antavantaḥ iti apekṣya pravṛttam iti ukta tvāt

original: mantravarṇasya jīveśvaranityatvopapādakatvamuktam | " nāyaṃ hanti" ityetadupapādakatvenāpi saṅgatirityāha || yasmādayameveti || etena mantravarṇasya jīveśvaranityatvamātropapādakatve'dhikaviśeṣaṇokteranupayoga ityetadapirahṛtam | jīvavadityanena " purāṇaḥ" ityasyopayogaṃ darśayati |
analyzed: mantra varṇasya jīveśvara nitya tva upapādaka tvam uktam na ayam hanti iti etad upapādaka tvena api saṅgatiḥ iti āha yasmāt ayam eva iti etena mantra varṇasya jīveśvara nitya tva mātra upapādaka tva idhika viśeṣaṇa ukteḥ anupayogaḥ iti etat apirahṛtam jīva vat iti anena purāṇaḥ iti asya upayogam darśayati

original: " na hanyate" ityasya pūrvārdhaprakṛtena parameśvarasyaiva svātantryamityanena saṅgatimabhipretya tadghaṭanāya tātparyamāha || jīvastviti || anenāsya gatārthatā parihṛtā bhavati |
analyzed: na hanyate iti asya pūrva ardha prakṛtena parameśvarasya eva svātantryam iti anena saṅgatim abhipretya tad ghaṭanāya tātparyam āha jīvaḥ tu iti anena asya gatārtha tā parihṛtā bhavati

original: " vedāvināśinam" itīśvarāvināśitvādeḥ " kathaṃ sa puruṣaḥ" ityanena sākṣātsaṅgaterabhāvādavatārakrameṇa tāmāha || ata evamiti || eteneśvarāvināśitvādeḥ prāgevoktatvātpunaruktirityapi parāntam | " kathaṃ sa puruṣaḥ" ityetadupapādakasvatantryopapādanāyoktānuvādo'yamityāśritatvāt | " vāsāṃsi" ityetasya prakṛteneśvarasvātantryeṇāpi saṅgatimāha ||
analyzed: veda avināśinam iti īśvara avināśi tva ādeḥ katham sa puruṣaḥ iti anena sākṣāt saṅgateḥ abhāvāt avatāra krameṇa tām āha atas evam iti etena īśvara avināśi tva ādeḥ prāk eva ukta tvāt punaruktiḥ iti api para antam katham sa puruṣaḥ iti etad upapādaka svatantrya upapādanāya ukta anuvādaḥ yam iti āśrita tvāt vāsāṃsi iti etasya prakṛtena īśvara svātantryeṇa api saṅgatim āha

original: vāsasa iti || nainamityasya prakṛteneśvarasvātantryeṇapi saṃgatimāha || īśvarasyeti || jñātavyamiti sambandhaḥ|
analyzed: vāsasaḥ iti na enam ityasya prakṛtena īśvara svātantryeṇa api saṃgatim āha īśvarasya iti jñātavyam iti sambandhaḥ

original: yadvā tathāpi nāsya prakaraṇasyobhayaviṣayatvaṃ yuktam | ubhayapratipādanasya prasaṅagānanuguṇatvāt | yuddhavidhānasyaiva prakṛtatvādato nobhayapratipādanaṃ prasaṅagānuguṇam | yuddhaṃ kartavyaṃ, tacceśvarasyaiva svatantratvena mokṣapradānasamarthatvāttatpūjātvena kāryamityatrābhipretam|
analyzed: yat vā tathā api na asya prakaraṇasya ubhaya viṣaya tvam yuktam ubhaya pratipādanasya prasaṅaga ananuguṇa tvāt yuddha vidhānasya eva prakṛta tvāt atas na ubhaya pratipādanam prasaṅaga anuguṇam yuddham kartavyam tat ca īśvarasya eva svatantra tvena mokṣa pradāna samartha tvāt tat pūjā tvena kāryam iti atra abhipretam

original: tatreśvarasya nityatvapratipādanaṃ yuddhavidhānāya śokanivāraṇārthamupayujyate | tasya sarvaprakāreṇāvināśaratvādipratipādanaṃ ca tatpūjāvidhānārthaṃ tasya mokṣadatvasāmarthyasamarthanāya svātantryopapādakatayopayujyate | jīvasya nityatvavarṇanaṃ yuddhavidhānāya śokanivāraṇārthamupayujyate |
analyzed: tatra īśvarasya nitya tva pratipādanam yuddha vidhānāya śoka nivāraṇa artham upayujyate tasya sarva prakāreṇa avināśa ratva ādi pratipādanam ca tad pūjā vidhāna artham tasya mokṣa da tva sāmarthya samarthanāya svātantrya upapādaka tayā upayujyate jīvasya nitya tva varṇanam yuddha vidhānāya śoka nivāraṇa artham upayujyate

original: tasya dehanāśādivarṇanamapi śokanivāraṇāya parameśvarasyaiva svātantryasiddhyarthaṃ jīvasyāsvātantryapradarśanāyopayujyate -- iti bhāvena sarvavākyānyabhipretārthe yojayati || yasmādevambhūta iti || sarvaprakāreṇāvināśītyarthaḥ | yasmādevambhūta ityavināśitvityabhinate prameye yojyam | atantatpūjeti nāsata iti |
analyzed: tasya deha nāśa ādi varṇanam api śoka nivāraṇāya parameśvarasya eva svātantrya siddhi artham jīvasya asvātantrya pradarśanāya upayujyate iti bhāvena sarva vākyāni abhipreta arthe yojayati yasmāt evambhūtaḥ iti sarva prakāreṇa avināśi iti arthaḥ yasmāt evambhūtaḥ iti avināśi tu iti abhinate prameye yojyam na asataḥ iti

original: atantadarthamityanāśina iti | anyeṣāmityantavanta iti | prākṛtadehina iti śarīriṇa iti | ata iti nāyaṃ hantīti | nityanvāditi na hanyata iti | tasmāditi ya enamiti | yasmāditi na mriyata iti | tatsaṃyogeti nāyaṃ bhūtveti | jīvastviti na hanyata iti | ata evamiti vedeti | vāsasa iti vāsāṃsīti | īśvasyeti nainamiti |
analyzed: atantadartham iti anāśinaḥ iti anyeṣām iti antavantaḥ iti prākṛta dehinaḥ iti śarīriṇaḥ iti atas iti na ayam hanti iti na hanyate iti tasmāt iti yaḥ enam iti yasmāt iti na mriyate iti tad saṃyoga iti na ayam bhūtvā iti jīvaḥ tu iti na hanyate iti atas evam iti veda iti vāsasaḥ iti vāsāṃsi iti īśvasya iti na enam iti

original: yadyapyetadvyākhyānata eva siddhaṃ, tathāpi viprakīrṇatayoktaṃ na mandabuddhāvārohatīti piṇḍīkṛtyoktam |
analyzed: yadi api etat vyākhyānataḥ eva siddham tathā api viprakīrṇa tayā uktam na manda buddhau ārohati iti piṇḍīkṛtya uktam

original: atra "nainaṃ chindanti " iti vartamānaprayogaḥ kālāntaracchedādyanujñārtha ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || nainamiti || na kālāntaracchedādyanujñārthaṃ vartamānaprayogaḥ | kintu mama dehe chedādikaṃ nāstīti tatra yuktitayā chedādiprāpitisadbhāve'pīdānīṃ tadabhāvasya pratyakṣata eva darśayituṃ śakyatvasūcanārthameveti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: atra na enam chindanti iti vartamāna prayogaḥ kāla antara cheda ādi anujñā arthaḥ iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya āha na enam iti na kāla antara cheda ādi anujñā artham vartamāna prayogaḥ kintu mama dehe cheda ādikam na asti iti tatra yukti tayā cheda ādi prāpiti sadbhāve pi idānīm tad abhāvasya pratyakṣataḥ eva darśayitum śakyatva sūcana artham eva iti bhāvaḥ

original: atreśvarasvarūpasyaiva cedādeyabhāvaḥ kathyate na tu taddehasyāpi | dehasya "niśataśarairvibhidyamānatvaci " iti tadbhāvokteḥ | ataḥ svadehasyeti kathamucyata ityato'bhiprāyamāha || cchedeti || mṛṣā pradarśanaṃ kimarthamityata āha || īśvara iti || kuto mṛṣā, paramārthata eva kiṃ na syādityato vā'ha || īśvara iti ||
analyzed: atra īśvara svarūpasya eva ced ādeya bhāvaḥ kathyate na tu tad dehasya api dehasya niśata śaraiḥ vibhidyamāna tvaci iti tad bhāva ukteḥ atas sva dehasya iti katham ucyate iti atas abhiprāyam āha cheda iti mṛṣā pradarśanam kimartham ityatas āha īśvaraḥ iti kutas mṛṣā paramārthataḥ eva kim na syāt iti atas vā āha īśvaraḥ iti

original: svatantrasya paramārthatastadayuktamityarthaḥ || 24 ||
analyzed: svatantrasya paramārthataḥ tat ayuktam iti arthaḥ 24

original: "avyakto'yam" itīśvaraviṣayamityuktam | tatreśavarasyāvyaktatvādikathane kā saṅgatirityataḥ "sarvagatasthāṇuḥ"iti paramātmanaḥ sarvagatatvamabhihitam | tatreśvarasya deho'sti na vā? ādye dehinaḥ sarvatra vartamānasya sarvatra darśanaṃ syāt | dvitīye śarīracchedādinirāso na yukta ityāśaṃkānirāsāyādyapadamavatārayati || sarveti ||
analyzed: avyakta uyam iti īśvara viṣayam iti uktam tatra īśa varasya avyakta tva ādi kathane kā saṅgatiḥ iti atas sarva gata sthāṇuḥ iti paramātmanaḥ sarva gata tvam abhihitam tatra īśvarasya dehaḥ usti na vā ādye dehinaḥ sarvatra vartamānasya sarvatra darśanam syāt dvitīye śarīra cheda ādi nirāsaḥ na yuktaḥ iti āśaṃkā nirāsāya ādya padam avatārayati sarva iti

original: dehitve'vyaktatvaṃ kathaṃ yujyata ityāśaṃkya tatparihātatvenācitantyapadaṃ vyācaṣṭe || kathamiti || avintyaśakteḥ prativandhe nāśe vā sati pratītiprasaṅga ityāśaṃkāparihārāyāvikāryapadaṃ vyācaṣṭe || na ceti || nanvekenaiva śabdena pūrteḥ kimarthaṃ nainamityatra prati ptatyenamiti vacanam |
analyzed: dehi tva ivyakta tvam katham yujyate iti āśaṃkya tad parihāta tvena ācitantya padam vyācaṣṭe katham iti avintya śakteḥ prativandhe nāśe vā sati pratīti prasaṅgaḥ iti āśaṃkā parihārāya avikārya padam vyācaṣṭe na ca iti nanu ekena eva śabdena pūrteḥ kimartham na enam iti atra vacanam

original: "avyakto'yam"ityatra prativiśeṣaṇam "ayam"iti vacanaṃ ca kimarthamityata āha || yānīti || ādipadena naño grahaṇam | anena prativiśeṣaṇamapi vīpsārūpeṇa "enam"ityādibahuśabdayojanāṃ sūcayati | evaṃ cejjīvasya bāhulyābhāvāt "acchedyo'yam"iti pṛthagvacanaṃ vyarthamityata āha || jīve tviti || jīve kṛthagvacanamiti śeṣaḥ |
analyzed: avyaktaḥ yam iti atra prativiśeṣaṇam ayam iti vacanam ca kimartham iti atas āha yāni iti ādi padena nañaḥ grahaṇam anena prativiśeṣaṇam api vīpsā rūpeṇa enam ityādi bahu śabda yojanām sūcayati evam ced jīvasya bāhulya abhāvāt acchedyaḥ yam iti pṛthagvacanam vyartham iti atas āha jīve tu iti jīve kṛthak vacanam iti śeṣaḥ

original: nanvīśvarasya dehavattvaṃ, tasya ca dehasya chedādirāhityamevambhāvaśca sarvarūpāṇāmityetatkuta ityata uktam "ucyate"iti padaṃ vyācaṣṭe || sarvamiti || kāstāḥ śrutaya ityata āha || saditi || chedādidoṣarahito deho yasyāsau saddehaḥ | sukhagandhaḥ | sukhātmakagandho vā | jñānajñāna ityāderatiśayitajñānādimānityarthaḥ |
analyzed: nanu īśvarasya dehavattvam tasya ca dehasya cheda ādi rāhityam evambhāvaḥ ca sarva rūpāṇām iti etat kutas iti atas uktam ucyate iti padam vyācaṣṭe sarvam iti kāḥ tāḥ śrutayaḥ iti atas āha sat iti cheda ādi doṣa rahitaḥ dehaḥ yasya asau sat dehaḥ sukha gandhaḥ sukha ātmaka gandhaḥ vā jñāna jñānaḥ ityādeḥ atiśayita jñāna ādimān iti arthaḥ

original: nanvīśvarasya dehasadbhāve śrutivipratipattestatsandeha eva syātkuto niścayastadbhāvasyetyataḥ śrutyantareṇa tadvyavasthāṃ darśayati || adeha iti || svarūpavān svarūpabhūtadehavān || sukhajñānādirūpakaḥ || astīti saṃbandhaḥ | tataśca dehavānucyata ityanuṣajyate | dehadehinoraikyamanyatrādṛṣṭaṃ kathaṃ yujyata ityata āha || sa ceti ||
analyzed: nanu īśvarasya deha sadbhāve śruti vipratipatteḥ tad sandehaḥ eva syāt kutas niścayaḥ tad bhāvasya iti atas śruti antareṇa tad vyavasthām darśayati adehaḥ iti sva rūpavān sva rūpa bhūta dehavān sukha jñāna ādi rūpakaḥ asti iti saṃbandhaḥ tatas ca dehavān ucyate iti anuṣajyate deha dehinoḥ aikyam anyatra adṛṣṭam katham yujyate iti atas āha sa ca iti

original: nanu sukhajñānādirūpakaḥ || astīti saṃbandhaḥ | tataśca deho viṣṇorananyaścet tadā tasya sukhādiguṇarūpatvaṃ prasajyate | na ca tadyujyate | "ānandabhuk" ityādāvānandabhoktṛtvasyoktatvāt | ekasya ca bhoktṛbhogyabhāvādarśanādityata āha || guṇeti || dṛṣṭopyayamabhinne bhoktṛbhogyabhāvaḥ kiṃnimitta upapadyata ityata āha || abhinne'pīti || asti |
analyzed: nanu sukha jñāna ādi rūpakaḥ asti iti saṃbandhaḥ tatas ca dehaḥ viṣṇoḥ ananyaḥ ced tadā tasya sukha ādi guṇa rūpatvam prasajyate na ca tat yujyate ānanda bhuj ityādau ānanda bhoktṛ tvasya uktatvāt ekasya ca bhoktṛ bhogya bhāva adarśanāt iti atas āha guṇa iti dṛṣṭaḥ upi ayam abhinne bhoktṛ bhogya bhāvaḥ kiṃnimittaḥ upapadyate iti atas āha abhinne pi iti asti

original: tenābhinne'pi bhoktṛbhogyabhāva upapadyata iti śeṣaḥ | viśeṣasadbhāva eva kuta ityata āha || ayamiti ||
analyzed: tena abhinne pi bhoktṛ bhogya bhāvaḥ upapadyate iti śeṣaḥ viśeṣa sadbhāvaḥ eva kutas iti atas āha ayam iti

original: nanvayaṃ viśeṣo viśeṣite'nyo'nanyo vā? ādye bhedaparamparayā'navasthā | dvitīye viśeṣaviśeṣibhāvavyavahārāyodaḥ | tatrāpi viśeṣāṅgīkāre'navasthetyata āha || viśeṣo'pīti || viśeṣo viśeṣito'nanya iti na bhedaparamparayā'navasthā |
analyzed: nanu ayam viśeṣaḥ vā ādye bheda paramparayā anavasthā dvitīye viśeṣa viśeṣi bhāva vyavahārāya udaḥ tatra api viśeṣa aṅgīkāreṇa avasthā iti atas āha viśeṣaḥ upi iti viśeṣaḥ viśeṣitaḥ unanyaḥ iti na bheda paramparayā anavasthā

original: na eva viśeṣo yathā'bhinne'pi vastuni bhoktṛbhogyabhāvanirvāhakaḥ tathā viśeṣito bhedarahitasyāpi svasya viśeṣatvaṃ, viśeṣiṇo viśeṣitvaṃ ca nirvahatīti na viśeṣaparamparayā'pyanavasthetyarthaḥ | itopyekasyaiva harerbhoktṛbhogyabhāvo yukta ityāha || parameti ||
analyzed: na eva viśeṣaḥ yathā a bhinne api vastuni bhoktṛ bhogya bhāva nirvāhakaḥ tathā viśeṣitaḥ bheda rahitasya api svasya viśeṣa tvam viśeṣiṇaḥ viśeṣi tvam ca nirvahati iti na viśeṣa paramparayā api anavasthā iti arthaḥ itas upi ekasya eva hareḥ bhoktṛ bhogya bhāvaḥ yuktaḥ iti āha parama iti

original: abhinnasyaiva svasya bhoktṛbhogyabhāve'nupapattiṃ parihartuṃ hareraiśvaryaṃ kuta ityata āha || yukteti || yuktāyuktatvaṃ vastunoriti śeṣaḥ | tatra īśvare | tarhīśvare duḥkhitvādyapi kalpyatāmayuktyabhāvādityata uktam | pramāṇeti || ekasyaiva bhoktṛbhogyatvādikaṃ pramāṇāvagatatvādviruddhamapyaiśvaryabalādaṅgīkāryaṃ nānyat |
analyzed: abhinnasya eva svasya bhoktṛ bhogya bhāvena upapattim parihartum hareḥ aiśvaryam kutas iti atas āha yukta iti yukta ayukta tvam vastunoḥ iti śeṣaḥ tatra īśvare tarhi īśvare duḥkhi tva ādi api kalpyatām ayukti abhāvāt iti atas uktam pramāṇa iti ekasya eva bhoktṛ bhogyatva ādikam pramāṇa avagata tvāt viruddham api aiśvarya balāt aṅgīkāryam na anyat

original: tasyāprāmāṇikatvāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tasya aprāmāṇika tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: ekasyaiva bhoktṛbhogyabhāvādiguṇā eveśvarasya pramāṇikā na duḥkhādidoṣā ityatra śrutyantaraṃ cāha || guṇā iti || kathaṃ na doṣāḥ śrutāḥ? "janitota viṣṇoḥ"ityādau pratīterityata āha || ajñairiti ||
analyzed: ekasya eva bhoktṛ bhogya bhāva ādi guṇāḥ eva īśvarasya pramāṇikāḥ na duḥkha ādi doṣāḥ iti atra śruti antaram ca āha guṇāḥ iti katham na doṣāḥ śrutāḥ janitā uta viṣṇoḥ ityādau pratīteḥ iti atas āha ajñaiḥ iti

original: pirakṛtaguṇānāṃ bhagavatā'bhede, sarvāṇyapi rūpāṇyovaṃvidhānītyatra ca śrutīrāha || ekamiti || ekam ekatvahaṅkhyāyogi | evetyavahavādibhedanirākaraṇam | advitīyaṃ samābhyadhikarahitam | kiñcana nāneti rūpāvayavaguṇakarmabhedaḥ | tarhi bhedābhedau syātāmityata āha || mṛtyoriti || mṛtyoḥ mṛtyuṃ tama āpnoti |
analyzed: bhagavatā abhede sarvāṇi api rūpāṇi ovaṃvidhāni iti atra ca śrutīḥ āha ekam iti ekam eka tva ahaṅkhyā yogi eva iti avahava ādi bheda nirākaraṇam advitīyam sama abhyadhika rahitam kiñcana nānā iti rūpa avayava guṇa karma bhedaḥ tarhi bheda abhedau syātām iti atas āha mṛtyoḥ iti mṛtyoḥ mṛtyum tamaḥ āpnoti

original: nāneveti bhedābhedau bhedadarśane ko'nartha ityata āha || yatheti || yathā parvateṣu durge śikhare vṛṣṭamudakam adho vidhāvati evaṃ guṇādīn bhinnān paśyan tān dṛṣṭānanu teṣāmeva darśanāntaramadho vidhāvatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: nānā iva iti bheda abhedau bheda darśane kaḥ anarthaḥ iti atas āha yathā iti yathā parvateṣu durge śikhare vṛṣṭam udakam adhas vidhāvati evam guṇa ādīn bhinnān paśyan tān dṛṣṭān anu teṣām eva darśana antaram adhas vidhāvati iti arthaḥ

original: sarvādvaitaparāḥ śrutaya etā ityatastāḥ smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || matsyeti || atyantābhede vyavahārabhedaḥ kiṃnimitta ityata āha || abhede'pīti || yadyabhinnaṣu guṇādiviśeṣeṣu viśeṣo varitate tarhi viśeṣiṇāṃ viśeṣasya tathābhedaviśeṣayoḥ bhedo'bhedo vā | ādeye'nasthā | dvitīye vyavahāraviśeṣāyogaḥ | tatrāpi viśeṣāṅgīkāre'navasthaivetyata āha ||
analyzed: sarva advaita parāḥ śrutayaḥ etāḥ iti atas tāḥ smṛtyā eva vyācaṣṭe matsya iti atyanta abhede vyavahāra bhedaḥ kiṃnimittaḥ iti atas āha abhede pi iti yadi abhinnaṣu guṇa ādi viśeṣeṣu viśeṣaḥ tarhi viśeṣiṇām viśeṣasya tathā abheda viśeṣayoḥ bhedaḥ bhedaḥ vā dvitīye vyavahāra viśeṣa ayogaḥ tatra api viśeṣa aṅgīkāreṇa avasthā eva iti atas āha

original: viśeṣiṇāmiti || viśeṣiṇāṃ viśeṣasya tathābhedaviśeṣayoḥ bhedābhāvānna bhedaparamparayā'navasthā | na ca vyavahāraviśeṣānupapattiḥ | yatantatta viśeṣo'ṅgīkriyate | na caivaṃ viśeṣaparamparayā'navasthā | ya eva viśeṣo'bhinneṣvapi guṇaguṇyādiṣu vyavahārabhedanirvāhakaḥ sa eva viśeṣo viśeṣaviṣeṣyādivyavahārabhedanirvāhaka ityaṅgīkārādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: viśeṣiṇām iti viśeṣiṇām viśeṣasya tathā abheda viśeṣayoḥ bheda abhāvāt na bheda paramparayā anavasthā na ca vyavahāra viśeṣa anupapattiḥ viśeṣaḥ uṅgīkriyate na ca evam viśeṣa paramparayā anavasthā yaḥ eva viśeṣaḥ bhinneṣu api guṇa guṇi ādiṣu vyavahāra bheda nirvāhakaḥ saḥ eva viśeṣaḥ iti aṅgīkārāt iti arthaḥ

original: matstādīnāmabhede'pi indrārjunādivattāratamyamapi nāstītyāha || prādurbhāveti ||
analyzed: matsta ādīnām abhede pi indrārjuna ādi vat tāratamyam api na asti iti āha prādurbhāva iti

original: ke te matsyādayaḥ prādurbhāvā ityata uktameva vivṛṇoti || matsyeti || brahmādayo'pi bhagavadavatāratvenānyatrocyante | te hi kimatrādiśabdena gṛhītā utānavatārā evetyapekṣāyāmāha || brahmeti || tarhyati || tarhyavatāratvokteḥ kā gatirityata āha || viṣṇuneti || āveśāviśeṣavattayā taduktirityāśayaḥ | sākṣādavatārā eva kiṃ na syurityata āha ||
analyzed: ke te matsya ādayaḥ prādurbhāvāḥ iti atas uktam eva vivṛṇoti matsya iti brahma ādayaḥ api bhagavat avatāra tvena anyatra ucyante te hi kim atra ādi śabdena gṛhītāḥ uta anavatārāḥ eva iti apekṣāyām āha brahma iti tarhi ati tarhi avatāra tva ukteḥ kā gatiḥ iti atas āha viṣṇunā iti āveśa aviśeṣavat tayā tad uktiḥ iti āśayaḥ sākṣāt avatārāḥ eva kim na syuḥ iti atas āha

original: saṃsariṇa iti || teṣveveti || śeṣasanatkumārāniruddhaśakrayamāśviṣu lakṣmaṇabharataśatrughnabalapradyumnāniruddhanarārjunayudhiṣṭhiranakulasahadevatvena jāteṣvatyarthaḥ | arjunādicaturṣu naikaprakārāveśa ityāha || svalpa iti || avatārāṇāmanavatāratvenānavatārāṇāmavatāratvena jñānaṃ saṅ‌karajñānam || 25 ||
analyzed: saṃsariṇaḥ iti teṣu eva iti śeṣa sanatkumāra aniruddha śakra yama aśviṣu lakṣmaṇa bharata śatrughna bala pradyumna aniruddha nara arjuna yudhiṣṭhira nakula sahadeva tvena jāteṣu atyarthaḥ arjuna ādi caturṣu na eka prakāra āveśaḥ iti āha su alpaḥ iti avatārāṇām anavatāra tvena anavatārāṇām avatāra tvena jñānam saṅkara jñānam

original: evaṃ svayaṃ yuktīruktvā śoko na kārya ityuktam | tatra dehasiddham | tenaiva śoko na kārya ityucyate "atheti"| tatra muktasyāpi jananamaraṇasadbhāvaṃ parākarvanneva ślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe || tiṣṭhatviti || "atha ca" ityasyārthastiṣṭhatviti | tathāpītyanūdya tāvanmātrajñānenāpīti vyākhyānam‌ |
analyzed: evam svayam yuktīḥ uktvā śokaḥ na kāryaḥ iti uktam tatra deha siddham tena eva śokaḥ na kāryaḥ iti ucyate atha iti tatra muktasya api janana maraṇa sadbhāvam parākarvan eva ślokam vyācaṣṭe tiṣṭhatu iti atha ca iti asya arthaḥ tiṣṭhatu iti tathā api iti anūdya tāvat mātra jñānena api iti vyākhyānam

original: nityapadasya niyamavācitve mānābhāvātkathaṃ niyameneti vyākhyetyata āha || nityamiti || evaṃ nityapadasyobhayārthatve niyamārthagrahaṇe ko heturityata āha || atra tviti || etacchlokārthavivaraṇātmakottaraśloke nityapadasya dhruva iti vivṛtatvādityarthaḥ || 26 ||
analyzed: nitya padasya niyama vāci tve māna abhāvāt katham niyamena iti vyākhyā iti atas āha nityam iti evam nitya padasya ubhaya artha tve niyama artha grahaṇe kaḥ hetuḥ iti atas āha atra tu iti etad śloka artha vivaraṇa ātmaka uttaraśloke nitya padasya dhruvaḥ iti vivṛta tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: jananamaraṇaniyamo'tra śokanivāraṇe hetutayoktaḥ sphuṭaṃ pratīyate | prāgabhiprete jīvasyāsvātantrye ca hetutayā'bhimata iti bhāvenā'ha || tanmāditi || tasmājjananādiniyamavattvādeva | atra jīve svātantryabuddhiśca na kāryetyarthaḥ || 27 ||
analyzed: janana maraṇa niyamaḥ utra śoka nivāraṇe hetutayā uktaḥ sphuṭam pratīyate prāk abhiprete jīvasya asvātantrye ca hetutayā abhimataḥ iti bhāvena āha tad māt iti tasmāt janana ādi niyamavat tvāt eva atra jīve svātantrya buddhiḥ ca na kāryā iti arthaḥ

original: yadi jīve nāścaryabuddhiḥ kāryā tarhi kutrāsau kāryā? īsvara ityuktamiti cetsatyam | kiṃ tato'nyatrāpi kvacidityāśaṃkya tatparihāratvenoktopasaṃhārarūpaṃ ślokamavatārayati || kiṃ tarhīti || nanvatrāścaryo'nya eva, īśvarastu tatsadṛśa eva, na svayamāścarya iti pratīteḥ kathamāścaryo bhagavānevetyucyata ityata āha || āścaryamiti ||
analyzed: yadi jīve na āścarya buddhiḥ kāryā tarhi kutra asau kāryā īsvaraḥ iti uktam iti ced satyam kim tatas nyatra api kvacid iti āśaṃkya tad parihāra tvena ukta upasaṃhāra rūpam ślokam avatārayati kim tarhi iti nanu atra āścaryaḥ nyaḥ eva īśvaraḥ tu tad sadṛśaḥ eva na svayam āścaryaḥ iti pratīteḥ katham āścaryaḥ bhagavān eva iti ucyate iti atas āha āścaryam iti

original: āścaryavadityanena neśvarasyānāścaryatvamabhipreyate kintvāścaryasyaiva sata āścaryopamatvamucyata iti bhāvaḥ | evamapi bhagavaditarasya svātantryamaṅgīkāryam | tasyaiva svatantratāyāmāścaryavadityuktyasambhavāt | svopamāyāḥ kvāpyadarśanāt | tathāca bhagavānevetyavadhāraṇāyoga ityata āha || gaganamiti ||
analyzed: āścarya vat iti anena na īśvarasya anāścarya tvam abhipreyate kintu āścaryasya eva sataḥ āścarya upama tvam ucyate iti bhāvaḥ evam api bhagavat itarasya svātantryam aṅgīkāryam tasya eva svatantra tāyām āścarya vat iti ukti asambhavāt svopamāyāḥ kvāpi adarśanāt tathāca bhagavān eva iti avadhāraṇa ayogaḥ iti atas āha gaganam iti

original: itivatsvopamābhidhānamukhena bhagavaditarasya svātantryābhāve tātparyamatreti bhāvaḥ | sāgaraṃ sāgarasamūhaḥ |
analyzed: itivat svopama abhidhāna mukhena bhagavat itarasya svātantrya abhāve tātparyam atra iti bhāvaḥ sāgaram sāgara samūhaḥ

original: pratīta evārthaḥ kiṃ na syādityataḥ svoktārthe smṛtisammatimāha || āścarya iti || tadgocaramityanena "āścaryavat" ityetatkriyāviśeṣamityuktaṃ bhavati | nanu bhagavānāścarya eva cettarhi sarveṣāmapyāścaryatvāt "kaścit" iti viśeṣaṇaṃ vyartham | na hi stambhaḥ kasyacideva stambha ityata āha || anāścaryavaditi || yadyapīśvaraḥ sarveṣāmāścarya eva |
analyzed: pratītaḥ eva arthaḥ kim na syāt iti atas sva ukta arthe smṛti sammatim āha āścaryaḥ iti tad gocaram iti anena āścarya vat iti etat kriyā viśeṣam iti uktam bhavati nanu bhagavān āścaryaḥ eva ced tarhi sarveṣām api āścarya tvāt kaścid iti viśeṣaṇam vyartham na hi stambhaḥ kasyacid eva stambhaḥ iti atas āha anāścarya vat iti yadi api īśvaraḥ sarveṣām āścaryaḥ eva

original: tathāpi viparītadarśināṃ bahūnāṃ bhāvādyathāvaddarśinaḥ kasyacideva bhāvādāścaryatayā darśanaṃ vivakṣya kaśyiditi viśeṣaṇaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ || 29||
analyzed: tathā api viparīta darśinām bahūnām bhāvāt yathāvat darśinaḥ kasyacid eva bhāvāt āścarya tayā darśanam vivakṣya kaśyid iti viśeṣaṇam yuktam iti bhāvaḥ

original: ākṣipati || dehīti || jīvo nitya ityuktam | tatra kiṃ svata eva nityo'theśvarasāmarthyena? nādyaḥ | sarvaṃ parameśvarādhīnamityabhimatavirodhāt | na dvitīyaḥ | nityasya svābhāvikatveneśvarādhīnatvānupapatteriti bhāvaḥ | etatparihārāya dehīti ślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe || yasmāditi || dehe rakṣakatvena sthitaścet pralayādau nāśaḥ syādityata uktam ||
analyzed: ākṣipati dehi iti jīvaḥ nityaḥ iti uktam tatra kim svatas eva nitya utha īśvara sāmarthyena na ādyaḥ sarvam parameśvara adhīnam iti abhimata virodhāt na dvitīyaḥ nityasya svābhāvika tvena īśvara adhīna tva anupapatteḥ iti bhāvaḥ etad parihārāya dehi iti ślokam vyācaṣṭe yasmāt iti dehe rakṣaka tvena sthitaḥ ced pralaya ādau nāśaḥ syāt iti atas uktam

original: sūkṣma iti || sūkṣmadehapadena liṅgaśarīraṃ caitanyaśarīraṃ cocyate | nityatvādeḥ svābhāvikatvātkathamīśvarādhīnatvamityata āha || dravyamiti || svābhāvikatve'pi nityatvāderīśvarādhīnatvaṃ yujyate | svābhāvasyāpi bhagavadadhīnatayā smṛtisiddhatvāditi bhāvaḥ | jīvasattāyā bhagavadadhīnatve ceyaṃ smṛtiḥ pramāṇam |
analyzed: sūkṣmaḥ iti sūkṣma deha padena liṅga śarīram caitanya śarīram ca ucyate nitya tva ādeḥ svābhāvika tvāt katham īśvara adhīnatvam iti atas āha dravyam iti svābhāvika tve api nitya tva ādeḥ īśvara adhīnatvam yujyate sva abhāvasya api bhagavat adhīnatayā smṛti siddha tvāt iti bhāvaḥ jīva sattāyāḥ bhagavat adhīnatve ca iyam smṛtiḥ pramāṇam

original: tathāpi jīve sthitvā tadrakṣaka īśvara iti viśeṣaḥ kuta ityata āha || tatrate || tataḥ tadadhīne | tatastasmāttannintṛtvāt | bhāvābhāvayorapi nityānityābahirbhāvāt || 30 ||
analyzed: tathā api jīve sthitvā tad rakṣakaḥ īśvaraḥ iti viśeṣaḥ kutas iti atas āha tatrate tatas tad adhīne tatas tasmāt tad nintṛ tvāt bhāva abhāvayoḥ api nitya anitya abahirbhāvāt

original: "yadvā jayema" ityuktasya pakṣadvaye'pyahāniḥ parihāra ucyate "hato veti" | tatra "hato vā prāpsyasi svargam" ityatreva "jitvā vā bhokṣyase mahīm"ityatrāpi mahīmātraṃ na svarga ityanyathāpratīnirāsāyā'ha || jitveti || "yuddhe mṛta eva svargaṃ prāpsyasi, jitvā mahīmeva bhokṣyase" iti pratīta evārthaḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha || ya iti ||
analyzed: yat vā jayema iti uktasya pakṣa dvaye pi ahāniḥ parihāraḥ ucyate hataḥ vā iti tatra hataḥ vā prāpsyasi svargam iti atra iva jitvā vā bhokṣyase mahīm iti atra api mahī mātram na svargaḥ iti anyathā pratī nirāsāya āha jitvā iti yuddhe mṛtaḥ eva svargam prāpsyasi jitvā mahīm eva bhokṣyase iti pratītaḥ eva arthaḥ kim na syāt iti atas āha ye iti

original: ye śūrāḥ yuddheṣu pirayudhyanti, ye ca tatra mriyante, ye ca sahasrasaṅkhyātadhanadakṣiṇādātāraḥ tānevāyaṃ preto'pi gacchatāditi yamaṃ pirati pretasya svargaprārthanājjaye'pi svargaprāptiḥ śrūyate | ato na pratīta evārtha iti bhāvaḥ || 37 ||
analyzed: ye śūrāḥ yuddheṣu ye ca tatra mriyante ye ca sahasra saṅkhyāta dhana dakṣiṇā dātāraḥ tān eva ayam pretaḥ api gacchatāt iti yamam pirati pretasya svarga prārthanāt jaye api svarga prāptiḥ śrūyate atas na pratītaḥ eva arthaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: uktamupasaṃhṛtya prakaraṇāntaramārabhyate "eṣeti" | tatra sāṅkhyayogaśabdau darśanaviśeṣaparāviti pratītinirāsāya tadarthaṃ sapramāṇakamāha || samyagiti || atroktayoḥ sāṅkhyayogayorbuddhya yukta iti praśastatvāditarayorninditatvānna tāvatroktāviti bhāvaḥ | ito'pi na sāṅkhyapadenātra prasiddhasāṅkhyaṃ vivakṣitamityāha || sāṅkhyasyeti ||
analyzed: uktam upasaṃhṛtya prakaraṇa antaram ārabhyate eṣā iti tatra sāṅkhya yoga śabdau darśana viśeṣa parau iti pratīti nirāsāya tad artham sapramāṇakam āha samyak iti atra uktayoḥ sāṅkhya yogayoḥ yuktaḥ iti praśasta tvāt itarayoḥ nindita tvāt na tau atra uktau iti bhāvaḥ itas api na sāṅkhya padena atra prasiddha sāṅkhyam vivakṣitam iti āha sāṅkhyasya iti

original: atira sāṅkhyapadena prasiddhasāṅkhyagrahaṇe sāṅkhyoktamabhihitamityuktaṃ syāt | na ca tadyuktam | atra "na jāyate"ityādāvīśvarasyoktatvāt, sāṅkhyasya nirīśvaratvāt | ataśca nātra sāṅkhyaṃ śāstraviśeṣa ityarthaḥ | ito'pi nātra sāṅkhyayogaśabdau prasiddhaśāstraparāvityāha || sāṅkhyairiti || atra pūrvottaraprakaraṇayoḥ |
analyzed: sāṅkhya padena prasiddha sāṅkhya grahaṇe sāṅkhya uktam abhihitam iti uktam syāt na ca tat yuktam atra na jāyate ityādau īśvarasya ukta tvāt sāṅkhyasya nirīśvara tvāt atas ca na atra sāṅkhyam śāstra viśeṣaḥ iti arthaḥ itas api na atra sāṅkhya yoga śabdau prasiddha śāstra parau iti āha sāṅkhyaiḥ iti atra pūrva uttara prakaraṇayoḥ

original: sāṅkhyādibhiḥ pāratrikānarthahetutvameva hiṃsāyā aṅgīkriyate | na tvaihike | atira punā rājyārthameva hiṃsā vidhīyate | ato na virodha ityata āha || mokṣeti || sāṅkhyayogaśabdayoḥ sopapattikamarthāntaraṃ cāha || parameti || pūrvottaraprakaraṇoktārthapratipādakatvādityarthaḥ | na virodho'tra taduktagrahaṇa iti śeṣaḥ || 39 ||
analyzed: sāṅkhya ādibhiḥ pāratrika anartha hetutvam eva hiṃsāyāḥ aṅgīkriyate na tu aihike punar rājya artham eva hiṃsā vidhīyate atas na virodhaḥ iti atas āha mokṣa iti sāṅkhya yoga śabdayoḥ sopapattikam artha antaram ca āha parama iti pūrva uttara prakaraṇa ukta artha pratipādaka tvāt iti arthaḥ na virodhaḥ utra tad ukta grahaṇe iti śeṣaḥ

original: yogaḥ stūyate neheti | tatra yogātikrame nāśaḥ pratyavāyaśca nāstītyanyathāpratītinirāsāya pūrvārdhe smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || prārambheti || tameva viṣṇudharmaṃ smṛtyā darśayati || svociteneti || pravṛttirhitakaraṇamapravṛttirniṣiddhaparityāgaścānyaviṣaye nānuṣṭhīyata ityarthaḥ | tasmin dharme'dhikārikālapramāṇānyāha || enamiti || tameva vivṛṇoti ||
analyzed: yogaḥ stūyate na iha iti tatra yoga atikrame nāśaḥ pratyavāyaḥ ca na asti iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya pūrva ardhe smṛtyā eva vyācaṣṭe prārambha iti tam eva viṣṇu dharmam smṛtyā darśayati svocitena iti pravṛttiḥ hita karaṇam apravṛttiḥ niṣiddha parityāgaḥ ca anya viṣaye na anuṣṭhīyate iti arthaḥ tasmin dharma ādhikāri kāla pramāṇāni āha enam iti tam eva vivṛṇoti

original: taditi || kārtayugatve tretādiṣu na phalaprado'nadhyāyādhītavedavadityata āha || treteti || kārtayugatvoktistatra prācuryeṇa sambhavābhiprāyeṇeti bhāvaḥ | kimasya phalaṃ yat‌tretādiṣvadhikaṃ syādityata āha || evamiti || kathaṃ sa eva mucyate? traividyasāyapi mokṣasadbhāvādityataḥ traividyadharmasvarūpamuktvā tadvato mokṣābhāvamāha ||
analyzed: tat iti kārtayuga tve tretā ādiṣu na phala pradaḥ ūnadhyāya adhīta veda vat iti atas āha tretā iti kārtayuga tva uktiḥ tatra prācuryeṇa sambhava abhiprāyeṇa iti bhāvaḥ kim asya phalam yat tretā ādiṣu adhikam syāt iti atas āha evam iti katham saḥ eva mucyate mokṣa sadbhāvāt iti atas traividya dharma svarūpam uktvā tadvataḥ mokṣa abhāvam āha
