original: traividya iti || traividyasyāpi bhagavajjñānādisadbhāvāttasyaiva mokṣahetutvātkathamasau svargaṃ bhuktvā nivartata ityata āha || samyagiti || kiṃ tasya kadāpi na mokṣa ityataḥ svargagamanāvadhikathanenaivārthataḥ siddhamarthaṃ sphuṭamāha || krameṇeti || ante samarpayan traividyo yadi niyamāt pratyekaṃ sarvāṇi samarpayatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: traividyaḥ iti traividyasya api bhagavat jñāna ādi sadbhāvāt tasya eva mokṣa hetutvāt katham asau svargam bhuktvā nivartate iti atas āha samyak iti kim tasya kadāpi na mokṣaḥ iti atas svarga gamana avadhi kathanena eva arthataḥ siddham artham sphuṭam āha krameṇa iti ante samarpayan traividyaḥ yadi niyamāt pratyekam sarvāṇi samarpayati iti arthaḥ

original: trayyuktakarmakaraṇamātreṇa traividyo bhavetkiṃ bhagavatsarvottamatvajñānādinetyata āha || paramiti || vedavāditvasya bhāgavatatraividyayorapi sāmyādasyaiva kimucyata ityato na vedānusāritvaṃ vedavāditvamatrābhipretamiti bhāvenāha || vāda iti || vivādātpaṭhanāditi || vivādapūrvakapaṭhanādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: trayī ukta karma karaṇa mātreṇa traividyaḥ bhavet kim bhagavat sarva uttama tva jñāna ādinā iti atas āha param iti veda vādi tvasya bhāgavata traividyayoḥ api sāmyāt asya eva kim ucyate iti atas na veda anusāri tvam veda vādi tvam atra abhipretam iti bhāvena āha vādaḥ iti vivādāt paṭhanāt iti vivāda pūrvaka paṭhanāt iti arthaḥ

original: astvevaṃ vedavāditvaṃ tathāpi tena mokṣādisiddheḥ kathaṃ bhāgavatasyaiva mokṣa ukta ityataḥ pāṣaṇḍādivattasya niṣiddhatvānna mokṣasādhanatvamiti bhāvenāha || vedeti || na kevalaṃ mokṣanādhanatvābhāvo'pi tu tamaḥsādhanatvaṃ cāstītyāha || tebhya iti || "anārambhamanantaṃ ca" iti tamasi duḥkhānubhavānuvṛtterādyantaśūnyatvamucyate |
analyzed: astu evam veda vādi tvam tathā api tena mokṣa ādi siddheḥ katham bhāgavatasya eva mokṣaḥ uktaḥ iti atas pāṣaṇḍa ādi vat tasya niṣiddha tvāt na mokṣa sādhanatvam iti bhāvena āha veda iti na kevalam mokṣa nādhanatva abhāvaḥ upi tu tamaḥ sādhanatvam ca asti iti āha tebhyaḥ iti anārambham anantam ca iti tamasi duḥkha anubhava anuvṛtteḥ ādi anta śūnyatvam ucyate

original: "yasmānnaivotthitiḥ" iti tatpraptānāmapunarāvṛttirucyate | tamasaḥ punarāvṛttirāhityaṃ kuta ityata āha || vavramiti || svagatānāṃ gamanaṃ vārayatīti vā, sadā vṛṇotīti vā varamānandaṃ vārayatīti vā vavram | "ityādivedamaditam || 40 ||
analyzed: yasmāt na eva utthitiḥ iti tad praptānām apunarāvṛttiḥ ucyate tamasaḥ punarāvṛtti rāhityam kutas iti atas āha vavram iti svagatānām gamanam vārayati iti vā sadā vṛṇoti iti vā varam ānandam vārayati iti vā vavram iti ādi veda maditam

original: evaṃvidhaścedayaṃ vaiṣṇavo dharmaḥ tarhi kimiti kaiścidevaikamatyenānuṣṭhīyate, parasparaviruddhatayā bahubhirnānuṣṭhīyata ityata āha || buddhiriti || keṣāñcideva buddhernirṇītatvāttāvanta evaikamatyena viṣṇuparāyaṇāḥ | bahūnāmanirṇītabuddhitvātparasparavirodhena na viṣṇuparatvamiti bhāvaḥ | anena vyavasāyeti ślokopi vyākhyāto bhavati || 41 ||
analyzed: evaṃvidhaḥ ced ayam vaiṣṇavaḥ dharmaḥ tarhi kim iti kaiścid eva ekamatyena anuṣṭhīyate paraspara viruddha tayā bahubhiḥ na anuṣṭhīyate iti atas āha buddhiḥ iti keṣāñcid eva buddheḥ nirṇīta tvāt tāvantaḥ eva ekamatyena viṣṇu parāyaṇāḥ bahūnām anirṇīta buddhi tvāt paraspara virodhena na viṣṇu paratvam iti bhāvaḥ anena vyavasāya iti ślokaḥ api vyākhyātaḥ bhavati

original: yadyavyavasāyātmakabuddhitvameva vaiṣṇavadharmarāhitye nimittaṃ tarhyavyavasāyabuddhistyājyā syāt | tyagaśca kāraṇaparityagena syāt | kena kāraṇenāvyavasāyabuddhirbhavatīti pṛcchati || avyavasāyeti || tatparihārāya "yām"iti ślokān yojayati || yāmiti || samādhāna iti niścayasya tattvaviṣayatayā dārḍhyamucyate |
analyzed: yadi avyavasāya ātmaka buddhi tvam eva vaiṣṇava dharma rāhitye nimittam tarhi avyavasāya buddhiḥ tyājyā syāt tyagaḥ ca kāraṇa parityagena syāt kena kāraṇena avyavasāya buddhiḥ bhavati iti pṛcchati avyavasāya iti tad parihārāya yām iti ślokān yojayati yām iti samādhāne iti niścayasya tattva viṣaya tayā dārḍhyam ucyate

original: samādhānābhāve ca na viṣṇudharmānuṣṭhānamiti vākyaśeṣaḥ |
analyzed: samādhāna abhāve ca na viṣṇu dharma anuṣṭhānam iti vākyaśeṣaḥ

original: smṛtyaiva ślokān vyācaṣṭe || yatheti || tathā tathāviṣayīkāri | tatsāmyāditi || vastadusāmyādityarthaḥ | asatāṃ vākyaṃ kuto vaiṣamyaheturityata āha || svargeti || yadyasmāt | nānyadastītyasyārthadvayamāha || na manyanta iti || anugatiḥ prāptiḥ | kriyābāhulyasantatām etatpratipādakām | janmetyasyārtho bahviti | anta ityabhiprāyamātram |
analyzed: smṛtyā eva ślokān vyācaṣṭe yathā iti tathā tathā viṣayīkāri tad sāmyāt iti vaḥ tad usāmyāt iti arthaḥ asatām vākyam kutas vaiṣamya hetuḥ iti atas āha svarga iti yat yasmāt na anyat asti iti asya artha dvayam āha na manyante iti anugatiḥ prāptiḥ kriyā bāhulya santatām etad pratipādakām janma iti asya arthaḥ bahu iti ante iti abhiprāya mātram

original: nānyadastītyādyarthe śrutiṃ yāha || iṣṭeti || anyacchreyo bhagavajjñānādi | sukṛte sukṛtaprāpye | anubhūtvā | bhogāniti śeṣaḥ | vedavādaratatvamuktārthatayā niṣiddhamityatra pramāṇāntaraṃ cāha || vedeti || iṣṭāpūrtaṃ variṣṭhaṃ manyamānāḥ kecana svargabhogānantaramimaṃ lokaṃ viśanti | kecana hīnataraṃ viśantītyuktam | tatsmṛtyā vivṛṇoti ||
analyzed: na anyat asti ityādi arthe śrutim yā āha iṣṭa iti anyat śreyaḥ bhagavat jñāna ādi sukṛte sukṛta prāpye anubhūtvā bhogān iti śeṣaḥ veda vāda rata tvam ukta artha tayā niṣiddham iti atra pramāṇa antaram ca āha veda iti iṣṭāpūrtam variṣṭham manyamānāḥ kecana svarga bhoga anantaram imam lokam viśanti kecana hīnataram viśanti iti uktam tad smṛtyā vivṛṇoti

original: ya iti || saṃśayāt saṃśayena | viṣayīkurvantīti śeṣaḥ | śraddhādisadbhāvave kathaṃ tattvajñānābhāvaḥ? "śraddhāvān sabhate jñānam" ityāderityata āha || nirṇetṛṇāmiti || tattvajñānarahitaśraddhādikamevaitatphalapradaṃ cettarhi kiyān viśeṣastattvajñānināṃ bhavadityata āha || yairiti || ādhikye ciraṃ neti ||
analyzed: ye iti saṃśayāt saṃśayena viṣayīkurvanti iti śeṣaḥ śraddhā ādi sadbhāvave katham tattva jñāna abhāvaḥ śraddhāvān sabhate jñānam ityādeḥ iti atas āha nirṇetṛṇām iti tattva jñāna rahita śraddhā ādikam eva etat phala pradam ced tarhi kiyān viśeṣaḥ tattva jñāninām bhavat iti atas āha yaiḥ iti ādhikye ciram na iti

original: brahmahatyāderapyadhikapāpācaraṇe'pyalpakālaṃ yātanāṃ yānti || na tu ciramityarthaḥ | yajñādimātreṇa bhagavad‌dveṣiṇāmapi svargasiddheḥ kiṃ jijñāsādinetyata āha || tadanyeṣāmiti || viparītaniścayānāmaśvamedhādibhirapi na svargaṃ ityarthaḥ | duryodhanādīnāṃ dveṣiṇāmeva svargādidarśanāt kathametadityata āha || ye tviti ||
analyzed: brahmahatyā ādeḥ api adhika pāpa ācaraṇe pi alpa kālam yātanām yānti na tu ciram iti arthaḥ yajña ādi mātreṇa bhagavat dveṣiṇām api svarga siddheḥ kim jijñāsā ādinā iti atas āha tad anyeṣām iti viparīta niścayānām aśvamedha ādibhiḥ api na svargam iti arthaḥ duryodhana ādīnām dveṣiṇām eva svarga ādi darśanāt katham etat iti atas āha ye tu iti

original: tathāpi dveṣiṇāṃ svargaprāptisadbhāvāt kathaṃ tadanyeṣāṃ viparyaya ityuktamityata āha || tadanya iti || bhāgavatācāryavarjitad‌dveṣyabhiprāyeṇa taduktamiti bhāvaḥ | anena "imaṃ lokam" ityajñaviṣayam | pramūḍhatvamajñatvameva | hīnataramiti tvavaiṣṇavācāryavadbhagavaddveṣiviṣayam | teṣāṃ pramūḍhatvaṃ mithyājñānitvamityuktaṃ bhavati || 42 -44 ||
analyzed: tathā api dveṣiṇām svarga prāpti sadbhāvāt katham tad anyeṣām viparyayaḥ iti uktam iti atas āha tad anye iti bhāgavata ācārya varjita ddveṣi abhiprāyeṇa tat uktam iti bhāvaḥ anena imam lokam iti ajña viṣayam pramūḍha tvam ajña tvam eva hīnataram iti tu avaiṣṇava ācārya vat bhagavat dveṣi viṣayam teṣām pramūḍha tvam mithyājñāni tvam iti uktam bhavati 42 42

original: pratijñāto jñānopāya ucyate || "traiguṇyeti" || tatra vedānāṃ traiguṇyaviṣayatvāt tān parityajya nistraiguṇyo bhavetyanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || traiguṇyeti || yāpayantītyasya prāpayantītyanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || apagamayantīti || pratīta evārthaḥ kiṃ na syādityataḥ svoktārthe smṛtisammatimāha || āśrityeti ||
analyzed: pratijñātaḥ jñāna upāyaḥ ucyate traiguṇya iti tatra vedānām traiguṇya viṣaya tvāt tān parityajya nistraiguṇyaḥ bhava iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya āha traiguṇya iti yāpayanti iti asya prāpayanti iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya āha apagamayanti iti pratītaḥ eva arthaḥ kim na syāt iti atas sva ukta arthe smṛti sammatim āha āśritya iti

original: sattvasthatvaṃ sāttvikatvaṃ, ātmavattvaṃ manasvitvamityanyathāpratītinirāsāya tattvātmaśabdārthe smṛtyaivā'ha || sattvamiti || santatiḥ samyagvyāptiḥ | sattvaṃ viṣṇuścet tatsthatvaṃ svabhāvikaṃ kiṃ vidhiyata ityata āha || santateti || na tadādhāratayā'vasthānamātramatra vivakṣitamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: sattva sthatvam sāttvika tvam ātmavat tvam manasvi tvam iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya tattva ātma śabda arthe smṛtyā eva āha sattvam iti santatiḥ samyak vyāptiḥ sattvam viṣṇuḥ ced tad sthatvam svabhāvikam kim vidhiyate iti atas āha santata iti na tad ādhāra tayā avasthāna mātram atra vivakṣitam iti bhāvaḥ

original: ātmā viṣṇuścettadvattvaṃ svabhāvikaṃ na vidheyamityata āha || paramātmeti || na tu tatsambandhamātramiti bhāvaḥ | sattvasthapadenaivāsyārthataḥ prāptatvātkiṃ punarucyata ityata āha || teneti || satataṃ viṣṇusmaraṇamātravidhāvaikyenāpi tatsmaraṇaṃ prāpyate | ata ātmavattvakathanena tannivārya yathāvatsmaraṇaprakāra ucyata iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: ātmā viṣṇuḥ ced tadvat tvam svabhāvikam na vidheyam iti atas āha paramātmā iti na tu tad sambandha mātram iti bhāvaḥ sattvastha padena eva asya arthataḥ prāptatvāt kim punar ucyate iti atas āha tena iti satatam viṣṇu smaraṇa mātra vidhau aikyena api tat smaraṇam prāpyate atas ātmavat tva kathanena tat nivārya yathāvat smaraṇa prakāraḥ ucyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: aprāptaprāptiryogaḥ | prāptaparirakṣaṇaṃ kṣemaḥ | tadubhayaṃ sarvathā tyājyamityanyathāpratītinirāsāyā'ha || viruddheti || na kevalaṃ śāstraviruddhaviṣayayogakṣemaparityāgamātramatra vivakṣitam | api tu tadicchātyāgo'pīti bhāvenecchetyuktam | pratīta evārthaḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha || anyetheti || utthānādīnāmapyaprāptaprāptirūpatvena yogatvāt |
analyzed: aprāpta prāptiḥ yogaḥ prāpta parirakṣaṇam kṣemaḥ tat ubhayam sarvathā tyājyam iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya āha viruddha iti na kevalam śāstra viruddha viṣaya yogakṣema parityāga mātram atra vivakṣitam api tu tad icchā tyāga upī iti bhāvena icchā iti uktam pratītaḥ eva arthaḥ kim na syāt iti atas āha utthāna ādīnām api aprāpta prāpti rūpatvena yoga tvāt

original: tataśca "yogamātiṣṭhottiṣṭha" ityādivirodha iti bhāvaḥ || 45 ||
analyzed: tatas ca yogam ātiṣṭha uttiṣṭha ityādi virodhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: traiguṇyanivṛttyarthaḥ vedāśrayaṇaṃ kāryamityatra yuktirucyate "yāvāniti" | tatrodapānaśabdaṃ, sarvataḥ saṃplutodakaśabdaṃ ca smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || udrekāditi || sarvakāryāṇāṃ pralaye līnatvāt kathaṃ sarvataḥ saṃplutodakaśabdārthatayā pralayo gṛhyata ityata āha || prakṛtiriti ||
analyzed: traiguṇya nivṛtti arthaḥ veda āśrayaṇam kāryam iti atra yuktiḥ ucyate yāvān iti tatra udapāna śabdam sarvatas saṃpluta udaka śabdam ca smṛtyā eva vyācaṣṭe udrekāt iti sarva kāryāṇām pralaye līna tvāt katham sarvatas saṃpluta udaka śabda artha tayā pralayaḥ gṛhyate iti atas āha prakṛtiḥ iti

original: samastaślokaṃ smṛtyā vyācaṣṭe || yāvaditi || sādhakasya sambhavatīti śeṣaḥ | vedajñānena kuto viṣṇuḥ phalaṃ dadātītyata āha || vedeti || astu vedārthajñānaṃ nāma viṣṇujñānam | tathāpi kuto bhāgavān phalaṃ dadātītyata āha || jñānāditi ||
analyzed: samasta ślokam smṛtyā vyācaṣṭe yāvat iti sādhakasya sambhavati iti śeṣaḥ veda jñānena kutas viṣṇuḥ phalam dadāti iti atas āha veda iti astu veda artha jñānam nāma viṣṇu jñānam tathā api kutas bhāgavān phalam dadāti iti atas āha jñānāt iti

original: vākyadvayasiddhaṃ ślokārthamekīkṛtya darśayati || sarvata iti || nanvatra kaścidudriktatvādiguṇaḥ śrūyate | sa viṣṇuriti kutaḥ? anyopi kiṃ na syādityata āha || sarve hīti || muktānāṃ ramāyāścodriktatvāt kathamudriktatvena viṣṇutvaniścaya ityata āha || ye ceti || muktānāmudriktatve'pi pālakavarjitatvābhāvenodapānatvāsambhava iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: vākya dvaya siddham śloka artham ekīkṛtya darśayati sarvatas iti nanu atra kaścid udrikta tva ādi guṇaḥ śrūyate sa viṣṇuḥ iti kutas anyaḥ api kim na syāt iti atas āha sarve hi iti muktānām ramāyāḥ ca udrikta tvāt katham udrikta tvena viṣṇu tva niścayaḥ iti atas āha ye ca iti muktānām udrikta tve api pālaka varjita tva abhāvena udapāna tva asambhavaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: muktānāmudapānatvāsambhave hetvantaraṃ cāha || na ceti || ramāyāḥ sarvābhimīnitvena kālādiceṣṭakatvādasaṅgrahaḥ | kiñcodriktatvaṃ teṣāmaṅgīkṛtameva na tu mukhyatostyato na teṣāmudapānatvamityāha || na ceti || anena ramāyā api ceṣṭakatvamanumatameveti jñāyate | udriktatvāderanyatrāsambhave'pi kimityata āha || ata iti ||
analyzed: muktānām udapāna tva asambhave hetu antaram ca āha na ca iti ramāyāḥ sarva abhimīni tvena kāla ādi ceṣṭaka tvāt asaṅgrahaḥ kiñca udrikta tvam teṣām aṅgīkṛtam eva na tu mukhyatas asti atas na teṣām udapāna tvam iti āha na ca iti anena ramāyāḥ api ceṣṭaka tvam anumatam eva iti jñāyate udrikta tva ādeḥ anyatra asambhave pi kim iti atas āha atas iti

original: kiñcodriktatvādyevānyatra na sambhavati | kimuta sarvataḥ samplutodake | ato'pyudapāno viṣṇurevetyāha || pralaya iti ||
analyzed: kiñca udrikta tva ādi eva anyatra na sambhavati kim uta sarvatas sampluta udake atas api udapānaḥ viṣṇuḥ eva iti āha pralaye iti

original: māstvanyeṣāmasambhavāt sarvataḥ samplutodake'pyudapānatvam | viṣṇorapi tatsambhavaḥ kuta iti cetpariśeṣāditi brūmaḥ | śrutibhyaścetyāha || ānīditi || tadekaṃ brahma vāyupreraṇāṃ vinā svasāmarthyenaiva kālādikaṃ prerayati sma | tasmādanyaduttamaṃ vastu kiñcana nā'sa | api tu tadevodriktamāsa |
analyzed: mā astu anyeṣām asambhavāt sarvatas sampluta udaka ipi udapāna tvam viṣṇoḥ api tad sambhavaḥ kutas iti ced pariśeṣāt iti brūmaḥ śrutibhyaḥ ca iti āha ānīt iti tat ekam brahma vāyu preraṇām vinā sva sāmarthyena eva kāla ādikam prerayati sma tasmāt anyat uttamam vastu kiñcana nā āsa api tu tat eva udriktam āsa

original: aparaṃ tamaḥ prakṛtirasmin sarvasmin deśe'vijñātaṃ salilaṃ bhūtvā'sīt | tena salilena pralaye sarvaṃ gūḍhamāsīdityarthaḥ | asyāgre salile samantātpālakavarjito bhagavānāsīdityarthaḥ | advaitaḥ sarvodriktaḥ || 46 ||
analyzed: aparam tamaḥ prakṛtiḥ asmin sarvasmin deśe vijñātam salilam bhūtvā āsīt tena salilena pralaye sarvam gūḍham āsīt iti arthaḥ asya agre salile samantāt pālaka varjitaḥ bhagavān āsīt iti arthaḥ advaitaḥ sarva udriktaḥ

original: aikyabhāvanaṃ na kāryamityatra heturucyate "karmaṇīti" | tatrārjunasya karmakaraṇe kiñcitsāmarthyamasti, na tu phalāpādana ityevocyate | tatkathamanena sarvajīvānāmīśvarābhedābhāvaḥ sādhyata ityata ityata āha || karmeti || nātra ta ityurjuna eva gṛhyate | api tu sarvajīvāḥ | teṣāṃ phalāpādanāsāmarthyamuktvā īśvare tatsāmarthyamabhipreyate |
analyzed: aikya bhāvanam na kāryam iti atra hetuḥ ucyate karmaṇi iti tatra arjunasya karma karaṇe kiñcid sāmarthyam asti na tu phala āpādane iti eva ucyate tat katham anena sarva jīvānām īśvara abheda abhāvaḥ sādhyate iti atas iti atas āha karma iti na atra te iti urjunaḥ eva gṛhyate api tu sarva jīvāḥ teṣām phala āpādana a sāmarthyam uktvā īśvare tad sāmarthyam abhipreyate

original: tenātroktaivābhedābhāve yuktiriti bhāvaḥ | nanvatrāstvetāvadabhipretam | tathāpi pratijñāyā abhāvādabhedābhāve yuktiriyamukteti kathaṃ jñāyata ityata āha || mā karmeti || phalaheturīśvaraḥ sa mā bhūrmanasetyarthaḥ | atra śrutiṃ cāha || eṣa iti || svayaṃ jīvaḥ || 47 ||
analyzed: tena atra uktā eva abheda abhāve yuktiḥ iti bhāvaḥ nanu atra astu etāvat abhipretam tathā api pratijñāyāḥ abhāvāt abheda abhāve yuktiḥ iyam uktā iti katham jñāyate iti atas āha mā karma iti phala hetuḥ īśvaraḥ sa mā bhūḥ manasā iti arthaḥ atra śrutim ca āha eṣaḥ iti svayam jīvaḥ

original: karmākaraṇe sneho mā'stvityuktam | kiṃ tarhītyata ucyate "yogasthaḥ" iti | tatra karmasaṅgaṃ tyaktvā karmāṇi kurviti vyāhatamityata āha || saṅgamiti || na saṅgapadena karmasambandho'bhidhīyate | yena vyāhatiḥ | api tu phalasneha eveti bhāvaḥ || 48 ||
analyzed: karma akaraṇe snehaḥ mā astu iti uktam kim tarhi iti atas ucyate yoga sthaḥ iti tatra karma saṅgam tyaktvā karmāṇi kuru iti vyāhatam iti atas āha saṅgam iti na saṅga padena karma sambandhaḥ abhidhīyate yena vyāhatiḥ api tu phala snehaḥ eva iti bhāvaḥ

original: jñānātkarmādhamamityuktam | tarhi jñānasyottamatvāt jñānāvāsthāyāmīśvaraikyabhāvanaṃ yuktamityāśaṃkāparihārāyocyate buddhāviti | tatraitacchaṃkāparihāraḥ kathamukta ityata āha || buddhāviti || asminnevārthe smṛtisammatiṃ darśayaṃstayaivottarapādamapi vyācaṣṭe || ajñānāmiti || phalahetupadavyākhyānaṃ "taṃ ye svaikyena" ityādi pūrvavat |
analyzed: jñānāt karma adhamam iti uktam tarhi jñānasya uttama tvāt jñānau āsthāyām īśvara aikya bhāvanam yuktam iti āśaṃkā parihārāya ucyate buddhau iti tatra etad śaṃkā parihāraḥ katham uktaḥ iti atas āha buddhau iti asmin eva arthe smṛti sammatim darśayan tayā eva uttara pādam api vyācaṣṭe ajñānām iti phala hetu pada vyākhyānam tam ye sva aikyena ityādi pūrvavat

original: kṛpaṇāḥ kṛpāviṣayāḥ | tatra hetumāha || tamasīti || 49 ||
analyzed: kṛpaṇāḥ kṛpā viṣayāḥ tatra hetum āha tamasi iti 49

original: nanvastu jñānasyādhikyaṃ, tataśca kimityataḥ "tasmāt"iti jñānasādhanamāpādyamityuktam | tatrāstu jñānasādhanāpādanam | kiṃ phalasneharahitakarmaṇetyāśaṃkāyāṃ phalasneharahitakarmaiva jñānasādhanamiti vaktavyam | kimarthamatra karmakauśalasya jñanasādhanatvamucyata ityataḥ phalasneharāhityādiyuktakarmaiva karmakauśalapadenocyata iti bhāvenāha ||
analyzed: nanu astu jñānasya ādhikyam tatas ca kim iti atas tasmāt iti jñāna sādhanam āpādyam iti uktam tatra astu jñāna sādhana āpādanam kim phala sneha rahita karmaṇā iti āśaṃkāyām phala sneha rahita karma eva jñāna sādhanam iti vaktavyam kimartham atra karma kauśalasya jñana sādhana tvam ucyate iti atas phala sneha rāhitya ādi yukta karma eva karma kauśala padena ucyate iti bhāvena āha

original: yathāvaditi || "yogasthaḥ" ityatra
analyzed: yathāvat iti yoga sthaḥ iti atra

original: bhagavajjñānasyāparigṛhītatvādatrāpi na tadabhipretamityata āha || bhagavaditi || etacchlokārthavivaraṇātmakottaraśloke "buddhiyuktaḥ"iti bhagavajjñānasyāparokṣajñānasādhanatvena gṛhītatvādatra pūrvatrāpi tadabhimatamiti bhāvaḥ || 50 || 51 ||
analyzed: bhagavat jñānasya aparigṛhīta tvāt atra api na tat abhipretam iti atas āha bhagavat iti etad śloka artha vivaraṇa ātmaka uttaraśloke buddhi yuktaḥ iti bhagavat jñānasya aparokṣa jñāna sādhanatvena gṛhīta tvāt atra pūrvatra api tat abhimatam iti bhāvaḥ 50 51

original: kiyatparyantamavaśyaṃ kartavyāni mumukṣuṇaivaṃ karmāṇītyata ucyate yadeti | tatra nirvedapadena vairāgyamucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || nirvedamiti || etacchlokadvayaṃ smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || buddhīti || śrotavyaśrutapadaṃ sarvakarmopalakṣakam | samādhānena śrutyarthajñānaniścalatvenāparokṣajñānaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: kiyat paryantam avaśyam kartavyāni mumukṣuṇā evam karmāṇi iti atas ucyate yadā iti tatra nirveda padena vairāgyam ucyate iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya āha nirvedam iti etat śloka dvayam smṛtyā eva vyācaṣṭe buddhi iti śrotavya śruta padam sarva karma upalakṣakam samādhānena śruti artha jñāna niścala tvena aparokṣa jñānam bhavati

original: anena "namādhāvacalā" iti samādhau satyaparokṣajñānaṃ tena viṣṇāvacaleti vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | tadyogaṃ bhagavadyogam | bhagavadyogasya sarveṣāmapi vidyamānatvāt ko viśeṣa ityuktaṃ vivṛṇoti || mukti iti || tadaśrnute brahmāpnotītyarthaḥ | atrāpi yadā tadeti sambadhyate | nanvatra "śrutiviprapatipannā" iti śrutiviruddhatvamucyate |
analyzed: anena nama ādhau acalā iti samādhau satya parokṣa jñānam tena viṣṇau acalā iti vyākhyātam bhavati tad yogam bhagavat yogam bhagavat yogasya sarveṣām api vidyamāna tvāt kaḥ viśeṣaḥ iti uktam vivṛṇoti iti brahma āpnoti iti arthaḥ atra api yadā tadā iti sambadhyate nanu atra śruti vipra patipannāḥ iti śruti viruddha tvam ucyate

original: tatkathaṃ śrutimārgaṃ prapanneti vyākhyotyata āha || śrutāviti || 52 || 53 ||
analyzed: tat katham śruti mārgam prapannā iti āha śrutau iti 52

original: prakṛtajñānilakṣaṇādipraśnaḥ kriyate sthiteti || tatra "kā bhāṣā" ityetadanyathāpratītinirāsāya vyācaṣṭe || keti || nanu jñānīti bhāṣyata iti siddhatvātkiṃ praśnenetyata āha || kairiti || "samādhisthasya"ityasya samādhiṃ kurvato jñānino lakṣaṇādi pṛcchatītyanyathāpratītinirāsārthamāha || samādhīti || 54 ||
analyzed: prakṛta jñāni lakṣaṇa ādi praśnaḥ kriyate sthitā iti tatra kā bhāṣā iti etat anyathā pratīti nirāsāya vyācaṣṭe kā iti nanu jñānī iti bhāṣyate iti siddha tvāt kim praśnena iti atas āha kaiḥ iti samādhi sthasya etyasya samādhim kurvataḥ jñāninaḥ lakṣaṇa ādi pṛcchati iti anyathā pratīti nirāsa artham āha samādhi iti

original: jñānilakṣaṇamucyate prajahātīti || tatra jñāninaḥ sarvakāmaprahāṇaṃ nāma niṣiddhāniṣiddhasarvakāmaprahāṇamityanyathāpratītinirāsāya tatsmṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || sarveti || kuto na jñāninaḥ sarvakāmanivṛttiḥ, yataḥ sarvaśabdasaṅ‌kocaṛ kriyata ityata āha || aparokṣati || jñāninaḥ kadācinniṣiddhamamanivṛttirapi nāsti | kutaḥ sarvakāmanivṛttirityarthaḥ |
analyzed: jñāni lakṣaṇam ucyate prajahāti iti tatra jñāninaḥ sarva kāma prahāṇam nāma niṣiddha a niṣiddha sarva kāma prahāṇam iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya tad smṛtyā eva vyācaṣṭe sarva iti kutas na jñāninaḥ sarva kāma nivṛttiḥ yatas sarva śabda saṅkocaḥ kriyate iti atas āha jñāninaḥ kadācid niṣiddha mama nivṛttiḥ api na asti kutas sarva kāma nivṛttiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tarhi jñānasyābhibhavakāle jñānilakṣaṇābhāvājjñānitvābhāvaḥ prasajyata ityataḥ satyamityāha || ata iti || niṣiddhakāmarāhityasya jñānānabhibhavakāla eva sattvādityarthaḥ | nanu yadi kadāyid dṛśirabhibhūyate tarhi sā na mokṣasādhanaṃ syāt | kādācitkatayā daurbalyādityata āha || tathāpīti || yogyā svabimbaviṣayā |
analyzed: tarhi jñānasya abhibhava kāle jñāni lakṣaṇa abhāvāt jñāni tva abhāvaḥ prasajyate iti atas satyam iti āha atas iti niṣiddha kāma rāhityasya jñāna anabhibhava kāle eva sattvāt iti arthaḥ nanu yadi kadāyid dṛśiḥ abhibhūyate tarhi sā na mokṣa sādhanam syāt kādācitkatayā daurbalyāt iti atas āha tathā api iti yogyā sva bimba viṣayā

original: "ātmanyevātmanā"ityātmaśabdau jīvamanaḥparāvityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || ātmanīti || kuto na jīvādiparovityata āha || tuṣṭa iti || atrātmasthityādinā tuṣṭyabhidhānājjīvasthityādinā tadasambhavānna tatparāvātmaśabdāviti bhāvaḥ || 55 ||
analyzed: ātmani eva ātmanā iti ātma śabdau jīva manaḥ parau iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya āha ātmani iti kutas na jīva ādi paraḥ iti atas āha tuṣṭaḥ iti atra ātma sthiti ādinā tuṣṭi abhidhānāt jīva sthiti ādinā tad asambhavāt na tad parau ātma śabdau iti bhāvaḥ 55

original: etādṛśaṃ cejjñānaṃ tatkiṃ sarve na sādhayantītyato nirāhāratvenendriyajayastenaiva jñānamityatiduḥsaṃpādatvaṃ jñānasyocyate "viṣayā" iti | tatra rasaśabdasyāpūrvamarthamāha || rasa iti || 59 ||
analyzed: etādṛśam ced jñānam tat kim sarve na sādhayanti iti atas nirāhāra tvena indriya jayaḥ tena eva jñānam iti ati duḥsaṃpāda tvam jñānasya ucyate viṣayāḥ iti tatra rasa śabdasya apūrvam artham āha rasaḥ iti

original: vītarāgetyādinā rāgādirāhityaṃ jñānilakṣaṇamuktam | jijñāsunā ca tatsādhyam | kāraṇaphalaparijñāne ca rāgādityāgo bhavati | ato rāgādiparihārāya tatkāraṇaphale ucyeti "dhyāyata" iti | tatra saṃmohasmṛtivibhramapadābhyāṃ viparītajñānamevocyate | ataḥ kathaṃ hetuhetumadbhāva ityata āha || saṃmohāditi ||
analyzed: vīta rāga ityādinā rāga ādi rāhityam jñāni lakṣaṇam uktam jijñāsunā ca tat sādhyam kāraṇa phala parijñāne ca rāga ādi tyāgaḥ bhavati atas rāga ādi parihārāya tad kāraṇa phale ucyā iti dhyāyataḥ iti tatra saṃmoha smṛti vibhrama padābhyām viparīta jñānam eva ucyate atas katham hetu hetumat bhāvaḥ iti atas āha saṃmohāt iti

original: atra saṃmohapadena paravittāpaharaṇādyadharme dharmabuddhirityādimithyājñānamucyate | smṛtivibhramapadena ca paravittāpaharaṇāderadharmatvābhidhāyakaśrutyādyarthasya pūrvaṃ svayaṃ jñātasyāpyanyathāsmaraṇamucyate | tayośca hetuhetumadbhāvassambhavatīti bhāvaḥ | smṛtibhraṃśādbuddhināśa iti durghaṭam |
analyzed: atra saṃmoha padena para vitta apaharaṇa ādi adharme dharma buddhiḥ ityādi mithyājñānam ucyate smṛti vibhrama padena ca para vitta apaharaṇa ādeḥ adharma tva abhidhāyaka śruti ādi arthasya pūrvam svayam jñātasya api anyathā smaraṇam ucyate tayoḥ ca hetu hetumat bhāvaḥ sambhavati iti bhāvaḥ smṛti bhraṃśāt buddhi nāśaḥ iti durghaṭam

original: cetanasya buddhyavinābhāvitvena buddhernāśāyogādityata uktaṃ vivṛśvannāha || vākyeti || nirṇītaṃ kevalavākyasāpekṣatāṃ vināpi niścitam | na tu jñānamātramiti bhāvaḥ || 63 ||
analyzed: cetanasya buddhi avinābhāvi tvena buddheḥ nāśa ayogāt iti atas uktam vivṛśvan āha vākya iti nirṇītam kevala vākya sāpekṣatām vinā api niścitam na tu jñāna mātram iti bhāvaḥ

original: indriyajaye jāte manasaḥ svato'pi prāyo viṣayāgatilakṣaṇena prasādena mokṣalābhādasāvāpādya ityuktam | tadanāpādane doṣaścocyate nāstīti | tatra bhāvanāyāḥ śāntisādhyatvāt "na cābhāvayataḥ śāntiḥ " iti kathamucyata ityato na śāntipadenatra cittanirodha ucyate | api tu bhagavanniṣṭhabuddhitvam |
analyzed: indriya jaye jāte manasaḥ svatas api prāyas viṣaya āgati lakṣaṇena prasādena mokṣa lābhāt asau āpādyaḥ iti uktam tad anāpādane doṣaḥ ca ucyate na asti iti tatra bhāvanāyāḥ śānti sādhya tvāt na ca abhāvayataḥ śāntiḥ iti katham ucyate iti atas na śānti padena atra citta nirodhaḥ ucyate api tu bhagavat niṣṭha buddhi tvam

original: tacca bhāvanāsādhyaṃ bhavatīti bhāvena śāntiśabdārthaṃ sapramāṇakamāha || śāntiriti || 66 ||
analyzed: tat ca bhāvanā sādhyam bhavati iti bhāvena śānti śabda artham sa pramāṇakam āha śāntiḥ iti

original: piṇḍīkṛtyoktalakṣamucyate yā niśeti | tatra sarvaprerakāṇāṃ devānāmapi jñānitvājjñānināṃ paramātmetarādarśane lokayātrocchedaḥ syādityatastadvākyaṃ devetarajñāniviṣayatayā smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || devebhya iti || "yathā'nyaiḥ " ityanena pūrvārdhatātparyamuktaṃ bhavati | yathājñairbṛhma na jñāyata ityarthaḥ || sūryavaditi ||
analyzed: piṇḍīkṛtya ukta lakṣam ucyate yā niśā iti tatra sarva prerakāṇām devānām api jñāni tvāt jñāninām paramātma itara adarśane lokayātrā ucchedaḥ syāt iti atas tat vākyam deva itara jñāni viṣaya tayā smṛtyā eva vyācaṣṭe devebhyaḥ iti yathā anyaiḥ iti anena pūrva ardha tātparyam uktam bhavati yathā jñaiḥ bṛhma na jñāyate iti arthaḥ sūrya vat iti

original: sūryo yathā svatejasā sarvaṃ prakāśayatyevaṃ svajñānena sarvaṃ viṣayīkurvantītyarthaḥ || 69 ||
analyzed: sūryaḥ yathā sva tejasā sarvam prakāśayati evam sva jñānena sarvam viṣayīkurvanti iti arthaḥ

original: evaṃ jñānī sarvatrodāsīnaścetkathaṃ viṣayabho,stasyetyata ucyate āpūryamāṇamiti | tatsmṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || bhuñjāna iti || dharmamayīṃ dharmākhyām | viṣayabhoktā na kāmī kathamucyata ityata uktasya "na kāmakāmī " ityasyārtho nāsāviti |
analyzed: evam jñānī sarvatra udāsīnaḥ ced katham viṣaya bhoḥ tasya iti atas ucyate āpūryamāṇam iti tad smṛtyā eva vyācaṣṭe bhuñjānaḥ iti dharma mayīm dharma ākhyām viṣaya bhoktā na kāmī katham ucyate iti atas uktasya na kāma kāmī iti asya arthaḥ na asau iti

original: nanu kāmābhāve viṣayabhogāsambhavāt kathaṃ jñāninaḥ kāmābhāvo mokṣasiddhyarthamucyata ityato'tra kāmapadena niṣiddhecchaivābhipretā | tasyā eva mokṣavirodhitvāt | necchāmātraṃ tasya mokṣāvirodhitvādityāha || keti || kutsiteyamiti mānaṃ yadviṣaye saivecchā kāma ityarthaḥ | itaśca "na kāmakāmī " ityatra necchāmātraniṣedha ityāha || na ceti ||
analyzed: nanu kāma abhāve viṣaya bhoga asambhavāt katham jñāninaḥ kāma abhāvaḥ mokṣa siddhi artham ucyate iti atas utra kāma padena niṣiddha icchā eva abhipretā tasyāḥ eva mokṣa virodhi tvāt na icchā mātram tasya mokṣa avirodhi tvāt iti āha kā iti kutsitā iyam iti mānam yad viṣaye sā eva icchā kāmaḥ iti arthaḥ itas ca na kāma kāmī iti atra na icchā mātra niṣedhaḥ iti āha na ca iti

original: nanu śāntiśabdasya bhagavanniṣṭhāvācitvāt kathaṃ sa mucyata iti vyākhyetyato bhagavanniṣṭhāsambandhādeva mokṣo'pi śāntiśabdābhidheya iti smṛtyaivāha || śāntiriti || 70 ||
analyzed: nanu śānti śabdasya bhagavat niṣṭhā vāci tvāt katham sa mucyate iti vyākhyā iti atas bhagavat niṣṭhā sambandhāt eva mokṣaḥ api śānti śabda abhidheyaḥ iti smṛtyā eva āha śāntiḥ iti

original: pūrvaślokoktaṃ prapañcyate vihāyeti | tatra kāmapadena yadīcchā gṛhyate tarhi niḥspṛha iti puraruktiḥ | yadi viṣayāntarhi viṣayatyāge
analyzed: pūrva śloka uktam prapañcyate vihāya iti tatra kāma padena yadi icchā gṛhyate tarhi niḥspṛhaḥ iti puraruktiḥ yadi viṣayān tarhi viṣaya tyāge

original: kiṃ bhakṣayati | niḥspṛhatvaṃ ca kathaṃ yujyate | sarvakāmanivṛttiriti vacanavirodhāt | jīvanādyabhāvaprasaṅgāccetyata āha || niṣiddheti || sarvakāmapadena viṣayāṇāṃ grahaṇānna puraruktidoṣaḥ | nāpi caraṇāsambhavaḥ | atra niḥspṛha ityanena viṣayāṇāṃ svarūpato hānamantareṇa spṛhābhāvamātreṇa hānasyābhipretatvāt | nāpi smṛtivacanādivirodhaḥ |
analyzed: kim bhakṣayati niḥspṛha tvam ca katham yujyate sarva kāma nivṛttiḥ iti vacana virodhāt jīvana ādi abhāva prasaṅgāt ca iti atas āha niṣiddha iti sarva kāma padena viṣayāṇām grahaṇāt na purarukti doṣaḥ na api caraṇa asambhavaḥ atra niḥspṛhaḥ iti anena viṣayāṇām svarūpataḥ hānam antareṇa spṛhā bhāva mātreṇa hānasya abhipreta tvāt nā api smṛti vacana ādi virodhaḥ

original: niḥspṛha iti niṣiddhaviṣayaspṛhābhāvasya vivakṣitatvāditi bhāvaḥ || nanu jñānināmapyahaṃ mameti pratyayaprayogadarśanāt kathaṃ tasyocyate nirahaṅ‌kāratvādītyato nāhamityādijñānādimātramahaṅ‌kārādīti bhāvena smṛtyaivāhaṅ‌kārādiśabdarthāmāha || asvarūpa iti || mamatā madadhīnamiti bhāvanā || 71 ||
analyzed: niḥspṛhaḥ iti niṣiddha viṣaya spṛhā abhāvasya vivakṣita tvāt iti bhāvaḥ nanu jñāninām api aham mama iti pratyaya prayoga darśanāt katham tasya ucyate nirahaṅkāra tva ādi iti atas na aham ityādi jñāna ādi mātram ahaṅkāra ādi iti bhāvena smṛtyā eva ahaṅkāra ādi śabda rthām āha asvarūpaḥ iti mamatā mad adhīnam iti bhāvanā

analyzed: ukta lakṣaṇam upasaṃhriyate eṣā iti tatra brāhmī iti brahma dharma bhūtā iti pratīti nirāsāya āha brāhmī iti nanu kṣīyante ca asya karmāṇi tasmin dṛṣṭe parāvare ityādeḥ jñāna mātreṇa sarva karmaṇām kṣayāt jñāna anantaram eva mokṣa sadbhāvena sthitvā asyām iti anta kāle bhagavat smṛti ādi vidhānam brahma prāpti artham kim iti kriyate iti atas āha jñāninām iti

original: jñānināmapi yadyantakāle bhagavatsmaraṇādi nāsti tarhi janmāntarameva bhavati | na brahmaprāptiratastadarthamantakāle tatsmaraṇādividhānaṃ yuktameva | na ca jñāninaḥ kṣīṇakarmatvājjanmāntarāyogaḥ | jñānamātreṇāprārabdhakarmanāśe'pi yeṣāmantakāle'pi na bhagavatsmaraṇaṃ teṣāṃ prārabdhakarmabhāvāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: jñāninām api yadi antakāle bhagavat smaraṇa ādi nā asti tarhi janmāntaram eva bhavati na brahma prāptiḥ atas tad artham antakāle tad smaraṇa ādi vidhānam yuktam eva na ca jñāninaḥ kṣīṇa karma tvāt janma antara ayogaḥ jñāna mātreṇa aprārabdha karma nāśe pi yeṣām antakāle api na bhagavat smaraṇam teṣām prārabdha karma bhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: yadi mokṣarthaṃ sākṣādantakāla eva bhagavatmṛtyādyapekṣitaṃ tarhi tasya duḥsampādatvena kasyāpi mokṣo na syāt | ataḥ sākṣādantakālasmaraṇaṃ sātra bhagavato'bhipretamityata āha || prārabdheti || na mokṣarthamantakālasmaraṇāpekṣāyāṃ kasyāpi mokṣaprasaṅgaḥ | prārabdhakarmaṇa evāntakālasmaraṇapratibandhakatvena tannāśe'ntakāle smaraṇaniyamāt |
analyzed: yadi mokṣa artham sākṣāt antakāle eva bhagavat mṛti ādi apekṣitam tarhi tasya duḥsampāda tvena kasya api mokṣaḥ na syāt atas sākṣāt antakāla smaraṇam sā atra bhagavataḥ abhipretam iti atas āha prārabdha iti na mokṣa artham antakāla smaraṇa apekṣāyām kasya api mokṣa prasaṅgaḥ prārabdha karmaṇaḥ eva antakāla smaraṇa pratibandhaka tvena smaraṇa niyamāt

original: tadbhāve ca mokṣaniyamāditi bhāvaḥ | nanvantakālasmaraṇādeva mokṣo nānyatheti bhagavadabhimatamiti niścayo yadi bhavettadaivamarthakalpanā bhavet | na eva kuta ityata āha || yaṃ yamiti || "śāntirmokṣo'tha nirvāṇam " ityādernirvāṇaśabdasya mokṣe'pi prasiddherbrahma nirvāṇamiti kathaṃ sāmāsādhikaraṇam | na ca brahma nirvāṇaṃ ceti yojanā |
analyzed: tad bhāve ca mokṣa niyamāt iti bhāvaḥ nanu anta kāla smaraṇāt eva mokṣaḥ na anyathā iti bhagavat abhimatam iti niścayaḥ yadi bhavet tadā evam artha kalpanā bhavet na eva kutas iti atas āha yam yam iti śāntiḥ mokṣaḥ atha nirvāṇam ityādeḥ nirvāṇa śabdasya mokṣe api prasiddheḥ brahma nirvāṇam iti katham sāmāsa adhikaraṇam na ca brahma nirvāṇam ca iti yojanā

original: brahmaprāptyatiriktamokṣānirūpaṇādityata āha || bāṇamiti || bāṇaśabdasya śarīravācitvānnirvāṇapadena kāryabrahmavyāvṛttyarthaṃ brahmaṇo'śarīratvamevocyate | na mokṣa iti bhāvaḥ | nanu kathamaśarīratvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ | sahasraśīrṣetyādivirodhādityāśaṅ‌kāṃ smṛtyaiva pariharati || abhāvāditi || 72 ||

analyzed: karma dhyāna yoga bhedāt tatra prāc uktam eva karmayogam prapañcayati anena adhyāyena bhagavān iti arthaḥ nanu karma jam buddhi yuktāḥ hi phalam tyaktvā ityādinā pūrvatra api karmayogasya prapañcita tvāt kim anna adhyāyena iti atas uktam viśeṣataḥ iti

analyzed: nanu atra api indriyāṇi parāṇi ityādinā jñānasya api ukteḥ katham karma yogam prapañcayati iti ucyate iti atas vā āha viśeṣataḥ iti prācuryeṇa iti arthaḥ

analyzed: nanu karmaṇaḥ sakāśāt buddheḥ jyāyaḥ tvam prāk kutra uktam yat bījā uyam jyāyasī ced karmaṇaḥ iti arjuna praśnaḥ iti atas āha dūreṇa iti 1

original: sāṅkhyānāṃ jñānameva yogināṃ karmaiveti pratīta evārthaḥ kiṃ na syāditi cettathā'ṅgīkāre smṛtivirodhaḥ syāditi bhāvenāha || sāṅkhyāiti || devānāṃ bahukarmasadbhāvātkathaṃ mukhyahāṅkhyatvamityata āha || bahviti || tato'pi karmaṇo'pi | gṛhasthādīnāmapi kiṃ kevalakarmaivetyapekṣāyāmāha || jñānino'pīti || tarhi kathaṃ karmayogina ityata āha ||
analyzed: sāṅkhyānām jñānam eva yoginām karma eva iti pratītaḥ eva arthaḥ kim na syāt iti ced tathā aṅgīkāre smṛti virodhaḥ syāt iti bhāvena āha sāṅkhyāḥ iti devānām bahu karma sadbhāvāt katham mukhya hāṅkhya tvam iti atas āha bahu iti tatas upi karmaṇaḥ upi gṛhastha ādīnām api kim kevala karma eva iti apekṣāyām āha jñāninaḥ api iti tarhi katham karma yoginaḥ iti atas āha

original: atīti || sāṅkhyānāṃ kevalaṃ jñānameva yogināṃ kevalaṃ karmaiveti tiṃ na syādityata āha || nobhayamiti || sāṅkhyānāṃ jñānena yogināṃ karmaṇāpuruṣārtho bhavatīti śrutyādau śrūyate | na caikaikena puruṣārtho yujyate | ato naikaikagrahaṇaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: ati iti sāṅkhyānām kevalam jñānam eva yoginām kevalam karma eva iti tiṃ na syāt iti atas āha na ubhayam iti sāṅkhyānām jñānena yoginām karmaṇā a puruṣa arthaḥ bhavati iti śruti ādau śrūyate na ca ekaikena puruṣa arthaḥ yujyate atas na ekaika grahaṇam yuktam iti bhāvaḥ

original: karmābhāve kuto na puruṣārtha iti cetkiṃ karmapadena karmamātraṃ vivakṣyate atha yajñādikarma vā | ādyaṃ dūṣayati || na hīti || dvitīyaṃ dūṣayati || na ceti || jñānamātraṃ karma vinā saṃsāranivṛttisādhanamapi na sampūrṇapuruṣārthakaramiti bhāvaḥ | tarhyastu kevalaṃ karmaiva puruṣārthakaramityata āha || na ceti
analyzed: karma abhāve kutas na puruṣa arthaḥ iti ced kim karma padena karma mātram vivakṣyate atha yajña ādi karma vā ādyam dūṣayati na hi iti dvitīyam dūṣayati na ca iti jñāna mātram karma vinā saṃsāra nivṛtti sādhanam api na sampūrṇa puruṣa artha karam iti bhāvaḥ tarhi astu kevalam karma eva puruṣa artha karam iti atas āha na ca iti

original: || "na karmaṇā na prajayā " ityādiśrutivirodhāditi bhāvaḥ | anena "na karmaṇāmanārambhāt " ityādeśca tātparyamuktaṃ bhavati | bhavedatra jñānakarmaṇoḥ samuccayakalpanaṃ, yadyatra sāṅkhyayogādeḥ puruṣārthahetutvamucyeta | ekaikasya puruṣārthasādhanatvābhāvokteḥ na ca tadatrocyata ityata āha || niṣṭheti ||

original: ṣṭhā gatinivṛttāvityato niṣṭhā paryavasitiḥ | gateriti śeṣaḥ | kathamanena codyaparihāra ityata āha || muktiriti || atra niṣṭhāpadena gatiparyavasitivācinā saṃsāragatiparyavasānaṃ muktirabhipretetyarthaḥ | nanvevaṃ jñānakarmabhyāṃ mokṣa ityaṅgīkāre "na karmaṇā na prajayā dhanena tyāgenaike amṛtatvamānaśuḥ " ityādiśrutivirodhaḥ syādityata āha ||
analyzed: gati nivṛttau iti atas niṣṭhā paryavasitiḥ gateḥ iti śeṣaḥ katham anena codya parihāraḥ iti atas āha muktiḥ iti atra niṣṭhā padena gati paryavasiti vācinā saṃsāra gati paryavasānam muktiḥ abhipretā iti arthaḥ nanu evam jñāna karmabhyām mokṣaḥ iti aṅgīkāre na karmaṇā na prajayā dhanena tyāgena eke amṛta tvam ānaśuḥ ityādi śruti virodhaḥ syāt iti atas āha

original: jñānina iti || jñānakarmabhyāṃ mokṣasiddhyaṅgīkāre'pi naitacchrutivirodhaḥ | karmarahitajñānamātrasya mokṣasādhanatvābhidhānāt | asmābhirapi tadaṅgīkārāt | karmaṇastu jñānamātreṇaiva siddhe mokṣe sukhādhikyahetutvenāṅgīkārāt | jñānādeva mokṣaḥ karmaṇā ānandavṛddhirityetat kuta it cet jñānina iti śrutereveti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: jñāninaḥ iti jñāna karmabhyām mokṣa siddhi aṅgīkāre api na etad śruti virodhaḥ karma rahita jñāna mātrasya mokṣa sādhanatva abhidhānāt asmābhiḥ api tad aṅgīkārāt karmaṇaḥ tu jñāna mātreṇa eva siddhe mokṣe sukha ādhikya hetutvena aṅgīkārāt jñānāt eva mokṣaḥ karmaṇā ānanda vṛddhiḥ iti etat kutas id ced jñāninaḥ iti śruteḥ eva iti bhāvaḥ

original: itaśca "jñānayogena " ityatra karmāpi saṃyojyam | na jñānamātramityāha || anyatheti || anyathā jñānamātreṇaiva puruṣārthāṅgīkāre | karmayogināmapi prakṛtatvātteṣāṃ karmānārambhe puruṣārthāsambhavābhidhāyakametadvākyaṃ kiṃ na syādityata uktam || ubhayeti ||
analyzed: itas ca jñāna yogena iti atra karma api saṃyojyam na jñāna mātram iti āha anyathā iti anyathā jñāna mātreṇa eva puruṣa artha aṅgīkāre karma yoginām api prakṛta tvāt teṣām karma anārambhe puruṣa artha asambhava abhidhāyakam etat vākyam kim na syāt iti atas uktam ubhaya iti

original: na kevalametatkarmayogiviṣayamapi tūbhayaviṣayamityarthaḥ kuta'syobhayaviṣayatvaṃ jñāyata ityata āha || samatvaṃ ceti || mokṣe karmaṇā ānandavṛddhirbhavatītyayuktam | "nānyaḥ panthā " iti śrutau karmaṇo mokṣasambandhasyaiva nirākaraṇādityata āha || nānya iti || jñānāyogameveyaṃ śrutirvyavacchinatti | na tu karmasambandhaṃ nirākaroti |

original: kāryata ityatra svatantrakarturanyasyāpratīteḥ prakṛtiguṇānāmeva svatantrakartutvamucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || kartṛtvamiti || atra guṇānāṃ vikārakartṛtvamevocyate | na tu svatantrakartṛtvam | avaśa iti viṣṇoḥ svatantrakartṛtvokteḥ | avaśapadena svānadhīnatvaṃ gṛtītvā guṇānāṃ svatantrakartṛtvameva kiṃ na gṛhyata iti cenna |

original: "kartṛtvam " iti śrutivirodhāditi bhāvaḥ | śrutiriti kutracitpāṭhaḥ | tatrānyathāpratītinirāsāya śrutyaiva vyākhyātaṃ viṣṇoḥ svatantrakartṛtvamatra na pratīyata ityata uktam || avaśa iti || avaśapadaṃ kathaṃ viṣṇuvaśatvaṃ vaktītyata āha || aḥ iti || 5 -8 ||
analyzed: kartṛ tvam iti śruti virodhāt iti bhāvaḥ śrutiḥ iti kutracid pāṭhaḥ tatra anyathā pratīti nirāsāya śrutyā eva vyākhyātam viṣṇoḥ svatantra kartṛ tvam atra na pratīyate iti atas uktam avaśaḥ iti avaśa padam katham viṣṇu vaśa tvam vakti iti atas āha iti

original: nanu "karmaṇā badhyate jantuḥ " ityādeḥ karmaṇo bandhakatvātkathaṃ "kuru karma " iti vidhīyata ityāśaṃkāparihārāya ślokāmavatārayati || karmaṇeti || ayajñarthaṃ karma bandhakamityevātra pratīyati, na tvavaiṣṇavaṃ karmabandhakamityato yajñaśabdārthaṃ śrutyaivāha || jña iti || nātra yajña padena prasiddhayajña ucyate |

original: api tu yāto viṣayīkṛto jñānarūpatvājjño bhagavān yenoddeśena sa evetyarthaḥ | ya eṣa uddeśa iti yojanā || 9 ||

original: karma kartavyamityatra hetvantaramucyate " annāditi " | atra kathamannasya parjanyāddevaviśeṣādavatpattiḥ | kathaṃ ca tasya yajñādutpattiḥ| kathaṃ cānnāditi paramparāyā evoktatvāt cakramityucyata ityāśaṃkāṃ parihartuṃ brahmākṣaraśabdayoranyārthakalpanāṃ ca nirākartuṃ smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || jananāditi || paraṃ janyaṃ yasyāsau tathoktaḥ |
analyzed: karma kartavyam iti atra hetu antaram ucyate annāt iti atra katham annasya parjanyāt deva viśeṣāt avatpattiḥ katham ca tasya yajñāt utpattiḥ katham ca annāt iti paramparāyāḥ eva ukta tvāt cakram iti ucyate iti āśaṃkām parihartum brahma akṣara śabdayoḥ anya artha kalpanām ca nirākartum smṛtyā eva vyācaṣṭe jananāt iti param janyam yasya asau tathā uktaḥ

analyzed: yajñāt iti yajña samārādhita devatāyāḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ yajñaḥ devatā uddeśena dravya parityāgaḥ karma tad itara kriyā vākyāt jāyate katham nityaḥ jāyate gamyate avagamyate iti arthaḥ vedena yathāvat avagataḥ eva īśvaraḥ satkarma kārayati iti bhāvaḥ yatas evam paramparayā yajña abhivyaṅgyaḥ tasmāt

original: bhagavato yajñe pratiṣṭhitatvādyajñānuṣṭhānena cakrapravṛttau bhagavadabhivyaktinimittaṃ ca sukṛtaṃ bhavati, na kevalaṃ bhūtasthitihetutvanimittamiti bhāvaḥ || cakraṃ nānuvartayatīti || karma na karotītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: bhagavataḥ yajñe pratiṣṭhita tvāt yajña anuṣṭhānena cakra pravṛttau bhagavat abhivyakti nimittam ca sukṛtam bhavati na kevalam bhūta sthiti hetutva nimittam iti bhāvaḥ cakram na anuvartayati iti karma na karoti iti arthaḥ

original: viśvasya cakrāntarbhāvātkarmākaraṇena cakrāpravṛttau viśvahantṛtvaṃ cet gārhasthyetarāśramānanuṣṭhānaṃ prasajyeta | karmaṇāṃ yajñadānataporūpeṇa traividyadāśramāntare ca yajñādyabhāvādityata āha || vācika iti || vācikaḥ svadhyāyādiḥ | mānaso dhyānādiḥ || viśeṣata iti || sarvasādhāraṇye'pi anyeṣāmanye'pi santyeṣāmayamevetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: viśvasya cakra antarbhāvāt karma akaraṇena cakra apravṛttau viśva hantṛ tvam ced gārhasthya itara āśrama ananuṣṭhānam prasajyeta karmaṇām yajña dāna tapaḥ rūpeṇa traividya dāśrama antare ca yajña ādi abhāvāt iti atas āha vācikaḥ iti vācikaḥ svadhyāya ādiḥ mānasaḥ dhyāna ādiḥ viśeṣataḥ iti sarva sādhāraṇye api anyeṣām anye api santi eṣām ayam eva iti arthaḥ

original: anyeṣāṃ yajñāntaramāha || vanasthasyeti || akratuḥ paśvālambhanahīnaḥ | śuśrūṣādyātmaka ityādipadenāgnipūjā | vidyābhayādītyādipadena svabhoktavyānnadānam | annapūrvakaṃ vidyābhayādidānam | svabhoktavyādadhikamāpādyānnadānamiha vivakṣitam | annaṃ tu mūlaphalādi |
analyzed: anyeṣām yajña antaram āha vanasthasya iti akratuḥ paśu ālambhana hīnaḥ śuśrūṣā ādi ātmakaḥ iti ādi padena agni pūjā vidyā bhaya ādi iti ādi padena sva bhoktavya anna dānam anna pūrvakam vidyā bhaya ādi dānam sva bhoktavyāt adhikam āpādya anna dānam iha vivakṣitam annam tu mūla phala ādi

original: " brahmākṣarasamudbhavam " itatra brahmapadena vedo'kṣarapadena brahmocyata ityapavyākhyānaṃ hetvantareṇa pratyākhyāti || brahmeti || yadyatra brahmapadena vedo'kṣarapadena brahmocyate tarhi upira brahmaṇaḥ " tasmātsarvagataṃ brahma " iti brahmapadena pratyabhijñā na syāt |

analyzed: yad padena yat na prakṛtam tasya tad padena kāraṇa viśeṣam vinā na ca tatra veda parāmarśaḥ tasya yajñe pratiṣṭhita tva ukteḥ anupayukta tvāt iti bhāvaḥ doṣa antaram ca āha cakra iti vedāt karmaṇām utpatti abhāvāt brahmaṇaḥ vedasya utpatti abhāvāt bhūtebhyaḥ brahmaṇaḥ janana abhāvāt artha antara kalpane veda ādeḥ cakra apraveśaḥ syāt

original: karma kartavyamityatra yuktyantaramucyate || yastviti || tatra santoṣastuptirāpūrtirityādestṛptisantoṣaśabdayorekārthatvāt " ātmatṛptaḥ

original: " itvaktatvāt " ātmanyeva ca santuṣṭaḥ " iti punaruktirityata āha || tṛptiti || viśeṣo'rtha iti śeṣaḥ | kuta evamarthakalpanetyataḥ ślokaṃ smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || viṣṇviti || evaṃ tṛptisantoṣaśabdayorekārthatvamaṅgīkṛtya vigrahabhedenārthabheda uktaḥ | atha tṛptisantoṣaśabdayorevārthabhedācca na punaruktiriti bhāvena tayorarthabhede pramāṇamāha ||
analyzed: itu akta tvāt ātmani eva ca santuṣṭaḥ iti punaruktiḥ iti atas āha tṛpti iti viśeṣaḥ ūrthaḥ iti śeṣaḥ kutas evam artha kalpanā iti atas ślokam smṛtyā eva vyācaṣṭe viṣṇu iti evam tṛpti santoṣa śabdayoḥ ekārtha tvam aṅgīkṛtya vigraha bhedena artha bhedaḥ uktaḥ atha tṛpti santoṣa śabdayoḥ eva artha bhedāt ca na punaruktiḥ iti bhāvena tayoḥ artha bhede pramāṇam āha

original: ratiriti || ānandaḥ svarūpabhūtaḥ | karmaja upakārādijātaḥ | ratitṛptiprītiśabdānāṃ bhinnarthatve kimāyātaṃ tṛptisantoṣaśabdayorarthabhede ityataḥ prītisantoṣaśabdayoḥ paryāyatvāt tṛptiprītiśabdayorarthabhede tṛptisantoṣaśabdayorarthabhedaḥ siddha eveti bhāvena tatparyāyatve pramāṇamāha || santoṣa iti || paryāyavācakāḥ paryāyeṣa vācakāḥ || 17 ||
analyzed: ratiḥ iti ānandaḥ sva rūpa bhūtaḥ karma jaḥ upakāra ādi jātaḥ rati tṛpti prīti śabdānām bhinna artha tve kim āyātam tṛpti santoṣa śabdayoḥ artha bhede iti atas prīti santoṣa śabdayoḥ paryāya tvāt tṛpti prīti śabdayoḥ artha bhede tṛpti santoṣa śabdayoḥ artha bhedaḥ siddhaḥ eva iti bhāvena tad paryāya tve pramāṇam āha santoṣaḥ iti paryāya vācakāḥ vācakāḥ

original: nanu muktasya kāryaṃ na vidyata itvaktvā " tasmādasaktaḥ " ityucyate | tatra karmakaraṇe hetoranuktatvāt " tasmāt " iti kiṃ parāmṛśyata ityata āha || yasmāditi || yathā muktasya prayojanābhāvātkāryābhāvaḥ evaṃ mumukṣorapi karmaṇā prayojanābhāvātkāryābhāvaḥ kiṃ na syādityata ucyate || asakta iti ||
analyzed: nanu muktasya kāryam na vidyate iti aktvā tasmāt asaktaḥ iti ucyate tatra karma karaṇe hetoḥ anukta tvāt tasmāt iti kim parāmṛśyate iti atas āha yasmāt iti yathā muktasya prayojana abhāvāt kārya abhāvaḥ evam mumukṣoḥ api karmaṇā prayojana abhāvāt kārya abhāvaḥ kim na syāt iti atas ucyate asaktaḥ iti

original: tatra karmaṇaiva mokṣaprāptirucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāya tadvyācaṣṭe || asakta iti || karma'carannevetyevārtho na tu karmaivāttaranniti bhāvaḥ | tasmādamuktasya karmaṇā phalasadbhāvādastyeva tasya kāryamiti vākyaśeṣaḥ |
analyzed: tatra karmaṇā eva mokṣa prāptiḥ ucyate iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya tat vyācaṣṭe asaktaḥ iti karma caran evā iti eva arthaḥ na tu karma eva attaran iti bhāvaḥ tasmāt amuktasya karmaṇā phala sadbhāvāt asti eva tasya kāryam iti vākyaśeṣaḥ

original: nanvamuktasya kāryamastītyanuktatvātkathaṃ tasmāditi tatparāmarśaḥ syāditi cenna | muktasyaiva kāryaṃ nāstītyuktyā'muktasya kārayamastīti prāptatvāt | nanu muktasyaiva kāryaṃ nāstītyevakārābhāvāt kathamamuktasya kāryasadbhāvaprāpitirityata āha || muktasyaiveti ||
analyzed: nanu amuktasya kāryam asti iti anukta tvāt katham tasmāt iti tad parāmarśaḥ syāt iti ced na muktasya eva kāryam na asti iti uktyā amuktasya kārayam asti iti prāptatvāt nanu muktasya eva kāryam na asti iti evakāra abhāvāt katham amuktasya kārya sadbhāva prāpitiḥ iti atas āha muktasya eva iti

original: evakārābhāve'pi tadarthāvadhāraṇasya tuśabdenāvagatatvāt tenāmuktasya kāryasadbhāvaḥ prāpyata iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: evakāra abhāve api tad artha avadhāraṇasya tuśabdena avagata tvāt tena āmuktasya kārya sadbhāvaḥ prāpyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: kecittu " yastu " iti vākyaṃ jñānimātraviṣayatayā vyākurvate | na tadyuktam | " yastvevātmarato mukto " " viṣṇuprasādādratimān " ityādismṛtyā muktiviṣayatayā gṛhītatvāt jñānināmapi kāryasadbhāvasyoktatvāccetyabhipretya doṣāntaraṃ āha || tasmāditi ||
analyzed: kecid tu yaḥ tu iti vākyam jñāni mātra viṣayatayā vyākurvate na tat yuktam yaḥ tu eva ātma rataḥ muktaḥ viṣṇu prasādāt ratimān ityādi smṛtyā mukti viṣayatayā gṛhīta tvāt jñāninām api kārya sadbhāvasya ukta tvāt ca iti abhipretya doṣa antaram āha tasmāt iti

original: yadyatra jñānimātrasya kāryābhāvo'bhipretaḥ syāttarhyarjunaṃ prati " tasmādasaktaḥ " ityuparaṃhāravākye karmavidhānaṃ viruddhaṃ syāt | tasyāpi jñānitvāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: yadi atra jñāni mātrasya kārya abhāvaḥ abhipretaḥ syāt tarhi arjunam prati tasmāt asaktaḥ iti uparaṃhāra vākye karma vidhānam viruddham syāt tasya api jñāni tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: arjunasya jñānitve pramāṇābhāvenājñatvāt karmādhikāritvamevātastaṃ prati karmavidhānaṃ na viruddhamityata āha || brahmeti || ye teṣāmiti yojyam | muktaviṣayatve'pyasyārjunaṃ prati karmavidhānaṃ viruddham | pāṇḍavānāmetadvacanabalāt brahmaratatvādimuktalakṣaṇavattayā muktasāmyādityata āha || ātmeti || na pāṇḍavānāṃ muktānāṃ cātisāmyam |
analyzed: arjunasya jñāni tve pramāṇa abhāvena ajña tvāt karma adhikāri tvam eva atas tam prati karma vidhānam na viruddham iti atas āha brahma iti ye teṣām iti yojyam mukta viṣaya tve pi asya arjunam prati karma vidhānam viruddham pāṇḍavānām etad vacana balāt brahma rata tva ādi mukta lakṣaṇavat tayā mukta sāmyāt iti atas āha ātmā iti na pāṇḍavānām muktānām ca ati sāmyam

original: " ātmaratireva " iti muktānāmarativyāvartaivaśabdena pāṇḍavebhyo viśeṣa ityata āha || eṣāmiti || 19 ||
analyzed: ātma ratiḥ eva iti muktānām arati vyāvarta eva śabdena pāṇḍavebhyaḥ viśeṣaḥ iti atas āha eṣām iti 19

original: nanu jñānādeva mokṣasiddheḥ kathamasaktaḥ karmā'caranneva paramāpnotītyaktamityata ucyate || karmaṇaiveti || tatra karmaṇaiva mokṣa ucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāya tatsamṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || sahaiveti || kāryaṃ karma jñānināmapīti śeṣaḥ | karma kartavyamityatra hetvantaramucyate || loketi ||
analyzed: nanu jñānāt eva mokṣa siddheḥ katham asaktaḥ karma ācaran eva param āpnoti iti aktam iti atas ucyate karmaṇā eva iti tatra karmaṇā eva mokṣaḥ ucyate iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya tat samṛtya eva vyācaṣṭe saha eva iti kāryam karma jñāninām api iti śeṣaḥ karma kartavyam iti atra hetu antaram ucyate loka iti

original: tatra lokasaṅgrasambhave'pi tena prayojanābhāvātkathaṃ jñānino lokasaṅgrahārthaṃ karma vidhīyata ityato loketyādiślokān smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || ajñānamiti || sā tuṣṭiḥ || 20 || 21 ||
analyzed: tatra tena prayojana abhāvāt katham jñāninaḥ loka saṅgraha artham karma vidhīyate iti atas loka ityādi ślokān smṛtyā eva vyācaṣṭe ajñānam iti sā tuṣṭiḥ 20

original: kiñca prayojanamātrarahitenāpi mayā kevalānugraheṇa lokasaṅgrahārthaṃ karma kriyate, ato muktāvānandavṛddhiprayojanavatā jñāninā tatkartavyamiti kiṃ vaktavyamityuktaṃ " na me pārtha " iti | asyārtho mamaiveti || asyārtho mamaiveti || nanvīśvaraḥ prayojanābhāve'pi lokarakṣādi karotīti na yujyate |
analyzed: kiñca prayojana mātra rahitena api mayā kevala anugraheṇa loka saṅgraha artham karma kriyate atas muktau ānanda vṛddhi prayojanavatā jñāninā tat kartavyam iti kim vaktavyam iti uktam na me pārthaḥ iti asya arthaḥ mama eva iti asya arthaḥ mama eva iti nanu īśvaraḥ prayojana abhāve pi loka rakṣā ādi karoti iti na yujyate

original: prayojanābhāve pravṛttyayogādityāśaṃkāṃ śrutyaiva pariharati || rakṣayeti || prayojanābhāve'pīśvarasya kartṛtvasvabhāvavattvāt rakṣādikarmakaraṇaṃ yuktamityarthaḥ | nanu tādṛśasvabhāvatvena pravṛttiracetaneṣveva dṛṣṭā | yathā dahanapavanādīnāṃ prayojanaṃ vinā svabhāvādeva dahanagamanādipravṛttiḥ |
analyzed: prayojana abhāve pravṛtti ayogāt iti āśaṃkām śrutyā eva pariharati rakṣayā iti prayojana abhāve pi īśvarasya kartṛ tva svabhāvavat tvāt rakṣā ādi karma karaṇam yuktam iti arthaḥ nanu tādṛśa svabhāva tvena pravṛttiḥ acetaneṣu eva dṛṣṭā yathā dahana pavana ādīnām prayojanam vinā svabhāvāt eva dahana gamana ādi pravṛttiḥ

original: cetanapravṛtteḥ prayojanahīnāyā adarśanātkathamīśvarasyāpi prayojanānuddeśena pravṛttirityata āha || matta iti || 22 -26 ||
analyzed: cetana pravṛtteḥ prayojana hīnāyāḥ adarśanāt katham īśvarasya api prayojana anuddeśena pravṛttiḥ iti atas āha mattaḥ iti 22

original: ajñavadāgraheṇa jñānināmapi karama kāryaṃ cedvidvadavidvatkarmaṇoraviśeṣaprasaṅga ityataḥ " saktāḥ " iti saktyasaktipūrvakatvaviśeṣa uktaḥ prapañcyate " prakṛteriti " | vidvadavidvatkarmaviśeṣamuktyavā vidvatkarmakaraṇaṃ vidhīyate " mayi " iti | tatra karmāṇi saṃnyasya yudhyasveti vyāhatamityataḥ tatsmṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || nāhamiti ||
analyzed: ajña vat āgraheṇa jñāninām api kāryam ced vidvat avidvat karmaṇoḥ aviśeṣa prasaṅgaḥ iti atas saktāḥ iti sakti asakti pūrvaka tva viśeṣaḥ uktaḥ prapañcyate prakṛteḥ iti vidvat avidvat karma viśeṣa mukti avā vidvat karma karaṇam vidhīyate mayi iti tatra karmāṇi saṃnyasya yudhyasva iti vyāhatam ityatas tad smṛtyā eva vyācaṣṭe na aham iti

original: " nāhaṃ kartā " iti nirmamatvam | " hariḥ kartā tatpūjā karma cākhilam " iti harau karmanyāsaḥ | harireva kartā cetkathaṃ tatpūjetyādinirūpaṇaṃ yuktamityata āha || tathāpīti || yadyapi harireva kartā, tathāpi tatpreraṇenaiva mamāpi kartṛtvāt tatpūjetyādinirūpaṇaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ | tadbhaktiriti nirāśīstvam | tatphalaṃ pūjāphalam |
analyzed: na aham kartā iti nirmamatvam hariḥ kartā tad pūjā karma ca akhilam iti harau karma nyāsaḥ hariḥ eva kartā ced katham tad pūjā ityādi nirūpaṇam yuktam iti atas āha tathā api iti yadi api hariḥ eva kartā tathā api tad preraṇena eva mama api kartṛ tvāt tad pūjā ityādi nirūpaṇam yuktam iti bhāvaḥ tad bhaktiḥ iti nirāśīḥ tvam tad phalam pūjā phalam

original: karmanyāso nirmamatvādiyuktaḥ viṣṇostṛptikara ityanena " ye me katam " ityādestātparyamuktaṃ bhavati | evaṃ nirmamatvādiyuktena harau karmanyāsena kuto viṣṇostṛptirityata āha || yasmāditi || yasmādevamarthasthitiḥ tasmāttathā bhāvanaṃ viṣṇostṛptikaraṃ bhavatyeva | yathārthajñānapriyatvādviṣṇoriti bhāvaḥ |
