original: karmavibhāgaḥ kīdṛśa ityata āha || karmeti || yadi vaiṣṇavā eva sāttvikāstarhi brāhmaṇāḥ sāttvikāḥ ityādyuktiḥ kiṃnimittetyāśaṃkāṃ smṛtyaiva pariharita || vaiṣṇavā iti || apare dveṣiṇaḥ | vaiṣṇavānāṃ śūdrādiṣu daurlabhyāt brāhmaṇā eva sāttvikā ityādirūpeṇa sāttvikatvādīnāṃ varṇāśramabhedena bhinnatocyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: karma vibhāgaḥ kīdṛśaḥ iti atas āha karma iti yadi vaiṣṇavāḥ eva sāttvikāḥ tarhi brāhmaṇāḥ sāttvikāḥ ityādi uktiḥ kiṃnimittā iti āśaṃkām smṛtyā eva vaiṣṇavāḥ iti apare dveṣiṇaḥ vaiṣṇavānām śūdra ādiṣu daurlabhyāt brāhmaṇāḥ eva sāttvikāḥ ityādi rūpeṇa sāttvika tva ādīnām varṇa āśrama bhedena bhinnatā ucyate iti arthaḥ

original: yathā sāttvikatvādikaṃ na varṇāmātralakṣaṇaṃ tathā śamādikamapi na varṇamātralakṣaṇam | kintu svābhāvikavarṇalakṣaṇamityat smṛtimāha || svābhāvika iti || nanvasvābhāvikaṃ brāhmaṇatvādikaṃ kīdṛśamityata āha || yonīti || ayamiti prasiddhaḥ |
analyzed: yathā sāttvika tva ādikam na varṇa amātra lakṣaṇam tathā śama ādikam api na varṇa mātra lakṣaṇam kintu svābhāvika varṇa lakṣaṇam iti at smṛtim āha svābhāvikaḥ iti nanu asvābhāvikam brāhmaṇa tva ādikam kīdṛśam iti atas āha yoni iti ayam iti prasiddhaḥ

original: svābhāvikabrāhmaṇasyaiva śamādikam | svābhāvikakṣatriyasyaiva śauryādītyādyuktam | tatrāpavādamāha || viṣṇviti || śamapadoditā viṣṇubhaktiḥ na kevalaṃ brāhmaṇasyaiva, api tu sarvavarṇeṣvanugatetyarthaḥ | upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat | damādikamapyevaṃ draṣṭavyam | kṣatriye śamavati rāṣṭraviplavaḥ syādityato nāyaṃ śamaḥ prasiddhaḥ |
analyzed: svābhāvika brāhmaṇasya eva śama ādikam svābhāvika kṣatriyasya eva śaurya ādi ityādi uktam tatra apavādam āha viṣṇu iti śama pada uditā viṣṇu bhaktiḥ na kevalam brāhmaṇasya eva api tu sarva varṇeṣu anugatā iti arthaḥ upalakṣaṇam ca etat dama ādikam api evam draṣṭavyam kṣatriye śamavati rāṣṭra viplavaḥ syāt iti atas na ayam śamaḥ prasiddhaḥ

original: api tu viṣṇubhaktiriti śama iti vaktavye tadartha evoktaḥ | śamādīnāṃ kṣatriyādiṣvapi sadbhāve kathamayaṃ brāhmaṇo'yaṃ neti svābhāvikavarṇabhedajñānamityata āha || viśvapatimiti || brāhmaṇe śamādīnāṃ bāhulyāt kṣatriyādiṣu krameṇābahulatvāt śamādīnāṃ bāhulyābāhulyato'yaṃ brāhmaṇo'yaṃ neti svābhāviko varṇabhedo jñātavya ityarthaḥ
analyzed: api tu viṣṇu bhaktiḥ iti śamaḥ iti vaktavye tad arthaḥ eva uktaḥ śama ādīnām kṣatriya ādiṣu api sadbhāve katham ayam brāhmaṇaḥ yam na iti svābhāvika varṇa bheda jñānam iti atas āha viśvapatim iti brāhmaṇe śama ādīnām bāhulyāt kṣatriya ādiṣu krameṇa abahula tvāt śama ādīnām bāhulya abāhulyataḥ yam brāhmaṇaḥ yam na iti svābhāvikaḥ varṇa bhedaḥ jñātavyaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: yathā bhavān sarvasca kartā evaṃ bhavato'pyanyaḥ kartā'sti kimityapekṣāyāmucyate "tasyeti " | tatra kartāramapyakartāraṃ viddhi, kartṛtvasya māyikatvādityanyathāpratītinirāsāya smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || karteti || evaṃvidhakartṛtvākartṛtvayoraviruddhatvāt kartāramapyakartāraṃ viddhītyatrāpiśabdo vyartha ityata āha || apīti || tatprakāraṃ darśayati ||
analyzed: yathā bhavān sarvaḥ ca kartā evam bhavatā api anyaḥ kartā asti kim iti apekṣāyām ucyate tasya iti tatra kartāram api akartāram viddhi kartṛ tvasya māyika tvāt iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya smṛtyā eva vyācaṣṭe kartā iti evaṃvidha kartṛ tva akartṛ tvayoḥ aviruddha tvāt kartāram api akartāram viddhi iti atra api śabdaḥ vyarthaḥ iti atas āha api iti tad prakāram darśayati

original: karteti || 13 ||
analyzed: kartā iti 13

original: sarvakartṛtve bhagavataḥ karmalepaḥ syādityata ucyate "na māmiti " | tatra māmityasya siddhatvāt "iti mām " iti punarasmacchabdaḥ kimartha ityata āha || jīveti || svasyeśvarābhedābhiprāyeṇa svātmānamuddiśya "na māṃ karmāṇi lampanti " ityādi yo jānātītyanyathapratītiḥ syāt |
analyzed: sarva kartṛ tve bhagavataḥ karma lepaḥ syāt iti atas ucyate na mām iti tatra mām ityasya siddha tvāt iti mām iti punar asmad śabdaḥ kimarthaḥ iti atas āha jīva iti svasya īśvara abheda abhiprāyeṇa sva ātmānam uddiśya na mām karmāṇi lampanti ityādi yaḥ jānāti iti anyathā pratītiḥ syāt

original: tannirākaraṇārtham iti māṃ yo'bhijānāti, na svātmānamiti bhāvena māmiti viśeṣaṇaṃ prayuktamityarthaḥ || 13 -16 ||
analyzed: tad nirākaraṇa artham iti mām yaḥ abhijānāti na sva ātmānam iti bhāvena mām iti viśeṣaṇam prayuktam iti arthaḥ 13

original: "tatte karma pravakṣyāmi " iti pratijñātamucyate "karmaṇaḥ " iti | taddavargamārthatvādvyācaṣṭe || karmeti|| matta eva bhavatīti boddhavyam | asamānapadasthasya rephottarasya nasya ṇatvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ "brahma ṇa indra upayāhi vidvān " ityādau | ādipadena "boddhavyaṃ ca " ityāderapi pūrvavadyojanāṃ sūcayati || 17 ||
analyzed: tat te karma pravakṣyāmi iti pratijñātam ucyate karmaṇaḥ iti tat da vargam ārthatvāt vyācaṣṭe karma iti mattaḥ eva bhavati iti boddhavyam asamāna pada sthasya repha uttarasya nasya ṇa tvam dṛṣṭam brahma naḥ indraḥ upayāhi vidvān ityādau ādi padena boddhavyam ca ityādeḥ api pūrvavat yojanām sūcayati

original: etadbodhanaṃ stūyate "karmaṇi " iti | tatra pūrvārdhaṃ durgamārthatvādvyācaṣṭe || karmaṇīti || karmavidhiphalayorabhāvāt akarmetyanena tadbhāvājjīvaḥ karmeti sūcitam | jīveśvarayorevaṃ vyutpattyā vyutpattyā karmākarmapadavācyatvaṃ kuta ityata āha || kara iti || amitatvādaviṣayīkṛtatvādityarthaḥ | ko'yaṃ karo nāmetyata āha || kara iti ||
analyzed: etat bodhanam stūyate karmaṇi iti tatra pūrva ardham durgama artha tvāt vyācaṣṭe karmaṇi iti karma vidhi phalayoḥ abhāvāt akarma iti anena tad bhāvāt jīvaḥ karma iti sūcitam jīva īśvarayoḥ evam vyutpattyā vyutpattyā karma akarma pada vācya tvam kutas iti atas āha karaḥ iti amita tvāt aviṣayīkṛta tvāt iti arthaḥ kaḥ ayam karaḥ nāma iti atas āha karaḥ iti

original: karaśabdasya hastādivācitvameva dṛṣṭaṃ, nāgṛṣṭādivācitvamityata uktam | sakārānta iti || hantādivācino'yaṃ sakārānto'nya eveti bhāvaḥ | karmavidhivācī ceti draṣṭavyam | ata eva karmavidhītyādyuktam | anena vidhiśabdenāmitvam akarmapadena kathamucyata iti parāstam | akartari jīve kathaṃ karo mīyata ityata āha || taditi ||
analyzed: kara śabdasya hasta ādi vāci tvam eva dṛṣṭam na agṛṣṭa ādi vāci tvam iti atas uktam sakāra antaḥ iti hanta ādi vācinaḥ yam sakāra antaḥ anyaḥ eva iti bhāvaḥ karma vidhi vācī ca iti draṣṭavyam atas eva karma vidhi ityādi uktam anena vidhi śabdena amitvam akarma padena katham ucyate iti parāstam akartari jīve katham karaḥ mīyate iti atas āha tat iti

original: nākartari kriyādarśanaṃ viruddhaṃ, svātantryeṇākartṛtve'pi bhagavadadhīnakartṛtvāditi bhāvaḥ | ata eva pūrvamasvātantryādityādyuktam | karmaśabdasya jīve vidvadrūḍhiṃ ca dśayati || prasiddhaśceti || nanu jñāninaḥ svātantryeṇa pāratantryeṇa vā kṛtsnakarmākaraṇāt kathaṃ kṛtsnakarmakṛttvamucyata ityata āha || kṛtsneti ||
analyzed: na akartari kriyā darśanam viruddham svātantryeṇa akartṛ tve api bhagavat adhīna kartṛ tvāt iti bhāvaḥ atas eva pūrvam asvātantryāt ityādi uktam karma śabdasya jīve vidvat rūḍhim ca dśayati prasiddhaḥ ca iti nanu jñāninaḥ svātantryeṇa pāratantryeṇa vā kṛtsna karma akaraṇāt katham kṛtsna karma kṛt tvam ucyate iti atas āha kṛtsna iti

original: svayogyāśeṣakarmaphalamokṣasya niyatatvāditi bhāvaḥ || 18 ||
analyzed: sva yogya aśeṣa karma phala mokṣasya niyata tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: na kevalaṃ kartṛtvābhimānaparityāgena kṛtsnakarmakṛttvādi | api tu kāmādiparityāgenāpi bhāvyamityucyate -- yasyetyādiślokapañcakena | tatra nirāśraya ityanyathā padavibhāgapratītinirāsāyāha || anirāśraya iti || pratītaprakāreṇaiva padavibhāgaḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha || bhagavaditi ||
analyzed: na kevalam kartṛ tva abhimāna parityāgena kṛtsna karma kṛt tva ādi api tu kāma ādi parityāgena api bhāvyam iti ucyate yasya ityādi śloka pañcakena tatra nirāśrayaḥ iti anyathā pada vibhāga pratīti nirāsāya āha anirāśrayaḥ iti pratīta prakāreṇa eva pada vibhāgaḥ kim na syāt iti atas āha bhagavat iti

original: jñānino'pi bhagavadāśrayatvena "ajñānāṃ caiva " ityādāvuktatvāt nirāśrayatvānupapatterna pratītaprakāreṇa padavibhāga ityarthaḥ | nanvatra jñāninaḥ śarīrasambandhasadbhāvāt kathaṃ muktatvamucyata ityata āha || muktasyeti || 19 -23 ||
analyzed: jñāninaḥ api bhagavat āśraya tvena ajñānām ca eva ityādau ukta tvāt nirāśraya tva anupapatteḥ na pratīta prakāreṇa pada vibhāgaḥ iti arthaḥ nanu atra jñāninaḥ śarīra sambandha sadbhāvāt katham mukta tvam ucyate iti atas āha muktasya iti 19

original: nanu kutra svātantryābhimānatyāgo vivakṣitaḥ? kiñca yajñarthatvamiti pṛcchati "kathamiti " | tatparihārāyottarapraghaṭṭakamavatārayati || brahmeti || atrārpaṇādīnāṃ brahmaikyamucyate, nābhimānaparityāgaprakāra ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || brahmaṇīti || pratītārtha eva kiṃ na syādityataḥ svoktārthe smṛtisammatimāha || eka iti ||
analyzed: nanu kutra svātantrya abhimāna tyāgaḥ vivakṣitaḥ kiñca yajña artha tvam iti pṛcchati katham iti tad parihārāya uttara praghaṭṭakam avatārayati brahma iti atra arpaṇa ādīnām brahma aikyam ucyate na abhimāna parityāga prakāraḥ iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya āha brahmaṇi iti pratīta arthaḥ eva kim na syāt iti atas sva ukta arthe smṛti sammatim āha ekaḥ iti

original: anena havirādiṣu svasya svātantryamanirūpya brahmādhīnatāṃ jñātvā homādikaraṇaṃ svātantryābhimānaparityāgaḥ | brahmārpaṇaṃ tu yajñārthatvamityuktaṃ bhavati || 24 ||
analyzed: anena haviḥ ādiṣu svasya svātantryam a nirūpya brahma adhīna tām jñātvā homa ādi karaṇam svātantrya abhimāna parityāgaḥ brahma arpaṇam tu yajña artha tvam iti uktam bhavati

original: tatprapañcyate "daivam " ityādinā || tatra pūrvārdhe kasyaciddevasyopāsanamevocyate na tu brahmārphaṇabuddhyā yajanam | ato nāyamardhaḥ pūrvasaṅgata ityata āha || daivamiti || bhagavantaṃ yajña ityupāsata ityanena bhagavāneva yajñaḥ tasya tathopāsanameva yajñakaraṇamityuktaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: tat prapañcyate daivam ityādinā tatra pūrva ardhe kasyacid devasya upāsanam eva ucyate na tu brahma arphaṇa buddhyā yajanam atas na ayam ardhaḥ pūrva saṅgataḥ iti atas āha daivam iti bhagavantam yajñaḥ iti upāsate iti anena bhagavān eva yajñaḥ tasya tathā upāsanam eva yajña karaṇam iti uktam bhavati

original: kathaṃ bhagavato yajñatvam? yena tathopāsanaṃ yajñakaraṇaṃ syādityata āha || sveti || svarūpamevānandādihaviḥ svayamevāgnirbhagavān bhuṅkte, ato'yaṃ yajña ityarthaḥ | "brahmāgnau " ityetaddurgamārthatvāt pūrvasaṅgatatvena vyācaṣṭe || brahmeti || yajñākhyenetyasya sarvaṃ tadadhīnaṃ jñātvetyarthaḥ || 25 ||
analyzed: katham bhagavataḥ yajña tvam yena tathā upāsanam yajña karaṇam syāt iti atas āha sva iti svarūpam eva ānanda ādi haviḥ svayam eva agniḥ bhagavān bhuṅkte atoyam yajñaḥ iti arthaḥ brahma agnau iti etat durgama artha tvāt vyācaṣṭe brahma iti yajña ākhyena iti asya sarvam tad adhīnam jñātvā iti arthaḥ

original: nanu "śrotrādīni " ityādau śrotrādihaviṣaḥ saṃyamākhyāgnyādau homa evocyate, na tu tasya brahmarpaṇam | ato naitatpūrvasaṅgatamityata āha || taditi || atrāpi brahmārpaṇasya "evaṃ bahuvidhāḥ " iti vakṣyamāṇaparyālocanayā vivakṣitatvāvagamāt nāsaṅgatiriti bhāvaḥ || 26 ||
analyzed: nanu śrotra ādīni ityādau śrotra ādi haviṣaḥ saṃyama ākhyā agni ādau homaḥ eva ucyate na tu tasya brahmarpaṇam atas na etat pūrva saṅgatam iti atas āha tat iti atra api brahma arpaṇasya evam bahuvidhāḥ iti vakṣyamāṇa paryālocanayā vivakṣita tva avagamāt na asaṅgatiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: || indriyādisaṃyamamiti || karmendriyāṇāṃ prāṇāpānādīnāṃ ca saṃyamamityarthaḥ | nanvatra kriyāyajña eva yajñenaivetyabhimānatyāgokteḥ kathaṃ daivamityādi pūrvasaṅgatamityata āha || yajñenaiveti || svayameva yajña ityādyapūrvārtho'yaṃ kuta ityata āha tenaiveti || 27 -31 ||
analyzed: indriya ādi saṃyamam iti karmendriyāṇām prāṇa apāna ādīnām ca saṃyamam iti arthaḥ nanu atra kriyā yajñaḥ eva yajñena eva iti abhimāna tyāga ukteḥ katham daivam ityādi pūrva saṅgatam iti atas āha yajñena eva iti svayam eva yajñaḥ iti ādya pūrva arthaḥ yam kutas iti atas āha tena eva iti

original: "brahmaṇo mukhe " ityasya vedādāvityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || śrotreti || iti śaṃkā syāt tāmiti śeṣaḥ | pratīta evarthaḥ kiṃ na syādityata uktārthe smṛtisammatimāha || sarveti || 32 ||
analyzed: brahmaṇaḥ mukhe iti asya veda ādau iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya āha śrotra iti iti śaṃkā syāt tām iti śeṣaḥ pratītaḥ eva arthaḥ kim na syāt iti atas ukta arthe smṛti sammatim āha sarva iti

original: dravyamayādyajñāt jñānayajñasyottamatve heturucyate " sarvamiti " | tatra sarvākhilaśabdayorekārthatvapratīteḥ jñānānantaraṃ karma nāstīnyathāpratīteśca nirāsāyāha || sarvamiti || pūryate saphalaṃ bhavatītyāśayaḥ | samāptiśabdasya pūrtivācitvādarśanāt kathamatra lūrtavācitvamityata āha || samāpteti ||
analyzed: dravya mayāt yajñāt jñāna yajñasya uttama tve hetuḥ ucyate sarvam iti tatra sarva akhila śabdayoḥ ekārtha tva pratīteḥ jñāna anantaram karma na asti inyathā pratīteḥ ca nirāsāya āha sarvam iti pūryate saphalam bhavati iti āśayaḥ samāpti śabdasya pūrti vāci tva adarśanāt katham atra lūrta vāci tvam iti atas āha samāpta iti

original: dhanurvidyāviṣaye sampūrṇavidyān kṛṣṇasātyakiyuktapañcayavacanam | astu pūrtāvapi samāptiśabdaprayogaḥ | tathāpyatra pūrtivācitvaṃ kutaḥ? pratītārtha eva kiṃ na syādityata āha || jñāneti || punaryogakathanāt jñānānantaramapi karmānuṣṭhānakathanāt || 33 ||
analyzed: dhanurvidyā viṣaye astu pūrtau api samāpti śabda prayogaḥ tathā api atra pūrti vāci tvam kutas pratīta arthaḥ eva kim na syāt iti atas āha jñāna iti punar yoga kathanāt jñāna anantaram api karma anuṣṭhāna kathanāt

original: jñānasya karmaṇo'dhikatvamuktvā tadāpādanaṃ vidhīyate "taditi " tatra svayaṃ jñānopadeśāyaiva pravṛttatvāt "na tvevāham " iti jñānasyopadiṣṭatvācca katham "upadekṣyanti te jñānam " ityucyata ityata āha || jñānamiti || upadekṣyantīti niścitatvābhiprāyeṇa | parokṣatayopadekṣyāma ityevocyamānatvāt na jñānopadeśārthaṃ pravṛttatvavirodhaḥ |
analyzed: jñānasya karmaṇā udhika tvam uktvā tad āpādanam vidhīyate tat iti tatra svayam jñāna upadeśāya eva pravṛtta tvāt na tu eva aham iti jñānasya upadiṣṭa tvāt ca katham upadekṣyanti te jñānam iti ucyate iti atas āha jñānam iti upadekṣyanti iti niścita tva abhiprāyeṇa parokṣa tayā upadekṣyāmaḥ iti eva ucyamāna tvāt na jñāna upadeśa artham pravṛtta tva virodhaḥ

original: na ca jñānasyopadiṣṭatvavirodhaḥ saṅkṣepeṇopadiṣṭatve'pi "jñānaṃ te'haṃ " ityādinā punarupadekṣyamāṇatvāditi bhāvaḥ || 34 ||
analyzed: na ca jñānasya upadiṣṭa tva virodhaḥ saṅkṣepeṇa upadiṣṭa tve api jñānam ityādinā punar upadekṣyamāṇa tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: jñānaṃ stūyate "yat iti | tatra svasmin, mayi cetyanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || ātmanīti || īśvaramantareṇa sarvabhūtādhāratvasyānyatrānupapatterna pratīta evārtha ityarthaḥ | evaṃ cet "atho " iti samuccayavācī śabdo vyartha ityata āha || atho iti || 35 -40 ||
analyzed: jñānam stūyate yat iti tatra svasmin mayi ca iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya āha ātmani iti īśvaram antareṇa sarva bhūta ādhāra tvasya anyatra anupapatteḥ na pratītaḥ eva arthaḥ iti arthaḥ evam ced atho iti samuccaya vācī śabdaḥ vyarthaḥ iti atas āha atho iti

original: jñānaphalamucyate "yoga " iti | tatra "ātmavantaṃ " ityātmā jīvaścet svasambandhoktirayuktā'nupayuktā ca | paramātmā cetsarveṣāmapi tadvattvasāmyāt ko viśeṣo jñānina ityata āha || ātmeti || 41 -43 ||
analyzed: jñāna phalam ucyate yogaḥ iti tatra ātmavantam iti ātmā jīvaḥ ced sva sambandha uktiḥ ayuktā anupayuktā ca paramātmā ced sarveṣām api tadvat tva sāmyāt kaḥ viśeṣaḥ jñāninaḥ iti atas āha ātmā iti 41

original: iti śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpādācāryaviracitasya śrīmadbhagavadgītātātparyanirṇayasya ṭīkāyāṃ jayatīrthamuniviracitāyāṃ nyāyadīpikāyāṃ caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||
analyzed: iti śrīmat ānandatīrtha bhagavat pāda ācārya viracitasya śrīmat bhagavadgītā tātparya nirṇayasya ṭīkāyām jayatīrtha muni viracitāyām nyāyadīpikāyām caturthaḥ udhyāyaḥ

original: hariḥ oṃ || etadadhyāyapratipādyamarthaṃ darśayati || yogeti || pūrvaṃ samuccitaḥ karmayogo nirūpitaḥ | saca yogasaṃnyāsabhedena dvividhaḥ | dvividhayośca svarūpaṃ saṅkṣepeṇa "kuru karmaṇi ", "saṅgaṃ tyaktvā " ityādāvuktam | tadevānenādhyāyena spaṣṭayatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: hariḥ om etad adhyāya pratipādyam artham darśayati yoga iti pūrvam samuccitaḥ karmayogaḥ nirūpitaḥ saca yoga saṃnyāsa bhedena dvividhaḥ dvividhayoḥ ca svarūpam saṅkṣepeṇa kuru karmaṇi saṅgam tyaktvā ityādau uktam tat eva anena adhyāyena spaṣṭayati iti arthaḥ

original: praśnavākyaṃ sābhiprāyamavatārayati || yogeti || "yogasaṃnyastakarmāṇam " ityādau paṭhito nyāsaśabdo yatyāśramaviṣayo "yogamātiṣṭha " ityādau śruto yogaśabdo gṛhasthāśramaviṣaya iti kalpayitvā yatīnāṃ sarvakarmatyāgena jñānamātrādhikāritvāt gṛhiṇāṃ jñānaparityāgena karmamātrādhikāritvāt tayorekapunniṣṭhatvaṃ na yujyata iti bhāvena
analyzed: praśna vākyam sa abhiprāyam avatārayati yoga iti yoga saṃnyasta karmāṇam ityādau paṭhitaḥ nyāsa śabdaḥ yati āśrama viṣayaḥ yogam ātiṣṭhe ityādau śrutaḥ yoga śabdaḥ gṛhastha āśrama viṣayaḥ iti kalpayitvā yatīnām sarva karma tyāgena jñāna mātra adhikāri tvāt gṛhiṇām jñāna parityāgena karma mātra adhikāri tvāt tayoḥ eka punniṣṭhatvam na yujyate iti bhāvena

original: yogasaṃnyāsayormadhye śreyaḥ pṛcchati | ubhayasyāpi kartavyatayā vihitatvādekenaivānuṣṭhātumaśakyatvāt anyataraparityāgenānyataragrahaṇe śreyasa eva grāhyatvāditi bhāvaḥ || 1 ||
analyzed: yoga saṃnyāsayoḥ madhye śreyaḥ pṛcchati ubhayasya api kartavya tayā vihita tvāt ekena eva anuṣṭhātum aśakya tvāt anyatara parityāgena anyatara grahaṇe śreyasaḥ eva grāhya tvāt iti bhāvaḥ 1

original: nanu yogasaṃnyāsayormadhye śreyomātra evāyaṃ praśno, na tūktarītyā virodhābhiprāyeṇa | tathātve parihārābhāvādityataḥ parihāravākyābhiprāyamāha || eketi || ubhayorekapuṃyogyatvāt niḥśreyasakaratvācca anuṣṭheyatvādanyatarasya śreṣṭhatve praśno vyartha eva | atha svarūpajñānamātrārthaḥ praśnaścedyoga eva viśiṣṭa iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: nanu yoga saṃnyāsayoḥ madhye śreyaḥ mātraḥ eva ayam praśnaḥ na tu ukta rītyā virodha abhiprāyeṇa tathātve parihāra abhāvāt iti atas parihāra vākya abhiprāyam āha eka iti ubhayoḥ eka puṃs yogyatvāt niḥśreyasa karatvāt ca anuṣṭheya tvāt anyatarasya śreṣṭha tve praśnaḥ vyarthaḥ eva atha svarūpa jñāna mātra arthaḥ praśnaḥ ced yogaḥ eva viśiṣṭaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: yogasaṃnyāsayorekapuṃyogyatvābhidhāyakaṃ padamatra na śrūyata ityatastatpaṭhitvā vyācaṣṭe || ubhāviti || dvāvapi pratyekaṃ śreyaskarāvityarthaḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha || saṃnyāsastviti || yogarahitasaṃnyāsasya anarthakaratvokteḥ saṃnyāsarahitayogasyaivāsambhavāt samuccitayoreva niḥśreyasakaratvamucyate na pratyekamiti bhāvaḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: yoga saṃnyāsayoḥ eka puṃs yogyatva abhidhāyakam padam atra na śrūyate iti atas tat paṭhitvā vyācaṣṭe ubhau iti dvau api pratyekam śreyaskarau iti arthaḥ kim na syāt iti atas āha saṃnyāsaḥ tu iti yoga rahita saṃnyāsasya anartha karatva ukteḥ saṃnyāsa rahita yogasya eva asambhavāt samuccitayoḥ eva niḥśreyasa karatvam ucyate na pratyekam iti bhāvaḥ

original: kathaṃ yogasaṃnyāsayoḥ samuccayo yujyate? yatigṛsthayoradhikārabhedādityāśaṃkāparihārāya ślokamavatārayati || dveṣādīti || atra "saṃnyastakarmāṇam " ityādau | evaṃ "yogamātiṣṭha "ityādau bhagavadarpaṇādīyoga evābhipreto na gṛhasthāśrama ityapi draṣṭavyam |
analyzed: katham yoga saṃnyāsayoḥ samuccayaḥ yujyate yati gṛ sthayoḥ adhikāra bhedāt iti āśaṃkā parihārāya ślokam avatārayati dveṣa ādi iti atra saṃnyasta karmāṇam ityādau evam yogam ātiṣṭhe ityādau bhagavat arpaṇa ādī yogaḥ eva abhipretaḥ na gṛhastha āśramaḥ iti api draṣṭavyam

original: nanu kathaṃ dveṣādivarjanasya saṃnyāsatvamatrocyate? "kāmyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ nyāsaṃ saṃnyāsaṃ kavayo viduḥ " iti kāmyakarmaparityāgasya saṃnyāsatvābhidhāyakavākyavirodhādityata āha || na ceti || bhavettadvirodho yadyatra dveṣādivarjanamātraṃ saṃnyāsatvena vivakṣitaṃ syāt | naitadasti |
analyzed: nanu katham dveṣa ādi varjanasya saṃnyāsa tvam atra ucyate kāmyānām karmaṇām nyāsam saṃnyāsam kavayaḥ viduḥ iti kāmya karma parityāgasya saṃnyāsa tva abhidhāyaka vākya virodhāt iti atas āha na ca iti bhavet tad virodhaḥ yadi atra dveṣa ādi varjana mātram saṃnyāsa tvena vivakṣitam syāt na etat asti

original: kāmyakarmaparityāgenāpi sahitasya dveṣādivarjanasya saṃnyāsatvenābhipretatvādityarthaḥ | kathamatra kāṅkṣādivarjanasya saṃnyāsatvamucyate? "sarvakarmaphalatyāgaṃ prāhustyāgaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ " iti tasya tyāgatvenoktatvāt | na ca saṃnyāsatyāgayoraikyādavirodhaḥ | "kāmyānāṃ " iti śloke nyāsāttyāgasya pṛthaktvenoktestadvirodhādityata āha || na ceti ||
analyzed: kāmya karma parityāgena api sahitasya dveṣa ādi varjanasya saṃnyāsa tvena abhipreta tvāt iti arthaḥ katham atra kāṅkṣā ādi varjanasya saṃnyāsa tvam ucyate sarva karma phala tyāgam prāhuḥ tyāgam vicakṣaṇaḥ iti tasya tyāga tvena ukta tvāt na ca saṃnyāsa tyāgayoḥ aikyāt avirodhaḥ kāmyānām iti śloke nyāsāt tyāgasya pṛthaktvena ukteḥ tad virodhāt iti atas āha na ca iti

original: bhavatyevākāṅkṣādivarjanaṃ nyāsaḥ | na ca tasya tyāgatvoktivarodhaḥ | nyāsatyāgayoraikyāt | na ca pṛthaktvoktivirodhaḥ |
analyzed: bhavati eva ākāṅkṣā ādi varjanam nyāsaḥ na ca tasya tyāga tva ukti varodhaḥ nyāsa tyāgayoḥ aikyāt na ca pṛthaktva ukti virodhaḥ

original: yathā khalu pāṇḍavānāṃ kurutve'pi "santānabījaṃ kurupāṇḍavānām " iti pṛthaguktiryujyate, pāṇḍavānāṃ kurvavāntarabhedatvena kurupāṇḍavānāṃ sākṣādaikyābhāvāt, evaṃ tyāgasya nyāsatve'pi nyāsāvāntarabhedatvena tyāganyāsayoḥ sākṣādaikyābhāvāt pṛthag vacanopapatteriti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: yathā khalu pāṇḍavānām kuru tve pi santāna bījam kuru pāṇḍavānām iti pṛthak uktiḥ yujyate pāṇḍavānām kuru avāntara bheda tvena kuru pāṇḍavānām sākṣāt aikya abhāvāt evam tyāgasya nyāsa tve pi nyāsa avāntara bheda tvena tyāga nyāsayoḥ sākṣāt aikya abhāvāt pṛthak vacana upapatteḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: nyasādiśabdasya yatyādyāśramārthatvaṃ gṛhītvā tayoradhikārabhedāt samāveśāyogo yaścodito'sau nyāsādiśabdasya tadarthatvānaṅgīkāreṇa parihṛtaḥ || 3 ||
analyzed: nyasa ādi śabdasya yati ādi āśrama artha tvam gṛhītvā tayoḥ adhikāra bhedāt samāveśa ayogaḥ yaḥ ca uditaḥ asau nyāsa ādi śabdasya tad artha tva anaṅgīkāreṇa parihṛtaḥ 3

original: athāsāvadhikārabhedo'pi na yujyata ityucyate "sāṅkhya "iti | durgamārthatvāt ślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe || bālā iti || jñānamārgaṃ samyagāsthita eva jñānaphalaṃ prāpnoti | karmakārgaṃ ca samyagāsthita eva karmaphalaṃ prāpnotītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: atha asau adhikāra bhedaḥ api na yujyate iti ucyate sāṅkhyaḥ iti durgama artha tvāt ślokam vyācaṣṭe bālāḥ iti jñāna mārgam samyak āsthitaḥ eva jñāna phalam prāpnoti karma kārgam ca samyak āsthitaḥ eva karma phalam prāpnoti iti arthaḥ

original: jñānaikagamyayatiprāpyasthānaprāptisadbhāvācca gṛdiṇāṃ jñānādhikāro'stītyuktvā upasaṃhriyate "yat " iti | tatra " ekaṃ sāṅkhyaṃ " ityupasaṃhāravākye jñānakarmaṇoraikyaṃ kimarthamucyata ityato yathāvadvyācaṣṭe || tasmāditi || jñānināṃ yatīnāmiti śeṣaḥ | samyakkarmānuṣṭhānenaiva karmī karmaphalaṃ prāpnoti cettathāpi kutastasya jñānamityata āha ||
analyzed: jñāna eka gamya yati prāpya sthāna prāpti sadbhāvāt ca gṛdiṇām jñāna adhikāraḥ usti iti uktvā upasaṃhriyate yat iti tatra ekam sāṅkhyam iti upasaṃhāra vākye jñāna karmaṇoḥ aikyam kimartham ucyate iti atas yathāvat vyācaṣṭe tasmāt iti jñāninām yatīnām iti śeṣaḥ samyakkarma anuṣṭhānena eva karmī karma phalam prāpnoti ced tathā api kutas tasya jñānam iti atas āha

original: na hīti || evaṃ samyagjñānamārgānuṣṭhānainaiva jñānaphalaṃ prāpnoti cettathāpi kuto jñaninaḥ karmeti śaṅ‌kāyāṃ na hi karma vinā jñānamārgastha samyaganuṣṭhānaṃ bhavati | saṃpūrṇaphalasādhanatvābhāvāditi parihāro draṣṭavyaḥ | atra smṛtisammatiṃ cāha || niṣkāmamiti || anena karmiṇāṃ jñānamucyate | " buddhyā " iti jñānasadbhāve hetvantaramāha ||
analyzed: na hi iti evam samyak jñāna mārga anuṣṭhānaiḥ eva jñāna phalam prāpnoti ced tathā api kutas jñaninaḥ karma iti śaṅkāyām na hi karma vinā jñāna mārga stha samyak anuṣṭhānam bhavati saṃpūrṇa phala sādhana tva abhāvāt iti parihāraḥ draṣṭavyaḥ atra smṛti sammatim ca āha niṣkāmam iti anena karmiṇām jñānam ucyate buddhyāḥ iti jñāna sadbhāve hetu antaram āha

original: etasmāditi || " muktiḥ " ityubhayam |
analyzed: etasmāt iti muktiḥ iti ubhayam

original: karmiṇāṃ jñānasadbhāvādevetyarthaḥ | anena " yatsāṅkhyaiḥ " iti vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | ubhayorapi jñānakarmasadbhāve kathamāśramabheda ityata āha || tasmāditi || ubhayorapyubhayasadbhāvasya yuktyādisiddhatvāditi bhāvaḥ | saṅ‌kocavikāsa sambhavaḥ || 4 || 5 ||
analyzed: karmiṇām jñāna sadbhāvāt eva iti arthaḥ anena yat sāṅkhyaiḥ iti vyākhyātam bhavati ubhayoḥ api jñāna karma sadbhāve katham āśrama bhedaḥ iti atas āha tasmāt iti ubhayoḥ api ubhaya sadbhāvasya yukti ādi siddha tvāt iti bhāvaḥ saṅkoca vikāsa sambhavaḥ

original: samuccitayoreva yogasaṃnyāsayorniḥśreyasakaratvamuktam | asamuccaye bādhakamucyate " saṃnyāsastu " iti | tatsmṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || mokṣeti || yoga iti || ucyata iti śeṣaḥ | viṣṇvarpitatayā tadrūpa iti sambandhaḥ | pādatrayam uttarārdhavyākhyātam | " nānyaḥ " iti pūrvārdhasya | tadvivṛṇoti || viṣṇviti ||
analyzed: samuccitayoḥ eva yoga saṃnyāsayoḥ niḥśreyasa kara tvam uktam asamuccaye bādhakam ucyate saṃnyāsaḥ tu iti tad smṛtyā eva vyācaṣṭe mokṣa iti yogaḥ iti ucyate iti śeṣaḥ viṣṇu arpita tayā tad rūpaḥ iti sambandhaḥ pāda trayam uttara ardha vyākhyātam na anyaḥ iti pūrva ardhasya tat vivṛṇoti viṣṇu iti

original: ādipadena svocitakarmaṇāṃ viṣṇvarpaṇādikaṃ na kāryamiti buddhyā kṛto narakaphala iti jñātavyam | " ayogataḥ " iti yogarūpatvaṃ vineti kimarthamucyate | yogaṃ vinetyeva kiṃ na syādityata āha || yamiti || yaṃ saṃnyāsam " iti yogasaṃnyāsayoraikyasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt saṃnyāsasya yogarūpatvameva vācyamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: ādi padena sva ucita karmaṇām viṣṇu arpaṇa ādikam na kāryam iti buddhyā kṛtaḥ naraka phalaḥ iti jñātavyam ayogataḥ iti yoga rūpatvam vinā iti kimartham ucyate yogam vinā iti eva kim na syāt iti atas āha yam iti yam saṃnyāsam iti yoga saṃnyāsayoḥ aikyasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt saṃnyāsasya yoga rūpatvam eva vācyam iti arthaḥ

original: yogasaṃnyāsayoraikye " saṃnyāsaḥ karmayogaśya " iti pṛthaguktiḥ kathamityata āha || yogeti || yogo nyāsaścetyeka evārthaḥ | api tu nyāso yogāvāntarabhedaḥ | ataḥ kurupāṇḍavavat pṛthaguktirupapannetyarthaḥ || 6 ||
analyzed: yoga saṃnyāsayoḥ aikye saṃnyāsaḥ iti pṛthak uktiḥ katham iti atas āha yoga iti yogaḥ nyāsaḥ ca iti ekaḥ eva arthaḥ api tu nyāsaḥ yoga avāntarabhedaḥ atas kuru pāṇḍava vat pṛthak uktiḥ upapannā iti arthaḥ

original: yogarūpatāṃ vinā nyāsasyānarthasādhanatvamuktvā | " yogayuktaḥ " ityanena yogarūpasaṃnyāsasyoktaṃ mokṣasādhanatvaṃ prapañcyate || yogayukta iti || tatra yogasaṃnyāsayoreva vaktavyatvāt tayośca yogayuktādipadairuktatvāt " sarvabhūtātmabhūtātmā " iti kimucyata ityata āha || rarveti || anenāpi yoga evocyata iti nāsaṅgatiḥ |
analyzed: yoga rūpatām vinā nyāsasya anartha sādhanatvam uktvā yoga yuktaḥ iti anena yoga rūpa saṃnyāsasya uktam mokṣa sādhanatvam prapañcyate yoga yuktaḥ iti tatra yoga saṃnyāsayoḥ eva vaktavya tvāt tayoḥ ca yoga yukta ādi padaiḥ ukta tvāt sarva bhūta ātma bhūta ātmā iti kim ucyate iti atas āha rarva iti anena api yogaḥ eva ucyate iti nā asaṅgatiḥ

original: nāpi yogayuktapadena yogasyoktatvādvaiyyarthyam | yogayuktapadena karmayogasyoktatvāt , anena dhyānayogasyoktatvāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: nā api yoga yukta padena yogasya ukta tvāt vaiyyarthyam yoga yukta padena karmayogasya ukta tvāt anena dhyānayogasya ukta tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: atrādhikāriṇaḥ sarvabhūtaikyamucyate | ataḥ kathamiyaṃ dhyānayogokitirityucyata ityataḥ smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || ādānāditi || bhūtamanāḥ sthitamanāḥ || 7 ||
analyzed: atra adhikāriṇaḥ sarva bhūta aikyam ucyate atas katham iyam dhyāna yoga ukitiḥ iti ucyate iti atas smṛtyā eva vyācaṣṭe ādānāt iti bhūtamanāḥ sthita manāḥ

original: yogarūpasaṃnyāsasya mokṣahetutvamuktam | tatra saṃnyāsasya yogarūpatvaṃ kena prakāreṇetyatantatparihāratvena ślokadvayamavatārayati || yatheti || tatrendriyāṇāmeva svatantryeṇa kartṛtvamucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāya smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || viṣṇunati || 8 || 9 ||
analyzed: yoga rūpa saṃnyāsasya mokṣa hetu tvam uktam tatra saṃnyāsasya yoga rūpa tvam kena prakāreṇa iti atas tad parihāra tvena śloka dvayam avatārayati yathā iti tatra indriyāṇām eva svatantryeṇa kartṛ tvam ucyate iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya smṛtyā eva vyācaṣṭe viṣṇu nati 8

original: yogarūpasaṃnyāsavato muktirbhavatīti nopacāramātramiti bhāvena punaḥ phalamucyate " brahmaṇi " iti | tatra karmaṇāṃ brahmaṇyādhānaṃ nāmākaraṇamevetyanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || tatpūjeti || ādhānaṃ karmaṇāmiti śeṣaḥ | anyathā karotītyasya vyāghātāditi bhāvaḥ | bhavatpakṣe'pi yadi karmāṇi bhagavatkṛtāni tarhi jīvasyākatrṛtvaṃ syāt |
analyzed: yoga rūpa saṃnyāsavataḥ muktiḥ bhavati iti na upacāra mātram iti bhāvena punar phalam ucyate brahmaṇi iti tatra karmaṇām brahmaṇi ādhānam nāma akaraṇam eva iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya āha tad pūjā iti ādhānam karmaṇām iti śeṣaḥ anyathā karoti iti asya vyāghātāt iti bhāvaḥ bhavat pakṣe pi yadi karmāṇi bhagavat kṛtāni tarhi jīvasya akatrṛ tvam syāt

original: tathāca karotīti vyāhataṃ syāt | mama śubhārthamiti cāsambhavītyata āha || svātantryeti || karmaṇāṃ bhagavatkṛtatve jīvasyākartṛtvaṃ syāditi satyameva | na ca tāvatā jīvasya kartṛtvaphalasambandhānupapattiḥ | svatantryābhāvavivakṣayaiva akartṛtvasyābhyupagatatvena bhagavadadhīnatayā kartṛtvopapatteriti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tathā ca karoti iti vyāhatam syāt mama śubha artham iti ca asambhavi iti atas āha svātantrya iti karmaṇām bhagavat kṛta tve jīvasya akartṛ tvam syāt iti satyam eva na ca tāvatā jīvasya kartṛ tva phala sambandha anupapattiḥ svatantrya abhāva vivakṣayā eva akartṛ tvasya abhyupagata tvena bhagavat adhīnatayā kartṛ tva upapatteḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: asvatantratve ca jīvasya bhagavatpūjākartṛtvaṃ śubhayogaśca na yujyate | asvatantre kartṛśabdaprayogasya phalasambandhasya cādarśanādityāśaṃkāṃ smṛtyaiva pariharati || svavandanamiti || kāritaṃ śiśuneti śeṣaḥ | śiśukartṛkaṃ bhavediti sambandhaḥ || 10 -12 ||
analyzed: asvatantra tve ca jīvasya bhagavat pūjā kartṛ tvam śubha yogaḥ ca na yujyate asvatantre kartṛ śabda prayogasya phala sambandhasya ca adarśanāt iti āśaṃkām smṛtyā eva pariharati sva vandanam iti kāritam śiśunā iti śeṣaḥ śiśu kartṛkam bhavet iti sambandhaḥ

original: itaśca karmaṇāṃ brahmaṇyādhānaṃ nāma tatra svasya svātantryābhimānatyāga eva | na tu svarūpaparityāga ityāha || ata iti || " brahmaṇyādhāya karmāṇi " iti saṃnyāso hyucyeta | tallakṣaṇaṃ ca " sarvakarmāṇi " ityanena prapañcyate | tatra karmaṇāṃ svarūpaparityāgābhāvādeva hi manasaiva tyāgo'bhihitaḥ |
analyzed: itas ca karmaṇām brahmaṇi ādhānam nāma tatra svasya svātantrya abhimāna tyāgaḥ eva na tu sva rūpa parityāgaḥ iti āha atas iti brahmaṇi ādhāya karmāṇi iti saṃnyāsaḥ hi ucyeta tad lakṣaṇam ca sarva karmāṇi iti anena prapañcyate tatra karmaṇām sva rūpa parityāga abhāvāt eva hi manasā eva tyāgaḥ abhihitaḥ

original: ataśca nātrāpi karmaṇāṃ svarūpatyāgo'rtha iti bhāvaḥ | manasaiva tyāgābhidhāne kathaṃ svarūpatyāgābhāva ityaha āha || asvātantryeti || manasaiva karmanyāso nāma svātantryābhimānaparityāga eva | na tu svarūpatyāgaḥ | tathātve manaseti viśeṣaṇavaiyyarthyāditi bhāvaḥ || 10 -13 ||
analyzed: atas ca na atra api karmaṇām sva rūpa tyāgaḥ ṛthaḥ iti bhāvaḥ manasā eva tyāga abhidhāne katham sva rūpa tyāga abhāvaḥ iti aha āha asvātantrya iti manasā eva karma nyāsaḥ nāma svātantrya abhimāna parityāgaḥ eva na tu sva rūpa tyāgaḥ tathātve manasā iti viśeṣaṇa vaiyyarthyāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: yaduktaṃ jīvānāṃ svātantryābhāvāpekṣayaivākartṛtvaṃ, paratantrakartṛtvaṃ tvastyeveti na tadyuktam | " na kartṛtvaṃ " ityuttaravākyavirodhādityata āha || yatheti || svato jīvānāṃ svatantrakartṛtvādyabhāve'pi paramātmadattaṃ tadasti | ataḥ kathaṃ brahmaṇyādhānamucyata ityāśaṃkāmevātra pariharati |
analyzed: yat uktam jīvānām svātantrya abhāva apekṣayā eva akartṛ tvam paratantra kartṛ tvam tu asti eva iti na tat yuktam na kartṛ tvam iti uttara vākya virodhāt iti atas āha yathā iti svatas jīvānām svatantra kartṛ tva ādi abhāve pi paramātma dattam tat asti atas katham brahmaṇi ādhānam ucyate iti āśaṃkām eva atra pariharati

original: na tu jīvānāṃ sarvātmanā kartṛtvābhāvaṃ vaktīti bhāvaḥ | karmaphalasaṃyoge ca svātantryamityapi saṃyojyam | anena " na kartṛtvaṃ na karmāṇi " iti paunaruktyaṃ ca paridṛtam | nanvatra kartṛtvādyabhāva evocyate, na tu tatrāsvātantryam | ataḥ kathamanenaiṣā śaṃkā parihriyata ityata āha kriyāyāmiti || kartṛtvādikaṃ na sṛjatītyasya tatra
analyzed: na tu jīvānām sarvātmanā kartṛ tva abhāvam vakti iti bhāvaḥ karma phala saṃyoge ca svātantryam iti api saṃyojyam anena na kartṛ tvam na karmāṇi iti paunaruktyam ca paridṛtam nanu atra kartṛ tva ādi abhāvaḥ eva ucyate na tu tatra asvātantryam atas katham anena eṣā śaṃkā parihriyate iti atas āha kriyāyām iti kartṛ tva ādikam na sṛjati iti asya tatra

original: svātantryaṃ na sṛjatītyevārthaḥ | ato bhavatyetadāśaṃkāparihāra ityarthaḥ | nanvatreśvarasyaiva kartṛtvādyabhāva ucyata iti kiṃ na syādityata āha || anyatheti || yadyatreśvarasyaiva kartṛtvādyabhava ucyate tadā lokasya kartṛtvādikaṃ na sṛjatīti vyarthaṃ syādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: svātantryam na sṛjati iti eva arthaḥ atas bhavati etad āśaṃkā parihāraḥ iti arthaḥ nanu atra īśvarasya eva kartṛ tva ādi abhāvaḥ ucyate iti kim na syāt iti atas āha anyathā iti yadi atra īśvarasya eva kartṛ tva ādi abhavaḥ ucyate tadā lokasya kartṛ tva ādikam na sṛjati iti vyartham syāt iti arthaḥ

original: yaduktaṃ jīvasya pāratantryeṇa kartṛtavādyastīti na tadyuktam | kartṛtvādi īśvaro lokasya na sṛjatītyuktatvāt | na ca tra tasya svātantryaṃ na sṛjatītyarthaḥ | kartṛtvādisadbhāve'pi svātantryāpradānābhiprāyeṇa kartṛtvādikaṃ na sṛjatītyevaṃjātīyaprayogādarśanādityata āha || janapada iti ||
analyzed: yat uktam jīvasya pāratantryeṇa kartṛ tava ādi asti iti na tat yuktam kartṛ tva ādi īśvaraḥ lokasya na sṛjati iti ukta tvāt na ca tasya svātantryam na sṛjati iti arthaḥ kartṛ tva ādi sadbhāve pi svātantrya apradāna abhiprāyeṇa kartṛ tva ādikam na sṛjati iti evaṃjātīya prayoga adarśanāt iti atas āha janapadaḥ iti

original: yadyatra jīvānāṃ sarvātmaneśvarasya ca kartṛtvaṃ na niṣidhyeta tarhi " svabhāvastu pravartate " iti svabhāvadeva pravṛttikathanaṃ na yujyata ityata āha || svayameveti || nātra svabhāvapadena prasiddhasvabhāvo'bhidhīyate | yonoktavirodhaḥ | kintu svasthitāvanyakaraṇe ca paranirapekṣatvādbhagavānevetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: yadi atra jīvānām sarvātmanā īśvarasya ca kartṛ tvam na niṣidhyeta tarhi svabhāvaḥ tu pravartate iti svabhāva deva pravṛtti kathanam na yujyate iti atas āha svayam eva iti na atra svabhāva padena prasiddha svabhāvaḥ abhidhīyate kintu sva sthitau anya karaṇe ca para nirapekṣa tvāt bhagavān eva iti arthaḥ

original: prasiddhapadaparityāgenāprasiddhapadaprayogaḥ kimarthamityato hetusūcanārthamiti bhāvena vākyārthamāha || svabhāvatvāditi ||
analyzed: prasiddha pada parityāgena aprasiddha pada prayogaḥ kimartham iti atas hetu sūcana artham iti bhāvena vākya artham āha svabhāva tvāt iti

original: nanu kimarthamevamarthāntaraṃ kalpanīyam? jīvasyeveśvarasya ca kartṛtvādikaṃ nāstyeva | viśvapravṛttistu svabhāvādevetyarthaḥ kiṃ na syāt? lokasyetyasya lokaviṣaya ityarthopapatterityataḥ svoktārthe smṛtisammatimāha || svātantryāditi || nāsyasya sṛjati | api tu svayameva pravartata iti śeṣaḥ | īśvarasyaiva kartṛtve karmalepaḥ syādityata āha ||
analyzed: nanu kimartham evam artha antaram kalpanīyam jīvasya iva īśvarasya ca kartṛ tva ādikam na asti eva viśva pravṛttiḥ tu svabhāvāt eva iti arthaḥ kim na syāt lokasya iti asya loka viṣayaḥ iti artha upapatteḥ iti atas sva ukta arthe smṛti sammatim āha svātantryāt iti na asya asya sṛjati api tu svayam eva pravartate iti śeṣaḥ īśvarasya eva kartṛ tve karma lepaḥ syāt iti atas āha

original: svātantryādeveti || anena " nādatte " ityasyārtho'pyukto bhavati | evaṃ sarveṣu sthitvā svātantreṇa kartā īśvaro'sti cet kathaṃ na dṛśyata ityata āha || ajñāneti || etenājñāneti vyākhyātaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: svātantryāt eva iti anena na ādatte iti asya arthaḥ upi uktaḥ bhavati evam sarveṣu sthitvā svātantreṇa kartā īśvaraḥ asti ced katham na dṛśyate iti atas āha ajñāna iti etena ajñāna iti vyākhyātam bhavati

original: yaduktamīśvaraḥ svayameva bhāvayatīti na tadyuktam | tasya kartṛtvābhāvāt | tasya kartṛtvasadbhāve'pi tasyāsvābhāvavikatvādityata āha || ahamiti || ahaṃ sarvasyeti vacanadvayaṃ kartṛtvasadbhāve mānam | parāsyetyādikaṃ kartṛtvasya svābhāvikatve | tvadṛte dūre samīpe vā kiñcana kenāpi na kriyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: yat uktam īśvaraḥ svayam eva bhāvayati iti na tat yuktam tasya kartṛ tva abhāvāt tasya kartṛ tva sadbhāve api tasya a svābhāvavika tvāt iti atas āha aham iti aham sarvasya iti vacana dvayam kartṛ tva sadbhāve mānam parāsya iti ādikam kartṛ tvasya svābhāvika tve tvad ṛte dūre samīpe vā kiñcana kena api na kriyate iti arthaḥ

original: atra bhagavaditarasya kartṛtvābhāvoktyā īśvarakartṛtvasyāparādhīnatvasambhavena svābhāvikatvamevocyate | lokavadityatrāpi phalādyapekṣā'bhāvena kartṛtvoktyā tasya svābhāvikatvamevocyate | itaśca neśvarasya akartṛtvamasvābhāvikaṃ kartṛtvaṃ cetyāha || viparīteti || nanvasmābhirīśvarasya kartṛtvamasvābhāvikapadenānirvācyamabhipreyate |
analyzed: atra bhagavat itarasya kartṛ tva abhāva uktyā īśvara kartṛ tvasya apara adhīnatva sambhavena svābhāvika tvam eva ucyate loka vat iti atra api phala ādi apekṣā bhāvena kartṛ tva uktyā tasya svābhāvika tvam eva ucyate itas ca na īśvarasya akartṛ tvam asvābhāvikam kartṛ tvam ca iti āha viparīta iti nanu asmābhiḥ īśvarasya kartṛ tvam asvābhāvika padena anirvācyam abhipreyate

original: na tu phalāpekṣaṃ parādhīnaṃ vā | ato nodāhṛtavacanavirodha ityata āha || anirvācyeti || īśvarasya kartṛtvamanirvacanīyamiti pakṣo dvitīyādhyāye'nirvācyavastuno nirastatvādeva nirastaḥ | ato na punaratra nirasanīya iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: na tu phala apekṣam para adhīnam vā atas na udāhṛta vacana virodhaḥ iti atas āha anirvācya iti īśvarasya kartṛ tvam anirvacanīyam iti pakṣaḥ dvitīya adhyāye nirvācya vastunaḥ nirasta tvāt eva nirastaḥ atas na punar atra nirasanīyaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu brahmaṇaḥ sarvaviśeṣarahitatvāt kathaṃ paramārthataḥ kartṛtvaṃ syādityata āha || na ceti || bhavedbrahmaṇaḥ kartṛtvasyāpāramārthikatveṃ, yadi tasya sarvaviśeṣarāhityaṃ syāt | na ca tadyuktam | tathātve brahmaṇaḥ śūnyatvāpattyā tadabhyupagantṛṇāṃ śūnyavāditvāpātāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: nanu brahmaṇaḥ sarva viśeṣa rahita tvāt katham paramārthataḥ kartṛ tvam syāt iti atas āha na ca iti bhavet brahmaṇaḥ kartṛ tvasya apāramārthika tve yadi tasya sarva viśeṣa rāhityam syāt na ca tat yuktam tathātve brahmaṇaḥ śūnyatva āpattyā tad abhyupagantṛṇām śūnyavādi tva āpātāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: sarvaviśeṣarahitatve'pi na brahmaṇaḥ śūnyatvāpattiḥ, astitvādityata āha || na hīti || na bhavedbrahmaṇaḥ śūnyatvāpattiḥ, yadi tasyāstitvaṃ sidhyet | na ca tatsiddhiḥ | sarvaviśeṣarahitamityaṅgīkārāditi bhāvaḥ | sarvaviśeṣarahitatve'pi kuto'stitvaṃ na siddhyatītyata āha || vācyatveti || astitve brahmaṇaḥ astitvamastiśabdavācyatvaṃ vā syāt |
analyzed: sarva viśeṣa rahita tve api na brahmaṇaḥ śūnyatva āpattiḥ astitvāt iti atas āha na hi iti na bhavet brahmaṇaḥ śūnyatva āpattiḥ yadi tasya astitvam sidhyet na ca tad siddhiḥ sarva viśeṣa rahitam iti aṅgīkārāt iti bhāvaḥ sarva viśeṣa rahita tve api kutas astitvam na siddhyati iti atas āha vācyatva iti astitve brahmaṇaḥ astitvam astiśabda vācyatvam vā syāt

original: tasya ca viśeṣatvāt na tatsarvaviśeṣarahitasya yujyata iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tasya ca viśeṣa tvāt na tad sarva viśeṣa rahitasya yujyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: bhavennirviśeṣatve'stitvāsiddhiḥ, yadyastitvaṃ brahmaṇo viśeṣatayā aṅgīkrayate | naitadasti | tasya brahmasvarūpamātratvādityata āha || anyatheti || yadyastitvādikaṃ brahmaṇaḥ svarūpamātraṃ na tadviśeṣastarhi brahma brahmetivadasti brahmetyādiśabdānāṃ paryāyatvaṃ syāt | tataśca " asti brahmeti cedveda " ityādisahaprayogānupapattiḥ syāt |
analyzed: bhavet nirviśeṣa tve stitva asiddhiḥ yadi astitvam brahmaṇaḥ viśeṣatayā na etat asti tasya brahma svarūpa mātra tvāt iti atas āha anyathā iti yadi astitva ādikam brahmaṇaḥ svarūpa mātram na tad viśeṣaḥ tarhi brahma brahma iti vat asti brahma iti ādi śabdānām paryāya tvam syāt tatas ca asti brahma iti ced vedaḥ ityādi sahaprayoga anupapattiḥ syāt

original: tathā copaniṣadāṃ punaruktidoṣeṇa unmattavākyavadanādaraṇīyatvaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | brahmaṇyastitvādiviśeṣābhāve'pi āropitāsattvādiviśeṣavyāvṛttikathanadvārā astyādipadāni tallakṣayanti | ato na śabdānāṃ paryāyatvādītyata āha || vyāvartyeti || bhavedastyādipadānāmaparyāyatvaṃ, yadyastyādipadāni brahmaṇo'sattvādi vyāvartayanti | na ca tadyuktam |
analyzed: tathā ca upaniṣadām punarukti doṣeṇa unmatta vākya vat anādaraṇīya tvam syāt iti bhāvaḥ brahmaṇi astitva ādi viśeṣa abhāve pi āropita asattva ādi viśeṣa vyāvṛtti kathana dvārā asti ādi padāni tat lakṣayanti atas na śabdānām paryāya tva ādi iti atas āha vyāvartya iti bhavet asti ādi padānām aparyāya tvam yadi asti ādi padāni brahmaṇaḥ śattva ādi vyāvartayanti na ca tat yuktam

original: vyāvartyāsattvādiviśeṣavyāvṛtteḥ vyāvṛttatayā'ṅgīkṛtabrahmagatāstitvādiviśeṣanivandhanatvāt | teṣāṃ cānaṅgīkārāt | brahmaṇyastitvādiviśeṣabhāve'pi asattvādivyāvṛttāvasato'pi tadvyāvṛttiprasaṅgāt | gaṅgāpadalakṣyo'pi tīre gaṅgātvābhāve'pi agaghgātvavyāvṛttiprasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: vyāvartya asattva ādi viśeṣa vyāvṛtteḥ vyāvṛtta tayā aṅgīkṛta brahma gata astitva ādi viśeṣa nibandhana tvāt teṣām ca anaṅgīkārāt brahmaṇi astitva ādi viśeṣa bhāve pi asattva ādi vyāvṛttau asataḥ upi tad vyāvṛtti prasaṅgāt gaṅgā pada lakṣyaḥ upi tīre gaṅgā tva abhāve pi agaghgā tva vyāvṛtti prasaṅgāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: ito'pyastyādipadāni astitvādiviśeṣabodhakāni neti na yuktamityāha || anyatheti || yadyastyādipadāni na astitvādibrahmaviśeṣabodhakāni tarhi teṣāṃ vaiyyarthyameva syāt | brahmajijñāsuṃ prati brahmakathanasyaiva sārthakyāt | brahmaṇaśca brahmapadādevāvagatatvāt | na cāsattvādivyāvṛttiḥ prayojanam | tadasambhavasyoktatvāt |
analyzed: itas upi asti ādi padāni astitva ādi viśeṣa bodhakāni na iti na yuktam iti āha anyathā iti yadi asti ādi padāni na astitva ādi brahma viśeṣa bodhakāni tarhi teṣām vaiyyarthyam eva syāt brahma jijñāsum prati brahma kathanasya eva sārthakyāt brahmaṇaḥ ca brahma padāt eva avagata tvāt na ca asattva ādi vyāvṛttiḥ prayojanam tad asambhavasya ukta tvāt

original: brahma kuto vyāvṛttamityajijñāsitatvācca | ajijñāsitatve'pi brahmaṇyasattvādibhrāntiḥ nivāryata iti cenna | vikalpāsahatvāt | bhrāntiḥ kiṃ pratīte'pratīte vā brahmaṇi bhavet? | nādyaḥ | brahmapratītau tanmātrasya sattvāderapi pratītatvena bhrāntyanavakāśāt | brahmapratītāvapi sattvādyapratītau tanmātratvānupapatteḥ | na dvitīyaḥ |
analyzed: brahma kutas vyāvṛttam iti ajijñāsita tvāt ca ajijñāsita tve pi brahmaṇi asattva ādi bhrāntiḥ nivāryate iti ced na vikalpa asaha tvāt bhrāntiḥ kim pratīte pratīte vā brahmaṇi bhavet na ādyaḥ brahma pratītau tanmātrasya sattva ādeḥ api pratīta tvena bhrānti anavakāśāt brahma pratītau api sattva ādi apratītau tanmātra tva anupapatteḥ na dvitīyaḥ

original: adṛṣṭakalpanāprasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: adṛṣṭa kalpanā prasaṅgāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: itaśca na astyādipadairasattvādivyāvṛttidvārā brahma lakṣyam | tasya sarvaśabdāvacyatvāṅgīkārāt | śabdavācyasyaiva
analyzed: itas ca na asti ādi padaiḥ asattva ādi vyāvṛtti dvārā brahma lakṣyam tasya sarva śabda avacya tva aṅgīkārāt śabda vācyasya eva

original: lakṣyatvadsanādityāha || na ceti | astitvāṅgīkāre brahmaṇaḥ saviśeṣatvaprasaṅgāt na tatsiddhyatītyuktam | ito'pi na brahmaṇo'stitvaṃ siddhyati | tatpramāṇābhāvāt | pramāṇaṃ vinā'rthasiddheḥ kvāpyadarśanāt | pramāṇakathane ca sarvapramāṇāgocaratvāṅgīkārabhaṅga iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: lakṣya tva dsanāt iti āha na ca iti astitva aṅgīkāre brahmaṇaḥ saviśeṣa tva prasaṅgāt na tad siddhi ati iti uktam itas api na brahmaṇaḥ astitvam siddhyati tad pramāṇa abhāvāt pramāṇam vinā artha siddheḥ kvāpi adarśanāt pramāṇa kathane ca sarva pramāṇa agocaratva aṅgīkāra bhaṅgaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: yadyastitve pramāṇābhāvāt na tatsiddhyatītyucyate tarhi brahmaṇo nāstitvamapi na siddhyati | tatra pramāṇābhāvāt | tathāca na śūnyavādāviśeṣāpādanaṃ brahmavādasya yujyata ityata āha || nāstitvamiti || brahmaṇo na nāstitve'smābhiḥ pṛthak pramāṇaṃ vaktavyam | tasyāstitvapramāṇābhāvenaiva siddheḥ |

original: || atra vāsudevasya pūrṇatvamevocyate, na tu sarvābheda ityarthaḥ | pramāṇavacanena bhagavajjñānināmevānuttamagatirbhavatītyatra hetvabhidhāyakatayaiva etadyojitam | atha bahūnāṃ ḍanmanāmante vāsudevaḥ sarvamiti jñānavān bhavatītyapi yojanāṃ sūcayati || jānanniti || abhedārthamevedaṃ vākyaṃ kiṃ na syādityata āha || prapadyanta iti ||
analyzed: atra vāsudevasya pūrṇa tvam eva ucyate na tu sarva abhedaḥ iti arthaḥ pramāṇa vacanena bhagavat jñāninām eva anuttama gatiḥ bhavati iti atra hetu abhidhāyaka tayā eva etat yojitam atha bahūnām ḍanmanām ante vāsudevaḥ sarvam iti jñānavān bhavati iti api yojanām sūcayati jānan iti abheda artham eva idam vākyam kim na syāt iti atas āha prapadyante iti

original: " devān devayajo yānti " ityetad " viṣṇuṃ tatparamajñātvā " ityādinā vivṛtam || 21 -22 ||

original: atha kecana dveṣiṇo'pi santītyucyate " avyaktam " iti || tadarthaṃ pūrvavadeṣāṃ phalasyānuktatvāt phalaṃ ca smṛtyaivāha || anyakta iti || evaṃ sarvaprerakatvādimahimavāṃścadbhagavān tatkathaṃ bhagavataḥ kecijjīvābhedaṃ manyanta ityato vaitaducyate | sarvātmanā jñeyatvājñeyatvābhyāṃ jīveśvarayorvyaktāvyaktatvam || 24 -25 ||
analyzed: atha kecana dveṣiṇaḥ api santi iti ucyate avyaktam iti tad artham pūrvavat eṣām phalasya anukta tvāt phalam ca smṛtyā eva āha anyaktaḥ iti evam sarva preraka tva ādi mahimavān cad bhagavān tat katham bhagavataḥ kecid jīva abhedam manyante iti atas vā etat ucyate sarva ātmanā jñeya tva ajñeya tvābhyām jīva īśvarayoḥ vyakta avyakta tvam

original: yadi māyāvaśādajñānaṃ lakasya bhagavadviṣayaṃ tarhi bhavato'pi lokaviṣayaṃ tadasti kiṃ, kuḍyobhayabhāgāvasthitayoranyonyādarśanavadityata ucyate || vedāhamiti || tatra kasyāpi bhagavajjñānābhāve rvedādivaiyyarthyāpatteḥ kathaṃ " māṃ tu veda na kaścana " ityucyata ityatastatsmṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || yatheti || 26 ||
analyzed: yadi māyā vaśāt ajñānam bhagavat viṣayam tarhi bhavataḥ api loka viṣayam tat asti kim kuḍya ubhaya bhāga avasthitayoḥ anyonya adarśana vat iti atas ucyate veda aham iti tatra kasya api bhagavat jñāna abhāve rveda ādi vaiyyarthya āpatteḥ katham mām tu veda na kaścana iti ucyate iti atas tad smṛtyā eva vyācaṣṭe yathā iti

original: yatkeṣāñcidadvaitajñānaṃ tadapi madicchayetyuktaṃ nāhaṃ prakāśa iti | tadayuktam | " aikātmyaṃ nāma yadidaṃ kecid brūyuranaipuṇāḥ | kāmakrodhābhibhūtatvādahaṃkārayaśaṃ gatāḥ || " ityādāvicchādveṣāderevādvaitajñānahetutvokterityata ucyate || iccheti || tatra mohasaṃmohaśabdayorarthabhedapradarśanāya dvandvamohapadamanūdya mohaśabdārthamāha ||
analyzed: yat keṣāñcid advaita jñānam tat api mad icchayā iti uktam na aham prakāśaḥ iti tat ayuktam aikātmyam nāma yat idam kecid brūyuḥ anaipuṇāḥ kāma krodha abhibhūta tvāt ahaṃkāra yaśam gatāḥ ityādau icchā dveṣa ādeḥ eva advaita jñāna hetutva ukteḥ iti atas ucyate icchā iti tatra moha saṃmoha śabdayoḥ artha bheda pradarśanāya dvandva moha padam anūdya moha śabda artham āha

original: dvandveti || mohaśabdasya mithyājñānavācitvaṃ kuta ityata āha || tama iti || śarvarīsaṃbandhitamovadāvarakamajñānamityarthaḥ | astu moho mithyājñānaṃ, dvandvamoho nāma ka ityata āha || jīveti || ādipadena sarvajñatvālpajñatvāditaddharmagrahaṇam | mohaśahdāgatārthatayā saṃmohaśabdaṃ vyācaṣṭe || saṃmoha iti || tadāgraho
analyzed: dvandva iti moha śabdasya mithyājñāna vāci tvam kutas iti atas āha tamaḥ iti śarvarī saṃbandhi tamaḥ vat āvarakam ajñānam iti arthaḥ astu mohaḥ mithyājñānam dvandvamohaḥ nāma kaḥ iti atas āha jīva iti ādi padena sarvajñatva alpajñatva ādi tad dharma grahaṇam saṃmoha śabdam vyācaṣṭe saṃmohaḥ iti tad āgrahaḥ

original: mithyājñānadārḍhyamityarthaḥ | kuto'yaṃ saṃmohaśabdartha ityata āha || tadagraha iti || " mohaścaiva viparyayaḥ " iti prakṛtaviparyayaḥ taditi parāmṛśyate | krodho yathārthajñāniṣu | uktaśaṅ‌kāparihārāyoktaṃ sargapadaṃ tadāśaṃkāparihārakaṃ yathā syāttathā vyācaṣṭe || sarga iti || satyamicchādveṣādinā mithyājñānaṃ bhavatīti ||
analyzed: mithyājñāna dārḍhyam iti arthaḥ kutas yam saṃmoha śabda arthaḥ iti atas āha tad agrahaḥ iti mohaḥ ca eva viparyayaḥ iti prakṛta viparyayaḥ tat iti parāmṛśyate krodhaḥ yathārtha jñāniṣu ukta śaṅkā parihārāya uktam sarga padam tad āśaṃkā parihārakam yathā syāt tathā vyācaṣṭe sargaḥ iti satyam icchā dveṣa ādinā mithyājñānam bhavati iti

original: tathāpi tadavāntarakāraṇameva | sargakālamārabhyaiva tasya kāraṇatvāt | śarīrānutpattāvicchādyabhāvāt | viṣṇostu sarvadā kāraṇatvāduktaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ | nanvatra jīveśvarādi viṣayadvandvamohasyecchādyavāntarakāraṇatvamucyate | na tu jīveśvarābhedajñānasya | na hi viśeṣyaikyajñānameva dvandvamoha iti niyāmakamastītyata āha || jīveti || 27 ||
analyzed: tathā api tat avāntarakāraṇam eva sarga kālam ārabhya eva tasya kāraṇa tvāt śarīra anutpattau icchā ādi abhāvāt viṣṇoḥ tu sarvadā kāraṇa tvāt uktam yuktam iti bhāvaḥ nanu atra jīveśvara ādi viṣaya dvandva mohasya icchā ādi avāntarakāraṇa tvam ucyate na tu jīveśvara abheda jñānasya na hi viśeṣya aikya jñānam eva dvandva mohaḥ iti niyāmakam asti iti atas āha jīva iti

original: bhagavajjñānena kiṃ bhavatītyata ucyate -- jareti | tatra bhagavatā tadbrahmetyukte'pi na brahmaṇo bhagavataḥ sakāśādanyatvaṃ śaṅ‌kanīyam | tadāśaṅ‌kāparihārāyaiva sādhibhūtādhidaivaṃ brahmeti vaktavye māmityuktatvāditi bhāvenāha || taditi || ityukte jātāmiti śeṣaḥ || 30 ||
analyzed: bhagavat jñānena kim bhavati iti atas ucyate jarā iti tatra bhagavatā tat brahma iti ukte api na brahmaṇaḥ bhagavataḥ sakāśāt anyatvam śaṅkanīyam tad āśaṅkā parihārāya eva sa adhibhūta adhidaivam brahma iti vaktavye mām iti ukta tvāt iti bhāvena āha tat iti iti ukte jātām iti śeṣaḥ

original: iti śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpādācāryaviracitasya śrīmadbhagavadgītātātparyanirṇayasya ṭīkāyāṃ jayatīrthamuniviracitāyāṃ nyāyadīpākāyāṃ saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 ||
analyzed: iti śrīmat ānandatīrtha bhagavat pāda ācārya viracitasya śrīmat bhagavadgītā tātparya nirṇayasya ṭīkāyām jayatīrtha muni viracitāyām nyāyadīpākāyām saptamaḥ adhyāyaḥ 7

original: pūrvādhyāyasaṅgatatvenaitadadhyāyapratipādyamarthaṃ darśayiti || ukteti || yaduktaṃ"te brahma tadviduḥ" ityādi tadvyākhyānamatrādau kriyate || "prayāṇakāle'pi ca mām" ityuktavyākhyānaprasaṅgena antakālasmaraṇaphalaṃ, tadupāyaprakāro, brahmaprāptimārgaścetyetaducyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: pūrva adhyāya saṅgata tvena etad adhyāya pratipādyam artham darśayiti uktā iti yat uktam te brahma tat viduḥ ityādi tad vyākhyānam atra ādau kriyate prayāṇa kāle api ca mām iti ukta vyākhyāna prasaṅgena anta kāla smaraṇa phalam tad upāya prakāraḥ brahma prāpti mārgaḥ ca iti etat ucyate iti arthaḥ

original: antakālasmaraṇādīnāṃ brahma prāpyate ebhiriti brahmaprāptiśabdābhidheyatvaṃ jñātavyam |
analyzed: antakāla smaraṇa ādīnām brahma prāpyate ebhiḥ iti brahma prāpti śabda abhidheya tvam jñātavyam

original: nanvarjunasya jñānitvājjānātyevāsau bhagavāneva brahmeti | ataḥ "kiṃ tadbrahma" it praśnaḥ kathaṃ yujyate, kāraṇābhāvādityata āha || taditi || arjunasya jñānitve'pi yukto'yaṃ praśnaḥ | tadbrahmetyatra brahmaṇo bhagavatā taditi pārokṣyeṇoktatvād bhagavato'nyadevatā''troktaṃ brahmeti pratīyate |
analyzed: nanu arjunasya jñāni tvāt jānāti eva asau bhagavān eva brahma iti atas kim tat brahma id praśnaḥ katham yujyate kāraṇa abhāvāt iti atas āha tat iti arjunasya jñāni tve api yuktaḥ yam praśnaḥ tat brahma iti atra brahmaṇaḥ bhagavatā tat iti pārokṣyeṇa ukta tvāt bhagavataḥ anya devatā atra uktam brahma iti pratīyate

original: vāsudevātmakaṃ brahmetyāderbhagavān brahmeti pratīyate | evamubhayathāpratītijanitasaṃśayasya praśnakāraṇasya sadbhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | nanu brahmaśabdasya bhagavanmātravṛttitvāt kathaṃ taditi viśeṣitatve'pyanyatvapratītirityata uktam || prakṛtīti ||
analyzed: vāsudeva ātmakam brahma ityādeḥ bhagavān brahma iti pratīyate evam ubhayathā pratīti janita saṃśayasya praśna kāraṇasya sadbhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ nanu brahma śabdasya bhagavat mātra vṛtti tvāt katham tat iti viśeṣita tve pi anyatva pratītiḥ iti atas uktam prakṛti iti

original: brahmaśabdasya bhagavati mukhyatve'pi prakṛtivedāderapyamukhyatayā tadarthatvāttaditi viśeṣitatvena mukhyārthāsambhave'pyamukhyārthaḥ prakṛtyādīnāṃ madhye yatkiñcidatra syāditi pratītiryukteti bhāvaḥ | nanu taditi viśeṣaṇena prāptā viśeṣaṇena prāptā brahmaṇo bhagavadanyatvaśaṃkā "sādhibhūtādhidaivaṃ mām" ityuparitanavākye bhagavataiva parihṛtā |
analyzed: brahma śabdasya bhagavati mukhya tve pi prakṛti veda ādeḥ api amukhya tayā tad artha tvāt tat iti viśeṣita tvena mukhya artha asambhave pi amukhya arthaḥ prakṛti ādīnām madhye yat kiñcid atra syāt iti pratītiḥ yuktā iti bhāvaḥ nanu tat iti viśeṣaṇena prāptā viśeṣaṇena prāptā brahmaṇaḥ bhagavat anyatva śaṃkā sa adhibhūta adhidaivam mām iti uparitana vākye bhagavatā eva parihṛtā

original: brahmeti vaktavye māmityuktatvāt | ataḥ kathaṃ brahmaṇo bhagavadanyatvapratītirityata uktam || uparīti || yadyapyeṣā pratītiruparitanavākye parihṛtā, tathāpi punarbhavatyeva | tatra "sādhiyajñaṃ ca" caśabdasya sādhibhūtādhiyajñaṃ māṃ ceti
analyzed: brahma iti vaktavye mām iti ukta tvāt atas katham brahmaṇaḥ bhagavat anyatva pratītiḥ iti atas uktam upari iti yadi api eṣā pratītiḥ uparitana vākye parihṛtā tathā api punar bhavati eva tatra sa adhiyajñam ca caśabdasya sa adhibhūta adhiyajñam mām ca iti

original: saṃyojanenādhibhūtādisahitatvena brahmajñānādanyadeva viṣṇujñānamucyata iti taditi viśeṣaṇādeva pratītisambhavāditi bhāvaḥ | yatkiñcidityatra anyadevetyatra ca iti pratītyā jāta iti śeṣaḥ |
analyzed: saṃyojanena adhibhūta ādi sahita tvena brahma jñānāt anyat eva viṣṇu jñānam ucyate iti tat iti viśeṣaṇāt eva pratīti sambhavāt iti bhāvaḥ yat kiñcid iti atra anyat eva iti atra ca iti pratītyā jātaḥ iti śeṣaḥ

original: nanu "sādhibhūtādhidaivaṃ mām" iti bhagavata eva brahmatvokteḥ kiṃ tadbrahmeti praśne'haṃ brahmeti parihāro baktavyaḥ | "akṣaraṃ brahma paramam" iti kathamucyata ityata āha || parameti || tathaiva paramākṣaraṃ brahmetyeva | bhavatu paramākṣaraṃ brahmetyuktiphalaṃ, paramākṣaraśabdasya viṣṇau prasiddhatvāt |
analyzed: nanu sa adhibhūta adhidaivam mām iti bhagavataḥ eva brahmatva ukteḥ kim tat brahma iti praśna iha brahma iti parihāraḥ baktavyaḥ akṣaram brahma paramam iti katham ucyate iti atas āha parama iti tathā eva parama akṣaram brahma iti eva bhavatu parama akṣaram brahma iti ukti phalam parama akṣara śabdasya viṣṇau prasiddha tvāt

original: tathāpyahamiti sākṣādanuktvā evaṃ kathane ko heturityata āha || ajñānāmiti || tadapi svasya paramākṣaratvamapi | nanu ye paramākṣaraṃ viṣṇuriti na jānanti teṣāmahaṃ brahmeti noktam | akṣaraṃ brahmetyevoktam | ato brahma akṣaraṃ ca bhagavato'nyadevetyāśaṃkaiva syānna tu paramākṣaraṃ brahma ca bhagavāniti jñānamityata āha || punariti ||
analyzed: tathā api aham iti sākṣāt an uktvā evam kathane kaḥ hetuḥ iti atas āha ajñānām iti tat api svasya parama akṣara tvam api nanu ye parama akṣaram viṣṇuḥ iti na jānanti teṣām aham brahma iti na uktam akṣaram brahma iti eva uktam atas brahma akṣaram ca bhagavataḥ anyat eva iti āśaṃkā eva syāt na tu parama akṣaram brahma ca bhagavān iti jñānam iti atas āha punar iti

original: satyameva śaṃkā bhavatīti | sā ca "avyakto'kṣara ityuktaḥ" ityuparyakṣarasyāvyaktatvoktyā parihriyate | "avyaktaṃ vyaktimāpannaṃ manyante mām" ityavyaktaśabdasya bhagavati prayuktatvāt | ataḥ "akṣaraṃ brahma paramam" iti parihāre ahamityuktādapi lābhasambhavāt tathā parihāro yukta iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: satyam eva śaṃkā bhavati iti sā ca avyakta ukṣaraḥ iti uktaḥ iti upari akṣarasya avyakta tva uktyā parihriyate avyaktam vyaktim āpannam manyante mām iti avyakta śabdasya bhagavati prayukta tvāt atas akṣaram brahma paramam iti parihāre aham iti uktāt api lābha sambhavāt tathā parihāraḥ yuktaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: yadyakṣaraśabhdo viṣṇāvena mukhyastarhi "ye cāpyakṣaramavyaktam" ityatra, "kūṭastho'kṣara ucyate" ityatra ca akṣaraśabdavācyo viṣṇuḥ syādityata āha || ye ceti || akṣaraśabdasya viṣṇau mukhyatve'pi "ye cāpyakṣaramavyaktam" ityatra tāvadviṣṇoranyadeva akṣaraśabdavācyamityevāvasīyate |
analyzed: yadi akṣara śabhdaḥ viṣṇau ena mukhyaḥ tarhi ye ca api akṣaram avyaktam iti atra kūṭastha ukṣaraḥ ucyate iti atra ca akṣara śabda vācyaḥ viṣṇuḥ syāt iti atas āha ye ca iti akṣara śabdasya viṣṇau mukhya tve pi ye ca api akṣaram avyaktam iti atra tāvat viṣṇoḥ anyat eva akṣara śabda vācyam iti eva avasīyate

original: "ye bhaktāstvaṃ paryupāsate", "ye cāpyakṣaram" iti bhagavadakṣarayoḥ pṛthaktvena tadapāsakayostāratamyasya pṛṣṭatvāt | ye tvakṣaramanirdeśyam", "ye tu sarvāṇi karmāṇi" ityādinā'kṣaropāsakānāṃ bhagavadupāsakānāṃ ca phalatāratamyasya kathanācca | tathā "kūṭastho'kṣara ucyate" ityatrāpi viṣṇoritadevākṣaramityavasīyate" |

original: bhagavato bhinna evetyāśaṃkā prāptā | tannivṛttyārthatvādahamevetyukteḥ | tadityuktyā brahmaṇo bhagavadanyatvaśaṃkāprāptāvapi māmityanena tasyāḥ prājñabuddhimapekṣya nirastatvena trāhamevetyuktyabhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | etena "evaṃ bahuvidhā yajñā vitatā brahmaṇo mukhe" ityuktatvādadhiyajñapraśnaparihārau prāptiśūnyāviti ca nirastaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: bhagavataḥ bhinnaḥ evā iti āśaṃkā prāptā tad nivṛttyā arthatvāt aham eva iti ukteḥ tat iti uktyā brahmaṇaḥ bhagavat anyatva śaṃkā prāptau api mām iti anena tasyāḥ prājña buddhim apekṣya nirasta tvena trā aham eva iti ukti abhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ etena evam bahuvidhāḥ yajñāḥ vitatāḥ brahmaṇaḥ mukhe iti ukta tvāt adhiyajña praśna parihārau prāpti śūnyau iti ca nirastam bhavati

original: bhagavānevādhiyajñaścet kathaṃ tatsāhityaṃ prāguktamityata āha || tasyaiveti || bhagavata evādhiyajñatve'pi tatsāhityaṃ yujyate | adhiyajñasya sarvaprāṇidehagatarūpāntaratvāditi bhāvaḥ | anena deha ityasyābhiprāyo varṇito bhavati |

original: atra pramāṇaṃ darśayan bhagavata eva brahmatve kathaṃ tadityuktirityāśaṃkāṃ ca piraharan ślokadvayaṃ smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || prāṇināmiti || brahmaṇaḥ sarvagatarūpāntaratvāt tadityuktiryukteti bhāvaḥ | taistaiḥ sarvaprāṇibhiradhikayājyatvādadhiyajño, bṛṃhitatvāt brahmetyarthaḥ | bhūtādhikatvata ityatra bhūtapadena pṛthivyādīni |
analyzed: atra pramāṇam darśayan bhagavataḥ eva brahmatve katham tat iti uktiḥ iti āśaṃkām ca piraharan śloka dvayam smṛtyā eva vyācaṣṭe prāṇinām iti brahmaṇaḥ sarvagata rūpa antara tvāt tat iti uktiḥ yuktā iti bhāvaḥ taiḥ taiḥ sarva prāṇibhiḥ adhika yājya tvāt adhiyajñaḥ bṛṃhita tvāt brahma iti arthaḥ bhūta adhikatvataḥ iti atra bhūta padena pṛthivī ādīni

original: puruprāṇā'taḥ puruṣākhyeti śeṣaḥ | "ṣakāraḥ prāṇa ātmā" iti śruteḥ | nanu "adhiyajñaḥ kathaṃ ko'tra" ityatra kuto'dhiyajñaḥ kathaṃpūpa iti praśnaḥ kasmānna parihṛta ityata āha || kathaṃrūpa iti || tallakṣaṇoktyeti || "kaviṃ purāṇam" iti bhagavallakṣaṇokyetyarthaḥ | bhagavallakṣaṇoktyā kathamadhiyajñasvarūpapraśnaḥ parihṛta ityata uktam ||
analyzed: puruprāṇātaḥ puruṣa ākhyā iti śeṣaḥ ṣakāraḥ prāṇaḥ ātmā iti śruteḥ nanu adhiyajñaḥ katham kotraḥ iti atra kutas adhiyajñaḥ kathaṃpūpaḥ iti praśnaḥ kasmāt na parihṛtaḥ iti atas āha kathaṃrūpaḥ iti tad lakṣaṇa uktyā iti kavim purāṇam iti bhagavat lakṣaṇa ukyā iti arthaḥ bhagavat lakṣaṇa uktyā katham adhiyajña svarūpa praśnaḥ parihṛtaḥ iti atas uktam

original: ahameveti || "adhiyajño'hameva" ityadhiyajñasya bhagavadabhinnatvenoktatvādityarthaḥ || 4 ||
analyzed: aham eva iti adhiyajñaḥ aham eva iti adhiyajñasya bhagavat abhinna tvena uktatvāt iti arthaḥ

original: prayāṇakāle ca kathaṃ jñeyo'sītyasya kimarthaṃ kathambhūtaḥ kena prakāreṇa smartavyo'sītyarthaḥ | tatra kimarthaṃ smartavyo'sītyasya parihāra ucyate "anteti" | tatra madbhāvapadasya anyathāpratītinirāsāyārthamāha || madbhāvamiti || anyathā taṃ tamevaitīti vākyaśeṣavirodha iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: prayāṇa kāle ca katham jñeyā ūsī iti asya kimartham kathambhūtaḥ kena prakāreṇa smartavyā ūsī iti arthaḥ tatra kimartham smartavyā ūsī iti asya parihāraḥ ucyate anta iti tatra mad bhāva padasya anyathā pratīti nirāsāya artham āha mad bhāvam iti anyathā tam tam eva eti iti vākyaśeṣa virodhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanvantakāle smaraṇādeva tatprāpteḥ sadā tadbhāvabhāvitatvaṃ kimarthamucyata ityata āha || sadeti || na tatprāptyarthaṃ sadā tadbhāvabhāvitatvamucyate | kintu smaran tyajatītyuktaṃ sākṣādantakālasmaraṇaṃ sadā tadbhāvabhāvitānāmeva bhavatīti sākṣādantakālasmaraṇopāya evocyata iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: nanu antakāle smaraṇāt eva tad prāpteḥ sadā tad bhāva bhāvita tvam kimartham ucyate iti atas āha sadā iti na tad prāpti artham sadā tad bhāva bhāvita tvam ucyate kintu smaran tyajati iti uktam sākṣāt antakāla smaraṇam sadā tad bhāva bhāvitānām eva bhavati iti sākṣāt antakāla smaraṇa upāyaḥ eva ucyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu antakāla eva mahatā prayatnena bhagavatsmaraṇasya kartuṃ śakyatvāt kiṃ sadā tadbhāvabhāvitatvenetyata āha || na cediti || sadā tadbhāvabhāvitatvābhāve mahatā prayatnena smarato'pyanyaviṣaya eva prārabdhakarmavaśāt smṛtirbhavati | tataśca tatprāptireva bhavati |
analyzed: nanu anta kāle eva mahatā prayatnena bhagavat smaraṇasya kartum śakya tvāt kim sadā tad bhāva bhāvita tvena iti atas āha na ced iti sadā tad bhāva bhāvita tva abhāve mahatā prayatnena smaratā api anya viṣaye eva prārabdha karma vaśāt smṛtiḥ bhavati tatas ca tad prāptiḥ eva bhavati

original: yathā khalu mahatā prayatnena samādhiṃ kurvato'pi prārabdhakarmavaśāt tataḥ skhalanaṃ bhavati | ataḥ sadā tadbhāvabhāvitatvena bhāvyamiti bhāvaḥ | yadi prārabdhakarmavaśādantakāle brahmasmṛtirna bhavet tarhi jñānināmapi prārabdhakarmabhāvādantakāle brahmasmṛtyabhāvena mokṣābhāvaḥ prasajyata
analyzed: yathā khalu mahatā prayatnena samādhim kurvataḥ api prārabdha karma vaśāt tatas skhalanam bhavati atas sadā tad bhāva bhāvita tvena bhāvyam iti bhāvaḥ yadi prārabdha karma vaśāt anta kāle brahma smṛtiḥ na bhavet tarhi jñāninām api prārabdha karma bhāvāt anta kāle brahma smṛti abhāvena mokṣa abhāvaḥ prasajyata

original: ityata āha || aparokṣeti || aparokṣajñānināṃ smaran tyajatītyuktaṃ sākṣādantakālasmaraṇaṃ bhavutyevāto nāmokṣaḥ | tasyāprārabdhapūrvottarakarmanāśāśleṣasadbhāvāt prārabdhakarmaṇāṃ parimitatvena bhogenāvasānasambhavāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: iti atas āha aparokṣa iti aparokṣa jñāninām smaran tyajati iti uktam sākṣāt antakāla smaraṇam na amokṣaḥ tasya aprārabdha pūrva uttara karma nāśa āśleṣa sadbhāvāt prārabdha karmaṇām parimita tvena bhogena avasāna sambhavāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: evaṃ vyākhyāne bhagavadvākyasammtimāha || prayāṇeti || nanvevaṃ sati antakālasmaraṇasya prārabdhakarmāvasānameva kāraṇaṃ, tatkāraṇatayā'parokṣajñānaṃ ceti prāptam | tathāca kiṃ sadā tadbhāvabhāvitatvenetyata āha || yukteti || satyaṃ sākṣādantakālasmaraṇasya prārabdhakarmāvasānameva kāraṇam | katkāraṇatvādaparokṣajñānaṃ ceti |
analyzed: evam vyākhyāne bhagavat vākya sammtim āha prayāṇa iti nanu evam sati antakāla smaraṇasya prārabdha karma avasānam eva kāraṇam tad kāraṇatayā aparokṣa jñānam ca iti prāptam tathā ca kim sadā tad bhāva bhāvita tvena iti atas āha yukta iti satyam sākṣāt antakāla smaraṇasya prārabdha karma avasānam eva kāraṇam kat kāraṇatvāt aparokṣa jñānam ca iti

original: tathāpi sadā tadbhāvabhāvitatvaṃ ca antakālasmaraṇakāraṇaṃ bhavatyeva | aparokṣajñānasādhanatvāt | sadā tadbhāvabhāvitatvasyāparokṣajñānasādhanatvena yuktacetasa ityuktatvāditi bhāvaḥ | anena yuktacetaso māmāśritya yatanti ye te tadbrahma viduriti yojanā sūcyate | yannityasmaraṇaṃ bhagavadaparokṣajñānasādhanamuktaṃ tadbhaktyādiyuktameva tathā |
analyzed: tathā api sadā tad bhāva bhāvita tvam ca anta kāla smaraṇa kāraṇam bhavati eva aparokṣa jñāna sādhanatvāt sadā tad bhāva bhāvita tvasya aparokṣa jñāna sādhanatvena yukta cetasaḥ iti ukta tvāt iti bhāvaḥ anena yukta cetasaḥ mām āśritya yatanti ye te tat brahma viduḥ iti yojanā sūcyate yat nitya smaraṇam bhagavat aparokṣa jñāna sādhanam uktam tat bhakti ādi yuktam eva tathā

original: na svayameveti smṛtyā''ha || bhaktyeti || 5 ||
analyzed: na svayam eva iti smṛtyā āha bhaktyā iti

original: kathambhūtaḥ smartavyo'sītyasya parihāra ucyate " kavim " iti || tatrā'dityavarṇaśceccharīritvena janmādiprasaṅga ityata uktaṃ " tamasa " parastāt " iti | tadanūdya vyācaṣṭe || tamasa iti || "avyaktaṃ vai tamaḥ " iti hi śrutiḥ || 9 ||
analyzed: kathambhūtaḥ smartavyaḥ asi iti asya parihāraḥ ucyate kavim iti tatra āditya varṇaḥ ced śarīri tvena janma ādi prasaṅgaḥ iti atas uktam parastāt iti tat anūdya vyācaṣṭe tamasaḥ iti avyaktam vai tamaḥ iti hi śrutiḥ

original: kena prakāreṇa smartavyo'sītyasya parihāra ucyate " yadakṣaram " iti | tatra pūrvamantakālasmaraṇasya sadā tadbhāvabhāvitatvaṃ sādhanamuktvā brahmacarye tathā kathamucyata ityato brahmacaryapadaṃ tatparatayā vyācaṣṭe || mana ādīnāmiti || " tatte padaṃ saṅgraheṇa pravakṣye " ityatra tatsmaraṇaprakāraṃ pravakṣya ityarthaḥ || 11 ||
analyzed: kena prakāreṇa smartavyā asi iti asya parihāraḥ ucyate yat akṣaram iti tatra pūrvam anta kāla smaraṇasya sadā tad bhāva bhāvita tvam sādhanam uktvā brahmacarye tathā katham ucyate iti atas brahmacarya padam tatparatayā vyācaṣṭe manaḥ ādīnām iti tat te padam saṅgraheṇa pravakṣye iti atra tad smaraṇa prakāram pravakṣye iti arthaḥ

original: " ekākṣaraṃ brahma " ityetadekamakṣaraṃ śabdabrahmeti pratītinirāsāya vyāyaṣṭe || eketi || āomityekamakṣaraṃ vācakaṃ yasya tadekākṣaramityarthaḥ | brahmaśabdasya parabrahmaṇyeva mukhyatvāt na pratīta evārthaḥ || 13 ||
analyzed: ekākṣaram brahma iti etat ekam akṣaram śabdabrahma iti pratīti nirāsāya vyāyaṣṭe eka iti āom iti ekam akṣaram vācakam yasya tat ekākṣaram iti arthaḥ brahma śabdasya para brahmaṇi eva mukhya tvāt na pratītaḥ eva arthaḥ

original: brahmādīn prāptānāmapi punarjanmābhāvāt kiṃ viśiṣyābhidhīyate māmupetya punarjanma nāmuvantīti | ata ucyate " ābrāmeti " | tatrā'janānnajanirbhuvīti vacanāt janalokādisthitānāmapi janmādyabhāvāt kathaṃ brahmabhavanamārabhya punarāvṛttirucyata ityāśaṃkāṃ smṛtyaiva pariharati || niyamīditi || atra janmapadaṃ maraṇasyāpyupalakṣakam || aṃsalayāviti ||
analyzed: brahma ādīn prāptānām api punarjanma abhāvāt kim viśiṣya abhidhīyate mām upetya punarjanma na amuvanti iti atas ucyate ābrāma iti tatra ajanān najaniḥ bhuvi iti vacanāt janaloka ādi sthitānām api janma ādi abhāvāt katham brahma bhavanam ārabhya punarāvṛttiḥ ucyate iti āśaṃkām smṛtyā eva pariharati niyamīt iti atra janma padam maraṇasya api upalakṣakam aṃsa layau iti

original: aṃśena bhūmau jananaṃ, layānte ca jananaṃ, tadādau maraṇaṃ cetyarthaḥ | aṃśasya maraṇaṃ cāstītyāha || tatrāpīti || aṃśato'vatīrṇatve'pi naitadayuktam | muktasyaiva mukhyatayā jananādyabhāvāt janādāvalpajananādibhāvādetadvākyasya ca tadarthatvādityuktaṃ bhavati || 16 ||
analyzed: aṃśena bhūmau jananam laya ante ca jananam tad ādau maraṇam ca iti arthaḥ aṃśasya maraṇam ca asti iti āha tatra api iti aṃśataḥ vatīrṇa tve pi na etat ayuktam muktasya eva mukhya tayā janana ādi abhāvāt jana ādau alpa janana ādi bhāvāt etad vākyasya ca tad artha tvāt iti uktam bhavati

original: matprāptāvevāpunarāvṛttirityuktasthāpanāya aśeṣasṛṣṭipralayādikartṛtvamātmana ucyate " sahasra " iti | tatra sahasrapadaṃ daśaśatavācītyanyathāpratītinirāsāya vyācaṣṭe || sahasramiti || bahveva prasiddhasahasrāditi śeṣaḥ | nanu " caturyugasahasrāṇi
analyzed: mad prāptau eva apunarāvṛttiḥ iti ukta sthāpanāya aśeṣa sṛṣṭi pralaya ādi kartṛ tvam ātmanaḥ ucyate sahasre iti tatra sahasra padam daśa śata vāci iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya vyācaṣṭe sahasram iti bahu eva prasiddha sahasrāt iti śeṣaḥ nanu caturyuga sahasrāṇi

original: brahmaṇo dinamucyate " ityādau yugasahasramatrasya viriñcadināditvenoktatvāt kathaṃ sahasrapadaṃ tato'pi bahvarthamityata āha || brahmaṇa iti || nātra caturmukhasyāhorātramucyate, yena sahasrapadaṃ tato'pi bahvarthaṃ na syāt | kintu parabrahmaṇo dvirarārdhātmakamahorātramiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: brahmaṇaḥ dinam ucyate ityādau yuga sahasra matrasya viriñca dina ādi tvena ukta tvāt katham sahasra padam tatas api bahu artham iti atas āha brahmaṇaḥ iti na atra caturmukhasya ahorātram ucyate yena sahasra padam tatas api bahu artham na syāt kintu para brahmaṇaḥ dvis ara ardha ātmakam ahorātram iti bhāvaḥ

original: kuto brahmapadena parabrahmetyaṅgīkṛtya tadahorātraparatvamucyate, viriñcāhorātraparatvaṃ kiṃ na syādityata āha || avyaktāditi || evaṃ vākyaśeṣasadbāve'pi kuto nāsya viriñcāhorātraparatvamityata āha || na hīti || āhanīti || tadavasāna ityarthaḥ | evaṃ na aharāgame sarvavyaktiprabhava ityapi draṣṭavyam | nanu kathaṃ bhagavato'horātrasadbhāvaḥ |
analyzed: kutas brahma padena para brahma iti aṅgīkṛtya tad ahorātra paratvam ucyate viriñca ahorātra paratvam kim na syāt iti atas āha avyaktāt iti evam vākyaśeṣa sadbāve pi kutas na asya viriñca ahorātra paratvam iti atas āha na hi iti āhani iti tad avasāne iti arthaḥ evam na ahar āgame sarva vyakti prabhavaḥ iti api draṣṭavyam nanu katham bhagavataḥ ūhorātra sadbhāvaḥ
