original: vastusiddhermānādhīnatvād viśeṣyasvarūpasyāmeyatve tadabhāvaśca syāditi bhāvaḥ | ito'pi na viśeṣyasvarūpaṃ nirviśeṣamityāha || svayamiti || yadviśeṣyasvarūpaṃ tasya tāvadviśeṣyasvarūpatvaṃ viśeṣo'ṅgīkārya eva | viśeṣyasvarūpatvaviśeṣavarjitasya viśeṣyasvarūpamiti jñātuṃ vyavahartuṃ vā'śakyatvāt | ato viśeṣyasvarūpamapi na nirvaśeṣamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: vastu siddheḥ māna adhīna tvāt viśeṣya svarūpasya ameya tve tad abhāvaḥ ca syāt iti bhāvaḥ itas api na viśeṣya svarūpam nirviśeṣam iti āha svayam iti yat viśeṣya svarūpam tasya tāvat viśeṣya svarūpa tvam viśeṣa uṅgīkāryaḥ eva viśeṣya svarūpa tva viśeṣa varjitasya viśeṣya svarūpam iti jñātum vyavahartum vā aśakya tvāt atas viśeṣya svarūpam api na nirviśeṣam iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu yadviśeṣyasvarūpatvaviśeṣaviśiṣṭaṃ tasmin viśiṣṭe yadviśeṣyasvarūpaṃ tadviśiṣṭādanyadeva | ato nirviśeṣamevetyata āha || taditi || yattasmin viśiṣṭe viśeṣyasvarūpaṃ tadviśiṣṭādanyadapi viśeṣyasvarūpatvaviśeṣasahitameva | ato na nirviśeṣamiti bhāvaḥ | tasminnapi viśiṣṭe yadviśeṣyasvarūpaṃ tadviśiṣṭānyadeva |
analyzed: nanu yat viśeṣya svarūpa tva viśeṣa viśiṣṭam tasmin viśiṣṭe yat viśeṣya svarūpam tad viśiṣṭāt anyat eva atas nirviśeṣam eva iti atas āha tat iti yat tasmin viśiṣṭe viśeṣya svarūpam tad viśiṣṭāt anyat api viśeṣya svarūpa tva viśeṣa sahitam eva atas na nirviśeṣam iti bhāvaḥ tasmin api viśiṣṭe yat viśeṣya svarūpam tad viśiṣṭa anyat eva

original: aoto nirviśeṣamityaṅgīkāre'navasthāmāha || itīti || yathā viśiṣṭaviśeṣyasvarūpayorbhedābhyupagame'navasthocyate tathā tayorabhedāṅgīkāre'pi tatpraptau so'pi pakṣastyājya eva syāt | viśiṣṭaviśeṣyasvarūpayorabhede ca viśeṣyasvarūpajñāne viśiṣṭākārasyāpi jñātatvaprasaṅgena viśeṣyasvarūpānuvādena viśiṣṭākārapraśnānupapattiḥ syādityata āha ||
analyzed: nirviśeṣam iti aṅgīkārena avasthām āha iti iti yathā viśiṣṭa viśeṣya svarūpayoḥ bheda abhyupagamena avasthā ucyate tathā tayoḥ abheda aṅgīkāre api tad praptau saḥ api pakṣaḥ tyājyaḥ eva syāt viśiṣṭa viśeṣya svarūpayoḥ abhede ca viśeṣya svarūpa jñāne viśiṣṭa ākārasya api jñāta tva prasaṅgena viśeṣya svarūpa anuvādena viśiṣṭa ākāra praśna anupapattiḥ syāt iti atas āha

original: abheda iti || ekameva vastu anūdyākareṇa jñānaṃ pṛcchyamānākāreṇājñātamiti pratyekamakhilavastūnāṃ jñātatvājñātatvāt na praśnānupapattiḥ | viśiṣṭākārasya viśeṣyasvarūpābhinnatvena na bhedasāpekṣānavasthā'pīti bhāvaḥ | abhinnasya viśiṣṭatvāditi || yadviśeṣyeṇābhinnaṃ tatsvarūpaṃ tasyaiva viśiṣṭatvādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: abhedaḥ iti ekam eva vastu anūdya ākareṇa jñānam pṛcchyamāna ākāreṇa ajñātam iti pratyekam akhila vastūnām jñāta tva ajñāta tvāt na praśna anupapattiḥ viśiṣṭa ākārasya viśeṣya svarūpa abhinna tvena na bheda sāpekṣā anavasthā api iti bhāvaḥ abhinnasya viśiṣṭa tvāt iti yat viśeṣyeṇa abhinnam tat svarūpam tasya eva viśiṣṭa tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: viśiṣṭaviśeṣyayoratyantābhede kathamākārabhedenāpi jñātatvājñātatvamityāśaṃkāṃ pariharannuktaṃ vivṛraṇoti || ekatveti || viśiṣṭavaśeṣyayorevatvānubhavāt nānavasthādoṣaḥ | abhede'pi viśeṣānubhavāt tadbalenaikasyaiva jñātatvājñātatvānubhavāt na praśnāsambhavadoṣo'pītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: viśiṣṭa viśeṣyayoḥ atyanta abhede katham ākāra bhedena api jñāta tva ajñāta tvam iti āśaṃkām pariharan uktam vivṛraṇoti ekatva iti na anavasthā doṣaḥ abhede api viśeṣa anubhavāt tad balena ekasya eva jñāta tva ajñāta tva anubhavāt na praśna asambhava doṣaḥ api iti arthaḥ

original: nanu viśiṣṭaviśeṣyayoḥ bhedābhedau kiṃ na syātām | tathātve bhedena praśnāsambhavasya parihartuṃ śakyatvādabhede nānavasthādeśca parihartuṃ śakyatvāditi cet | kiṃ viśiṣṭaviśeṣyayoḥ kvacidbhedābhedāvaṅgīkriyete uta sarvatrāpi ? ādye sampratipattiḥ | ayāvad‌dravyabhāviviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭasya viśeṣyeṇa bhedābhedāṅgīkārāt | dvitīyaṃ dūṣayati ||
analyzed: nanu viśiṣṭa viśeṣyayoḥ bheda abhedau kim na syātām tathātve bhedena praśna asambhavasya parihartum śakya tvāt abhede na anavasthā ādeḥ ca parihartum śakya tvāt iti ced kim viśiṣṭa viśeṣyayoḥ kvacid bheda abhedau aṅgīkriyete uta sarvatra api ādye sampratipattiḥ ayāvaddravya bhāvi viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭasya viśeṣyeṇa bheda abheda aṅgīkārāt dvitīyam dūṣayati

original: bhedābhedāviti || tau pareṇāṅgīkṛtau | sarvatra viśiṣṭaviśeṣyayoriti śeṣaḥ | kartṛbhoktṛviśeṣaṇa iti || kartṛtvabhoktṛtve viśeṣaṇe yasya viśiṣṭasya tasminnityarthaḥ | kartṛtvabhoktṛtvādiyāvad‌dravyabhāviviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaviṣaye kartā bhoktā madanyo'haṃ ceti viśeṣeṇa bhedābhedānubhavābhāvāditi
analyzed: bheda abhedau iti tau pareṇa aṅgīkṛtau sarvatra viśiṣṭa viśeṣyayoḥ iti śeṣaḥ kartṛ bhoktṛ viśeṣaṇe iti kartṛ tva bhoktṛ tve viśeṣaṇe yasya viśiṣṭasya tasmin iti arthaḥ kartṛ tva bhoktṛ tva ādi yāvat dravya bhāvi viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭa viṣaye kartā bhoktā mad anyaḥ aham ca iti viśeṣeṇa bheda abheda anubhava abhāvāt iti

original: bhāvaḥ | etena kartṛbhoktrādiviśiṣṭaviśeṣayayorabhedapratipādanenaiva yaduktaṃ cetanaviśeṣāṇāmāvirbhāvatirobhāvavatāṃ kartṛtvadīnāṃ
analyzed: bhāvaḥ etena kartṛ bhoktṛ ādi viśiṣṭa viśeṣayayoḥ abheda pratipādanena eva yat uktam cetana viśeṣāṇām āvirbhāva tirobhāvavatām kartṛ tva dīnām

original: viśeṣiṇā'bhinnatvaṃ tadapi samarthitaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: viśeṣiṇā abhinna tvam tat api samarthitam bhavati

original: atha nityābhivyaktānāṃ svarūpatvādīnāṃ cābhedaṃ sādhayati || bheda iti || nityābhivyaktasyeti śeṣaḥ || āntarasyeti || dehopādhitvaṃ vinā cetanagatasyetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: atha nitya abhivyaktānām svarūpa tva ādīnām ca abhedam sādhayati bhedaḥ iti nitya abhivyaktasya iti śeṣaḥ āntarasya iti deha upādhi tvam vinā cetana gatasya iti arthaḥ

original: śuddhasvarūpa ityādau śuddhasvarūpatvavastutvādīnāṃ nityābhivyaktaviśeṣāṇāṃ śuddhasvarūpo mukta iti sāmānādhikaraṇyenābhedasyaiva darśanādviśiṣṭaviśeṣyayorabhede viśeṣaṇābhedasya niyatadatvāditi bhāvaḥ | āvirbhāvatirobhāvavatāṃ kartṛtvādiviśeṣāṇāṃ viśeṣicaitanyaikyajñānādiviśeṣāṇāmapi viśeṣyaikyaṃ sādhayati || apṛthagiti ||
analyzed: śuddha svarūpaḥ ityādau śuddha svarūpa tva vastu tva ādīnām nitya abhivyakta viśeṣāṇām śuddha svarūpaḥ muktaḥ iti sāmānādhikaraṇyena abhedasya eva darśanāt viśiṣṭa viśeṣyayoḥ abhede viśeṣaṇa abhedasya niyata da tvāt iti bhāvaḥ āvirbhāva tirobhāvavatām kartṛ tva ādi viśeṣāṇām viśeṣi caitanya aikya jñāna ādi viśeṣāṇām api viśeṣya aikyam sādhayati apṛthak iti

original: pṛthaktvena darśanābhāvaniyamādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: pṛthaktvena darśana abhāva niyamāt iti arthaḥ

original: nanu yathocyate śuddhasvarūpa ityādi yathā ca kartā bhoktā balavān vidvāniti tathā kṛṣṇaḥ sthūla ityādi yocyate | ato dehanimittānāṃ kārṣṇyādiviśeṣāṇāmapi caitanyaikyaṃ syādityata āha || bāhyeti || nāsmābhirubhayavidhaviśeṣṭaviśeṣyayoḥ sāmānādhikaṇyamātrādviśeṣāṇāṃ caitanyaikyamucyate | kintu bhedādarśane sati sāmānādhikaraṇyena |
analyzed: nanu yathā ucyate śuddha svarūpaḥ ityādi yathā ca kartā bhoktā balavān vidvān iti tathā kṛṣṇaḥ sthūlaḥ ityādi yā ucyate atas deha nimittānām kārṣṇya ādi viśeṣāṇām api caitanya aikyam syāt iti atas āha bāhya iti na asmābhiḥ ubhayavidha viśeṣṭa viśeṣyayoḥ sāmānādhikaṇya mātrāt viśeṣāṇām caitanya aikyam ucyate kintu bheda adarśane sati sāmānādhikaraṇyena

original: na cātra kṛṣṇadevadattayoḥ bhedādarśanaṃ, yena ca kārṣṇyaṃ devadattasvarūpaṃ syāt | bhedasyaiva dṛṣṭatvāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: na ca atra kṛṣṇa devadattayoḥ bheda adarśanam yena ca kārṣṇyam devadatta svarūpam syāt bhedasya eva dṛṣṭa tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: eke tu śuddhasvarūpatvādīnāṃ nityābhivyaktānāmeva viśeṣāṇāṃ caitanyaikyaṃ, na tu kartṛtvādīnāmiti manyante | nān nirākaroti || viśeṣeti || śuddhasvarūpatvādīnāmeva caitanyaikyaṃ na tu kartṛtvādīnāmiti devaividhyaṃ kiṃ yatkiñciddhetubalena kalpyate tadvinā vā? nādyaḥ | tadadarśanāt | na dvitāyaḥ |
analyzed: eke tu śuddha svarūpa tva ādīnām nitya abhivyaktānām eva viśeṣāṇām caitanya aikyam na tu kartṛ tva ādīnām iti manyante nirākaroti viśeṣa iti śuddha svarūpa tva ādīnām eva caitanya aikyam na tu kartṛ tva ādīnām iti de vaividhyam kim yat kiñcid hetu balena kalpyate tat vinā vā na ādyaḥ tad adarśanāt na dvitāyaḥ

original: rakartṛtvādīnāmapyaikyopapattau vṛthā dvaividhyakalpne kalpanāgauravaprasaṅgāt | aprāmāṇikapramāṇaviruddhakalpanaprasakteśca | yadi kalpanāgauravādidoṣānaṅgīkṛtyāpi kartṛtvādīnāṃ bhinnatvamucyate tarhi śuddhasvarūpatvādayo'pi viśeṣā bhinnā evetyatiprasaṅgaḥ syāt | parasya doṣabhayābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | evaṃ cetane viśeṣāderatyantābhedaḥ samarthitaḥ |
analyzed: ra kartṛ tva ādīnām api aikya upapattau vṛthā dvaividhya kalpne kalpanā gaurava prasaṅgāt aprāmāṇika pramāṇa viruddha kalpana prasakteḥ ca yadi kalpanā gaurava ādi doṣān aṅgīkṛtya api kartṛ tva ādīnām bhinnatvam ucyate tarhi śuddha svarūpa tva ādayaḥ api viśeṣāḥ bhinnāḥ eva iti atiprasaṅgaḥ syāt parasya doṣa bhaya abhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ evam cetane viśeṣa ādeḥ atyanta abhedaḥ samarthitaḥ

original: tannyāyenācetane'pi yāvad‌dravyabhāvino viśeṣāderviśeṣiṇā'tyantābhedo draṣṭavyaḥ |
analyzed: tad nyāyena acetane api yāvaddravyabhāvinaḥ viśeṣa ādeḥ viśeṣiṇā atyanta abhedaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ

original: ayāvad‌dravyabhāviviśeṣasya yau bhedābhedāvuktau tau samarthayati || naikatvamiti || ekatvaṃ nānātvaṃ ca nāstītyakte'nirvacanīyatvaśaṃkā syāt | tannirāsāya niyamādityuktam | ata ekaikasyābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | anubhavādantathā gatyabhāvācca naikatvam, nāpi nānātvamiti sambandhaḥ |
analyzed: ayāvaddravya bhāvi viśeṣasya yau bheda abhedau uktau tau samarthayati na ekatvam iti ekatvam nānātvam ca na asti iti akta inirvacanīya tva śaṃkā syāt tad nirāsāya niyamāt iti uktam atas ekaikasya abhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ anubhavāt antathā gati abhāvāt ca na ekatvam na api nānātvam iti sambandhaḥ

original: nanu cetane'pi bhedābhedasadbhāvena cetanācetanayorekaprakāratvāt acetana iti kiṃ viśiṣyābhidhīyata ityata āha |. eka iti || ahaṃ madabhinno ghaṭāderbhinna iti cetane bhinnapratiyogikāveva bhedābhedāvanubhūyete | acetane tvekapratiyogikāveva | ato na cetanācetanayorekaprakāratetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: nanu cetane api bheda abheda sadbhāvena cetana acetanayoḥ eka prakāra tvāt acetanaḥ iti kim viśiṣya abhidhīyate iti atas āha ekaḥ iti aham mat abhinnaḥ ghaṭa ādeḥ bhinnaḥ iti cetane bhinna pratiyogikau eva bheda abhedau anubhūyete acetane tu eka pratiyogikau eva atas na cetana acetanayoḥ eka prakāra tā iti arthaḥ

original: kathamacotane bhedābhedāvanubhavasiddhāvityataḥ tantvādyavayavebhyaḥ paṭādyavayavino bhedābhedasadbhāve'nubhavakathanena tantvādīnāṃ paṭatvādiviśeṣairbhetābhedasadbhāve'nubhavaḥ pradarśita eva bhavatīti manvāna āha || ekamiti || tantūnāṃ paṭarūpeṇaikatvasya parasparaṃ bhedasya cānubhavāderakaikatantoḥ paṭena bhedābhedāvanubhūyete |
analyzed: katham acotane bheda abhedau anubhava siddhau iti atas tantu ādi avayavebhyaḥ paṭa ādi avayavinaḥ bheda abheda sadbhāva inubhava kathanena tantu ādīnām paṭa tva ādi viśeṣaiḥ pradarśitaḥ eva bhavati iti manvānaḥ āha ekam iti tantūnām paṭa rūpeṇa eka tvasya parasparam bhedasya ca anubhava ādeḥ aka eka tantoḥ paṭena bheda abhedau anubhūyete

original: ekaikatantoḥ paṭenātyantābhede'nyonyabhedānubhavāyogāditi bhāvaḥ | gatyantarābhāvaṃ cāha || tantubhya iti || yadyekaikatantoḥ paṭo'tyantabhinnastarhyekaikatantubhyaḥ paṭaḥ pṛthag dṛśyata | na caitadasti | nāpyekaikatantunā paṭo'tyantābhinnaḥ | yathāsvasaṃsthānaviśeṣeṇāvasthitaikaikatantubhāve paṭābhāvānupapatteriti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: ekaika tantoḥ paṭena atyanta abhede nyonya bheda anubhava ayogāt iti bhāvaḥ gati antara abhāvam ca āha tantubhyaḥ iti yadi ekaika tantoḥ paṭa utyanta bhinnaḥ tarhi ekaika tantubhyaḥ paṭaḥ pṛthak na ca etat asti na api ekaika tantunā paṭa utyanta abhinnaḥ yathāsva saṃsthāna viśeṣeṇa avasthita ekaika tantu bhāve paṭa abhāva anupapatteḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: sarvāvayavasamudāyasya svayamabahutvāt tadbhāve'vayavyabhāvābhāvāt saṃsthānaviśeṣeṇāvasthitānāmevāvayavatvāt avayavinā'tyantābhedo draṣṭavyaḥ | yathā''tmagatānāṃ kartṛtvādiviśeṣāṇāṃ bahutve'pyekenā'tmanā'tyantābhedaḥ tathā bahutvepi tantūnāṃ ekena paṭenātyantābhedaḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha || na ceti ||
analyzed: sarva avayava samudāyasya svayam abahu tvāt tad bhāva ivayavi abhāva abhāvāt saṃsthāna viśeṣeṇa avasthitānām eva avayava tvāt avayavinā atyanta abhedaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ yathā ātma gatānām kartṛ tva ādi viśeṣāṇām bahutve pi ekena ātmanā atyanta abhedaḥ tathā bahutve pi tantūnām ekena paṭena atyanta abhedaḥ kim na syāt iti atas āha na ca iti

original: kimannoktasya vyabhicāraścocyate utātmagataviśeṣadṛṣṭāntena jaḍe'pyantābhedasādhanamātram? nādyaḥ | atra kartṛtvādīnāṃ bahutvābhāvāt | vyavahāraviśeṣasya svanirvāhakaviśeṣeṇaivopapatteruktatvāt | nāpi dvitāyaḥ | kartā'haṃ bhoktā'hamityekaikaviśeṣaviśiṣṭasyātmano bhedānubhavenaikaikaviśeṣasyāpi kevalābhedānubhavāt |
analyzed: kim anna uktasya vyabhicāraḥ ca ucyate uta ātma gata viśeṣa dṛṣṭāntena jaḍe ipi anta abheda sādhana mātram na ādyaḥ atra kartṛ tva ādīnām bahu tva abhāvāt vyavahāra viśeṣasya sva nirvāhaka viśeṣeṇa eva upapatteḥ ukta tvāt na api dvitāyaḥ kartāham bhoktāham iti ekaika viśeṣa viśiṣṭasya ātmanaḥ bheda anubhavena ekaika viśeṣasya api kevala abheda anubhavāt

original: ekaikasmiṃśca tantau paṭapratyayābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | kimacetane paṭādāvantyāvayavinyeva avayavāvayavinorbhedābhedāviti ? netyāha || atreti || acetane paṭādau svāvayavairbhedābhedau tadavayavasyāpi svāvayavairbhedābhedāvityevam aparyavasānameva bhavedityarthaḥ | paramāṇornityatvena tatra paryavasānasambhavāt kathamanavasthitirityata āha ||
analyzed: ekaikasmin ca tantau paṭa pratyaya abhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ kim acetane paṭa ādau antya avayavinī eva avayava avayavinoḥ bheda abhedau iti na iti āha atra iti acetane paṭa ādau sva avayavaiḥ bheda abhedau tad avayavasya api sva avayavaiḥ bheda abhedau iti evam aparyavasānam eva bhavet iti arthaḥ paramāṇoḥ nitya tvena tatra paryavasāna sambhavāt katham anavasthitiḥ iti atas āha

original: "tenaiva rūpeṇa bhava " ityarjunaprarthanāvākye viśvarūpaṃ vihāya pūrvatanaṃ gṛhāṇetyucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || tenaiveti || yadā rūpāntaraṃ pratīyate tadā viśvarūpatyaga eva kiṃ na syāt, kiṃ tadgopanenetyata āha || pañcānanamiti | narasiṃharūpe'pi gopitaviśvarūpatvokterna rūpantarapratītau viśvarūpatyāga iti bhāvaḥ || 46 ||
analyzed: tena eva rūpeṇa bhavaḥ iti arjuna prarthanā vākye viśva rūpam vihāya pūrvatanam gṛhāṇa iti ucyate iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya āha tena eva iti yadā rūpa antaram pratīyate tadā viśva rūpa tyage eva kim na syāt kim tad gopanena iti atas āha pañcānanam iti narasiṃha rūpe api gopita viśva rūpa tva ukteḥ na rūpa antara pratītau viśva rūpa tyāgaḥ iti bhāvaḥ 46

analyzed: na atra viśvarūpa lasya arjuna itaraiḥ adṛṣṭa tvam ucyate pratyuta itas pūrvam kena api na dṛṣṭam iti an uktvā tvad anyena iti ukta tvāt taina eva itas pūrvam indra śarīreṇa dṛṣṭam iti eva ucyate iti arthaḥ tarhi brahma ādibhiḥ api na dṛṣṭam iti api na āśaṅkanīyam tvad anyena iti arjunāt adhama vivakṣayā ukta tvāt iti āha tvat iti na etāvat arjuna adhamaiḥ na dṛṣṭam iti kalpanīyam

original: indrasyādhikadarśatve'lpadarśitve vā viśiṣya tvayendraśarīreṇa draṣṭamityuktirna nambhavati | ādhikye'nukterādhamye niṣedhasya cādarśanāt || 47 ||

original: yadyanyeṣāmapi vaśvarūpadarśanamatrābhipretaṃ syāttarhi "na vedayajñādhyayanairna dānaiḥ " ityuttaravākyavirodha ityata āha || vedeti || nottaravākye'rjunādanyeṣāṃ viśvarūpadarśanābhāva ucyate |

original: kintu tvadavaraistvadvanna dṛṣṭamityukteḥ svatastathā darśanābhāve'pi vedādisādhanaistathā tairdṛśyatāmityāśaṃkya tvadavarairvedādisādhanairapi tvadvanna draṣṭuṃ śakyata ityevocyata iti bhāvaḥ | viśvarūpasyārjunādanyenādṛṣṭatvamevārthaḥ kiṃ na syāditi cenna | udāhṛtasmṛtivirodhāt |

original: atrāpi "dṛṣṭvā'dbhutaṃ pūpaṃ ", "dṛṣṭā lokāḥ " ityādipūrvavākyavirodhaḥ syādityata āha || anyatheti || 48 -49 ||

original: "svakaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa " iti kṛṣṇarūpasya viśiṣya svīyatvokteḥ yaduktaṃ viśvarūpasya sākṣādīśvarasvarūpatvaṃ tadayuktamityata āha || svavaditi || nātra svakaśabdena kṛṣṇarūpasya svakīyatvamucyate, yena viśvarūpasya svakīyatvaṃ na syāt | kintu svavat svakīyavat kriyate pradarśyata iti vyutpattyā svakīyatayā pradarśanīyatvamevetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: svakam rūpam darśayāmāsa iti kṛṣṇa rūpasya viśiṣya svīya tva ukteḥ yat uktam viśvarūpasya sākṣāt īśvara sva rūpa tvam tat ayuktam iti atas āha sva vat iti na atra svaka śabdena kṛṣṇa rūpasya svakīya tvam ucyate yena viśva rūpasya svakīya tvam na syāt kintu svavat svakīya vat kriyate pradarśyate iti vyutpattyā svakīya tayā pradarśanīya tvam eva iti arthaḥ

original: nanūbhayorapi bhagavadīyatayā pradarśyamānatvāt kṛṣṇarūpasyaiva kuto viśeṣoktirityata āha || viśvarūpamiti || satyamubhayaṃ pūpaṃ bhagavadīyatayā pradarśyata,

original: iti, kintu jñānināmeva | ajñānināṃ tu kṛṣṇarūpameva bhagavadīyatayā pradarśyate | na tu viśvarūpamato'jñavivakṣayā viśeṣoktiryukteti bhāvaḥ | ata evālpajñānivivakṣayā svavadityuktam | kimarthamevaṃ vyākhyeyam? viśvarūpaṃ bhagavadīyameva kiṃ na syādityata āha || anyatheti ||
analyzed: iti kintu jñāninām eva ajñāninām tu kṛṣṇa rūpam eva bhagavadīya tayā pradarśyate na tu viśva rūpam atojña vivakṣayā viśeṣa uktiḥ yuktā iti bhāvaḥ atas eva alpa jñāni vivakṣayā sva vat iti uktam kimartham evam vyākhyeyam viśva rūpam bhagavadīyam eva kim na syāt iti atas āha anyathā iti

original: kṛṣṇarūpaviśvarūpayoḥ svakīyatvāsvakīyatvapratītinirākaraṇaprasaṅgena paramaṃ pūpaṃ darśayāmāseti viśvarūpasya paratyoktyā kṛṣṇarūpasyāparatvaṃ smṛtyaiva nirākaroti || pareti || anyathā svabhāvataḥ | tarhi viśvarūpa eva paratvaṃ viduṣāmapi kathaṃ dṛśyata ityata āha || vyaktiriti || viśvarūpe paratvavyāktirnāvatārarūpeṣu ||
analyzed: kṛṣṇa rūpa viśvarūpayoḥ svakīya tva asvakīya tva pratīti nirākaraṇa prasaṅgena paramam pūpam darśayāmāsa iti viśvarūpasya paratya uktyā kṛṣṇa rūpasya aparatvam smṛtyā eva nirākaroti parā iti anyathā svabhāvataḥ tarhi viśvarūpe eva paratvam viduṣām api katham dṛśyate iti atas āha vyaktiḥ iti viśvarūpe paratva vyāktiḥ na avatāra rūpeṣu

original: atastathā dṛṣṭiryukteti bhāvaḥ | iyaṃ ca vyaktiralpajñānivivakṣayocyate | na tu brahmādimahājñānivivakṣayaṭā | teṣāṃ kṛṣṇādāvapi paratvasya pratīterityāha || ajñeti || 50

original: nanu "dṛṣṭvedaṃ mānuṣaṃ rūpaṃ " iti kṛṣṇarūpasya mānuṣatvokteḥ kathaṃ nāvaratvamityata āha || kiñciditi || anyathodāhṛtavākyavirodhaḥ syādityarthaḥ || 51 ||
analyzed: nanu dṛṣṭvā idam mānuṣam rūpam iti kṛṣṇa rūpasya mānuṣa tva ukteḥ katham na avara tvam iti atas āha kiñcid iti anyathā udāhṛta vākya virodhaḥ syāt iti arthaḥ

original: nanu "sudurdarśamidaṃ rūpaṃ " ityatra apyasya rūpasya nityaṃ darśanakāṅkṣiṇa eva vartante, na tu paśyantītyuktatvāt kathamarjunāduttamairadhamaiśca viśvarūpasya dṛṣṭatvamucyata ityatastadvākyaṃ yathāvadyojayati || ya iti ||
analyzed: nanu su durdarśam idam rūpam iti atra api asya rūpasya nityam darśana kāṅkṣiṇaḥ eva vartante na tu paśyanti iti ukta tvāt katham arjunāt uttamaiḥ adhamaiḥ ca viśva rūpasya dṛṣṭa tvam ucyate iti atas tat vākyam yathāvat yojayati yaḥ iti

original: anena yanmama rūpaṃ dṛṣṭavānasi, asya rūpasya nityaṃ darśanakāṅkṣiṇo ye devāste'pi yaddṛṣṭantastadidaṃ sudurdarśamiti yojanāsūcitā bhavati | anyathoktavirodha iti bhāvaḥ || 52 ||
analyzed: anena yat mama rūpam dṛṣṭavān asi asya rūpasya nityam darśana kāṅkṣiṇaḥ ye devāḥ te api yat dṛṣṭa antaḥ tat idam su durdarśam iti yojanā sūcitā bhavati anyathā ukta virodhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: iti śrīmadānandatirthabhagavatpādācāryaviracitasya śrīmadbhagavadgītātātparyanirṇayasya ṭīkāyāṃ jayatīrthamuniviracitayāṃ nyāyadīpikāyāṃ ekādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 ||

original: "te me yuktātamā matāḥ" iti bhagavatā svopāsakanāmuttamatvamuktvā "mayyeva" iti madupāsakānāmevottamatvāt madupāsaka eva bhaveti sphuṭamuktatvādavyaktopāsakānāmādhikyaṃ vadatāmapalāpakatvameva | tataśca sāhasikatvāt "aho naṣṭā ete" iti śokaviṣayatvameva na tu parihāraṃ vaktaṃ prativāditvamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: te me yuktātamāḥ matāḥ iti bhagavatā sva upāsakanām uttama tvam uktvā mayi eva iti mad upāsakānām eva uttama tvāt mad upāsakaḥ eva bhava iti sphuṭam ukta tvāt avyakta upāsakānām ādhikyam vadatām apalāpaka tvam eva tatas ca sāhasika tvāt aho naṣṭāḥ ete iti śoka viṣaya tvam eva na tu parihāram prativādi tvam iti arthaḥ

original: nanu ceṣṭāvatyāḥ śriyo'calatvam "acalaṃ dhruvam" iti kathamucyata ityataḥ smṛtyaiva tadghaṭayati || neti || "anirdeśyamavyaktamacintyaṃ paryupāsate" iti vyāhatam | anirdeśyāvyaktācintayasyopāsanāyogādityataḥ anirdeśyatvādikamupāsyatvāvirodhena smṛtyaiva ghaṭayati || sūkṣmatvāditi ||
analyzed: nanu ceṣṭāvatyāḥ śriyāḥ ucala tvam acalam dhruvam iti katham ucyate iti atas smṛtyā eva tat ghaṭayati na iti anirdeśyam avyaktam acintyam paryupāsate iti vyāhatam anirdeśya avyakta acintayasya upāsana ayogāt iti atas anirdeśya tva ādikam upāsya tva avirodhena smṛtyā eva ghaṭayati sūkṣma tvāt iti

original: madupāsakā evottamā ityucyate "mayi iti | tvadupāsakānāmivāvyaktopāsakānāmapi mokṣasadbhāvāt kathaṃ teṣāmuttamatvamityato'vyaktopāsakānāṃ mokṣamaṅgīkṛtya sahetukaṃ svopāsakānāmuttamatvamucyate "ye tvakṣaram' iti | tatrocyamānabhagavatprāptiḥ na kevalaśākteyānāmiti bhāvena mayītyādikaṃ śrutyaiva vyācaṣṭai || aviṣṇujñairiti ||
analyzed: mad upāsakāḥ eva uttamāḥ iti ucyate mayi iti tvad upāsakānām iva avyakta upāsakānām api mokṣa sadbhāvāt katham teṣām uttama tvam iti atas vyakta upāsakānām mokṣam aṅgīkṛtya sa hetukam sva upāsakānām uttama tvam ucyate ye tu akṣaram iti tatra ucyamāna bhagavat prāptiḥ na kevala śākteyānām iti bhāvena mayi ityādikam śrutyā eva vyācaṣṭai a viṣṇu jñaiḥ iti

original: atra "dhyāyīta nityadā" ityantena parītyupasargābhiprāya ukto bhavati | "tena tuṣṭā"ityanena "te prāpnuvanti māmeva" ityasyābhiprāya ukto bhavati | evamavyaktopāsanasya mokṣasādhanatve'pi na tadevottamaṃ mantavyamiti bhāvenāha || tathāpīti || upāsate śriyā saheti śeṣaḥ | anena "mayyāveśya" ityuktārthaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: atra dhyāyīta nityadā ityantena pari iti upasarga abhiprāyaḥ uktaḥ bhavati tena tuṣṭāḥ iti anena te prāpnuvanti mām eva iti asya abhiprāyaḥ uktaḥ bhavati evam avyakta upāsanasya mokṣa sādhana tve pi na tat eva uttamam mantavyam iti bhāvena āha tathā api iti upāsate śriyā saha iti śeṣaḥ anena mayi āveśyaḥ iti ukta artham bhavati

original: avyaktopāsakānāmapi mokṣasadbhāve kathaṃ bhagavadupāsakānāmuttamatvamityata āha || yata iti || anena "kleśaḥ" iti vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | anena uktaprakāreṇa paryupāsanam indriyagrāmātiniyamanaṃ, sarvatra samabuddhitvaṃ,
analyzed: avyakta upāsakānām api mokṣa sadbhāve katham bhagavat upāsakānām uttama tvam iti atas āha yatas iti anena kleśaḥ iti vyākhyātam bhavati anena ukta prakāreṇa paryupāsanam indriya grāma ati niyamanam sarvatra sama buddhi tvam

original: sarvabhūtahiteratvādisuṣṭvācāramantareṇa avyaktaprasādābhāvāt paramaśraddhāmātrayuktānāṃ suṣṭvācārāderaunye'pi bhagavatprasādasambhavāt kleśādhikayaṃ jñātavyam | itaśca bhagavadupāsanamevottamamityāha || viṣṇuneti || śriyā saha bhagavadupāsane dvayorapi paramaprasādasambhavenācirāt mokṣo bhavati |
analyzed: sarva bhūta hiteḥ atva ādi suṣṭu ācāram antareṇa avyakta prasāda abhāvāt parama śraddhā mātra yuktānām bhagavat prasāda sambhavāt jñātavyam itas ca bhagavat upāsanam eva uttamam iti āha viṣṇunā iti śriyā saha bhagavat upāsane dvayoḥ api parama prasāda sambhavena acirāt mokṣaḥ bhavati

original: pṛthagavyaktopāsanapakṣe tu kiñcidbhagavadupāsanaṃ kṛtvā bahukālaṃ pṛthak śriyamupāsya punaḥ śriyā saha nirantaraṃ bhagavadupāsanaṃ kartavyam | tato muktiriti cireṇaiva bhavatītyato'pi bhagavadupāsanamevādhikamiti bhāvaḥ | anena "ye tu sarvāṇi" ityetaduktārthaṃ bhavati | hetudvayenoktaṃ viṣṇūpāsanasyādhikyamupasaṃharati || tasmāditi ||
analyzed: pṛthak avyakta upāsana pakṣe tu kiñcid bhagavat upāsanam kṛtvā bahukālam pṛthak śriyam upāsya punar śriyā saha nirantaram bhagavat upāsanam kartavyam tatas muktiḥ iti cireṇa eva bhavati iti atas api bhagavat upāsanam eva adhikam iti bhāvaḥ anena ye tu sarvāṇi iti etat ukta artham bhavati hetu dvayena uktam viṣṇu upāsanasya ādhikyam upasaṃharati tasmāt iti

original: teṣāmādhikyaṃ ceti śeṣaḥ ||
analyzed: teṣām ādhikyam ca iti śeṣaḥ

original: ye nityayuktāste yuktatamā ityayuktam | ekārthatvādityata āha || yukteti || nityuyuktapadaṃ nityodyuktārthamiti ca draṣṭavyam | nanu 'ye tu sarvāṇi'ityatrānanyayogena bhagavadupasanasyottamatvamucyate | ataḥ kathaṃ śriyā sahitabhagavadupāsanasya ādhikyakathanaparatayaitadvyākhyāyata ityāśaṃkāṃ pramāṇavākyenaiva pariharati || viṣṇoriti ||
analyzed: ye nitya yuktāḥ te yuktatamāḥ iti ayuktam ekārtha tvāt iti atas āha yukta iti nityuyukta padam nitya udyukta artham iti ca draṣṭavyam nanu ye tu sarvāṇi iti atra ananyayogena bhagavat upasanasya uttama tvam ucyate atas katham śriyā sahita bhagavat upāsanasya ādhikya kathana para tayā etat vyākhyāyate iti āśaṃkām pramāṇa vākyena eva pariharati viṣṇoḥ iti

original: nātrānanyayogapadena anyopāsanasmbandho niṣiddhyate | kintvanyasya bhagavadadhīnatvaṃ tatparivāratvaṃ vinopāsanam | ato yuktaṃ prājīnavyākhyānamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: na atra ananyayoga padena anya upāsana smbandhaḥ niṣiddhyate kintu anyasya bhagavat adhīna tvam tad parivāra tvam vinā upāsanam atas yuktam prājīna vyākhyānam iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu yadi bhagavadupāsakānāmivāvyaktopāsakānāmapi mokṣaśravaṇāt tadupāsanaviṣaye kimuttamamiti praśnaḥ kriyate tarhi 'jñātvā śivaṃ śāntimatyantameti', 'hariṃ haraṃ virañcaṃ ca jñātvā mucyeta saṃsṛteḥ' ityanyadevatopāsanasyāpi mokṣahetutvaśravaṇāt tadviṣaye kimiti praśno na kriyata ityāśaṃkāṃ siṃhāvalokananyāyena pariharati || antavaditi ||
analyzed: nanu yadi bhagavat upāsakānām iva avyakta upāsakānām api mokṣa śravaṇāt tad upāsana viṣaye kim uttamam iti praśnaḥ kriyate tarhi jñātvā śivam śāntim atyantam eti harim haram ca jñātvā mucyeta saṃsṛteḥ iti anya devatā upāsanasya api mokṣa hetutva śravaṇāt tad viṣaye kim iti praśnaḥ na kriyate iti āśaṃkām siṃhāvalokana nyāyena pariharati antavat iti

original: anyadevatopāsanāyā mokṣasādhanatvasya pūrvameva niṣiddhatvena śrutyādau taduktāvapi tasyānyārthatvaṃ kalpayitvā'vyaktopāsanaviṣaya eva praśnaḥ kṛto nānyadevatopāsanaviṣaya iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: anya devatā upāsanāyāḥ mokṣa sādhanatvasya pūrvam eva niṣiddha tvena śruti ādau tad uktau api tasya anya artha tvam kalpayitvā avyakta upāsana viṣayaḥ eva praśnaḥ kṛtaḥ na anya devatā upāsana viṣayaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: tarhi nāmānyato bhagavadanyopāsanasya mokṣasādhanatvasya pūrvameva niṣiddhatvenāvyaktopāsanasyāpi tadabhāvaprāptestadvacanānāmapyarthāntaram akalpayityā kimiti tadviṣaye praśnaṛ kiyata ityata uktam || lakṣmyā iti ||
analyzed: tarhi nāma anyatas bhagavat anya upāsanasya mokṣa sādhanatvasya pūrvam eva niṣiddha tvena avyakta upāsanasya api tad abhāva prāpteḥ tad vacanānām api artha antaram kim iti tad viṣaye kiyataḥ iti atas uktam lakṣmyāḥ iti

original: sāmānyato bhagavadanyopāsanasya mokṣasādhanatvamiṣedhe'pi lakṣmyāḥ bhagavadatipriyatvenānyebhyo viśeṣasadbhāvāt tadupāsanasya mokṣasādhanatvasambhavena niṣdhasya tadatiriktopāsanaviṣayatvaṃ kalpayitvā'rjunenānyopāsanaviṣayapraśnamakṛtvāpyavyaktopāsanaviṣaya eva praśnaḥ kṛta iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: sāmānyatas bhagavat anya upāsanasya mokṣa sādhanatva miṣedhe api lakṣmyāḥ bhagavat atipriya tvena anyebhyaḥ viśeṣa sadbhāvāt tad upāsanasya mokṣa sādhanatva sambhavena tad atirikta upāsana viṣaya tvam kalpayitvā arjunena anya upāsana viṣaya praśnam a kṛtvā api avyakta upāsana viṣayaḥ eva praśnaḥ kṛtaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: madupāsanasyādhikatvāttadeva kuru | tadalābhe māṃ jānīhī | tadabhāve cābhyāsayogena māṃ jānihī | tadabhāve ca matkarmaparo bhava | tadaśaktau ca madyogamāśritaḥ karmaphalatyāgaṃ kurvityucyate -- 'mayi' iti | tatra matkarmakṛttvameva madyogaḥ | ataḥ kathametadityataḥ smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || vāṣṇavānīti || sarvakarmāṇi vaiṣṇavāni karotīti yojanā |
analyzed: mad upāsanasya adhika tvāt tat eva kuru tad alābhe mām jānīhi tad abhāve ca abhyāsa yogena mām jānihi tad abhāve ca mad karma paraḥ bhava tad aśaktau ca mad yogam āśritaḥ karma phala tyāgam kuru iti ucyate mayi iti tatra mad karma kṛt tvam eva mad yogaḥ atas katham etat iti atas smṛtyā eva vyācaṣṭe vāṣṇavāni iti sarva karmāṇi vaiṣṇavāni karoti iti yojanā

original: viṣṇuviṣayatayā karotītyarthaḥ | arcāmārjanaṃ pratimāsnāpanam | ādipadena dhyānaṃ ca grāhyam | tadyogamātravān tatkarmatvopāyamātravān | anena madyogamiti matkarmatvayogamiti vyākhyātam | yadi bhagavatkarmatvaṃ kāmayate tarhyeva tadyogo bhavati | na tu kāmyenānyopāsanādinetyarthaḥ | anena 'sarvakarma' ityuktārthaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: viṣṇu viṣaya tayā karoti iti arthaḥ arcā mārjanam pratimā snāpanam ādi padena dhyānam ca grāhyam tad yoga mātravān tad karma tva upāya mātravān anena mad yogam iti mad karma tva yogam iti vyākhyātam yadi bhagavat karma tvam kāmayate tarhi eva tad yogaḥ bhavati na tu kāmyena anya upāsana ādinā iti arthaḥ anena sarva karma iti ukta artham bhavati

original: bhagavadupāsane'pi tāratamyamāha || asamyagiti || dhyānālābhe jñānaṃ, tadalābhe'bhyāsa ityetatsamarthyate -- 'śreyo hi' iti | tadanena vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | jñānapūrvadhyāne'pi sakāmānniṣkāmamevādhikamityāha || tasmāt || iti | tatra hetumāha || tasmāditi || anena 'dhyānāt' ityetad vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | nanvatra tyāgācchāntiḥ phalamucyate |
analyzed: bhagavat upāsane api tāratamyam āha asamyak iti dhyāna alābhe jñānam tad alābha bhyāsaḥ iti etat samarthyate śreyaḥ hi iti tat anena vyākhyātam bhavati jñāna pūrva dhyāne api sa kāmāt niṣkāmam eva adhikam iti āha tasmāt iti tatra hetum āha tasmāt iti anena dhyānāt iti etat vyākhyātam bhavati nanu atra tyāgāt śāntiḥ phalam ucyate

original: ataḥ kathamucyate tasmānmuktirityata āha || śāntiriti || nanvatra karmaphalatyāgamātrasyaiva dhyānādhikyamucyata iti kiṃ neṣyate? jñānapūrvaṃ dhyānasāhityaṃ kimucyate? ityato vā''ha || śāntiriti || atra tyāgasya śāntipadoditamuktihetutvamicyate | na ca tatkevalatyāgagrahaṇe yuktam | 'saṃnyāsastu mahāvāho duḥkhamāptumayogataḥ' ityuktatvāt |
analyzed: atas katham ucyate tasmāt muktiḥ iti atas āha śāntiḥ iti nanu atra karma phala tyāga mātrasya eva dhyāna ādhikyam ucyate iti kim na iṣyate jñāna pūrvam dhyāna sāhityam kim ucyate iti atas vā āha śāntiḥ iti atra tyāgasya śānti pada udita mukti hetutvam icyate na ca tat kevala tyāga grahaṇe yuktam saṃnyāsaḥ tu mahā vāho duḥkham āptum ayogataḥ iti ukta tvāt

original: jñānapūrvakadhyānasahitatyāgasya
analyzed: jñāna pūrvaka dhyāna sahita tyāgasya

original: tatsambhavāt sa evatra vivakṣita iti bhāvaḥ || 4 -15 ||
analyzed: tad sambhavāt saḥ eva atra vivakṣitaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: 'ye tu sarvāṇi karmāṇi ityādi prapañcyate -- 'adveṣṭā' iti | tatra 'sarvārambhaparityāgī' ityetadanyathāpratītinirāsāya caturdhā vyācaṣṭe || avaiṣṇaveti || uktārthānupapādayati || sarveti || sarvakarmaphalatyāgamityanena sarvārambhaphalaparityāgena sarvārambhaparityāgītyuktaṃ siddhyati |
analyzed: ye tu sarvāṇi karmāṇi ityādi prapañcyate a dveṣṭā iti tatra sarva ārambha parityāgī iti etat anyathā pratīti nirāsāya caturdhā vyācaṣṭe avaiṣṇava iti ukta arthān upapādayati sarva iti sarva karma phala tyāgam iti anena sarva ārambha phala parityāgena sarva ārambha parityāgī iti uktam siddhi ati

original: mayītyanena sarvāmbhābhimānatyāgena sarvārambhāṇāṃ bhagavati samarpaṇena ca sarvārambhaparityāgītyuktaṃ siddhyati | 'mayi' iti vākyasya smṛtyaiva tathā vyākhyātatvāt | ādipadagṛhītena 'sarvadharmān parityajya' ityādinā'vaiṣṇavārambhaparityāgena sarvārambhaparityāgītyuktaṃ siddhyati | tasya tathā sayuktikaṃ vyākariṣyamāṇatvāt |
analyzed: mayi iti anena sarva ambhā abhimāna tyāgena sarva ārambhāṇām bhagavati samarpaṇena ca sarva ārambha parityāgī iti uktam siddhi ati mayi iti vākyasya smṛtyā eva tathā vyākhyāta tvāt ādi pada gṛhītena sarva dharmān parityajya iti ādinā avaiṣṇava ārambha parityāgena sarva ārambha parityāgī iti uktam siddhi ati tasya tathā sayuktikam vyākariṣyamāṇa tvāt

original: nanu 'sarvārambhaparityāgī' ityasya 'śubhāśubhaparityāgī' iti prapañcyamānatvāt avaiṣṇavārambhapirityāgītyādikaṃ kiṃ viśiṣyābhidhīyata ityatastatsmṛtyaiva uktāviruddhatayā vyācaṣṭe || bhaktimiti || upalakṣaṇe caitat | tatsādhanatayā vaiṣṇavārambhāṃśceti jñātavyam |
analyzed: nanu sarva ārambha parityāgī iti asya śubha aśubha parityāgī iti prapañcyamāna tvāt avaiṣṇava ārambha pirityāgī iti ādikam kim viśiṣya abhidhīyate iti atas tad smṛtyā eva ukta aviruddhatayā vyācaṣṭe bhaktim iti upalakṣaṇe ca etat tad sādhanatayā vaiṣṇava ārambhān ca iti jñātavyam

original: 'samaduḥkhasukhaḥ', 'harṣāmarṣabhayodvegairmuktaḥ' ityetanniyamapratītinirāsāya smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || prāya iti || tathocyate sukhādiṣu samo harṣādivarjita ucyeta | evaṃ cedalpavaiṣamyādervidyamānatvāt kathaṃ tadabhāvoktirityata āha || yatheti || mukhyārtha eva kiṃ na syādityata āha || na hīti ||
analyzed: sama duḥkha sukhaḥ harṣa amarṣa bhaya udvegaiḥ muktaḥ iti etat niyama pratīti nirāsāya smṛtyā eva vyācaṣṭe prāyas iti tathā ucyate sukha ādiṣu samaḥ harṣa ādi varjitaḥ ucyeta evam ced alpa vaiṣamya ādeḥ vidyamāna tvāt katham tad abhāva uktiḥ iti atas āha yathā iti mukhya arthaḥ eva kim na syāt iti atas āha na hi iti

original: nanu harṣasya guṇatvāt kathaṃ tatparityāgo'pekṣitatayocyata ityato harṣaśabdasya heyārthatāṃ smṛtyaiva darśayati || hṛtiriti || manasa iti śeṣaḥ | nanu 'adveṣṭā' ityādāvadveṣādimatāṃ priyatvamātramuktvā ' ye tu dharmyāmṛtam ' ityatra śraddhādimatāmatipriyatvaṃ
analyzed: nanu harṣasya guṇa tvāt katham tad parityāga upekṣita tayā ucyate iti atas harṣa śabdasya heyārthatām smṛtyā eva darśayati hṛtiḥ iti manasaḥ iti śeṣaḥ nanu adveṣṭā ityādau adveṣa ādimatām priya tva mātram uktvā ye tu dharmya amṛtam iti atra śraddhā ādimatām atipriya tvam

original: kiṃ nimittamucyata ityata āha || vyastenet || ' adveṣṭā ' ityādau yat pṛthak pṛthak sādhanamuktaṃ tattanmātreṇa priyatvamuktam | ' ye tu ' ityatrādveṣṭetyādiprāguktasamastasādhanenātīvapriyatvam | vyastāt samastasyādhikyāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: kim nimittam ucyate iti atas āha vyastena id adveṣṭā ityādau yat pṛthak pṛthak sādhanam uktam tad tad mātreṇa priya tvam uktam ye tu iti atra adveṣṭa ityādi prāgukta samasta sādhanena atīva priya tvam vyastāt samastasya ādhikyāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu ' adveṣṭā ' ityādāvadveṣādisādhanena priyatvamucyate, ' ye tu ' iti bhaktyā'tīva priyatvamucyata iti kiṃ na syāta bhakteḥ sarvasādhanottamatvādityata āha || bhaktiriti || adveṣādikathane'pi bhakteruktatvāt nāyaṃ vibhāgo yukta iti bhāvaḥ |

original: etadyo vettītyasya jīvaparatve'pi nottaravākyavaiyyarthyam | jīvasya kṣetrajñatvamuktvā īśvarasyāpyucyata iti kṣetrajñatvenoktajīvasya kṣetrasya ceśvaraikyamucyata iti sārthakyopapatteḥ | pratyutaivamanabhyupagamyeśvarasyaiva kṣetrajñatvasiddherityata āha || bhedeti ||

original: ' kṣetrajñaṃ cāpi māṃ viddhi ' ityevokte kṣetra ca jñaśceti kṣetrajña iti vyutpattyā jaḍajīvātmakatvamīśvarasyaivocyata iti pratītiḥ syāt | tannirākaraṇāya prasiddhā'pi vyutpattirucyate | na ca prasiddhavyutpattiṃ parityajyaivaṃ vyutpattyā śaṃkāprāptireva nāstīti vācyam |

original: jaḍajīvātmakasya sarvasyāpīśvareṇābhedamaṅgīkurvatāṃ tathā pratītisambhavāditi bhāvaḥ |

original: īśvarasya kṣetrajñanāmaniruktiḥ, jīvasya tadabhāva ityetatsarvasya etadyo vettīśvarastaṃ kṣetrajñaṃ prāhurityādivākya eva īśvaravācipadaprakṣepeṇa vaktuṃ śakyatvāt tadarthaṃ pṛthag vākyakalpane gauravamityata āha || kṣetrajñamiti || nottaravākye jīvavyāvṛttyarthameva svasya kṣetrajñatvamātramucyate | yena gauravaṃ syāt |

original: kintu jīvavyāvṛttyarthamiśvarasyāsphuṭamuktaṃ kṣīyate'tra īśvareṇeti kṣetramityarthasūcānāya svasya kṣetre sthitiścocyata iti bhāvaḥ |

analyzed: ca īśvara abheda kathanāya kṣetrajñam ca api mām viddhi iti sārthakam iti uktam dūṣayati sarva iti yadi kṣetrajñam ca api mām viddhi iti sārthakam iti uktam dūṣayati sarva iti yadi kṣetiḥ ajñam ca api mām iti atra kṣetra kṣejña rūpasya sarvasya abhedaḥ vivakṣitaḥ syāt tarhi sarva kṣetram kṣetrajñam ca api mām viddhi iti vaktavyam

original: sarvakṣetreṣviti saptamīprayogo'nupapannaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ | tarhi kṣetrajñasyaiveśvarābhedo'trocyatām | tathātve bādhakābhāvādityata āha || na ceti || yadi kṣetrajñatayoktajīvasyeśvarasya caikyamātra vivakṣitaṃ syāttarhi kṣetrajño'haṃ caika eveti vaktavyam | na tu kṣetrajñamanūdyeśvaratvavidhānaṃ yujyate |

original: ' yataśca yat ' , ' sa ca yaḥ ' iti pratijñādyayaṃ cettarhi tadubhayamuttaratrocyate | na cobhayoktiḥ śrūyata ityata āha || upadraṣṭeti || atra pramāṇamāha upadraṣṭā'numantā ityādinā'numanturuktatvāt taddharmatayā'numatirapyuktaiveti bhāvaḥ | yatprabhāvaśca iti pratijñātaṃ kutrocyata ityata āha || jñeyamiti ||

original: nanu caitanyasyāvikāritvāt kathaṃ vikāreṣu cetanā paṭhyata ityata āha || cetaneti || nanu mahābhūtānītyādinoktānāṃ saṅghātasya kṣetratvāta kāryatvaṃ kathamucyata ityāśaṃkāṃ pariharan uktarthaṃ pramāṇamāha || suṅghāta iti || 7 ||
analyzed: nanu caitanyasya avikāri tvāt katham vikāreṣu cetanā paṭhyate iti atas āha cetanā iti nanu mahābhūtāni ityādinā uktānām saṅghātasya kārya tvam katham ucyate iti āśaṃkām pariharan ukta artham pramāṇam āha suṅghātaḥ iti

original: jñeyaṃ vaktuṃ jñānamucyate amānitvaṃ iti | tatra tattvajñānārthadarśanapadasyāsphuṭārthatvāt tadarthamāha || tattveti || nanvamānitvamityādinā jñānasādhanaṃ tattvajñānārthadarśanamiti jñānaṃ coktvopasaṃhāre katham etajjñānamiti proktaṃ ityucyata ityata āha || jñāyata iti || proktamityatra jñānaśabdeneti śeṣaḥ | uktamityucyata iti vā || 12 ||
analyzed: jñeyam vaktum jñānam ucyate amāni tvam iti tatra tattva jñāna artha darśana padasya asphuṭa artha tvāt tad artham āha tattva iti nanu amāni tvam ityādinā jñāna sādhanam tattva jñāna artha darśanam iti jñānam ca uktvā upasaṃhāre katham etat jñānam iti proktam iti ucyate iti atas āha jñāyate iti proktam iti atra jñāna śabdena iti śeṣaḥ uktam iti ucyate iti vā

original: nanu anādimatparaṃ brahma ityatrānādītyetāvatā pūrṇatvāt anādimaditi kimarthamucyata ityata āha || anādīti || na cātra

original: bhāṣyavirodhaḥ tatroktasya matupo mukhyārthasyānaṅgīkāre bhāṣye doṣasyoktatvāt | atra punastamaṅgīkṛtyaiva prayojanāntaraṃ matupā cinotīti || paraṃbrahma na sattannāsaducyata ityetat pramāṇavākyenaiva vyācaṣṭe || mukhyata iti || kathaṃ mūrtāmūrtayoḥ sadasacchabdavācyatvaṃ, kathaṃ ca bhagavatastadvilakṣaṇatvamitta āha || mūrtamiti ||
analyzed: bhāṣya virodhaḥ tatra uktasya matupaḥ mukhya arthasya anaṅgīkāre bhāṣye doṣasya ukta tvāt atra punar tam aṅgīkṛtya eva prayojana antaram matupā cinoti iti paraṃbrahma na sat tat na asat ucyate iti etat pramāṇa vākyena eva vyācaṣṭe mukhyatas iti katham mūrta amūrtayoḥ sat asat śabda vācyatvam katham ca bhagavataḥ tad vilakṣaṇa tvam itte āha mūrtam iti

original: paraṃ amūrtam || 17 ||
analyzed: param amūrtam

original: jñānagamyamiti jñānaviṣayatvamucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyaha || svayameveti || atra svajñeyatvamevocyate, na tu parajñeyatvam | na ca bhagavataḥ svajñeyatvābhāvaḥ | svayamiti tasyoktatvādityarthaḥ | anyajñeyatvamarthaḥ kiṃ na syāditi āha || anyeti ||
analyzed: jñāna gamyam iti jñāna viṣaya tvam ucyate iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya āha svayam eva iti atra sva jñeya tvam eva ucyate na tu para jñeya tvam na ca bhagavataḥ sva jñeya tva abhāvaḥ svayam iti tasya ukta tvāt iti arthaḥ anya jñeya tvam arthaḥ kim na syāt iti āha anya iti

original: jñānaṃ jñeyamiti jñeyaśabdenaikasyāṃ kriyāyāṃ kartṛkarmaṇoraikyavirodhānneśvarasya jñeyatvamuktamiti badatāṃ vādināṃ matanirāsāya svajñeyatvamevocyate | na tvanyajñeyatvam | tasya 'jñeyaṃ yattat pravakṣyāmi ' ityupakramavākya evoktatvena punaruktiprasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ | svajñeyārthatve prabhāvoktiriyaṃ kathamityata āha || kartṛkarmeti ||
analyzed: jñānam jñeyam iti jñeya śabdena ekasyām kriyāyām kartṛ karmaṇoḥ aikya virodhāt na īśvarasya jñeya tvam uktam iti badatām vādinām mata nirāsāya sva jñeya tvam eva ucyate na tu anya jñeya tvam tasya jñeyam yat tat pravakṣyāmi iti upakrama vākye eva ukta tvena punarukti prasaṅgāt iti bhāvaḥ sva jñeya artha tve prabhāva uktiḥ iyam katham iti atas āha kartṛ karma iti

original: aghaṭitamapyekasyāṃ jñānakriyāyāṃ kartṛrmabhāvamātmani īśvaro ghaṭayatītyevamabhiprāyeṇedamucyate | ato bhavati prabhāvoktiriyamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: aghaṭitam api ekasyām jñāna kriyāyām ātmani īśvaraḥ ghaṭayati iti evam abhiprāyeṇa idam ucyate atas bhavati prabhāva uktiḥ iyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: īśvarasva jñeyatve pramāṇāntaraṃ cāha || svavettā svatantravettā | tasya vedanaṃ ca svatantram | kasya vettetyata āha || sveneti || yacca tasya vedanaṃ svatantramuktaṃ tadapi na tasmādbhinnamityāha || vittiśceti || kiṃ svenaiva vedya ityata āha || vedyaśceti || kvaciditi kimarthamucyate, sarvathā parairvedyaḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha || taditi ||
analyzed: īśvara sva jñeya tve pramāṇa antaram ca āha sva vettā svatantra vettā tasya vedanam ca svatantram kasya vettā iti atas āha svena iti yat ca tasya vedanam svatantram uktam tat api na tasmāt bhinnam iti āha vittiḥ ca iti kim svena eva vedyaḥ iti atas āha vedyaḥ ca iti kvacid iti kimartham ucyate sarvathā paraiḥ vedyaḥ kim na syāt iti atas āha tat iti

original: yathā'nyeṣāṃ bhagavajjñāne tatprasādasāpekṣatā tathā bhagavato'pi svavedanādo parasāpekṣatā nāstīti svātantryaṃ vivṛṇoti || sveti || tena svavettṛtvādinā | tathāhi -- svaḥ svatantraḥ prakāśo yasyāsau prakāśaśceti svaprakāśaḥ | parasya vettā vedyaśca syāditi na svaprakāśaśabdārthakathanam |
analyzed: yathā anyeṣām bhagavat jñāne tad prasāda sāpekṣa tā tathā bhagavataḥ api para sāpekṣa tā na asti iti svātantryam vivṛṇoti sva iti tena sva vettṛ tva ādinā tathā hi svaḥ svatantraḥ prakāśaḥ yasya asau prakāśaḥ ca iti sva prakāśaḥ parasya vettā vedyaḥ ca syāt iti na sva prakāśa śabda artha kathanam

original: jīvānāmapi svaprakāśatvāt kathameka ityucyata ityata āha || jīvānāmiti || jīvānāṃ svatantratvettṛtvābhāvādeka iti yuktamiti bhāvaḥ || 18 ||

original: uktamupasaṃhṛtyata tajjñānaṃ stūyate itīti || tatra madbhāvapadamanyathāpratītinirāsāya vyācaṣṭe || madbhāvāyeti || 19 ||

original: yataśca yat sa ca ya iti pratijñātaṃ vaktuṃ prakṛtyādisvarūpamucyate 'prakṛtimiti ' | tatra prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ cetyuktamiti śeṣaḥ | ubhāvikyuktasya pulliṅgenānvayāya vyutkramaḥ | anenobhāvityetat pṛthagvākyamityuktaṃ bhavati | ubhe apīti saṅgrahaśca |
analyzed: yatas ca yat sa ca yaḥ iti pratijñātam vaktum prakṛti ādi svarūpam ucyate prakṛtim iti tatra prakṛtim puruṣam ca iti uktam iti śeṣaḥ ubhau iki uktasya pulliṅgena anvayāya vyutkramaḥ anena ubhau iti etat pṛthak vākyam iti uktam bhavati ubhe api iti saṅgrahaḥ ca

analyzed: vikārān ca guṇān ca iti atra vikāra ādīnām prakṛtiḥ svatantram kāraṇam iti anyathā pratītim icchā ādayaḥ vikārāḥ iti uktatvāt guṇa śabda artham eva vadan nirākaroti vikārāṇām iti upadraṣṭā anumantā ca iti īśvarasya eva svātantryasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt na prakṛteḥ svātantryam kintu upādānatvam eva iti arthaḥ

original: nanvicchādivat sattvādiguṇānāmapi vikāratvād vikārāṃśca guṇāṃśceti pṛthaguktiḥ kinimittetyata

original: āha || guṇānāṃ ceti || sattvādiguṇānāṃ vikāratve'pi vikānāṃśca guṇāṃśceti pṛthaguktiḥ sattvādīnāmalpavikāratvādicchādīnāṃ tato'dhikavikāratvāttadvivakṣayā yuktetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: āha guṇānām ca iti sattva ādi guṇānām vikāra tve pi guṇān ca iti pṛthak uktiḥ sattva ādīnām alpa vikāra tvāt icchā ādīnām tatas adhika vikāra tvāt tad vivakṣayā yuktā iti arthaḥ

original: 'kāryakāraṇakatrṛtve ' iti ślokamacetanaprakṛtijīvaviṣayatvapratītinirāsāya cetanaprakṛtīśvaraviṣayatayā pramāṇenaiva vyācaṣṭe || svadeheti || viṣṇutattvamāvṛtyeti || viṣṇoryathāsthitimajñāyitvetyarthaḥ | viṣṇutattvājñasyaiva bandhakarmasambhavena dehendriyahetutvādajñānahetucitprakṛterjīvasya śarīrendriyahetutvam |
analyzed: iti ślokam acetana prakṛti jīva viṣayatva pratīti nirāsāya cetana prakṛti īśvara viṣayatayā pramāṇena eva vyācaṣṭe sva deha iti viṣṇu tattvam āvṛtya iti viṣṇoḥ yathā sthitim ajñāyi tvā iti arthaḥ viṣṇu tattva ajñasya eva bandha karma sambhavena deha indriya hetu tvāt ajñāna hetu cit prakṛteḥ jīvasya śarīra indriya hetutvam

original: īśvaraparatayottarārdhaṃ vyācaṣṭe || jīvasyeti || sarvakattṛtvādīśvarasya bhogaśaktikartṛtvaṃ kiṃ viśiṣyocyata ityata āha |. sarveti || yathā sarvapālo'pi vikuṇṭhapo viśiṣyocyate, sthānāntarasyeva viṇṭhasya pālakāntararahitatvāt tathā sarvakartā'pi hariḥ keṣāñcidbhoktṛtvādīnāṃ kartā viśiṣyocyate |
analyzed: īśvara para tayā uttara ardham vyācaṣṭe jīvasya iti sarva kattṛ tvāt īśvarasya bhoga śakti kartṛ tvam kim viśiṣya ucyate iti atas āha sarva iti yathā sarva pālaḥ api vikuṇṭhapaḥ viśiṣya ucyate sthāna antarasya iva viṇṭhasya pālaka antara rahita tvāt tathā sarva kartā api hariḥ keṣāñcid bhoktṛ tva ādīnām kartā viśiṣya ucyate

original: kāryāntara iva bhoktṛtvādāvanyeṣāṃ pravṛttyabhāvādityarthaḥ | viśeṣeṇa svakarmaṇā kevalena svakarmaṇā | etena bhagavataḥ kāryakāraṇakartṛtvahetutve'pi citprakṛterbhoktṛtvapradāne svapravṛttimapekṣya kāryakāraṇakartṛtve'dhikapravṛttiriti kāryakāraṇakatṛtve hetutvoktiriti sūcitaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: kārya antare iva bhoktṛ tva ādau anyeṣām pravṛtti abhāvāt iti arthaḥ viśeṣeṇa sva karmaṇā kevalena sva karmaṇā etena bhagavataḥ kārya kāraṇa kartṛ tva hetutve pi cit prakṛteḥ bhoktṛ tva pradāne sva pravṛttim apekṣya kārya kāraṇa kartṛ tva adhika pravṛttiḥ iti kārya kāraṇa katṛ tve hetutva uktiḥ iti sūcitam bhavati

original: etadubhayaṃ gītāyāmeva sūcitamityāha || parameśvarasyeti || parameśvarasyaiva kāryakāraṇakartṛtve hetutve'pi citprakṛtestaduktiryuktā | bhoktṛtvadāne tasyā alpapravṛttitvena tadapekṣayā kartṛtve'dhikapravṛttimattvāt | tathā parameśvarasya sarvakartṛtve'pi viśiṣya bhoktṛtvadānoktiryuktā |
analyzed: etat ubhayam gītāyām eva sūcitam iti āha parameśvarasya iti parameśvarasya eva kārya kāraṇa kartṛ tve hetutve pi cit prakṛteḥ tad uktiḥ yuktā bhoktṛ tva dāne tasyāḥ alpa pravṛtti tvena tad apekṣayā kartṛ tva idhika pravṛttimat tvāt tathā parameśvarasya sarva kartṛ tve api viśiṣya bhoktṛ tva dāna uktiḥ yuktā

original: bhoktṛtvadāne citprakṛtyādīnāmanyatra pravṛttimapekṣyālpapravṛttitvena bhagavata evādhikapravattitvādityetatsūcayitumasya ślokasya pūrvottarārdhayorucyata ityuktamityarthaḥ | kathamanenaitatsūcitamityata āha || kartṛtve'pīti || bhoktṛtvāpekṣayeti || svasyā bhoktṛtvadāne pravṛttyapekṣayetyarthaḥ | adhikapravṛttiḥ kāryakāraṇakartṛtva iti śeṣaḥ |
analyzed: bhoktṛ tva dāne cit prakṛti ādīnām anyatra pravṛttim apekṣya alpa pravṛtti tvena bhagavataḥ eva adhika pravatti tvāt iti etat sūcayitum asya ślokasya pūrva uttara ardhayoḥ ucyate iti uktam iti arthaḥ katham anena etat sūcitam iti atas āha kartṛ tve api iti bhoktṛ tva apekṣayā iti svasyāḥ bhoktṛ tva dāne pravṛtti apekṣayā iti arthaḥ adhika pravṛttiḥ kārya kāraṇa kartṛ tve iti śeṣaḥ

original: bhoktṛtve heturucyate | viśeṣeṇeti śeṣaḥ |
analyzed: bhoktṛ tve hetuḥ ucyate viśeṣeṇa iti śeṣaḥ

original: 'puruṣaḥ prakṛtistho hi ' ityatreśvara ucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || puruṣa iti || īśvarasya 'puruṣaḥ sukhaduḥkhānāṃ ' iti puruṣaśabdena prakṛtatvāt kathamatra jīve puruṣaśabda ityata āha || ubhayoriti || yadyapyatra puruṣaśabdeneśvaraḥ prakṛtastathāpyatra puruṣaśabdasya jīvaviṣayatvagrahaṇaṃ yuktam |
analyzed: puruṣaḥ prakṛti sthaḥ hi iti atra īśvaraḥ ucyate iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya āha puruṣaḥ iti īśvarasya puruṣaḥ sukha duḥkhānām iti puruṣa śabdena prakṛta tvāt katham atra jīve puruṣa śabdaḥ iti atas āha ubhayoḥ iti yadi api atra puruṣa śabdena īśvaraḥ prakṛtaḥ tathā api atra puruṣa śabdasya jīva viṣayatva grahaṇam yuktam

original: 'prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva ' ityatra puruṣaśabdeneśvaravat jīvasyāpi pirakṛtatvāt | anyathā 'ubhau ' ityasya vaiyyarthyāditi bhāvaḥ | astu jīvaḥ prakṛtastathāpi samīpaprakṛtaṃ parityajya dūraprakṛtagrahaṇaṃ nopapannamityata āha || yatheti || samīpaprakṛtatve'pīśvarasya tatparityāgaṃna dūraprakṛtajīvagrahaṇamupapadyate |
analyzed: prakṛtim puruṣam ca eva iti atra puruṣa śabdena īśvara vat jīvasya api anyathā ubhau iti asya vaiyyarthyāt iti bhāvaḥ astu jīvaḥ prakṛtaḥ tathā api samīpa prakṛtam parityajya dūra prakṛta grahaṇam na upapannam iti atas āha yathā iti samīpa prakṛta tve pi īśvarasya tad parityāgam na dūra prakṛta jīva grahaṇam upapadyate

original: asya puruṣasya prakṛtijaguṇabhoktṛtvapratīteḥ |
analyzed: asya puruṣasya prakṛti ja guṇa bhoktṛ tva pratīteḥ

original: īśvarasya tadayogāt, jīvasya tadyogyatvāt | yathāyogyamevārthāśrayaṇasyopapannatvāditi bhāvaḥ | ubhayoḥ prakṛtatve jīvamātragrahaṇaṃ kathamityato vā'ha || yatheti || 21 ||
analyzed: īśvarasya tad ayogāt jīvasya tad yogya tvāt yathāyogyam eva artha āśrayaṇasya upapanna tvāt iti bhāvaḥ ubhayoḥ prakṛta tve jīva mātra grahaṇam katham iti atas vā āha yathā iti

original: yadyatra puruṣapadaṃ jīvaparaṃ tarhi punaruktiḥ syāt | jīvasya 'kāryakāraṇakartṛtve ' ityanenoktakāryakāraṇasaṃbandhasyaiva prakṛtisthapadenokteḥ | sukhaduḥkhānāṃ bhoktṛtve ityanenoktasukhaduḥkhādibhogasyaiva 'bhuṅkte prakṛtijān guṇān ' ityuktatvādityata āha || kāryeti ||
analyzed: yadi atra puruṣa padam jīva param tarhi punaruktiḥ syāt jīvasya kārya kāraṇa kartṛ tve iti anena ukta kārya kāraṇa saṃbandhasya eva prakṛtistha padena ukteḥ sukha duḥkhānām bhoktṛ tve iti anena ukta sukha duḥkha ādi bhogasya eva bhuṅkte prakṛti jān guṇān iti ukta tvāt iti atas āha kārya iti

original: kāryakāraṇasaṃbandhasya sukhādibhogasya ca prāguktatve'pi tanmithyātvavādināṃ nirāsāya 'puruṣaḥ prakṛtistho hi ' ityuktatvānna punaruktidoṣa iti bhāvaḥ | nisākaraṇasya pramāṇasāpekṣatvāt tadanuktoktābhidhānamātreṇa kathaṃ nirākaraṇamityata āha || hīti ||
analyzed: kārya kāraṇa saṃbandhasya sukha ādi bhogasya ca prāgukta tve pi tad mithyātva vādinām nirāsāya puruṣaḥ prakṛti sthaḥ hi iti ukta tvāt na punarukti doṣaḥ iti bhāvaḥ nisākaraṇasya pramāṇa sāpekṣa tvāt tad anukta ukta abhidhāna mātreṇa katham nirākaraṇam iti atas āha hi iti

original: atra kāryakāraṇasambandhasya sukhādibhogasya ca hiśabdenānubhavaprasiddhikathanena tanmithyātvavādināmanubhavavirodhasya tarśitatvāt naitaduktābhidhānamātramiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: atra kārya kāraṇa sambandhasya sukha ādi bhogasya ca hi śabdena anubhava prasiddhi kathanena tad mithyātva vādinām anubhava virodhasya tarśita tvāt na etat ukta abhidhāna mātram iti bhāvaḥ

original: ahaṃ sukhīduḥkhītyādyanubhavasya bhrāntitvasambhavāt sukhādibhogasya mithyātvāṅgīkāre kathaṃ tadvirodha ityata aha || na hīti || sukhādiviṣayānubhavo na bhramaḥ āntarārthānubhavatvāt | āntarārthānubhavasya bhramatvārśanāditi bhāvaḥ | bādhakābhāvācca nāyamanubhavo bhrama ityāha || na ceti ||
analyzed: aham sukhī duḥkhī ityādi anubhavasya bhrānti tva sambhavāt sukha ādi bhogasya mithyātva aṅgīkāre katham tad virodhaḥ iti atas aha na hi iti sukha ādi viṣaya anubhavaḥ na bhramaḥ āntara artha anubhava tvāt āntara artha anubhavasya bhrama tva arśanāt iti bhāvaḥ bādhaka abhāvāt ca na ayam anubhavaḥ bhramaḥ iti āha na ca iti

original: nanvātmādau jainādīnāṃ madhyamaparimāṇatvādijñānasya bhramatvadarśanāt kathamāntarārthānubhavatvādabhratvamucyata ityāśaṃkāṃ pariharan vyāptimāha || śarīramiti || nātrā'ntarānubhavatvameva hetuḥ | yena vyabhicāraḥ syāt | api tvaparokṣatvaviśiṣṭam | aparokṣānubhavasya ca vahireva bhramatvadarśanādāntarānubhavasya tadabhāvaḥ siddhyati ||
analyzed: nanu ātma ādau jaina ādīnām madhyama parimāṇa tva ādi jñānasya bhrama tva darśanāt katham āntara artha anubhava tvāt abhra tvam ucyate iti āśaṃkām pariharan vyāptim āha śarīram iti na atra antara anubhava tvam eva hetuḥ yena vyabhicāraḥ syāt api tu aparokṣa tva viśiṣṭam aparokṣa anubhavasya ca vahis eva bhrama tva darśanāt āntara anubhavasya tad abhāvaḥ siddhi ati

original: jainādīnāṃ cānumānādinaiva madhyamaparimāṇatvādibhrama iti bhāvaḥ | bādhakābhāve'pi sukhādyanubhavasya bhramatvaṃ kiṃ na syādityata āha || tatrāpīti || yatra bahirarthānubhavasya bhramatvaṃ tatrāpi balavatpramāṇavirodhādeva tat kalpyate | ataḥ sukhādiviṣayānubhavasya bādhakābhāvenābhramatvaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: jaina ādīnām ca anumāna ādinā eva madhyama parimāṇa tva ādi bhramaḥ iti bhāvaḥ bādhaka abhāve pi sukha ādi anubhavasya bhrama tvam kim na syāt iti atas āha tatra api iti yatra bahirartha anubhavasya bhrama tvam tatra api balavat pramāṇa virodhāt eva tat kalpyate atas sukha ādi viṣaya anubhavasya bādhaka abhāvena abhrama tvam yuktam iti bhāvaḥ

original: itaśca na sukhādiviṣayānubhavasya bhramatvena sukhādermithyātvaṃ vācyamityāha || sākṣīti || sākṣiyanubhavasidhdhasyāpi sukhāderbhrāntikalpitatve sarvaṃ mithyā, ātmā satya iti vyavasthā'pi na siddhyati | etadvyavasthāyā api sākṣyanubhavasiddhatvena mithyātvāpātāditi bhāvaḥ | bhrāntitvamabhrāntitvamiti ||
analyzed: itas ca na sukha ādi viṣaya anubhavasya bhrama tvena sukha ādeḥ mithyātvam vācyam iti āha sākṣī iti sukha ādeḥ bhrānti kalpita tve sarvam mithyā ātmā satyaḥ iti vyavasthā api na siddhi ati etad vyavasthāyāḥ api sākṣi anubhava siddha tvena mithyātva āpātāt iti bhāvaḥ bhrānti tvam abhrānti tvam iti

original: bhrāntikalpitatvamabhrāntikalpitatvamityarthaḥ
analyzed: bhrānti kalpita tvam abhrānti kalpita tvam iti arthaḥ

original: | sarvaṃ mithyā ātmā satya iti vyavahārata evāsti, na tu paramārthataḥ | atastadasiddhirnāniṣṭetyata āha || vyavahārata iti || vyavahārata eveyaṃ vyavasthā'stītyapi na siddhyati | sākṣiṇo'prāmāṇye tatra pramāṇābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | kiñca sākṣyanubhavasyāprāmāṇye stambhādau sthāṇvādimanovṛttirbhrāntiḥ |
analyzed: sarvam mithyā ātmā satyaḥ iti vyavahārataḥ evā asti na tu paramārthataḥ atas tad asiddhiḥ na aniṣṭā iti atas āha vyavahārataḥ iti vyavahārataḥ evā iyam vyavasthā asti iti api na siddhi ati sākṣiṇā uprāmāṇye tatra pramāṇa abhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ kiñca sākṣi anubhavasya aprāmāṇye stambha ādau sthāṇu ādi manaḥ vṛttiḥ bhrāntiḥ

original: stambhādimanovṛttirabhrāntirityapa na siddhyati | sākṣiṇa eva jñānasya bhrāntitvābhrāntitvagrāhakatvāt | tadasiddhau ca vyavahāramātraṃ ca na siddhyatīti bhāvenāha || bhrāntiriti || etena sarvaṃ mithyā ātmā satya iti vyavasthā vyavahārato'stītyetadāgamādinā siddhyatītyetadapi nirastam | āgamādiprāmāṇyasyāpi sākṣigrāhyatvāt |
analyzed: stambha ādi manaḥ vṛttiḥ abhrāntiḥ iti apa na siddhi ati sākṣiṇaḥ eva jñānasya bhrānti tva abhrānti tva grāhaka tvāt tad asiddhau ca vyavahāra mātram ca na siddhi ati iti bhāvena āha bhrāntiḥ iti etena sarvam mithyā ātmā satyaḥ iti vyavasthā vyavahāratosti iti etat āgama ādinā siddhi ati iti etat api nirastam āgama ādi prāmāṇyasya api sākṣi grāhya tvāt

original: 'sākṣisiddhasya ' ityāderekagranthatve bhrāntirityasya sādhyābhidhānaparatayā taccheṣatvaṃ jñātavyam |
analyzed: sākṣi siddhasya ityādeḥ eka grantha tve bhrāntiḥ iti asya sādhya abhidhāna para tayā tad śeṣa tvam jñātavyam

original: yaduktaṃ sukhādiviṣayasākṣyanubhavasya na bhrāntitvaṃ, bādhakābhāvāditi tadayuktam | 'vimuktaśca vimucyate ' ityādipramāṇasadbhāvādityata āha || anubhava iti || nānena sukhādiviṣayasyānubhavasya bhrāntitvaṃ siddhyati | tatsvarūpaprāmāṇyayoḥ siddhyabhāvāt | sākṣyanubhavasyaiva tatsādhakatvāt | tasya ca bhrāntitvābhidhānāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: yat uktam sukha ādi viṣaya sākṣi anubhavasya na bhrānti tvam bādhaka abhāvāt iti tat ayuktam vimuktaḥ ca vimucyate ityādi pramāṇa sadbhāvāt iti atas āha anubhavaḥ iti na anena sukha ādi viṣayasya anubhavasya bhrānti tvam siddhi ati tad svarūpa prāmāṇyayoḥ siddhi abhāvāt sākṣi anubhavasya eva tad sādhaka tvāt tasya ca bhrānti tva abhidhānāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: na ca sukhādiviṣaya eva sākṣyanubhavasya bhramatvaṃ, pramāṇasvarūpādāvabhramatvamiti yuktam | viśeṣapramāṇābhāvenānāśvāsāt | sākṣyanubhavasya bhramatve'pi pramāṇasvarūpapramāṇye lokavyavahārādeva setsyata ityāśaṃkyāha || vyavahārata iti || na lokavyavahārataḥ pramāṇasvarūpādisiddhiḥ | lokasya ca tadvyavahārasya cāsiddheḥ |
analyzed: na ca sukha ādi viṣaye eva sākṣi anubhavasya bhrama tvam pramāṇa svarūpa ādau abhrama tvam iti yuktam viśeṣa pramāṇa abhāvena anāśvāsāt sākṣi anubhavasya bhrama tve pi pramāṇa svarūpa pramāṇye lokavyavahārāt eva setsyate iti āśaṃkya āha vyavahārataḥ iti na lokavyavahārataḥ pramāṇa svarūpa ādi siddhiḥ lokasya ca tad vyavahārasya ca asiddheḥ

original: sākṣiṇa eva tadgrāhakatvāt | tasya ca bhrāntitvāṅgīkārāditi bhāvaḥ | sākṣiṇo bhrāntitve'pi vyavahāravyavahartṛsiddhiḥ pratītita eva bhaviṣyatītyāśaṃkya pariharati || pratītita iti || bhavet pratītyaiva vyavahārādisiddhiḥ yadi saiva siddhyet | na ca tatsādhakaṃ vaktuṃ śakyata iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: sākṣiṇaḥ eva tad grāhaka tvāt tasya ca bhrānti tva aṅgīkārāt iti bhāvaḥ sākṣiṇaḥ bhrānti tve pi vyavahāra vyavahartṛ siddhiḥ pratītitaḥ eva bhaviṣyati iti āśaṃkya pariharati pratītitaḥ iti bhavet pratītya eva vyavahāra ādi siddhiḥ yadi sā eva siddhyet na ca tad sādhakam vaktum śakyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: sākṣiṇa eva pratītisiddheḥ kathaṃ tatsādhakābhāva ityāśaṃkya pariharati || svata iti || na sākṣiṇā pratītisiddhiḥ | tasya sukhādau bhrāntitvāṅgīkāreṇa pratītyabhāve'pi pratītirastīti bhramo'yamiti śaṃkākuṇṭhitaśaktitvāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: sākṣiṇaḥ eva pratīti siddheḥ katham tad sādhaka abhāvaḥ iti āśaṃkya pariharati svatas iti na sākṣiṇā pratīti siddhiḥ tasya sukha ādau bhrānti tva aṅgīkāreṇa pratīti abhāve api pratītiḥ asti iti bhramaḥ yam iti śaṃkā kuṇṭhita śakti tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: itaśca na sukhādiviṣayānubhavasya bhramatvamityāha || sveti || sukhādiviṣayānubhavasya bhramatvāṅgīkṛtāvātmābhāvo'pi syāt | ātmasādhakābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | nanvahamiti pratyakṣata evātmopalabhyate | ataḥ kathaṃ tatsādhakābhāva ityata āha || svayamiti ||
analyzed: itas ca na sukha ādi viṣaya anubhavasya bhrama tvam iti āha sva iti sukha ādi viṣaya anubhavasya bhrama tva aṅgīkṛtau ātma abhāvaḥ api syāt ātma sādhaka abhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ nanu aham iti pratyakṣataḥ eva ātmā upalabhyate atas katham tad sādhaka abhāvaḥ iti atas āha svayam iti

original: nāhamityanubhavenātmasiddhiḥ, anubhavasya sukhādau bhrāntitvābhyupagemenātmanyapi bhramatvaśaṃkāvārakābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | niradhiṣṭhānabhramāsambhavāt sukhādiramānyathānupapattyā'dhiṣṭhānabhūtātmasiddhirityata āha || nirālambana iti || nānena tarkeṇātmasiddhiḥ | etattarkānubhavasyāpi sukhānubhavavat bhramatvaśaṃkāyāḥ prasaṅgāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: na aham iti anubhavena ātma siddhiḥ anubhavasya sukha ādau bhrānti tva abhyupagemena ātmani api bhrama tva śaṃkā vāraka abhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ niradhiṣṭhāna bhrama asambhavāt sukha ādi rama anyathā anupapattyā adhiṣṭhāna bhūta ātma siddhiḥ iti atas āha nirālambanaḥ iti na anena tarkeṇa ātma siddhiḥ etad tarka anubhavasya api sukha anubhava vat bhrama tva śaṃkāyāḥ prasaṅgāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: śrutirātmani pramāṇamityata āha || taditi || yacchrutiḥ pramāṇamātmanyucyate tacchrutiprāmāṇyasādhakābhāvenāpramāṇyasyāpi vaktuṃ śakyatvāt na tenātmasiddhiriti bhāvaḥ | śruteḥ prāmāṇyānubhavāt kathamaprāmāṇyamityata āha || pramāṇatveti || nānubhavena śruteḥ prāmāṇyasiddhiḥ |
analyzed: śrutiḥ ātmani pramāṇam iti atas āha tat iti yat śrutiḥ pramāṇam ātmani ucyate tad śruti prāmāṇya sādhaka abhāvena apramāṇyasya api vaktum śakya tvāt na tena ātma siddhiḥ iti bhāvaḥ śruteḥ prāmāṇya anubhavāt katham aprāmāṇyam iti atas āha pramāṇa tva iti na anubhavena śruteḥ prāmāṇya siddhiḥ

original: sukhānubhavavadasyāpyaprāmāṇye pramāṇatvabhramatvasambhavāditi bhāvaḥ | sākṣisiddhasyetyādyuktamupasaṃharati || itīti || evamuktaprakāreṇa sākṣyanubhavasya bhramatve sarvaṃ mithyā ātmā satya iti vyavasthādi kiñcidapi na siddhyatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: sukha anubhava vat asya api aprāmāṇye pramāṇa tva bhrama tva sambhavāt iti bhāvaḥ sākṣi siddhasya ityādi uktam upasaṃharati iti iti evam ukta prakāreṇa sākṣi anubhavasya bhrama tve sarvam mithyā ātmā satyaḥ iti vyavasthā ādi kiñcid api na siddhi ati iti arthaḥ

original: sukhādyanubhavo bhrama ityarthasādhakaśruteḥ prāmāṇyāsiddherna tayā sukhādyanubhavasya bhramatvasiddhirityuktam | atha tasya śrautānubhavasyāpi bhramatvopapattyā sukhādyanubhavasyābhramatvameva bhavati | na tu tena tasya bhramatvasiddhiḥ | parasparaviruddhayoranyataraniṣedhasyetaravidhināntarīyakatvāditi bhāvenāha || bhrama iti ||
analyzed: sukha ādi anubhavaḥ bhramaḥ iti artha sādhaka śruteḥ prāmāṇya asiddheḥ na tayā sukha ādi anubhavasya bhrama tva siddhiḥ iti uktam atha tasya śrauta anubhavasya api bhrama tva upapattyā sukha ādi anubhavasya abhrama tvam eva bhavati na tu tena tasya bhrama tva siddhiḥ paraspara viruddhayoḥ anyatara niṣedhasya itara vidhi nāntarīyaka tvāt iti bhāvena āha bhramaḥ iti

original: ito'pi na sukhādyanubhavasya bhramatvamityāha || sukheti || yadi lasukhādyanubhavo bhramastarhi yat pracchannaṃ nairātmyamatamaṅgīkṛtaṃ tatparakaṭitaṃ syāt | sukhādiviṣayānubhavasya ātmasvarūpatvādityarthaḥ | sukhādiviṣayānubhavasyātmarūpatvaṃ bhavanmata eva nāsmanmate | kintu manovṛttirūpatvamevetyato'pasiddhānta ityāha || na hīti ||
analyzed: itas api na sukha ādi anubhavasya bhrama tvam iti āha sukha iti yadi la sukha ādi anubhavaḥ bhramaḥ tarhi yat pracchannam nairātmya matam aṅgīkṛtam tat parakaṭitam syāt sukha ādi viṣaya anubhavasya ātma svarūpa tvāt iti arthaḥ sukha ādi viṣaya anubhavasya ātma rūpa tvam bhavat mate eva na asmat mate kintu manaḥ vṛtti rūpatvam eva iti atas upasiddhāntaḥ iti āha na hi iti

original: nanvastu sukhādyanubhavasya bhramatvamātmasvarūpatvaṃ ca | tathāpi kathamātmābhāvaprasaṅga ityata āha || bhramasyeti || sukhādiviṣayānubhavasya bhramatve'vidyākāryatvaṃ syāt | bhramasyāvidyākāryatvāṅgīkārāt | tathācātma no'pyavidyākāryatvaṃ syāt | sukhādiviṣayānubhavasyātmasvarūpatvāt | avidyākāryatve cātmano mithyātvaṃ durnivāramiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: nanu astu sukha ādi anubhavasya bhrama tvam ātma svarūpa tvam ca tathā api katham ātma abhāva prasaṅgaḥ iti atas āha bhramasya iti sukha ādi viṣaya anubhavasya bhrama tve vidyā kāryatvam syāt bhramasya avidyā kāryatva aṅgīkārāt tathā ca ātma na upi avidyā kāryatvam syāt sukha ādi viṣaya anubhavasya ātma svarūpa tvāt avidyā kāryatve ca ātmanaḥ mithyātvam durnivāram iti bhāvaḥ

original: astvevamātmano yuktyā durghaṭatvam | tathāpi na tadbādhakam | ātmanaḥ pramāṇasiddhatvāt | na hi pramāṇasiddhasya yuktyā durghaṭatvamātreṇa bādho'stītyāśaṃkya pariharati || durghaṭatvamiti || yadyātmanaḥ prāmāṇikatvādyuktyā durghaṭatvamapi na bādhakamityucyate tarhi sukhādīnāmapi durghaṭatvaṃ sughaṭatvaṃ vā'stu |
analyzed: astu evam ātmanaḥ yuktyā durghaṭa tvam tathā api na tat bādhakam ātmanaḥ pramāṇa siddha tvāt na hi pramāṇa siddhasya yuktyā durghaṭa tva mātreṇa bādhaḥ usti iti āśaṃkya pariharati durghaṭa tvam iti yadi ātmanaḥ prāmāṇika tvāt yuktyā durghaṭa tvam api na bādhakam iti ucyate tarhi sukha ādīnām api durghaṭa tvam sughaṭa tvam vā astu

original: na tadbādhakaṃ, pramāṇasiddhatvāditi vaktavyamityarthaḥ | yuktyā durghaṭatvamastu | na tadbādhakamiti kathamityata āha || na hīti || aṅgīkṛtya cedamuktam | yuktyā durghaṭatvamaparihṛtya tasyābādhakatvābhyupagame'tiprasaṅgaḥ syādityāha || durghaṭatvamiti ||
analyzed: na tat bādhakam pramāṇa siddha tvāt iti vaktavyam iti arthaḥ yuktyā durghaṭa tvam astu na tat bādhakam iti katham iti atas āha na hi iti aṅgīkṛtya ca idam uktam yuktyā durghaṭa tvam a parihṛtya tasya ābādhaka tva abhyupagama iti prasaṅgaḥ syāt iti āha durghaṭa tvam iti

original: yadi yuktyā durghaṭatvaṃ na bādhakamityātmāstitvaṃ durghaṭatayā'ṅgīkriyate tarhyātmano'vidyātvaṃ durghaṭamapyaṅgīkriyatāmaviśeṣādityarthaḥ | prāmāṇikasyaiva yuktyā durghaṭatvaṃ na
analyzed: yadi yuktyā durghaṭa tvam na bādhakam iti ātma astitvam durghaṭatayā aṅgīkriyate tarhi ātmanaḥ vidyā tvam durghaṭam api aṅgīkriyatām aviśeṣāt iti arthaḥ prāmāṇikasya eva yuktyā durghaṭa tvam na

original: bādhakamityucyate | na cātmano'vidyātvaṃ prāmāṇikaṃ, yena yuktyā durghaṭatvamabādhakaṃ syādityata āha |. atīti || nātmano'vidyātvamaprāmāṇikam | kiñciccetanaṃ kiñcidacetanamityaṅgīkāre gauravaprāpteḥ | sarvasyācetanatvāṅgīkṛtereva jyāyastvamiti yuktisiddhatvāditi bhāvaḥ | na kevalaṃ prāmāṇike yuktyā durghaṭatvamabādhakam |
analyzed: bādhakam iti ucyate na ca ātmanovidyā tvam prāmāṇikam yena yuktyā durghaṭa tvam abādhakam syāt iti atas āha ati iti na ātmanovidyā tvam aprāmāṇikam kiñcid cetanam kiñcid acetanam iti aṅgīkāre gaurava prāpteḥ sarvasya acetana tva aṅgīkṛteḥ eva jyāyastvam iti yukti siddha tvāt iti bhāvaḥ na kevalam prāmāṇike yuktyā durghaṭa tvam abādhakam

original: kintu yadaṅgīkāre pramāṇāvirodhastatraiva | ātmano'vidyātvaṃ pramāṇaviruddhamato yuktyā viruddhatvaṃ tatra bādhakamevetyata āha|| na ceti || atmano'vidyātvaṃ vadatāṃ pratipakṣiṇāmuktarītyā na ko'pi pramāṇavirodho'stīti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: kintu yad aṅgīkāre pramāṇa avirodhaḥ tatra eva ātmanaḥ vidyā tvam pramāṇa viruddham atas yuktyā viruddha tvam tatra bādhakam eva iti atas āha na ca iti vadatām pratipakṣiṇām ukta rītyā na kaḥ api pramāṇa virodhaḥ usti iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanvevamanubhavabalena kāryakāraṇasambandhasya sukhaduḥkhādibhogasya ca satyatvaṃ vadatā bhagavatā'nubhavasya bhramatvamabhyupagacchatāṃ matamevaṃ kimiti na nirākṛtamityāśaṃkāṃ pariharannuktamupasaṃharati || ata iti || anubhavabhramatvasya sphuṭamuktarītyā anantadoṣaduṣṭatvapratīterna svayaṃ bhagavatā tannirākṛtiḥ kṛteti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: nanu evam anubhava balena kārya kāraṇa sambandhasya sukha duḥkha ādi bhogasya ca satyatvam vadatā bhagavatā anubhavasya bhrama tvam abhyupagacchatām matam evam kim iti na nirākṛtam iti āśaṃkām pariharan uktam upasaṃharati atas iti anubhava bhrama tvasya sphuṭam ukta rītyā ananta doṣa duṣṭatva pratīteḥ na svayam bhagavatā tad nirākṛtiḥ kṛtā iti bhāvaḥ

original: puruṣaḥ prakṛtistha ityuktam | tatra svataḥ śuddhasya jīvasya prakṛtisthatve kiṃkāraṇamityata ucyate 'kāraṇam ' iti || tatra paramātmano jīvabhāvena śarīrasambandhādyuktau śuddhasya kiṃ kāraṇaṃ śarīrasambandhāderityataḥ saguṇatvaṃ tatkāraṇamucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyā'ha || asyeti || 22 ||
analyzed: puruṣaḥ prakṛti sthaḥ iti uktam tatra svatas śuddhasya jīvasya prakṛti stha tve kiṃkāraṇam iti atas ucyate kāraṇam iti tatra paramātmanaḥ jīva bhāvena śarīra sambandha ādi uktau śuddhasya kim kāraṇam śarīra sambandha ādeḥ iti atas sa guṇa tvam tat kāraṇam ucyate iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya āha asya iti

original: atra jīvasya śarīrasambandhe sattvādiguṇasaṅgaḥ kāraṇamucyate, na tu paramātmanastatra saguṇatvam | paramārthatastadanupapatteḥ | tanmithyātvasya dūṣitatvāditi bhāvaḥ | kiṃ jīvasya sattvādiguṇasaṅgaḥ sadasadyonijanmasu svatantrakāraṇamuta nimittamātram? nādyaḥ | jaḍatvena tadanupapatteḥ |
analyzed: atra jīvasya śarīra sambandhe sattva ādi guṇa saṅgaḥ kāraṇam ucyate na tu paramātmanaḥ tatra saguṇa tvam paramārthataḥ tad anupapatteḥ tad mithyātvasya dūṣita tvāt iti bhāvaḥ kim jīvasya sattva ādi guṇa saṅgaḥ sat asat yoni janmasu svatantra kāraṇam uta nimitta mātram na ādyaḥ jaḍa tvena tad anupapatteḥ

original: dvitīye svatantrakāraṇaṃ vācyamiti śaṃkāparihāratvena ślokamavatārayati || svatantreti || kathamanena hareḥ svatantrakāraṇatvamucyata ityataḥ pramāṇavākyena ślokaṃ vyācaṣṭe || sarvebhya iti || upari upari vartamānaḥ, uttama iti yāvat | svānukūlyena svātmano'vikṣepakatayā | matyā buddhipūrvakam | svātantryaṃ tatra hetutvenaivoktam |
analyzed: dvitīye svatantra kāraṇam vācyam iti śaṃkā parihāra tvena ślokam avatārayati svatantra iti katham anena hareḥ svatantra kāraṇa tvam ucyate iti atas pramāṇa vākyena ślokam vyācaṣṭe sarvebhyaḥ iti upari upari vartamānaḥ uttamaḥ iti yāvat sva ānukūlyena sva ātmanaḥ vikṣepakatayā matyā buddhi pūrvakam svātantryam tatra hetu tvena eva uktam

original: paramatvādityanena paramātmetyuktārthaṃ bhavati | upadraṣṭetyādau sarvatretiśabdānvayonānumantṛtve hetvabhidhāyakatvaṃ draṣṭavyam | dehinonya ityanena paraśabdo vyākhyāto bhavati | nanvanumantuḥ prāgdehasthitatvenānuktatvādapyukto dehe'sminniti kathamucyata ityata āha || māmiti ||
analyzed: parama tvāt iti anena paramātmā iti ukta artham bhavati upadraṣṭā ityādau sarvatra itiśabda anvayaḥ na anumantṛ tve hetu abhidhāyaka tvam draṣṭavyam dehinaḥ anyaḥ iti anena para śabdaḥ vyākhyātaḥ bhavati nanu anumantuḥ prāk deha sthita tvena anukta tvāt api uktaḥ dehe ismin iti katham ucyate iti atas āha mām iti

original: ' kṣetrajñaṃ cāpi māṃ viddhi sarvakṣetreṣu bhārata ' iti prāganumanturdehagatatvenoktatvādapyukto dehesminnityuktiryukteti bhāvaḥ | nanūpadraṣṭṛtvādikamanumantṛtve hetutvenocyatām | anumanturdehasthatayoktatvaṃ kimarthamucyata ityata āha || teneti || ko'yamanumantetyato dehe'pyukta ityanenāhamevānumanteti darśayati ||
analyzed: kṣetrajñam ca api mām viddhi sarva kṣetreṣu bhārata iti prāk anumantuḥ deha gata tvena ukta tvāt api uktaḥ dehe ismin iti uktiḥ yuktā iti bhāvaḥ nanu upadraṣṭṛ tva ādikam anumantṛ tve hetu tvena ucyatām anumantuḥ deha stha tayā ukta tvam kimartham ucyate iti atas āha tena iti kaḥ yam anumantā iti atas dehe pi uktaḥ iti anena aham eva anumantā iti darśayati

original: dehasthatvenātmanaḥ kathitatvāditi bhāvaḥ || 23 ||
analyzed: deha stha tvena ātmanaḥ kathita tvāt iti bhāvaḥ 23

original: 'prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva' ityādyuktārthaṃ bubhutsātiśayotpādanāya tajjñānaphalamucyate -- 'ya enaṃ' iti | tatpramāṇavacanenaiva vyācaṣṭe || dvividhamiti || jñātvā parokṣataḥ | 'sarvathā vartamānaḥ' ityasya pramādādanyāyena vartamāno'pi niyatamokṣa ityarthaḥ | paramapuraṣādidarśane kiṃ sādhanamityata āha || anādīti ||
analyzed: prakṛtim puruṣam ca eva ityādi ukta artham bubhutsā atiśaya utpādanāya tad jñāna phalam ucyate yaḥ enam iti tad pramāṇa vacanena eva vyācaṣṭe dvividham iti jñātvā parokṣataḥ sarvathā vartamānaḥ iti asya pramādāt anyāyena vartamānaḥ api niyata mokṣaḥ iti arthaḥ parama puraṣa ādi darśane kim sādhanam iti atas āha anādi iti

original: kathaṃ nānātvamityata āha ||tatreti || svayamiti || svapratibhayā || tatheti || uktaprakāradvayena | anena 'dhyānena' ityuktākteṃ bhavati | 'kiñcit' ityuktyāteṣāṃ dhyānātiriktasādhanasadbhāve'pi tasyālpatvādanuktirityuktaṃ bhavati | ṛṣayo'ntaḥprakāśā ityādau ṛṣīṇāmantardarśananiyamokteḥ kecanetyuktiḥ kimarthetyata āha || keciditi ||
analyzed: katham nānātvam iti atas āha tatra iti svayam iti sva pratibhayā tathā iti ukta prakāra dvayena anena dhyānena bhavati kiñcid iti uktyā teṣām dhyāna atirikta sādhana sadbhāve pi tasya alpatvāt anuktiḥ iti uktam bhavati ṛṣayaḥ ntar prakāśāḥ ityādau ṛṣīṇām antar darśana niyama ukteḥ kecana iti uktiḥ kimarthā iti atas āha kecid iti

original: ṛṣyantaraviṣayā śrutiriti bhāvaḥ | 'devāḥ' ityanena 'anye sāṅkhyena' ityuktārthaṃ bhavati | krameṇa kālakrameṇa |
analyzed: ṛṣi antara viṣayā śrutiḥ iti bhāvaḥ devāḥ iti anena anye sāṅkhyena iti ukta artham bhavati krameṇa kāla krameṇa

original: devānāṃ dhyānābhāve darśanaṃ bhavati cettarhi darśanavirodhidhyānaṃ kimarthaṃ te kurvantītyata āha || yeṣāmiti || sāṅkhyaṃ pratibhā yogo darśanopāyo yeṣāṃ te sāṅkhyayogāḥ | 'pratibhā spaṣṭatākramāt' ityuktam | tatra sarvottamapratibhā deveṣu kasya mukhyetyata āha || brahmeti || kecidityanena 'karma' iti vyākhyātaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: devānām dhyāna abhāve darśanam bhavati ced tarhi darśana virodhi dhyānam kimartham te kurvanti iti atas āha yeṣām iti sāṅkhyam pratibhā yogaḥ darśana upāyaḥ yeṣām te sāṅkhya yogāḥ pratibhā spaṣṭatā kramāt iti uktam tatra sarva uttama pratibhā deveṣu kasya mukhyā iti atas āha brahma iti kecid iti anena karma iti vyākhyātam bhavati

original: atrāpi śravaṇapratibhayolpatvaṃ draṣṭavyam | anya ityanena 'anye tu' ityuktārthaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: atra api śravaṇa pratibhayā ulpatvam draṣṭavyam anye iti anena anye tu iti ukta artham bhavati

original: ṛṣidevarājñāṃ pratibhoktā | tatra kimeteṣāmekavidyaiva pratibhā'sti, atha tāratamyenetyapekṣāyāmāha || ṛṣīniti || brahmaṇaḥ pratibhāpramāṇamāha || brahmaṇa iti || tarhi tasya hareḥ sakāśāt śravaṇaṃ kimarthamityata āha || viṣṇoriti || prītyarthameva, na tu jñānārtham | keṣāṃ tarhi jñānārthaṃ śravaṇamityata āha anyeṣāmiti || mānuṣettaramiti ||
analyzed: ṛṣi deva rājñām pratibhā uktā tatra kim eteṣām eka vidyā eva pratibhā asti atha tāratamyena iti apekṣāyām āha ṛṣīn iti brahmaṇaḥ pratibhā pramāṇam āha brahmaṇaḥ iti tarhi tasya hareḥ sakāśāt śravaṇam kimartham iti atas āha viṣṇoḥ iti prīti artham eva na tu jñāna artham keṣām tarhi jñāna artham śravaṇam iti atas āha anyeṣām iti mānuṣa ittaram iti

original: mānuṣāṇāṃ prāyaḥ śravaṇādeva jñānamityarthaḥ | nanvevaṃ dhyānādiyogināmapi śravaṇādisadbhāve kathaṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ śrutaveditvaṃ kvaciducyata ityata āha || atyalpeti || evaṃ darśanasādhanaṃ nānāvidhamuktvā prakṛtamanusandhatte || sarva iti ||
analyzed: mānuṣāṇām prāyas śravaṇāt eva jñānam iti arthaḥ nanu evam dhyāna ādi yoginām api śravaṇa ādi sadbhāve katham mānuṣāṇām śruta vedi tvam kvacid ucyate iti atas āha ati alpa iti evam darśana sādhanam nānāvidham uktvā prakṛtam anusandhatte sarve iti

original: yaduktaṃ dhyānādiyogināmapi śravaṇādyastīti tadayuktam | tathāsati keṣāñcit 'śrutvā'nyebhyaḥ' iti viśiṣyoktyasambhavādityata āha || anyeṣāmiti || dhyānādiyogināṃ śravaṇādisadbhāve'pi manuṣyāṇāṃ 'śrutvā'nyebhyaḥ' upāsate iti viśeṣoktiryuktā | teṣāmatyalpapratibhānatvena śravaṇabāhulya.sadbhāvāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: yat uktam dhyāna ādi yoginām api śravaṇa ādi asti iti tat ayuktam tathā asati keṣāñcid śrutvā anyebhyaḥ iti viśiṣya ukti asambhavāt iti atas āha anyeṣām iti dhyāna ādi yoginām śravaṇa ādi sadbhāve pi manuṣyāṇām śrutvā anyebhyaḥ upāsate iti viśeṣa uktiḥ yuktā teṣām ati alpa pratibhāna tvena śravaṇa bāhulya sadbhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: anenātyalpapratibhānatvāditi vivṛtaṃ bhavati | kathaṃ manuṣyāṇāmatyalpā'pi pratibhā yujyate | śrutiparāyaṇā iti śravaṇaikāśrayatvokterityata āha || manuṣyāṇāmiti ||
analyzed: anena ati alpa pratibhāna tvāt iti vivṛtam bhavati katham manuṣyāṇām ati alpā api pratibhā yujyate śruti parāyaṇāḥ iti śravaṇa eka āśraya tva ukteḥ iti atas āha manuṣyāṇām iti

original: manuṣyāṇāmatyalpapratibhāsadbhāve'pi śrutiparāyaṇā iti viśeṣaṇaṃ yuktam | tatpratibhāyā mūlapramāṇāpekṣatvena svātantryābhāvāt prāyeṇāsamyaktvācca | asvatantre'sādhuni cāsattvoktidarśanāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: manuṣyāṇām ati alpa pratibhā sadbhāve pi śruti parāyaṇāḥ iti viśeṣaṇam yuktam tad pratibhāyāḥ mūlapramāṇa apekṣa tvena svātantrya abhāvāt prāyeṇa asamyaktvāt ca asvatantre sādhuni ca asattva ukti darśanāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: yaduktaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ piratibhā mūlapramāṇasāpekṣā prāyo na samyagutpadyate, alpā ceti tadayuktam | pāṇḍavādimanuṣyāṇāmaśrutārthe'pi samyak bahupratibhādarśanādityāśaṃkāṃ pramāṇenaiva pariharati || aśruteti || viśrutā vyāptā bahuletyarthaḥ | tallakṣaṇāntarāṇi cāha || yaśceti ||
analyzed: yat uktam manuṣyāṇām mūlapramāṇa sāpekṣā prāyas na samyak utpadyate alpā ca iti tat ayuktam pāṇḍava ādi manuṣyāṇām aśruta arthe api samyak bahu pratibhā darśanāt iti āśaṃkām pramāṇena eva pariharati aśrutā iti viśrutā vyāptā bahulā iti arthaḥ tad lakṣaṇa antarāṇi ca āha yaḥ ca iti

original: yaḥ puruṣaḥ svamukhaparimāṇenanavaparimāṇādhodehavān, yā ca strī svamukhaparimāṇenāṣṭaparimāṇavatī tau punaḥ svasvāṅguliparimāṇena ṣaṇṇavatyaṅgalau, svasvatālaparimāṇena daśatālau, svasvapādaparimāṇena saptapādau tau ca surottamau vidyādityarthaḥ | atra tālo nāma madhyamāṅgulyagrāt maṇibandhaparyantaḥ kara ucyate |
analyzed: yaḥ puruṣaḥ sva mukha parimāṇena nava parimāṇa adhas dehavān yā ca strī sva mukha parimāṇena aṣṭa parimāṇavatī tau punar sva sva aṅguli parimāṇena ṣaṇṇavati aṅgalau sva sva tāla parimāṇena daśa tālau sva sva pāda parimāṇena sapta pādau tau ca sura uttamau vidyāt iti arthaḥ atra tālaḥ nāma madhyama aṅguli agrāt maṇibandha paryantaḥ karaḥ ucyate

original: devottamalakṣaṇamuktvā devamātralakṣaṇamāha || yāvaditi || tat ṣaṇṇavatyaṅgulaṃ krameṇa hrasadekanavatyaṅgulaparyantamuttamāvarasurāvadhikadevamānaṃ bhavati | atra saptapādaparimāṇaṃ krameṇa hrasadekāṅgulonameva bhavatītyarthaḥ | mandharvādilakṣaṇamāha || tadūnamiti ||
analyzed: deva uttama lakṣaṇam uktvā deva mātra lakṣaṇam āha yāvat iti tat ṣaṇṇavati aṅgulam krameṇa hrasat ekanavati aṅgula paryantam uttama avara surau adhika deva mānam bhavati atra sapta pāda parimāṇam krameṇa hrasat eka aṅgula ūnam eva bhavati iti arthaḥ mandharva ādi lakṣaṇam āha tad ūnam iti

original: tadekanavatyaṅgulaṃ saptāśītyaṅgulaparyantaṃ krameṇa hrasadgandharvādiparimāṇaṃ bhavati | atrāpi saptapādaparimāṇaṃ krameṇa hrasatpunarekāṅgulonaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ ||manuṣyalakṣaṇamāha || tāvaditi || saptāśītyaṅgulaṃ manuṣyaparimāṇamityarthaḥ | asuralakṣaṇamāha || tata iti || saptāśīteradhastāt asuraparimāṇamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tat ekanavati aṅgulam sapta aśīti aṅgula paryantam krameṇa hrasat gandharva ādi parimāṇam bhavati atra api sapta pāda parimāṇam krameṇa hrasat punar eka aṅgula ūnam bhavati iti arthaḥ manuṣya lakṣaṇam āha tāvat iti saptāśīti aṅgulam manuṣya parimāṇam iti arthaḥ asura lakṣaṇam āha tatas iti saptāśīteḥ adhastāt asura parimāṇam iti arthaḥ

original: devopadevānāṃ mānasya sambhūya kiyatīpvaṅgulādupari devottamaparimāṇāt | ṣaṇṇavatyaṅgulādadho yadaṣṭacāṅgulaṃ taddevopadevaparimāṇaṃ jñātavyamityarthaḥ | ṛṣyādilakṣaṇamāha || deveṣviti || cyavanādīnāṃ pṛthvādīnāmavaradevavat parimāṇaṃ jñātavyamityarthaḥ | etallakṣaṇatāratamye hetumāha || yāvaditi || anenaitat svābhāvikamiti coktaṃ bhavati ||
analyzed: deva upadevānām mānasya sambhūya kiyatīpu aṅgulāt upari deva uttama parimāṇāt ṣaṇṇavati aṅgulāt adhas yat aṣṭaca aṅgulam tat deva upadeva parimāṇam jñātavyam iti arthaḥ ṛṣi ādi lakṣaṇam āha deveṣu iti cyavana ādīnām pṛthu ādīnām avaradeva vat parimāṇam jñātavyam iti arthaḥ etad lakṣaṇa tāratamye hetum āha yāvat iti anena etat svābhāvikam iti ca uktam bhavati
