original: yaduktaṃ harireva sarvajīvānāṃ sadasadyonijanmasu svatantrakāraṇamiti tatprapañcyate 'yāvaditi' | tatra kṣetrajñasya hareḥ kṣetrasaṃyogo nāma jaḍadehasaṃyoga ityantathāpratītinirāsāyāha || kṣetreti ||
analyzed: yat uktam hariḥ eva sarva jīvānām sat asat yoni janmasu svatantra kāraṇam iti tat prapañcyate yāvat iti tatra kṣetrajñasya hareḥ kṣetra saṃyogaḥ nāma jaḍa deha saṃyogaḥ iti antathā pratīti nirāsāya āha kṣetra iti

original: 'yāvat sañjāyate' ityetadvivaraṇarūpe 'mama yoniḥ' ityuttarādhyāyagatavākye lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃyogātsarvabhūtasambhavasyoktatvāt atrāpi kṣetrapadena śrīrevocyata iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: yāvat sañjāyate iti etad vivaraṇa rūpe mama yoniḥ iti uttara adhyāya gata vākye lakṣmī nārāyaṇa saṃyogāt sarva bhūta sambhavasya ukta tvāt atra api kṣetra padena śrīḥ eva ucyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: avyaktatatve prasiddhaḥ kṣetraśabdaḥ śrīvācītyetatkuta ityataḥ śriyaḥ śretraśabdavācyatvaṃ, prasaṅgāt mahābhūtānītyādyuktāhaṅ‌kārādiśabdānāṃ ca devatāvācitvaṃ pramāṇena darśayati || avyaktamiti || sarasvatyādīnāmapi śrīśabdavācyatvāt tadvyāvṛttyarthamāha || sadeti || kiṃ jaḍāvyaktābhedāt tacchabdavācyetyata āha || nirdoṣeti ||
analyzed: prasiddhaḥ kṣetra śabdaḥ śrī vāci iti etat kutas iti atas śriyaḥ śretra śabda vācyatvam prasaṅgāt mahābhūtāni ityādi ukta ahaṅkāra ādi śabdānām ca devatā vācitvam pramāṇena darśayati avyaktam iti sarasvatī ādīnām api śrī śabda vācyatvāt tad vyāvṛtti artham āha sadā iti kim jaḍa avyakta abhedāt tad śabda vācyā iti atas āha nirdoṣa iti

original: kathaṃ tarhi avyaktādipadavācyatvamityata āha || sā hīti || na vyajyata ityavyaktam | viṣṇurasyāṃ nivasatīti kṣetram | mahāguṇeti mahadbrahma, jīvottameti pradhānamucyata ityarthaḥ | atra mahato'nuktatvepyādikāryatvāt grāhya eva | kriyāḥ uddiśya | uktaṃ vivṛṇoti || jīveti || śabdādi bodhayatīti buddhirityarthaḥ | tatsuto'niruddho'pi ||
analyzed: katham tarhi avyakta ādi pada vācyatvam iti atas āha sā hi iti na vyajyate iti avyaktam viṣṇuḥ asyām nivasati iti kṣetram mahā guṇā iti mahat brahma jīva uttamā iti pradhānam ucyate iti arthaḥ atra mahataḥ anukta tve pi ādi kārya tvāt grāhye eva kriyāḥ uddiśya uktam vivṛṇoti jīva iti śabda ādi bodhayati iti buddhiḥ iti arthaḥ tad sutaḥ niruddhaḥ api

original: sparśayatīti sparśaḥ | hṛñ haraṇa iti dhātoḥ rasāharaṇahetutvāt jihvetyarthaḥ | āghrātergandhāghrāṇahetutvāt | vacanāt vacanapravartakatvāt | hānilābhayornimittatvāt | sana lābha iti dhātuḥ | kvacidviṣṇoḥ pādadevatvokteḥ viṣṇunetyuktam | yajñaśambhū ca na hariharāvityuktam || śacīti || padanāt gatipravartakatvāt | pada gatāviti dhātuḥ |
analyzed: sparśayati iti sparśaḥ haraṇe iti dhātoḥ rasa āharaṇa hetutvāt jihvā iti arthaḥ āghrāteḥ gandha āghrāṇa hetutvāt vacanāt vacana pravartaka tvāt hāni lābhayoḥ nimitta tvāt lābhaḥ iti dhātuḥ kvacid viṣṇoḥ pāda deva tva ukteḥ viṣṇunā iti uktam yajña śambhū ca na hariharau iti uktam śacī iti padanāt gati pravartaka tvāt pada gatau iti dhātuḥ

original: nirāvṛtyā pratibandhābhāvena | vātīti vāyuḥ | adanādagniḥ | prathanād vistṛtatvāt pṛthivī | janmalayahetutvāt jalamityarthaḥ | pṛthu vistāra iti dhātuḥ | utpattilayayorjalādhīnatvadarśanāt tanniyāmakadevatāyāstatsiddham | śabdanādityādeḥ śabdādipravartakatvāditvātyarthaḥ | mukhyavāyuḥ sukhanāt sukhamityādi draṣṭavyam | sā śrīreva |
analyzed: nirāvṛtyā pratibandha abhāvena vāti iti vāyuḥ adanāt agniḥ prathanāt vistṛta tvāt pṛthivī janma laya hetu tvāt jalam iti arthaḥ pṛthu vistāraḥ iti dhātuḥ utpatti layayoḥ jala adhīna tva darśanāt tad niyāmaka devatāyāḥ tat siddham śabdanāt ityādeḥ śabda ādi pravartaka tva ādi tva atyarthaḥ mukhya vāyuḥ sukhanāt sukham ityādi draṣṭavyam sā śrīḥ eva

original: evaṃ sarasvatīvadvāyoḥ patnīvirdhṛtirmatetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: evam sarasvatī vat vāyoḥ patnī viḥ dhṛtiḥ matā iti arthaḥ

original: śrīrevecchetyuktam | tadupapādayati | iccheti || yadyavyaktacetanecchādiśabdaiḥ lakṣmyādidevatā ucyante tarhi kvacidavyaktamuktvā
analyzed: śrīḥ eva icchā iti uktam tat upapādayati icchā iti yadi avyakta cetanā icchā ādi śabdaiḥ lakṣmī ādi devatāḥ ucyante tarhi kvacid avyaktam uktvā

original: punaścetanādikaṃ kathamucyata ityata āha || sthāneti || avyaktapadoktaśriyaḥ cetanādipadena punaruktiryuktā | aibhimānyamānasthānabhedena rūpabhedādityarthaḥ | evaṃ devatāntare'pi draṣṭavyam | kathaṃ tarhi jaḍapadārtheṣvavyaktādiśabdāḥ pravartanta ityata āha || etairiti ||
analyzed: punar cetanā ādikam katham ucyate iti atas āha sthāna iti avyakta pada ukta śriyaḥ cetanā ādi padena punaruktiḥ yuktā rūpa bhedāt iti arthaḥ evam devatā antare api draṣṭavyam katham tarhi jaḍa padārtheṣu avyakta ādi śabdāḥ pravartante iti atas āha etaiḥ iti

original: avyaktādināmakadevatābhimanyamānatvāt jaḍānāmavyaktādiśabdavācyatvamiti bhāvaḥ | kṣiṇoti nāśayati | kṣitiṃ kṛtvā trāti svanivāsanimittena rakṣati | kṣīṇam adhamam || viśeṣavikṛtisthitā iti || mahadādibhyo'tiśayena vikāritayā'vasthitā ityarthaḥ | ghaṭādāvapyetadeva vikāraśabdapravṛttinimittamityāha || viśeṣāditi ||
analyzed: avyakta ādi nāmaka devatā abhimanyamāna tvāt jaḍānām avyakta ādi śabda vācyatvam iti bhāvaḥ kṣiṇoti nāśayati kṣitim kṛtvā trāti sva nivāsa nimittena rakṣati kṣīṇam adhamam viśeṣa vikṛti sthitāḥ iti mahat ādibhyaḥ atiśayena vikāri tayā avasthitāḥ iti arthaḥ ghaṭa ādau api etat eva vikāra śabda pravṛtti nimittam iti āha viśeṣāt iti

original: vigatamityādeḥ atrāntimakārye nāśaṃ vinā kāryāntarotpādakatvaṃ nāstītyarthaḥ | abhimānināmapīcchādiśabdavācyatvāt kathaṃ vikāratvamityata āha || taditi || sambandho niyamyaniyāmakabhāvaḥ |
analyzed: vigatam ityādeḥ atra antima kārye nāśam vinā kārya antara utpādaka tvam na asti iti arthaḥ abhimāninām api icchā ādi śabda vācyatvāt katham vikāra tvam iti atas āha tat iti sambandhaḥ niyamya niyāmaka bhāvaḥ

original: yaduktaṃ cetanācenataṃ sarvaṃ kṣetramiti, taduktam | cetanasya 'idaṃ śarīraṃ' ityuktaśarīratvānupapatteḥ | hiṃsāheturityādinirvacanasya tatrāsambhavādityata āha || yasyeti || cetanasya kṣetratve'pi na tasyoktaśarīratvāsambhavaḥ | 'yasyātmā śarīram' ityuktatvāt
analyzed: yat uktam sarvam kṣetram iti tat uktam cetanasya idam śarīram iti ukta śarīra tva anupapatteḥ hiṃsā hetuḥ ityādi nirvacanasya tatra asambhavāt iti atas āha yasya iti cetanasya kṣetra tve api na tasya ukta śarīra tva asambhavaḥ yasya ātmā śarīram iti ukta tvāt

original: | uktaniruktyasambhave'pi bhagavattantratvena śarīratvopapatteriti bhāvaḥ | 'yāvatsañjāyate kiñcit sattvaṃ'ityatra sattvaśabdo jīvavācīti 'mama yoniḥ' iti vākyasyodāharaṇenaiva sūcitam | tatra sattvaśabdasya jīvavācitve pramāṇamāha || sattvamiti || tayoranya iti yaducyate sa jīva iti vaktavye sattvamiti śrutyocyate |
analyzed: ukta nirukti asambhave api bhagavat tantratvena śarīra tva upapatteḥ iti bhāvaḥ yāvat sañjāyate kiñcid sattvam iti atra sattva śabdaḥ jīva vāci iti mama yoniḥ iti vākyasya udāharaṇena eva sūcitam tatra sattva śabdasya jīva vāci tve pramāṇam āha sattvam iti tayoḥ anyaḥ iti yat ucyate sa jīvaḥ iti vaktavye sattvam iti śrutyā ucyate

original: sattvaśabdena jīvagrahaṇe tasyānāditvāt saṃjāyata ityuktajananaṃ na yujyata ityata āha || janīprādurbhāva iti || 27 ||
analyzed: sattva śabdena jīva grahaṇe tasya anādi tvāt saṃjāyate iti ukta jananam na yujyate iti atas āha janī prādurbhāve iti 27

original: parameśvarasya sarvaśarīrasthātvamuktam | tarhyadhiṣṭhānatāratamyāttasya tāratamyaṃ duḥkhisahāvasthānāt duḥkhaṃ ca syādityata ucyate -- 'samaṃ' iti | tatra 'vinaśyatsvavinaśyantam' ityayuktam | jīvānāṃ vināśābhāvāt | na ca tasyācetanaviṣayatvam | caśabdādyabhāvādityata āha || jīveṣviti || evaṃ vijānanneva jñānītyuktam |
analyzed: parameśvarasya sarva śarīra sthātvam uktam tarhi adhiṣṭhāna tāratamyāt tasya tāratamyam duḥkhi saha avasthānāt duḥkham ca syāt iti atas ucyate samam iti tatra vinaśyat sva vinaśyantam iti ayuktam jīvānām vināśa abhāvāt na ca tasya acetana viṣaya tvam caśabda ādi abhāvāt iti atas āha jīveṣu iti evam vijānan eva jñānī iti uktam

original: tajjñānaphalamucyate 'samaṃ' iti | ślokadvayaṃ smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || duḥkheti || na hinastītyasyārthaḥ 'sa eva' iti || 28 -29 ||
analyzed: tad jñāna phalam ucyate samam iti śloka dvayam smṛtyā eva vyācaṣṭe duḥkha iti na hinasti iti asya arthaḥ saḥ eva iti 28

original: īśvaraḥ sadasadyonijanmasu karmānapekṣyaiva kāraṇaṃ cettarhi tasya vaiṣamyādi syāt | karmāpekṣāyāṃ svātantryapracyutiḥ | tathā tasyāpi ḍanakasadbhāvācca na svātantryamityata ucyate -- 'prakṛtya' iti | tatra prakṛtireva katrīṃ na paramātmetyanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || prakṛtyeti || svayameva prārabhyeti ||
analyzed: īśvaraḥ sat asat yoni janmasu karmān apekṣya eva kāraṇam ced tarhi tasya vaiṣamya ādi syāt karma apekṣāyām svātantrya pracyutiḥ tathā tasya api ḍanaka sadbhāvāt ca na svātantryam iti atas ucyate prakṛtyaḥ iti tatra prakṛtiḥ eva katrīm na paramātmā iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya āha prakṛtyā iti svayam eva prārabhya iti

original: pūrvakarmādikaṃ svayameva prabodhyetyarthaḥ | abhiprāyaṃ vakti || viṣṇoriti || karmasāpekṣatve'pi na bhagavataḥ svatantryapracyutiḥ | yāvatā'sau svayameva pūrvakarmādikamudbodhya tadapekṣyedānīṃ karmāṇi kārayati | na tu karmādikaṃ viṣṇorudbodhakamiti bhāvaḥ | kuta etadityata āha || pūrvamiti ||
analyzed: pūrva karma ādikam svayam eva prabodhya iti arthaḥ abhiprāyam vakti viṣṇoḥ iti karma sāpekṣa tve api na bhagavataḥ svatantrya pracyutiḥ yāvatā asau svayam eva pūrva karma ādikam udbodhya tat apekṣya idānīm karmāṇi kārayati na tu karma ādikam viṣṇoḥ udbodhakam iti bhāvaḥ kutas etat iti atas āha pūrvam iti

original: astu karmādi harirudbodhayati, na tu ddharimudbodhayatīti | tathāpi harestadapekṣatvādasvātantryamityataḥ karmādisattāyā api bhagavadadhīnatvāt tadapekṣāyāmapi nāsvātantryamiti bhāvena karmādisattāyā bhagavadadhīnatve pramāṇamāha || dravyamiti || kuta evamarthakalpanetyata uktarthe smṛtisamākhyāṃ darśayati || svayamiti ||
analyzed: astu karma ādi hariḥ udbodhayati na tu harim udbodhayati iti tathā api hareḥ tad apekṣa tvāt asvātantryam iti atas karma ādi sattāyāḥ api bhagavat adhīna tvāt tad apekṣāyām api na asvātantryam iti bhāvena karma ādi sattāyāḥ bhagavat adhīna tve pramāṇam āha dravyam iti kutas evam artha kalpanā iti atas ukta arthe smṛti samākhyām darśayati svayam iti

original: nanvatra īśvareṇetyaśravaṇāt kathamayamarthaḥ syādityata āha || teneti || 'samaṃ paśyan hi sarvatra samavasthitamīśvaram' iti īśvarasya prasatutatvāt teneśvareṇetyanukte'pi siddhyatītyarthaḥ | kimanayā kalpanayā? prakṛtereva kartṛtvaṃ neśvarasyetyevārthaḥ kiṃ nasyādityata udāhṛtaḥ smṛtivirodhastāvat vākyāntaravirodhaṃ ca darśayati || ahamiti ||
analyzed: nanu atra īśvareṇa iti aśravaṇāt katham ayam arthaḥ syāt iti atas āha tena iti samam paśyan hi sarvatra samavasthitam īśvaram iti īśvarasya prasatuta tvāt tena īśvareṇa iti anukte api siddhi ati iti arthaḥ kim anayā kalpanayā prakṛteḥ eva kartṛ tvam na īśvarasya iti eva arthaḥ kim nasyāt iti atas udāhṛtaḥ smṛti virodhaḥ tāvat vākya antara virodham ca darśayati aham iti

original: teneśvareṇetyatra sūcitaṃ cetyāha || prakṛtyeti || caśabdena kathametatsiddhyatītyata āha || prakṛteneti || ucyamānakriyāyāḥ prakṛtakartṛtvamīrayedityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tena īśvareṇa iti atra sūcitam ca iti āha prakṛtyā iti caśabdena katham etat siddhi ati iti atas āha prakṛtena iti ucyamāna kriyāyāḥ prakṛta kartṛ tvam īrayet iti arthaḥ

original: īśvarasya kartṛtvābhidhāyakavacanavirodhānnārthāntarakalpanā yuktetyuktam | prakṛteḥ kartṛtvasya śrutyādiviruddhatvācca nāsau yuktetyāha || prakṛteriti || tvadṛte dūre'pi kiñcana kenāpi na kriyata ityarthaḥ | itaśca nārthāntarakalpanā yuktetyāha || kevaleti ||
analyzed: īśvarasya kartṛ tva abhidhāyaka vacana virodhāt na artha antara kalpanā yuktā iti uktam prakṛteḥ kartṛ tvasya śruti ādi viruddha tvāt ca na asau yuktā iti āha prakṛteḥ iti tvat ṛte dūre pi kiñcana kena api na kriyate iti arthaḥ itas ca na artha antara kalpanā yuktā iti āha kevala iti

original: īśvarasamuccacārthaścaśabda ityataḥ kevaletyuktam ātmānamakartāramityatra pareṇeśvarasyākartṛtvāṅgīkārāt na tatsamuccayārthaścaśabda iti bhāvaḥ | itaśca neśvarasyākartṛtvametadarthaṃ ityāha || tata eveti || ito'pi nārthāntarakalpanā yuktetyāha || ahamiti ||
analyzed: īśvara samuccaya arthaḥ caśabdaḥ iti atas kevala iti uktam ātmānam akartāram iti atra pareṇa īśvarasya akartṛ tva aṅgīkārāt na tad samuccaya arthaḥ caśabdaḥ iti bhāvaḥ itas ca na īśvarasya akartṛ tvam etad artham iti āha tatas eva iti itas api na artha antara kalpanā yuktā iti āha aham iti

original: atra yāvatsañjāyata itīśvarasya sarvakartṛtvaṃ prakṛtamiti tenāpīśvarākartṛtvavyākhyānaṃ viruddham | na ca vācyaṃ pūrvavākye'pi prakṛtereva kartṛtvaṃ kṣetrajñasya tatsaṃyogāt kartṛtvopacāra iti | mama yonirmahadbrahmetyādinā uttarādhyāye'nyathaitadvākyārthasya vakṣyamāṇatvādityarthaḥ | ito'pi na prakṛtereva kartṛtvamiti asyārtha ityāha ||
analyzed: atra yāvat sañjāyate iti īśvarasya sarva kartṛ tvam prakṛtam iti tena api īśvara akartṛ tva vyākhyānam viruddham na ca vācyam pūrva vākye api prakṛteḥ eva kartṛ tvam kṣetrajñasya tad saṃyogāt kartṛ tva upacāraḥ iti mama yoniḥ mahat brahma ityādinā uttara adhyāye nyathā etad vākya arthasya vakṣyamāṇa tvāt iti arthaḥ itas upi na prakṛteḥ eva kartṛ tvam iti asya arthaḥ iti āha

original: acetanamiti || kathaṃ svoktivirodha ityata āha || iccheti || icchāpūrvakriyāsvīkāro hi kartṛtvam | tathā śruteḥ | acetanaṃ nāmecchārahitam | ato'cotanaṃ ca karoti ceti vyāhatiriti bhāvaḥ | nanu prakṛteḥ svatantrakartṛtvābhāve'pi pariṇāmarūpaṃ kartṛtvamaṅgīkriyata eva siddhāntinā'pi | atantadartho'yaṃ ślokaḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha || vikāreti ||
analyzed: acetanam iti katham sva ukti virodhaḥ iti atas āha icchā iti icchā pūrva kriyā svīkāraḥ hi kartṛ tvam tathā śruteḥ acetanam nāma icchā rahitam ca karoti ca iti vyāhatiḥ iti bhāvaḥ nanu prakṛteḥ svatantra kartṛ tva abhāve pi pariṇāma rūpam kartṛ tvam aṅgīkriyate eva siddhāntinā api ślokaḥ kim na syāt iti atas āha vikāra iti

original: yadyapi prakṛteḥ pariṇāmarūpaṃ kartṛtvamaṅgīkṛtaṃ, tathāpi na tadartho'yaṃ ślokaḥ | atra sarvakarmaṇāṃ prakṛtyaiva kriyamāṇatvokteḥ | etadarthatve ca parameśvarādikarmasu prakṛtivikāratvābhāvāt sarvaśa iti padasyārthasaṅ‌kottaprāpterityarthaḥ |parameśvarādikarmaṇaḥ prakṛtivikāratvābhāvaḥ kuta ityata āha || acetaneti || 30 ||
analyzed: yadi api prakṛteḥ pariṇāma rūpam kartṛ tvam aṅgīkṛtam tathā api na tad arthaḥ yam ślokaḥ atra sarva karmaṇām prakṛtyā eva kriyamāṇa tva ukteḥ etad artha tve ca parameśvara ādi karmasu prakṛti vikāra tva abhāvāt sarvaśas iti padasya prakṛti vikāra tva abhāvaḥ kutas iti atas āha acetana iti

original: na kevalaṃ bhagavataḥ sarvaprerakatvādijñānamātreṇālam | kintu tasya sarvādhāratvādyapi jñātavyamityucyate -- " yadā " iti | tat tirohitārthatvāt pramāṇavākyenaiva vyācaṣṭe || eketi || bhūtapṛthagbhāvasya paramātmasthatvoktyā pṛthagbhūtānāṃ tatsthatvamabhipretam |
analyzed: na kevalam bhagavataḥ sarva preraka tva ādi jñāna mātreṇa alam kintu tasya sarva ādhāra tva ādi api jñātavyam iti ucyate yadā iti tat tirohita artha tvāt pramāṇa vākyena eva vyācaṣṭe eka iti bhūta pṛthagbhāvasya paramātma stha tva uktyā pṛthak bhūtānām tad stha tvam abhipretam

original: tadevātroktam || 31 ||
analyzed: tat eva atra uktam 31

original: sarvacetanācetanātmakatvāt paramātmanaḥ kathaṃ bhūtānāṃ tataḥ paṛthagbhāva ityata ucyate -- " anāditvāt " iti | tatra paramātmano'kartṛtvapratītiṃ ca nirākartuṃ śarīrasthapadaṃ vyākhyāti || śarīrastha iti || śarīrasthaśabdasya kuto jīvavācitvamityataḥ tatparayogaṃ darśayati || svapneneti ||
analyzed: sarva cetana acetana ātmaka tvāt paramātmanaḥ katham bhūtānām tatas paṛthagbhāvaḥ iti atas ucyate anādi tvāt iti tatra paramātmano kartṛ tva pratītim ca nirākartum śarīrastha padam vyākhyāti śarīrasthaḥ iti śarīrastha śabdasya kutas jīva vāci tvam iti atas tad para yogam darśayati svapnena iti

original: nanu jīvavadīśvarasyāpi śarīrasthiteḥ jīvasyaiva tatpadavācyatvaṃ kutaityata āha || śarīrastha iti || viṣṇorapi mayedaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ, madadhīnamityabhimāno'styeva | ataḥ kathaṃ tadanabhimāna ityata
analyzed: nanu jīva vat īśvarasya api śarīra sthiteḥ jīvasya eva tatpada vācyatvam kutas eti atas āha śarīra sthaḥ iti viṣṇoḥ api mayā idam sṛṣṭam mad adhīnam iti abhimānaḥ usti eva atas katham tad anabhimānaḥ iti atas

original: āha || tadgatānāmiti || śarīrasthapadaṃ jīvavācakaṃ cet kathaṃ yojanetyata āha || anāditvāditi || iti vācyamiti śeṣaḥ | jīvasyāpyanāditvāt kiṃ viśiṣyeśvarasyaiva taducyate, yenāsya jīvābhedanivāraṇe hetutvaṃ syādityata āha || śarīreti || evambhūtādimattvābhāve'pi kathaṃ paramātmano jīvādviśeṣa ityata āha || jīvasyeti || itiśabdo hetau |
analyzed: āha tad gatānām iti śarīra stha padam jīva vācakam ced katham yojanā iti atas āha anādi tvāt iti iti vācyam iti śeṣaḥ jīvasya api anādi tvāt kim viśiṣya īśvarasya eva tat ucyate yena asya jīva abheda nivāraṇe hetu tvam syāt iti atas āha śarīra iti evam bhūta ādimattva abhāve pi katham paramātmanaḥ jīvāt viśeṣaḥ iti atas āha jīvasya iti itiśabdaḥ hetau

original: nanu nirguṇatvaṃ kathamīśvarasya jīvabhede heturbhavati jagatkartṛtvādiguṇānām īśvare bhāvena hetorasiddherityata āha || sattveti || nātra guṇapadena jagatkartṛtvādayo vivakṣitāḥ | kintu sattvādaya eva | tatsambandhaśceśvare nāsti, jīve'stīti bhavati heturiti bhāvaḥ | karoti na lipyata iti jīveśvarabhede hetvantaram | tadvyācaṣṭe || sarvamiti ||
analyzed: nanu nirguṇa tvam katham īśvarasya jīva bhede hetuḥ bhavati jagatkartṛ tva ādi guṇānām īśvare bhāvena hetoḥ asiddheḥ iti atas āha sattva iti na atra guṇa padena jagatkartṛ tva ādayaḥ vivakṣitāḥ kintu sattva ādayaḥ eva tad sambandhaḥ ca īśvare na asti bhavati hetuḥ iti bhāvaḥ karoti na lipyate iti jīva īśvara bhede hetu antaram tat vyācaṣṭe sarvam iti

original: jīvo na karoti lipyata eveti draṣṭavyam | lepaśca tatphalena | nanvatra jīvādyabhedasyāprāptatvātkathaṃ niṣedho yukta ityata āha || vādīti || yathā śūnyavādisiddhatvāt śūnyakāraṇatvasya " taddhaika āhuḥ " ityādinā niṣedhaḥ kriyate tathā sarvādvaitavādiprāptatvāt advaitaniṣedho yujyate |
analyzed: jīvaḥ na karoti lipyate eva iti draṣṭavyam lepaḥ ca tad phalena nanu atra jīva ādi abhedasya aprāpta tvāt katham niṣedhaḥ yuktaḥ iti atas āha vādi iti yathā śūnyavādi siddha tvāt śūnya kāraṇatvasya tat ha eke āhuḥ ityādinā niṣedhaḥ kriyate tathā sarva advaita vādi prāpta tvāt advaita niṣedhaḥ yujyate

original: yathā ca jñānadvārā mokṣārthaṃ karmabhirīśvara evārādhya iti karmaśrutyabhiprāyāparijñānaprāptasya kevalakarmaṇaivasvargādipuruṣārthalābho bhavatītyasya " iṣṭāpūrtaṃ " ityādinā niṣedhaḥ kriyate tathā bhagavatā sarvaṃ vyāptamiti " sarvaṃ khalidaṃ brahma " ityādiśrutyābhiprāyāparijñānaprāptasyādvaitasya niṣedho yukta iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: yathā ca jñāna dvārā mokṣa artham karmabhiḥ īśvaraḥ eva ārādhyaḥ iti karma śruti abhiprāya aparijñāna prāptasya kevala karmaṇā eva svarga ādi puruṣa artha lābhaḥ bhavati iti asya iṣṭāpūrtam ityādinā niṣedhaḥ kriyate tathā bhagavatā sarvam vyāptam iti sarvam khalu idam brahma ityādi śrutyā abhiprāya aparijñāna prāptasya advaitasya niṣedhaḥ yuktaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: prātītika evarthaḥ kiṃ na syādityata uktārthe vākyāntarasammatimāha || kurvāṇa iti || mṛtyādirahita ityanenāvyayapadaṃ vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | īśvarasya cetanācetanabhinnatve śrutisammatiṃ cāha || sa eṣa iti || 32 -34 ||
analyzed: prātītikaḥ eva arthaḥ kim na syāt iti atas ukta arthe vākya antara sammatim āha kurvāṇaḥ iti mṛtyā ādi rahitaḥ iti anena avyaya padam vyākhyātam bhavati īśvarasya cetana acetana bhinna tve śruti sammatim ca āha saḥ eṣaḥ iti

original: adhyāyārtha upasaṃhriyate || kṣetreti || tatra bhūtaprakṛtimokṣapadaṃ tirohitārthatvāt vyācaṣṭe || jīvānāmiti || mokṣaṃ mokṣasādhanamamānitvamityādyuktam || 35 ||
analyzed: adhyāya arthaḥ upasaṃhriyate kṣetra iti tatra bhūta prakṛti mokṣa padam tirohita artha tvāt vyācaṣṭe jīvānām iti mokṣam mokṣa sādhanam amāni tvam ityādi uktam

original: iti śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpādācāryaviracatasya śrīmadbhagavadgītātātparyanirṇayasya ṭīkāyāṃ jayatīrthamuniviracitāyāṃ nyāyadīpikāyāṃ trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 ||
analyzed: iti śrīmat ānandatīrtha bhagavat pāda ācārya viracatasya śrīmat bhagavadgītā tātparya nirṇayasya ṭīkāyām jayatīrtha muni viracitāyām nyāyadīpikāyām trayodaśaḥ adhyāyaḥ

original: || atha caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
analyzed: atha caturdaśaḥ udhyāyaḥ

original: hariḥ oṃ|| etadadhyāyapratipādyamarthaṃ darśayati || kṣetreti || prādhānyenottarādhyāyaiḥ sādhanamevocyate | tatra bandhaprakāraparijñāna eva tanmokṣasādhanānuṣṭhānaṃ yujyate | bandhaśca triguṇātmakaḥ | ato " yāvatsañjāyate " ityuktavivaraṇapūrvakaṃ triguṇavikārasthitiṃ tadatyayopāyaṃ ca darśayatyanenādhyāyeneti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: hariḥ om etad adhyāya pratipādyam artham darśayati kṣetra iti prādhānyena uttara adhyāyaiḥ sādhanam eva ucyate tatra bandha prakāra parijñāne eva tad mokṣa sādhana anuṣṭhānam yujyate bandhaḥ ca triguṇa ātmakaḥ atas yāvat sañjāyate iti ukta vivaraṇa pūrvakam triguṇa vikāra sthitim tad atyaya upāyam ca darśayati anena adhyāyena iti bhāvaḥ

original: " kāryate hyavaśaḥ karma " ityādau traiguṇyasya saṅkṣepeṇoktatvāt vivicyetyuktam |
analyzed: kāryate hi avaśaḥ karma ityādau traiguṇyasya saṅkṣepeṇa ukta tvāt vivicya iti uktam

original: " paraṃ bhūyaḥ pravakṣyāmi " iti pratijñātamucyate " mama yoniḥ " iti | tatra yoniśabdasya kāraṇārthatvapratītinirāsāya bhāryādyarthatve pramāmamāha || yoniriti || sthānaṃ guhyasthānam | astvevaṃ yoniśabdo bhāryādyanekārthaḥ | prakṛtaḥ kimartha ityata āha || atreti || yoniśabdasyānekārthatvāt kathamayamevārtha ityata āha || tasminniti || 3 ||
analyzed: param bhūyas pravakṣyāmi iti pratijñātam ucyate mama yoniḥ iti tatra yoni śabdasya kāraṇa artha tva pratīti nirāsāya bhāryā ādi artha tve pramām āha yoniḥ iti sthānam guhya sthānam astu evam yoni śabdaḥ bhāryā ādi aneka arthaḥ prakṛtaḥ kimarthaḥ iti atas āha atra iti yoni śabdasya aneka artha tvāt katham ayam eva arthaḥ iti atas āha tasmin iti

original: traiguṇye vivicyokte sati tarhi guṇā eva sarvottamāḥ, na tu tato'nyaḥ sarvottama iti śaṃkā syāt | sā nirākriyate -- nānyamiti | atra guṇānānameva kartṛtvaṃ, neśvarasyaityanyathāpratītinirasāyāha || etabhya iti || ajñasyāpi puruṣatvāt ko viśeṣo jñānina ityata āha || antheti || evaṃ yojanāyāṃ " madbhāvaṃ so'dhigacchati " iti vyarthaṃ syāt |
analyzed: traiguṇye vivicya ukte sati tarhi guṇāḥ eva sarva uttamāḥ na tu tatonyaḥ sarva uttamaḥ iti śaṃkā syāt sā nirākriyate na anyam iti atra guṇa ānānam eva kartṛ tvam na īśvarasya eti anyathā pratīti nirasāya āha etabhyaḥ iti ajñasya api puruṣa tvāt kaḥ viśeṣaḥ jñāninaḥ iti atas āha antha iti evam yojanāyām mad bhāvam saḥ adhigacchati iti vyartham syāt

original: vākyasya tadvinaiva samāptatvādityataḥ tatsārthakyaṃ darśayati || kathamiti || bhagavati bhāvaprāptiyogyasyaiva puruṣatvaṃ " puruṣatve vā vistarādātmā " ityādiśrutisiddham | pratīta evārthaḥ kiṃ na syādityato " mama yoniḥ " ityādi smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || mahālakṣmīriti || parā ṣaḍbhyo'dhikā |
analyzed: vākyasya tat vinā eva samāpta tvāt iti atas tad sārthakyam darśayati katham iti bhagavati bhāva prāpti yogyasya eva puruṣa tvam puruṣa tve vā vistarāt ātmā ityādi śruti siddham pratītaḥ eva arthaḥ kim na syāt iti atas mama yoniḥ ityādi smṛtyā eva vyācaṣṭe mahā lakṣmīḥ iti parā ṣaḍbhyaḥ adhikā

original: dguṇatvāt sat, tviṣa dīptāviti dhātoḥ prabhārūpatvāt tvamiti sattvamityarthaḥ | sṛṣṭyā hi rañjanaṃ bhavati | kimiyaṃ prasiddhā pṛthivīdevatā'sāvityata āha || yaditi || tamu glapana iti dhatuḥ | glapanaṃ saṃsāreṇa glānidānam | amuktigā ityanena " dehe dehinaṃ " ityasyārtha ukto bhavati | keṣāṃ ko bandhiketyata āha || sarvāniti ||
analyzed: dguṇa tvāt sat tviṣa dīptau iti dhātoḥ prabhā rūpa tvāt tvam iti sattvam iti arthaḥ sṛṣṭyā hi rañjanam bhavati kim iyam prasiddhā pṛthivī devatā asau iti atas āha yat iti glapanaḥ iti dhatuḥ glapanam saṃsāreṇa glāni dānam amukti gāḥ iti anena dehe dehinam iti asya arthaḥ uktaḥ bhavati keṣām kaḥ bandhikā iti atas āha sarvān iti

original: anena tatra sattvamityādinā tāratamyenoktabandhatraividhyasya viṣayaḥ pradarśito bhavati | evametāsāṃ sarvabandhakatvenātisāmarthyāt sarvottamatvamiti na mantavyamityāha || etābhya iti || viṣṇuṃ sarvottamatvena jānanneva yato vimucyate'taḥ sa eva puruṣaḥ | ato naitābhyo vidyate paraḥ iti jānan nṛpaśurityarthaḥ || 16 -19 ||
analyzed: anena tatra sattvam ityādinā tāratamyena ukta bandha traividhyasya viṣayaḥ pradarśitaḥ bhavati evam etāsām sarva bandhaka tvena ati sāmarthyāt sarva uttama tvam iti na mantavyam iti āha etābhyaḥ iti viṣṇum sarva uttama tvena jānan eva yatas vimucyate itas saḥ eva puruṣaḥ atas na etābhyaḥ vidyate paraḥ iti jānan nṛ paśuḥ iti arthaḥ

original: " rajasastu phalaṃ duḥkham " ityatra duḥkhaśabdaḥ kevaladuḥkhārtha ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || rajasa iti || duḥkhaśabdaḥ kathaṃ duḥkhamiśrasukhavācītyata āha || duḥkhamiti || atra kevaladuḥkhavācī kiṃ na syādityato rajaso miśraphalatve smṛtimāha || karmaṇa
analyzed: rajasaḥ tu phalam duḥkham iti atra duḥkha śabdaḥ kevala duḥkha arthaḥ iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya āha rajasaḥ iti duḥkha śabdaḥ katham duḥkha miśra sukha vācī iti atas āha duḥkham iti atra kevala duḥkha vācī kim na syāt iti atas rajasaḥ miśra phala tve smṛtim āha karmaṇaḥ

original: iti || ajñānajamityanena ajñānamiti vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | tena kevaladuḥkhasya tamaḥphalatvoktiścārthāntare bādhiketi sūcitaṃ bhavati || 20 -21 ||
analyzed: iti ajñāna jam iti anena ajñānam iti vyākhyātam bhavati tena kevala duḥkhasya tamaḥ phala tva uktiḥ ca artha antare bādhikā iti sūcitam bhavati 20

original: guṇātyayopāyādipraśnasya parihāra ucyate " prakāśaṃ " iti | tatra svasmin prakāśaṃ necchati, svagatamohaṃ na dveṣṭi, duḥkhādisāmyaṃ ca spṛhādyabhāvamātraṃ, sarvārambhaparityāgaśca sarvatrodāsīnatvamityanyathāpratītinirāsāya pramāṇāntareṇa tadvyācaṣṭe || loketi || puruṣāntare sthitaṃ prakāśādi sādhu na dveṣṭi | tatra mohādyasādhu necchatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: guṇa atyaya upāya ādi praśnasya parihāraḥ ucyate prakāśam iti tatra svasmin prakāśam na icchati svagata moham na dveṣṭi duḥkha ādi sāmyam ca spṛhā ādi abhāva mātram sarva ārambha parityāgaḥ ca sarvatra udāsīna tvam iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya pramāṇa antareṇa tat vyācaṣṭe loka iti puruṣa antare sthitam prakāśa ādi sādhu na dveṣṭi tatra moha ādi asādhu na icchati iti arthaḥ

original: svasya prāptaprakāśatvāt mohojjñitatvāt svasminneva tadicchādyabhāvaḥ kiṃ na syādityata āha || svayamiti || mohaṃ dveṣṭi ceti draṣṭavyam | taṃ cāpītyanena māṃ cetyuktārthaṃ bhavati | sukhaduḥkhādītyasya viṣṇubhaktiparityāge sukhasya, anyathā duḥkhasya bhāve'pītyarthaḥ | arthārthamityādinā samaloṣṭhetyādyuktarthaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: svasya prāpta prakāśa tvāt moha ujjñita tvāt svasmin eva tad icchā ādi abhāvaḥ kim na syāt iti atas āha svayam iti moham dveṣṭi ca iti draṣṭavyam tam ca api iti anena mām ca iti ukta artham bhavati sukha duḥkha ādi iti asya viṣṇu bhakti parityāge sukhasya anyathā duḥkhasya bhāve api iti arthaḥ artha artham ityādinā sama loṣṭha ityādi ukta artham bhavati

original: avaiṣṇavetyanena sarvārambhetyuktārthaṃ bhavati | viṣṇu yātītyanena saguṇānityādeḥ tātparyamuktaṃ bhavati || 22 ||
analyzed: avaiṣṇava iti anena sarva ārambha iti ukta artham bhavati viṣṇu yāti iti anena sa guṇa a nitya ādeḥ tātparyam uktam bhavati

original: itaśca sarvārambhaparityāgīti na kevalodāsīnatvamucyate | udāsīnavaditi pūrvavākye kevalodāsīnatvābhāvasyokteḥ | neṅgata iti pūrvavākye karmābhāvasyoktatvāt kathaṃ kevalodāsīnatvābhāva ityata āha || neṅgata iti || neṅgata iti na sarvapravṛttiniṣedhaḥ, kintu bhagavadudāsīnapravṛttiniṣedha evetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: itas ca sarva ārambha parityāgi iti na kevala udāsīna tvam ucyate udāsīna vat iti pūrva vākye kevala udāsīna tva abhāvasya ukteḥ na iṅgataḥ iti pūrva vākye karma abhāvasya ukta tvāt katham kevala udāsīna tva abhāvaḥ iti atas āha na iṅgataḥ iti na iṅgataḥ iti na sarva pravṛtti niṣedhaḥ kintu bhagavat udāsīna pravṛtti niṣedhaḥ eva iti arthaḥ

original: tarhi neṅgata ityanenaiva avaiṣṇavakarmākaraṇasyoktatvāt sarvārambhaparityāgīti punaruktirityata āha || iti vaktīti śeṣaḥ | neṅgata iti sāmānyoktiriti draṣṭavyam | neṅgata ityalpāvaiṣṇavapravṛttyabhāva ucyate |
analyzed: tarhi na iṅgataḥ iti anena eva avaiṣṇava karma akaraṇasya ukta tvāt sarva ārambha parityāgi iti punaruktiḥ iti atas āha iti vakti iti śeṣaḥ na iṅgataḥ iti sāmānya uktiḥ iti draṣṭavyam na iṅgataḥ iti alpa avaiṣṇava pravṛtti abhāvaḥ ucyate

original: sarvārambhaparityāgīti dīrghāvaiṣṇavapravṛttyabhāva ucyata ityataśca na punaruktiriti bhāvena iṅganārambhaśabdayoḥ alpamahatkarmārthatve pramāṇamāha || iṅganamiti || 23 -25 ||
analyzed: sarva ārambha parityāgi iti dīrgha avaiṣṇava pravṛtti abhāvaḥ ucyate iti atas ca na punaruktiḥ iti bhāvena iṅgana ārambha śabdayoḥ alpa mahat karma artha tve pramāṇam āha iṅganam iti 23

original: nanu guṇaśabdena śryādīnāṃ vivakṣitatvāt " saguṇān samatītyaitān " iti tadatyayaḥ kathamucyate | aśakyatvādityata āha || lakṣmyādibhiriti || lakṣmīti śrīrucyate | smṛtyuktārthānuvādeva arthāntaraṃ cāha || taditi || ubhayatra prayogaṃ darśayati || yatheti ||
analyzed: nanu guṇa śabdena śrī ādīnām vivakṣita tvāt saguṇān samatītya etān iti tad atyayaḥ katham ucyate aśakya tvāt iti atas āha lakṣmī ādibhiḥ iti lakṣmī iti śrīḥ ucyate smṛti ukta artha anuvādā iva artha antaram ca āha tat iti ubhayatra prayogam darśayati yathā iti

original: yathā dvārapālakṛtabandhātyayena gacchan dvārapālamatītya rājānaṃ gacchatītyucyate, yathā ca yo rājānaṃ gacchati sa dvārapālamatītya gacchatītyucyate tathaivetyarthaḥ | brahmabhūyāya ityasya brahmabhāvāyetyanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || brahmeti || 'mama yonirmahadbrahma' iti mahālakṣmyā eva brahmaśabdena prakṛtatvāt atrāpi saivocyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: yathā dvārapāla kṛta bandha atyayena gacchan dvārapālam atītya rājānam gacchati iti ucyate yathā ca yaḥ rājānam gacchati sa dvārapālam atītya gacchati iti ucyate tathā eva iti arthaḥ brahma bhūyāya iti asya brahma bhāvāya iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya āha brahma iti mama yoniḥ mahat brahma iti mahā lakṣmyāḥ eva brahma śabdena prakṛta tvāt atra api sā eva ucyate iti arthaḥ

original: pramāṇāntarasamākhyānenāpyetat sādhayati || atītyeti || guṇātītasya bhagavatprāptyādyeva vaktavyaṃ, lakṣmīprāptyā bhagavatprāptiḥ | yena taduktiḥ saṅgatā syādityato'bhiprāyamāha || maditi || tatsthatva iti śeṣaḥ | lakṣmīnārāyaṇayoraviyogaścet guṇatīto māmāpnotītyeva vaktavyam | kiṃ paramparoktyetyata āha || tathāpīti ||
analyzed: pramāṇa antara samākhyānena api etat sādhayati atītya iti guṇa atītasya bhagavat prāpti ādi eva vaktavyam lakṣmī prāptyā bhagavat prāptiḥ yena tad uktiḥ saṅgatā syāt iti atas abhiprāyam āha mad iti tad stha tve iti śeṣaḥ lakṣmī nārāyaṇayoḥ aviyogaḥ ced guṇa tītaḥ mām āpnoti iti eva vaktavyam kim paramparā uktyā iti atas āha tathā api iti

original: yadyapi tayoraviyogastathāpi lakṣmīsamīpaṃ prāpya tadanujñayā bhagavatprāptirbhavatīti paramparoktiryuktetyarthaḥ | 'sukhasyaivakāntikasya' iti tirohitārthatvādvyāyaṣṭe || ekāntikasyeti || ekamevāsmādadhikamiti gaṇane'nte sthitamekāntikam | tattu mokṣa eveti bhāvaḥ ||
analyzed: yadi api tayoḥ aviyogaḥ tathā api lakṣmī samīpam prāpya tad anujñayā bhagavat prāptiḥ bhavati iti paramparā uktiḥ yuktā iti arthaḥ sukhasya eva akāntikasya iti tirohita artha tvāt vyāyaṣṭe ekāntikasya iti ekam eva asmāt adhikam iti gaṇanena ante sthitam ekāntikam tat tu mokṣe eva iti bhāvaḥ

original: iti śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpādācāryaviracitasya śrīmadbhagavadgītātātparyanirṇayasya ṭīkāyāṃ jayatīrthamuniviracitāyāṃ nyāyadīpikāyāṃ caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 ||
analyzed: iti śrīmat ānandatīrtha bhagavat pāda ācārya viracitasya śrīmat bhagavadgītā tātparya nirṇayasya ṭīkāyām jayatīrtha muni viracitāyām nyāyadīpikāyām caturdaśaḥ adhyāyaḥ

original: etadadhyāyapratipādyaṃ darśayati || trayodaśeti || yat trayodaśādhyāye jagatsvarūpaṃ varṇitaṃ tadasmin adhyāye vivicya darśayati | tasyaiva saṃsārarūpatvāt | saṃsāraṃ jihāsatā tatsvarūpasya jñātavyatvāt | yaśca tatra saṃsārātyayopāyo nirūpitastaṃ cātra darśayatītyarthaḥ | tatrāpratipattyanyathāpratipattinirāsāya śrutyaivādhyāyo vyākhyāyate ||
analyzed: etad adhyāya pratipādyam darśayati trayodaśa iti yat trayodaśa adhyāye jagat svarūpam varṇitam tat asmin adhyāye vivicya darśayati tasya eva saṃsāra rūpa tvāt saṃsāram jihāsatā tad svarūpasya jñātavya tvāt yaḥ ca tatra saṃsāra atyaya upāyaḥ nirūpitaḥ tam ca atra darśayati iti arthaḥ tatra apratipatti anyathā pratipatti nirāsāya śrutyā eva adhyāyaḥ vyākhyāyate

original: pṛthagiti || tatrordhvamulamityasyārthaḥ pṛthagiti | jagadvṛkṣasya harirmūlaṃ cettarhi tasya jagadekadeśatvaṃ syādityataḥ pṛthagityuktam | yathā prasiddhasya vṛkṣasya bhūmiratadekadeśatvena mūlaṃ tathaivetyarthaḥ | prakārāntareṇordhvamūlatvaṃ darśayati || sattvādīti || mūlabhāgavaditi || prasiddhavṛkṣasyaikadeśabhūtamūlavanmūlamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: pṛthak iti tatra ūrdhva mulam iti asya arthaḥ pṛthak iti jagat vṛkṣasya hariḥ mūlam ced tarhi tasya jagat eka deśa tvam syāt iti atas pṛthak iti uktam yathā prasiddhasya vṛkṣasya bhūmiḥ a tad eka deśa tvena mūlam tathā eva iti arthaḥ prakāra antareṇa ūrdhva mūla tvam darśayati sattva ādi iti mūlabhāga vat iti prasiddha vṛkṣasya eka deśa bhūta mūla vat mūlam iti arthaḥ

original: sattvādiyukte ityanena trimūlo jagadvṛkṣa ityuktaṃ bhavati | guṇapravṛddhā ityasya tātparyaṃ coktaṃ bhavati | mūlairhi śākhā pravardhante | nanu jagato'cetanatvāt acetanaprakṛtereva etanmūlatvaṃ, tarhi tasya jagadrūpeṇa pariṇāmaḥ syāt | bhūmyaṃśānāṃ loke pariṇāmitvadarśanādityata āha || pṛthivīti ||
analyzed: sattva ādi yukte iti anena tri mūlaḥ jagat vṛkṣaḥ iti uktam bhavati guṇa pravṛddhāḥ iti asya tātparyam ca uktam bhavati mūlaiḥ hi śākhā pravardhante nanu jagatā ucetana tvāt acetana prakṛteḥ eva etat mūla tvam tarhi tasya jagat rūpeṇa pariṇāmaḥ syāt bhūmi aṃśānām loke pariṇāmi tva darśanāt iti atas āha pṛthivī iti

original: tattatra jagadvṛkṣe hariḥ prasiddhavṛkṣasya pṛthivīdevatāvannimittatvenaiva mūlaṃ na tu mṛdvadupādānatayetyarthaḥ | tarhi tadvatpariṇāmitayā mūlaṃ kimityata āha || mṛdvaditi || acetanā acetanaprakṛtiḥ | evaṃ cejjagadvṛkṣo viṣṇvādimūlaḥ syāt, ūrdhvamūlaḥ kathamityata āha || uttamatvāditi ||
analyzed: tat tatra jagat vṛkṣe hariḥ prasiddha vṛkṣasya pṛthivī devatā vat nimittatvena eva mūlam na tu mṛd vat upādānatayā iti arthaḥ tarhi tadvat pariṇāmitayā mūlam kim iti atas āha mṛd vat iti acetanā acetana prakṛtiḥ evam ced jagat vṛkṣaḥ viṣṇu ādi mūlaḥ syāt ūrdhva mūlaḥ katham iti atas āha uttama tvāt iti

original: viṣṇoḥ sarvottamatvāt, śriyaḥ paratantreṣūttamatvāt, acitprakṛteracetaneṣūttamatvāt ūrdhvāni uttamāni viṣṇavādimūlāni yasyāsāvūrdhvamūla ityarthaḥ | adhaḥśākhamityasyārtho nīcā iti | adho bhagavadapekṣayā nīcā mahadādayaḥ śākhā yasyāsāvadhaḥ śākha ityarthaḥ | jagadvṛkṣasyeti sambadhyate | chandasāṃ parṇatvamupapādayati | kāmeti ||
analyzed: viṣṇoḥ sarva uttama tvāt śriyaḥ paratantreṣu uttama tvāt acit prakṛteḥ acetaneṣu uttama tvāt ūrdhvāni uttamāni viṣṇava ādi mūlāni yasya asau ūrdhva mūlaḥ iti arthaḥ adhaḥśākham iti asya arthaḥ nīcāḥ iti adhas bhagavat apekṣayā nīcāḥ mahat ādayaḥ śākhāḥ yasya asau adhas śākhaḥ iti arthaḥ jagat vṛkṣasya iti sambadhyate chandasām parṇa tvam upapādayati kāma iti

original: loke parṇotpattyanantarameva phaladarśanādatrāpi phalahetutvācchandanāṃ parṇatvamiti bhāvaḥ | anena dharmārthayoḥ kāmamokṣārthatvāt kāmamokṣākhyadviphalo jagadvṛkṣa ityuktaṃ bhavati | adhaścordhvaṃ cetyasyārthaḥ anyonyeti || anenādhobhūtāḥ śākhā ūrdhvamūleṣu prasṛtāḥ, mūlāni cādhaḥ śākhāsu santatānītyuktaṃ
analyzed: loke parṇa utpatti anantaram eva phala darśanāt atra api phala hetu tvāt chandanām parṇa tvam iti bhāvaḥ anena dharma arthayoḥ kāma mokṣa artha tvāt kāma mokṣa ākhya dvi phalaḥ jagat vṛkṣaḥ iti uktam bhavati adhas ca ūrdhvam ca iti asya arthaḥ anyonya iti anena adhas bhūtāḥ śākhāḥ ūrdhva mūleṣu prasṛtāḥ mūlāni ca adhas śākhāsu santatāni iti uktam

original: bhavati | tasyopapādanaṃ kāraṇeṣviti |
analyzed: bhavati tasya upapādanam kāraṇeṣu iti

original: kāraṇeṣu kāryasya sthitatvāt śākhānāṃ mūleṣu prasṛtiryujyate | kāryeṣu kāraṇasya vyāptatvānmūlānāṃ śākhāsu santatiryuktetyarthaḥ | vṛkṣamātrasāmyasyoktatvāt ' aśvatthaṃ prāhuḥ' ityādāvaśvatthoktiḥ kathamityata āha || jagaditi || aśvavat sthito'śvattha ityarthaḥ | cañcalaścet kiṃ sarvātmanocchidyata ityata āha || avyaya iti ||
analyzed: kāraṇeṣu kāryasya sthita tvāt śākhānām mūleṣu prasṛtiḥ yujyate kāryeṣu kāraṇasya vyāpta tvāt mūlānām śākhāsu santatiḥ yuktā iti arthaḥ vṛkṣa mātra sāmyasya ukta tvāt aśvattham prāhuḥ ityādau aśvattha uktiḥ katham iti atas āha jagat iti aśva vat sthita uśvatthaḥ iti arthaḥ cañcalaḥ ced kim sarva ātmanā ucchidyate iti atas āha avyayaḥ iti

original: kimato yadyevaṃ jagadvṛkṣa ityata āha || svasaktīti || saṅgarāhityasahitajñānāsinetyarthaḥ | asya viṣṇoḥ pṛthaktvameva kutaḥ? tajrānena ca kimityata uktaṃ vivṛṇvannāha || avyaktādīti || neti netītyādeḥ pṛthaktvajñānena ca bhagavanmārgaṇaṃ bhavati | jagato bhagavadvailakṣaṇye jñāte hi tatsvarūpaṃ jñātuṃ śakyata iti bhavaḥ |
analyzed: kim atas yadi evam jagat vṛkṣaḥ iti atas āha sva sakti iti saṅga rāhitya sahita jñāna asinā iti arthaḥ asya viṣṇoḥ pṛthaktvam eva kutas ca kim iti atas uktam vivṛṇvan āha avyakta ādi iti na iti na iti ityādeḥ pṛthaktva jñānena ca bhagavat mārgaṇam bhavati jagataḥ bhagavat vailakṣaṇye jñāte hi tad svarūpam jñātum śakyate iti bhavaḥ

original: anena 'tameva' iti vivṛtaṃ bhavati | vṛkṣacchedārthamiti śeṣaḥ | nanu jagadvakṣacchedo brahmādipratipattyā'pi bhavati | ataḥ 'tameva' iti kimavadharyata ityata āha || yaditi || brahmādīnāṃ bhagavadaṃśābhāsatvenāsamarthatvāt jagadvṛkṣacchedāya bhagavantameva prapadyetetyāśayaḥ || 1 -4 ||
analyzed: anena tam eva iti vivṛtam bhavati vṛkṣa cheda artham iti śeṣaḥ nanu brahma ādi pratipattyā api bhavati atas tam eva iti kim avadharyate iti atas āha yat iti brahma ādīnām bhagavat aṃśa ābhāsa tvena asamartha tvāt jagat vṛkṣa chedāya bhagavantam eva prapadyeta iti āśayaḥ 1 4

original: aṃśa eva kiṃ na syāditi cenna | bhinnatvāt | tarhyaṃśābhāvaso'pi kathamityata āha || kiñciditi || anena 'mamaiva' ityuktārthaṃ bhavati | kiñca jīvasya viṣayān prati indriyapreraṇādikamapīśvarādhīnamiti tatprapattirjagadvṛkṣacchedanopāya iti bhāvena bhagavanmahimānaṃ darśayat | bhuṅkta ityanena 'śrotraṃ' ityasyārtha ukto bhavati |
analyzed: aṃśaḥ eva kim na syāt iti ced na bhinnatvāt katham iti atas āha kiñcid iti anena mama eva iti ukta artham bhavati kiñca jīvasya viṣayān prati indriya preraṇa ādikam api īśvara adhīnam iti tad prapattiḥ jagadvṛkṣa chedana upāyaḥ iti bhāvena bhagavat mahimānam darśayat bhuṅkte iti anena śrotram iti asya arthaḥ uktaḥ bhavati

original: śubhānityanena 'guṇān' ityuktārthaṃ bhavati | īśvarasya pūrṇānandatvāt kiṃ viṣayabhogenetyata āha || pūrṇeti || 9 -12 ||
analyzed: śubhān iti anena guṇān iti ukta artham bhavati īśvarasya pūrṇa ānanda tvāt kim viṣaya bhogena iti atas āha pūrṇa iti

original: upajīvyatayā viśvanarasambandho vaiśvānara ityarthaḥ | kṣaraṇaṃ vināśaḥ | kṣara vināśasantatadānayoriti dhātoḥ | atrātmapadaprayogeṇa 'dvāvimau puruṣau' iti puruṣaśabdaḥ cetanārtha ityuktaṃ bhavati | tataśca na śriyaḥ puruṣatvavirodhaḥ || 13 -20 ||
analyzed: upajīvya tayā viśva nara sambandhaḥ vaiśvānaraḥ iti arthaḥ kṣaraṇam vināśaḥ dhātoḥ atra ātma pada prayogeṇa dvau imau puruṣau iti puruṣa śabdaḥ cetanā arthaḥ iti uktam bhavati tatas ca na śriyaḥ puruṣa tva virodhaḥ

original: iti śrīādānandatīrthabhagavatpādācāryaviracite śrīmadbhagavadgītātātparyanirṇaye pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 ||
analyzed: iti śrī āt ānandatīrtha bhagavat pāda ācārya viracite śrīmat bhagavadgītā tātparyanirṇaye pañcadaśaḥ adhyāyaḥ 15

original: || atha ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
analyzed: atha ṣoḍaśaḥ adhyāyaḥ

original: hariḥ oṃ|| etadadhyāyapratipādyamarthaṃ darśayati || deveti || abhayādidevatālakṣaṇānāṃ mokṣahetutvāt tadāpādanāya dambhādyasuralakṣaṇānāṃ tadvirodhitvāt tatparityāgāya tadubhayamasminnadhyāye nirūpyata iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: hariḥ om etad adhyāya pratipādyam artham darśayati deva iti abhayā ādi devatā lakṣaṇānām mokṣa hetu tvāt tad āpādanāya dambha ādi asura lakṣaṇānām tad virodhi tvāt tad parityāgāya tat ubhayam asmin adhyāye nirūpyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: tatra 'abhimānaśaca', 'īśvaro'haṃ', 'asatyamapratiṣṭhaṃ te jagadāhuranīśvaram | 'aparasparasambhūtaṃ', 'māmātmaparadeheṣu praddhiṣantaḥ', 'tato yāntyadhamāṃ gatiṃ, 'trividhaṃ narakasyedaṃ' ityādinā cārvākāṇāmasuratvamucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāya vyācaṣṭe || ya iti || parebhyo na ca jāyate | bhramajatvādeva | kuta ete'surā ityata āha ||
analyzed: tatra abhimāna śacaḥ īśvaraḥ ham asatyam apratiṣṭham te jagat āhuḥ anīśvaram a paraspara sambhūtam mām ātma para deheṣu tatas yānti adhamām gatim trividham narakasya idam ityādinā cārvākāṇām asura tvam ucyate iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya vyācaṣṭe ye iti parebhyaḥ na ca jāyate bhrama ja tvāt eva kutas ete surāḥ iti atas āha

original: akṣeti || satī pṛthivītyādipratyakṣasya, viśvaṃ satyamityādyāgamasya, pramāṇadṛṣṭatvādyanumānasya sarvasya mithyātve sarvamithyātvasyāpi mithyātvaprāptyā sarvasya tvamiti svoktivirodhaḥ | na kevalaṃ parameśvaro'hamityādi manvānā asurāḥ, kintu yo'nye pratyakṣādiviruddhavādinaste sarve'pyasurā ityāha || evamiti ||
analyzed: akṣa iti satī pṛthivī ityādi pratyakṣasya viśvam satyam ityādi āgamasya pramāṇa dṛṣṭa tva ādi anumānasya sarvasya mithyātve sarva mithyātvasya api mithyātva prāptyā sarvasya tvam iti sva ukti virodhaḥ na kevalam parameśvaraḥ ham ityādi manvānāḥ asurāḥ kintu pratyakṣa ādi viruddha vādinaḥ te sarve api asurāḥ iti āha evam iti

original: devalakṣaṇamāha || ye tviti || anena 'jñānayogavyavasthitirdānaṃ' ityādi vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | kuta evaṃvidhānāṃ devatvamityata āha || pratyakṣeti || vamuktigā ityanenaiva devītyuktārthaṃ bhavati |

original: śraddhāyā jīvasvarūpatvena tayā tajjñānamupapadyate | āhārādyaistatkathamityata āha || sāttvikā iti || atra jīvānāṃ sāttvikatvādi uttamatvādīti jñeyam | sāttviyajñādīnāmitthaṃbhāvāntaravidhānāyāha || omiti || anena oṃ tatsat' ca ityādi vyākhyātaṃ bhavati | kena hetunā viṣṇoromiti nāmetyata āha || viprā iti ||

original: tasmādoṅ‌kārasya bhagavannāmatvāt, omityuccāryeti śeṣaḥ || pravartanta iti || pravartayantītyarthaḥ | anena brāhmaṇā ityādyuktārthaṃ bhavati | bhagavannāmāntarasadbhāvāt kathametaduccāraṇaniyatirityato'sya viśeṣamāha || anoṅ‌kṛtamiti || oṅ‌kāroccāraṇaṃ tadarthajñānapūrvakameva kāryamiti bhāvenāha || oṅ‌kṛtaṃ tviti ||

analyzed: bhagavatā eva śraddhā abhāve śāstra vidhāna anusāriṇā upi asattvasya eva uktatvāt śraddhā eva prayojikā na anyat iti jñāyate iti bhāvaḥ hutam iti atra śāstra vidhāna anusāreṇa iti siddham vidhāna ukti prasaṅgāt aṅgīkṛtya ca idam uktam bhagavat śraddhā abhāve śāstra vidhāna anusāri tvam ca na asti tatas api śraddhā eva sāttvika tva ādau prayojikā iti āśayena āha bhagavat iti

original: tatkuta ityata āha || viṣṇubhaktīti || viṣṇubhaktividhānārthameva śāstrapravṛttiśruteḥ tadabhāve na śāstravidhānānusāritvaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | śāstravidhānāsyāprayojakatve

original: 'rasyāḥ snigdhāḥ sthirāḥ'ityāhārāṇāṃ kiṃnāma sthiratvaṃ, keṣāṃ cocyata ityata āha || sthirā iti || bahukālaṃ guṇapradā ityarthaḥ | kaṭ‌vāmlalavaṇeti kaṭūvādīnāṃ yadrājasatvamuktaṃ tanna niyataṃ, kadācit sāttvikatvamapi syādityāha || kaṭūvādīnāmiti || raso rasāyanam |
analyzed: rasyāḥ snigdhāḥ sthirāḥ iti āhārāṇām kiṃnāma sthira tvam keṣām ca ucyate iti atas āha sthirāḥ iti bahukālam guṇa pradāḥ iti arthaḥ kaṭu āmla lavaṇa iti kaṭūva ādīnām yat rājasa tvam uktam tat na niyatam kadācid sāttvika tvam api syāt iti āha kaṭūva ādīnām iti rasaḥ rasāyanam

original: duḥkhādipradāścet rājasā ityuktatvādārogyādihetutve kaṭūvādīnāṃ sāttvikatvāvagaterna rājasattvaniyama ityarthaḥ | rasyādīnāṃ sāttvikatvāniyame cāyuḥsattvetyādyudāhartavyam | balaśabdāt sattvaśabdasyānatibhinnārthatvāt punaruktirityata āha || sattvamiti ||

analyzed: abhisandhāya tu phalam iti tatra phala abhisandhinā pravṛtteḥ rājasa yāgena indra ādi deva lokaḥ svargaḥ bhavati iti kvacid vacanāt ca iti āśaṃkām smṛti antareṇa pariharati yāgāt iti svarga abhisandhānāt tatra pravṛtteḥ katham tad abhāvaḥ iti atas āha viṣṇau iti svarga kāmanena pratyuta narakaḥ eva bhavati na svargaḥ

original: teṣāṃ viṣṇāvaśraddhāsadbhāvena svargayogyānāṃ tatkāmasyāyogyatvāditi bhāvaḥ | rājasānāṃ sakāmayajñābhāve'pi narakasadbhāvāt kathamayogyakāmādi tatkāraṇamityata āha || vineti || kvacinnarakadarśanasya gatimāha || niṣiddhamiti || atra narakalokapracuratvoktyā rājasoṣu madhyamā vivakṣitāḥ na tu nityatraividyā iti jñātavyam |
analyzed: teṣām viṣṇau aśraddhā sadbhāvena svarga yogyānām tad kāmasya ayogya tvāt iti bhāvaḥ rājasānām sa kāma yajña abhāve pi naraka sadbhāvāt katham ayogya kāma ādi tat kāraṇam iti atas āha vinā iti kvacid naraka darśanasya gatim āha niṣiddham iti atra naraka loka pracura tva uktyā madhyamāḥ vivakṣitāḥ na tu nitya traividyāḥ iti jñātavyam

original: yadi rājasakarmaṇā narakaḥ syāttarhi sāttvikānāmapi tatkaraṇasambhavāt narakaprāptiḥ stādityata āha || kadāciditi || yadyapi sāttvikā rājasatāmase, rājasāḥ sāttvikatāmase, tāmasāśca sāttvikarājase karmaṇī yadyapi kurvanti | tathāpi tatkādācideva | svābhāvikakarmaṇyeva prādhānyena sthitiḥ | mahatā cālpābhibhava iti na phalasaṅ‌kara iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: yadi rājasa karmaṇā narakaḥ syāt tarhi sāttvikānām api tad karaṇa sambhavāt naraka prāptiḥ stād iti atas āha kadācid iti yadi api sāttvikāḥ rājasa tāmase rājasāḥ sāttvika tāmase tāmasāḥ ca sāttvika rājase karmaṇī yadi api kurvanti tathā api tat kādācid eva svābhāvika karmaṇi eva prādhānyena sthitiḥ mahatā ca alpa abhibhavaḥ iti na phala saṅkaraḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: svābhāvikaṃ mahāphamasvābhāvikam alpaphalamityato'pi svābhāvikenānyābhibhavasambhavānna phalasaṃkara ityāha || svamiti || yadi sāttvikādīnāṃ svābhāvikāsvābhāvikakarmakaraṇaṃ syāttarhi idaṃ svābhāvikaṃ karma, idaṃ neti kathaṃ jñāyata ityata āha || bāhulyamiti ||
analyzed: svābhāvikam mahā pham asvābhāvikam alpa phalam iti atas api svābhāvikena anya abhibhava sambhavāt na phala saṃkaraḥ iti āha svam iti yadi sāttvika ādīnām svābhāvika asvābhāvika karma karaṇam syāt tarhi idam svābhāvikam karma idam na iti katham jñāyate iti atas āha bāhulyam iti

analyzed: svābhāvika ādi karmasu yat bahulam tat svābhāvikam alpam asvābhāvikam iti bāhulya ādi jñāpakam iti bhāvaḥ 10

original: 'manaḥprasādaḥ saumyatvaṃ maunaṃ' ityatra maunaśabdasyānyarthatvapratīti nirāsāyāha || maunamiti || kathaṃmanyathā mānasaṃ tapaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ | 'aphalākāṅkṣibhiryuktaiḥ' ityatra yuktatvaṃ nāma kimityata āha || yuktairiti || nanu sāttvikayajñadānayorbhagavadarpaṇamanuktvā tapasyeva kimucyata ityata āha || yuktairiti ||
analyzed: manaḥ prasādaḥ saumya tvam maunam iti atra mauna śabdasya anyarthatva pratīti nirāsāya āha maunam iti mānasam tapaḥ syāt iti bhāvaḥ aphala ākāṅkṣibhiḥ yuktaiḥ iti atra yukta tvam nāma kim iti atas āha yuktaiḥ iti nanu sāttvika yajña dānayoḥ bhagavat arpaṇam an uktvā tapasi eva kim ucyate iti atas āha yuktaiḥ iti

original: na kevalaṃ tapasyevaitaducyate kintu yajñadānatapassvapi etadanuṣañjanīyamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: na kevalam tapasi eva etat ucyate kintu yajña dāna tapassu api etat anuṣañjanīyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: 'oṃtatsaditi nirdeśaḥ' ityetadvākyāntareṇa vyākhyātam | tadvākyavivaraṇenaitadvākyaṃ vivṛṇoti || 16 -22 || saditi || tataśca kimityata āha || omiti || karmādīnāṃ satsambandhitvādeva hi sattvam | tacca padaṃ brahmaiva | oṃtatsaditi nāmnāṃ viṣṇau prasiddhatvāt | ato viṣṇusambandhyeva karmādi saditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: om tat sat iti nirdeśaḥ iti etat vākya antareṇa vyākhyātam tad vākya vivaraṇena etat vākyam vivṛṇoti sat iti tatas ca kim iti atas āha om iti karma ādīnām sat sambandhi tvāt eva hi sattvam tat ca padam brahma eva om tat sat iti nāmnām viṣṇau prasiddha tvāt atas viṣṇu sambandhi eva karma ādi sat iti bhāvaḥ

original: anena 'oṃ tatsaditi yadviṣṇoḥ' iti vivṛtaṃ bhavati | anoṅ‌kṛtaṃ hyāsuraṃ syāt ityanoṅ‌kṛtasyāsuratvaprasiddhiḥ taduccāraṇe hetutayoktā | kā'sāvityato vaidikītyāha || sravatīti || 'oṅ‌kṛtaṃ tvapi'ityuktārthe śrutiṃ cā'ha || anarthajñeti || nirartho niṣprayojanaḥ | kutaḥ? yasmādarthajñānata eva jñātāraṃ trāti tena hi mantraḥ kathitaḥ |
analyzed: anena om tat sat iti yat viṣṇoḥ iti vivṛtam bhavati anoṅkṛtam hi āsuram syāt iti anoṅkṛtasya āsura tva prasiddhiḥ tad uccāraṇe hetutayā uktā kā asau iti atas vaidikī iti āha sravati iti oṅkṛtam tu api iti ukta arthe śrutim ca āha anartha jñā iti nirarthaḥ niṣprayojanaḥ kutas yasmāt artha jñānataḥ eva jñātāram trāti tena hi mantraḥ kathitaḥ

original: nanvasminnadhyāye sadasatkarmavivekhaḥ kāryaḥ | taṃ vihāya oṃ tatsadityādinā kimucyata ityato'bhiprāyamāha || tadarthatveneti || atra hyoṅ‌karārthasmaraṇapūrvakaṃ tamuccārya bhaktyā bhagavadarthatvena niṣkāmatayā kṛtameva
analyzed: nanu asmin adhyāye sat asat karma vivekhaḥ kāryaḥ tam vihāya om tat sat ityādinā kim ucyate iti atas abhiprāyam āha tad artha tvena iti atra hi oṅkara artha smaraṇa pūrvakam tam uccārya bhaktyā bhagavat artha tvena niṣkāma tayā kṛtam eva

original: karma sāttvikamanyadrājasādītyucyate | tataścaitādṛśameva satkarma anyadasatkarmeti sadasatkarma vivicyoktameveti bhāvaḥ | na ca vācyamatraivaṃvidhakarmaṇaḥ sattvamanyasyāsattvaṃ svayamevocyata iti | anyathā prasaṅgānanuguṇatvaprasaṅgena sadādiśabdasya sāttvikādyarthatvāt | etena 'aphalākāṅkṣibhiḥ' ityāderapyevamevādhyāyasaṅgatiḥ sūcitā bhavati |
analyzed: karma sāttvikam anyat rājasa ādi iti ucyate tatas ca etādṛśam eva sat karma anyat asat karma iti sat asat karma vivicya uktam eva iti bhāvaḥ na ca vācyam atra evaṃvidha karmaṇaḥ sattvam anyasya asattvam svayam eva ucyate iti anyathā prasaṅga ananuguṇa tva prasaṅgena sat ādi śabdasya sāttvika ādi artha tvāt etena aphala ākāṅkṣibhiḥ ityādeḥ api evam eva adhyāya saṅgatiḥ sūcitā bhavati

original: nanu 'karma caiva tadartho'yaṃ' iti sāttvikaṃ karmoktvā rājasamanabhidhāya 'aśraddhayā hutaṃ' iti tāmasameva kimucyata ityata āha || rājasasyeti || nātra tāmasamevāsacchabdenocyate api tu rājasamapīti bhāvaḥ | takuta ityato'śraddhayetyuktāsallakṣaṇasya rājase'pi bhāvādityāha || viṣṇivati ||
analyzed: nanu karma ca eva tad arthaḥ yaḥ iti sāttvikam karma uktvā rājasam an abhidhāya aśraddhayā hutam iti tāmasam eva kim ucyate iti atas āha rājasasya iti na atra tāmasam eva asat śabdena ucyate api tu rājasam api iti bhāvaḥ iti atas śraddhayā iti ukta asat lakṣaṇasya rājase api bhāvāt iti āha viṣṇu ati

original: 'na ca tatpretya no iha' iti yadrājasatāmasakarmaṇoḥ phalamuktaṃ tadvivicya smṛtyā darśayati || sāttvikamiti ||

original: iti śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpādācāryaviracitasya śrīmadbhagavadgītātātparyanirṇayasya ṭīkāyāṃ jayatīrthamuniviracitāyāṃ nyāyadīpikāyāṃ saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 ||
analyzed: iti śrīmat ānandatīrtha bhagavat pāda ācārya viracitasya śrīmat bhagavadgītā tātparya nirṇayasya ṭīkāyām jayatīrtha muni viracitāyām nyāyadīpikāyām saptadaśaḥ adhyāyaḥ 17

original: || atha aṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
analyzed: atha aṣṭādaśaḥ adhyāyaḥ

original: hariḥ oṃ|| etadadhyāyapratipādyamarthaṃ darśayati || sarveti || yatsarveṣvadhyāyeṣu viprakīrṇatayā puruṣārthasādhanamuktaṃ tanmandānāṃ buddhyārohārthaṃ saṅkṣepeṇāsminnadhyāye nirūpyate | caturdaśādyanuktaṃ traiguṇyaṃ cocyata ityarthaḥ || 1 -2 ||
analyzed: hariḥ om etad adhyāya pratipādyam artham darśayati sarva iti yat sarveṣu adhyāyeṣu viprakīrṇa tayā puruṣa artha sādhanam uktam tat mandānām buddhi āroha artham saṅkṣepeṇa asmin adhyāye nirūpyate caturdaśa ādi anuktam traiguṇyam ca ucyate iti arthaḥ

original: 'sarvakarmaphalatyāgaṃ' iti svoktatyāgasvarūpāvadhāraṇāya prātītikī vidvanmatavipratipattirudbhāvyate -- 'tyājyam' iti | atra yajñadānatapaḥkarma na tyājyaṃ, kāryameva taditi bhagavanmatavirodhitvāt tyājyaṃ doṣavaditi tyāgapakṣiṇo nindyā ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || manīṣiṇa iti || ata iti ||
analyzed: sarva karma phala tyāgam iti sva ukta tyāga svarūpa avadhāraṇāya prātītikī vidvat mata vipratipattiḥ udbhāvyate tyājyam iti atra yajña dāna tapaḥ karma na tyājyam kāryam eva tat iti bhagavat mata virodhi tvāt tyājyam doṣavat iti tyāga pakṣiṇaḥ nindyāḥ iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya āha manīṣiṇaḥ iti atas iti

original: 'kāryamityeva vatkarma' ityatra yathā karmaṇi saṅgaphalatyāgena karmatyāgo varṇyate, na tu karmasvarūpatyāgena, tathā tyājyamityetadartho varṇayituṃ śakyate | ato na tasya bhagavanmatavirodhaḥ | kuto'rthāntarakalpaneti cet manīṣiṇa ityuktatvādeveti bhāvaḥ || 3 -4 ||
analyzed: kāryam iti eva vat karma iti atra yathā karmaṇi saṅga phala tyāgena karma tyāgaḥ varṇyate na tu karma svarūpa tyāgena tathā tyājyam iti etad arthaḥ varṇayitum śakyate atas na tasya bhagavat mata virodhaḥ kutas ṛtha antara kalpanā iti ced manīṣiṇaḥ iti ukta tvāt eva iti bhāvaḥ 3

original: niścayaṃ śrṛṇviti pratijñātamucyate -- yajñeti | tatra jyotiṣṭomādiyajñeṣu hiraṇyādidāneṣu yatīnāṃ śūdrādīnāṃ cādhikārābhāvāt ūrdhvaretastvāditapassu gṛhasthādīnām adhikārābhāvāt kathaṃ sarveṣāṃ yajñādividhīyata ityata āha || dravyeti ||
analyzed: niścayam śrṛṇu iti pratijñātam ucyate yajña iti tatra jyotiṣṭoma ādi yajñeṣu hiraṇya ādi dāneṣu yatīnām śūdra ādīnām ca adhikāra abhāvāt ūrdhvaretaḥ tva ādi tapassu gṛhastha ādīnām adhikāra abhāvāt katham sarveṣām yajña ādi vidhīyate iti atas āha dravya iti

original: nātra sarveṣāṃ jyotiṣṭomādiyajñaḥ, hiraṇyādidānāni, ūrdhvaretastvāditapāṃsyeva vidhīyante, kintu dravyayajñādiyajñāḥ, vidāyādidānāni, satyavacanāditapāṃsi | teṣāṃ ca yatyādīnāmapyucitatvāt yuktaṃ sarveṣāṃ tadvidhiriti bhāvaḥ | 'nāgnirna yajñaḥ' ityādeḥ trivarṇabāhyānāṃ na kvāpi yajñe'dhikāra ityata āha || viṣṇviti ||
analyzed: na atra sarveṣām jyotiṣṭoma ādi yajñaḥ hiraṇya ādi dānāni ūrdhvaretaḥ tva ādi tapāṃsi eva vidhīyante kintu dravya yajña ādi yajñāḥ vidāya ādi dānāni satyavacana ādi tapāṃsi teṣām ca yati ādīnām api ucita tvāt yuktam sarveṣām tad vidhiḥ iti bhāvaḥ na agniḥ na yajñaḥ ityādeḥ tri varṇa bāhyānām na kvāpi yajña adhikāraḥ iti atas āha viṣṇu iti

original: dravyādiyajñābhāve'pi teṣāṃ svādhyāyayajñe'dhikāro'styeva | na ca vedānadhikāreṇa tadabhāvaḥ | viṣṇunāmasvādhyāyayajñe'dhikārasambhavāditi bhāvaḥ | teṣāṃ kiṃ tapa ityata āha || satyeti || 5 -6 ||
analyzed: dravya ādi yajña abhāve pi teṣām svādhyāya yajña idhikāraḥ usti eva na ca veda anadhikāreṇa tad abhāvaḥ viṣṇu nāma svādhyāya yajña idhikāra sambhavāt iti bhāvaḥ teṣām kim tapaḥ iti atas āha satya iti 5 6

original: 'tyāgo hi' ityuktaṃ prapañcyate -'niyatasya' iti | tatra karmatyāgasya svayameva stūyamānatvāt kathaṃ mohanimittatvamucyata ityata āha || saṅgeti || svarūpatyāgasyāpi mohanimittatvaṃ kutaḥ? yonāyamarthaḥ syādityata āha || sveti ||
analyzed: tyāgaḥ hi iti uktam prapañcyate niyatasya iti tatra karma tyāgasya svayam eva stūyamāna tvāt katham moha nimitta tvam ucyate iti atas āha saṅga iti svarūpa tyāgasya api moha nimitta tvam kutas syāt iti atas āha sva iti

original: bandhakakarmaphalabhāve pramāṇamāha || jñānāderiti || tyāgimātrasya jñānabhaktyādeḥ | tasyaivāparokṣatastattvasaṃvettuḥ mokṣabhogyānandātiśayāt | tadṛte jñānādikamṛte | anena 'bhavatyatyāgināṃ' ityuktārthaṃ bhavati | bhavatyatyāgināṃ pretya na tu tyāgināmityatyāgināṃ pratiyogitvena tyāgina eva vaktavyāḥ | saṃnyāsinastu kimityucyanta ityata āha ||

original: sāttvikajñānādisādhanānuṣṭhānāya guṇabhedā ucyante -- 'jñānam' iti | tatra, guṇāḥ saṅkhyāyante'sminniti guṇasaṅkhyānapadena prasiddhasāṅkhyaśāstramucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || evamiti || prasiddhasāṅkhyaśāstramevātra kiṃ na syādityata evamityuktam |

original: evaṃ sarvagatasyeśvarasya sarvato bhedādiviṣayaṃ jñānaṃ sāttvikamityādi guṇasaṅkhyāne procyata iti hyatrocyate | tacca paramasāṅkhyaśāstragrahaṇa evopapadyate, na nirīśvarasāṅkhyagrahaṇa iti bhāvaḥ || 19 ||
analyzed: evam sarva gatasya īśvarasya sarvatas bheda ādi viṣayam jñānam sāttvikam ityādi guṇa saṅkhyāne procyate iti hi atra ucyate tat ca parama sāṅkhya śāstra grahaṇe eva upapadyate na nirīśvara sāṅkhya grahaṇe iti bhāvaḥ

original: tatra pratijñātaṃ jñānatraividhyamucyate -- 'sarva' iti | tadapratītyādi nirāsāya smṛtyaiva vyācaṣṭe || astitvāditi || pṛthaktvenetyantena sarvabhūteṣviti saptamyā abhiprāyo'pyukto bhavati | viṣṇorityādinā avibhaktamityuktārthaṃ bhavati | tāratamyenetyanena vibhakteṣviti dvedhā vyākhyātaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: tatra pratijñātam jñāna traividhyam ucyate sarve iti tat aprati ityādi nirāsāya smṛtyā eva vyācaṣṭe astitvāt iti pṛthaktvena ityantena sarva bhūteṣu iti saptamyāḥ abhiprāyaḥ upi uktaḥ bhavati viṣṇoḥ ityādinā avibhaktam iti ukta artham bhavati tāratamyena iti anena vibhakteṣu iti dvedhā vyākhyātam bhavati

original: atha bhūtaśabdena bhavatīti jaḍaṃ cocyata ityabhiptetya vibhakteṣvityasyārtha ucyate || jaḍebhya iti || tebhyo jaḍebhya ityanena saptamyartha ukto bhavati || samyagiti || viṣṇuḥ sarvottamaḥ jīvāstadadhīnajñānādimantaḥ, jaḍaṃ tadrahitamityato viṣṇvādīnāṃ bheda ityarthaḥ | anenaikamityuktābhiprāyaṃ bhavati || 20 ||
analyzed: atha bhūta śabdena bhavati iti jaḍam ca ucyate iti abhiptā itya vibhakteṣu iti asya arthaḥ ucyate jaḍebhyaḥ iti tebhyaḥ jaḍebhyaḥ iti anena saptamī arthaḥ uktaḥ bhavati samyak iti viṣṇuḥ sarva uttamaḥ jīvāḥ tad adhīna jñāna ādimantaḥ jaḍam tad rahitam iti atas viṣṇu ādīnām bhedaḥ iti arthaḥ anena ekam iti ukta abhiprāyam bhavati

original: viṣṇorityanena pṛthaktvenetyuktatātparyaṃ bhavati | sāttvikajñānasyāpi viṣṇoranyathra yathārthatvenoktatvāt kathaṃ rājasatvamasya syādityata āha || yadīti || miśratattvavit sandigdhatayā bhagavatsvarūpaṃ jānannityarthaḥ | anyathetyanena yattvityuktārthaṃ bhavati | yatkiñcidekaṃ kṛtsnaṃ jānātīti cādau draṣṭavyam |
analyzed: viṣṇoḥ iti anena pṛthaktvena iti ukta tātparyam bhavati sāttvika jñānasya api viṣṇoḥ yathārtha tvena ukta tvāt katham rājasa tvam asya syāt iti atas āha yadi iti miśra tattva vid sandigdhatayā bhagavat svarūpam jānan iti arthaḥ anyathā iti anena yat tu iti ukta artham bhavati yat kiñcid ekam kṛtsnam jānāti iti ca ādau draṣṭavyam

original: jānātītyantena kārye kṛtsnavat saktamityasya tātparyamuktaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: jānāti ityantena kārye kṛtsna vat saktam iti asya tātparyam uktam bhavati

original: kṛtsnamakāryatvādiguṇapūrṇaṃ brahma yathā viṣayīkaroti brahmeti tathetyarthaḥ | sa evetyanena kārye kṛtsnayat saktamityasya kṛtsnapadamakhilajagadviṣayamaṅgīkṛtya artāntaramuktaṃ bhavati | eketyanena ekasmin kārye kṛtsnavatsaktamityuktatātparyaṃ bhavati | yuktītvanenāhaitukamityasya yuktirāhityacca tathā manyata ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: kṛtsnam akārya tva ādi guṇa pūrṇam brahma yathā viṣayīkaroti brahma iti tathā iti arthaḥ saḥ eva iti anena kārye saktam iti asya kṛtsna padam akhila jagat viṣayam aṅgīkṛtya arta antaram uktam bhavati eka iti anena ekasmin kārye kṛtsna vat saktam iti ukta tātparyam bhavati yuktītvanena ahaitukam ityasya tathā manyate iti arthaḥ

original: alpetyanenālpamityuktārthaṃ bhavati | alpasamyagjñānaṃ ityarthaḥ | bhrāntasyāpyadhiṣṭhānādi viṣayasambagjñānavattvāt | atattvārthamityanenātattvārthavadityuktārthaṃ bhavati | yathāvasthitākārād viparītākāramityarthaḥ | tattvārthajñānavarjanāditi || yathāsthitākārajñānābhāvādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: alpa iti anena alpam iti ukta artham bhavati alpa samyak jñānam iti arthaḥ bhrāntasya api adhiṣṭhāna ādi atattvārtham iti anena atattvārthavat iti ukta artham bhavati yathā avasthita ākārāt viparīta ākāram iti arthaḥ tattvārtha jñāna varjanāt iti yathāsthita ākāra jñāna abhāvāt iti arthaḥ

original: nanu sarveṣu bhūteṣu pṛthaktevena yajjñānamityetadeva nānābhāvān pṛthagvidhānityucyate | ataḥ punaruktideṣa ityata āha || pṛthaktveneti || vyākhyānavyākhyeyabhāvāt na punaruktideṣa iti bhāvaḥ | nanu sarveṣu bhūteṣu pṛthaktvājñānaviṣayasya sāttvikatvenoktatvāt kathaṃ rājasatvamatrocyata ityata āha || sarveti ||
analyzed: nanu sarveṣu bhūteṣu yat jñānam iti etat eva nānā bhāvān pṛthagvidhān iti ucyate atas punarukti deṣaḥ iti atas āha pṛthaktvena iti vyākhyāna vyākhyeya bhāvāt na punarukti deṣaḥ iti bhāvaḥ nanu sarveṣu bhūteṣu pṛthaktva ajñāna viṣayasya sāttvika tvena ukta tvāt katham rājasa tvam atra ucyate iti atas āha sarva iti

original: na kevalaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu pṛthaktvaviṣayaṃ sāttvikajñānamuktam | kintu tadgateśvaramapṛthaktvena sarvottamatvena ca viṣayīkurvat | tadabhāvādbhūteṣu pṛthaktvaviṣayatve'pyasya rājñasatvaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ | anena yadīti smṛtirvivṛtā bhavati |
analyzed: na kevalam sarveṣu bhūteṣu pṛthaktva viṣayam sāttvika jñānam uktam kintu tadgata īśvaram apṛthaktvena sarva uttama tvena ca viṣayīkurvat tad abhāvāt bhūteṣu pṛthaktva viṣaya tve pi asya rājñasatvam yuktam iti bhāvaḥ anena yadi iti smṛtiḥ vivṛtā bhavati

original: 'yattu kṛtsnavadekasmin kārye saktaṃ jñānaṃ tadahaitukaṃ, atattvārthavadalpasajjñānayuktam' iti niyatamevātaḥ taduktau punaruktirityata uktaṃ vivṛṇvannāha || ekasyeti || yasya kasyacidekasya nāstītyantamuktārthaḥvivaraṇam | na pūrvoktasyaivāhaitukatvādiviśeṣaṇāni vidhīyante, yena punaruktiḥ syāt |
analyzed: yat tu kṛtsna vat ekasmin kārye saktam jñānam tat ahaitukam atattvārthavat alpa sat jñāna yuktam iti niyatam eva atas tad uktau punaruktiḥ iti atas uktam vivṛṇvan āha ekasya iti yasya kasyacid ekasya na asti ityantam ukta arthaḥ vivaraṇam na pūrvoktasya eva ahaituka tva ādi viśeṣaṇāni vidhīyante yena punaruktiḥ syāt

original: kintvahaitukatvādīnāṃ svayameva tāmasānāmuktaviśeṣaṇayogitayā atitāmasatvajñāpanāya uktaviśeṣaṇānyucyanta iti bhāvaḥ | sadasadvailakṣaṇyādyavidyamānākārakalpanāyuktamityarthaḥ | evameṣāṃ padānāṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamaṅgīkṛtyaiva punaruktiṃ parihṛtyānekādhikaraṇa tayā'pi tāṃ pariharati || ekasminniti ||
analyzed: kintu ahaituka tva ādīnām svayam eva tāmasānām ukta viśeṣaṇa yogitayā ati tāmasa tva jñāpanāya ukta viśeṣaṇāni ucyante iti bhāvaḥ sat asat vailakṣaṇya ādya vidyamāna ākāra kalpanā yuktam iti arthaḥ evam eṣām padānām sāmānādhikaraṇyam aṅgīkṛtya eva punaruktim parihṛtya aneka adhikaraṇa tayā api tām pariharati ekasmin iti

original: kārye sarvaṃ jagaditi, saktamekasmin kārye sarvaṃ jagaditi caitāni padāni yojyānīti vā na punaruktiriti samyaddhyate | nanvevaṃvidhajñānasya kvāpyabhāvāt tasya tāmasatvakathanaṃ kathaṃmityata āha || māyeti || 21 -22 ||
analyzed: kārye sarvam jagat iti saktam ekasmin kārye sarvam jagat iti ca etāni padāni yojyāni iti vā na punaruktiḥ iti samyat hyate nanu evaṃvidha jñānasya kvāpi abhāvāt tasya tāmasa tva kathanam āha māyā iti 21 21

original: guṇabhedena karmatraividhyamucyate -- 'niyataṃ' iti | tatra niyatapadena svavarṇāśramocitamātramucyata ityanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || mayīti || viṣṇoḥ sarvottamatvajñānapūrvakaṃ tadbhaktyā tadarpaṇabuddhyā kriyamāṇameva karma niyatamityatrocyate | na tu svavarṇāśramocitatvamātram |
analyzed: guṇa bhedena karma traividhyam ucyate niyatam iti tatra niyata padena sva varṇa āśrama ucita mātram ucyate iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya āha mayi iti viṣṇoḥ sarva uttama tva jñāna pūrvakam tad bhaktyā tad arpaṇa buddhyā kriyamāṇam eva karma niyatam iti atra ucyate na tu sva varṇa āśrama ucita tva mātram

original: kutaḥ? 'mayi sarvāṇi karmāṇi' iti bhagavatsarvottamatvajñānapurvakaṃ tadarpaṇabuddhyā karmakaraṇaṃ vidhāya 'ye me matamidam' iti tasya mokṣādhanatvokteḥ | 'ye tvetat' iti tadakaraṇe pratyavāyasya cokteḥ | yatkaraṇe phalaprāptiḥ, yadakaraṇe pratyavāyaḥ tasyaiva niyatatvāditi bhāvaḥ | bhavatu bhagavadarpaṇabuddhya kriyamāṇaṃ karma niyatam |
analyzed: kutas mayi sarvāṇi karmāṇi iti bhagavat sarva uttama tva jñāna purvakam tad arpaṇa buddhyā karma karaṇam vidhāya ye me matam idam iti tasya mokṣa ādhana tva ukteḥ ye tu etat iti tad akaraṇe pratyavāyasya ca ukteḥ yad karaṇe phala prāptiḥ yad akaraṇe pratyavāyaḥ tasya eva niyata tvāt iti bhāvaḥ bhavatu bhagavat arpaṇa buddhya kriyamāṇam karma niyatam

original: tasya bhagavatsarvottamatvajñānādipūrvakatvaṃ kutaḥ mayi sarvāṇi karmāṇi ityatra tadanukterityata āha || adhyātmeti || sarvādhike paramātmani cetaḥ adhyātmacetaḥ | apekṣitatayā jñāyata iti sambaddhyate | bhavedetat, yadyadhyātmacetaseti padaṃ bhagavatsarvottamatvajñānārthaṃ syāt | tadeva kuta ityata āha || ye tviti ||
analyzed: tasya bhagavat sarva uttama tva jñāna ādi pūrvaka tvam kutas mayi sarvāṇi karmāṇi iti atra tad anukteḥ iti atas āha adhyātma iti sarva adhike paramātmani cetaḥ adhyātma cetaḥ apekṣita tayā jñāyate iti sambaddhyate bhavet etat yadi adhyātma cetasā iti padam bhagavat sarva uttama tva jñāna artham syāt tat eva kutas iti atas āha ye tu iti

original: mayi sarvāṇi iti ślokārthānuvādarūpe ye tu sarvāṇi ityanmin śloke'dhyātmacetaseti padasya 'matparāḥ' ityādinā bhagavatsarvottamatvajñānatatsmaraṇādyarthatayā vyakhyātatvāt bhavedevaitatpadaṃ tadarthamiti bhāvaḥ | ahaṃ paraḥ sarvottamo yeṣāṃ te matparāḥ | na ca vācyametacchlokasya tacchlokānuvādarūpatvaṃ kuta iti |
analyzed: mayi sarvāṇi iti śloka artha anuvāda rūpe ye tu sarvāṇi śloke idhi ātma cetasā iti padasya mad parāḥ ityādinā bhagavat sarva uttama tva jñāna tad smaraṇa ādi arthatayā vyakhyāta tvāt bhavet eva etat padam tad artham iti bhāvaḥ aham paraḥ sarva uttamaḥ yeṣām te mad parāḥ na ca vācyam etad ślokasya tad śloka anuvāda rūpa tvam kutas iti

original: 'evaṃ satatayuktā ye ' ityarjunena prāguktaprakārānuvādena pṛṣṭasya bhagavatastathaiva parihārokteryuktatvāt | samākhyāvaśācca etacchlokārthānuvāditvaṃ vijñāyate | kimetanniyatatvaṃ karmaṇa eva sāttvikatve prayojakamuta jñānādīnāmapītyata āha || evamiti || bhagavadarpaṇādikaṃ cātra draṣṭavyam || 23 -25 ||
analyzed: evam satata yuktāḥ ye iti arjunena prāk ukta prakāra anuvādena pṛṣṭasya bhagavataḥ tathā eva parihāra ukteḥ yukta tvāt samākhyā vaśāt ca etad śloka artha anuvādi tvam vijñāyate kim etat niyata tvam karmaṇaḥ eva sāttvika tve prayojakam uta jñāna ādīnām api iti atas āha evam iti bhagavat arpaṇa ādikam ca atra draṣṭavyam 23 23

original: guṇabhedataḥ kartustraividhmucyate -- 'mukta ' iti | tatra kartā cedanahaṃvādīti kathamityata āha || sarvasyeti || kartā'pyahameva karteti sāttviko na vadati | tena svakartṛtvādeḥ sarvasya bhagavadadhīnatayā niścitatvādityarthaḥ || 26 -27 ||
analyzed: guṇa bhedataḥ kartuḥ traividhm ucyate muktaḥ iti tatra kartā ced anahaṃvādī iti katham iti atas āha sarvasya iti kartā api aham eva kartā iti sāttvikaḥ na vadati tena sva kartṛ tva ādeḥ sarvasya bhagavat adhīna tayā niścita tvāt iti arthaḥ 26

original: nanu sāttvikasyāpi prakākṛtatvadīrghasūtritvayoḥ sadbhāvāt kathaṃ tattāmasasyaivocyata ityataḥ tatpadadvayasyārthaṃ smṛtyaiva darśayati || bhagavaditi || smaranniti | cintayannityarthaḥ | paścāt kuryāmiti cintanaṃ sāttvike'pi samamityata āha || prāpteti ||
analyzed: nanu sāttvikasya api sadbhāvāt katham tat tāmasasya eva ucyate iti atas tad pada dvayasya artham smṛtyā eva darśayati bhagavat iti smaran iti cintayan iti arthaḥ paścāt kuryām iti cintanam sāttvike api samam iti atas āha prāpta iti

original: yasya karmaṇo yaḥ kālo vihitaḥ tasmin kāle prāpte'pi paścāt kuryāmiti cintayan dīrghasūtrītyarthaḥ | anena alasādapyasya vailakṣaṇyaṃ sūcitam | saḥ prāptakālaṃ karma udāsta eveti | nanvevaṃ ceddīrghasūtritaḥ stabdhādīnāṃ utkṛṣṭatvāt kathaṃ tāmasatayā gaṇanamityataḥ gaṇanamityataḥ pramāṇavākyenaiva tāmaseṣveva tān vibhajyāha || alasa iti ||
analyzed: yasya karmaṇaḥ yaḥ kālaḥ vihitaḥ tasmin kāle prāpte api paścāt kuryām iti cintayan dīrghasūtrī iti arthaḥ anena alasāt api asya vailakṣaṇyam sūcitam saḥ prāpta kālam karma udāste eva iti nanu evam ced dīrghasūtritaḥ stabdha ādīnām utkṛṣṭa tvāt katham tāmasa tayā gaṇanam ityatas gaṇanam ityatas pramāṇa vākyena eva tāmaseṣu eva tān vibhajya āha alasaḥ iti

original: ayukto bhagavadarpaṇādiyogarahitaḥ | stabdho nāma ātmasambhāvanayā kvāpyanataḥ | naikṛtiko nīcakarmā | śaṭho gūḍhadveṣī | trividhatāmasānāṃ phalamāha || durnaratvamiti || 29 -30 ||
analyzed: ayuktaḥ bhagavat arpaṇa ādi yoga rahitaḥ stabdhaḥ nāma ātma sambhāvanayā kvāpi anataḥ naikṛtikaḥ nīca karmā śaṭhaḥ gūḍha dveṣī trividha tāmasānām phalam āha durnara tvam iti 29

original: 'buddheḥ ' iti pratijñātamucyate -- 'pravṛttiṃ ' iti | tatra 'yayā darmamadharmaṃ ' ityuktaddhyorekaprakāratvāt kathaṃ rājasatāmasatvamityataḥ tadvibhāgaṃ vākyāntareṇa darśayati || kiñciditi || anena 'ayathāvat ' iti niyamena yathāvannetyuktaṃ bhavati | 'yogena ' iti upāyabalenetyalpārthapratītinirāsāya tad vākyāntareṇa vyācaṣṭe || vaiṣṇava iti ||
analyzed: buddheḥ iti pratijñātam ucyate pravṛttim iti tatra yayā darmam adharmam iti ukta ddhyoḥ eka prakāra tvāt katham rājasa tāmasa tvam iti atas tad vibhāgam vākya antareṇa darśayati kiñcid iti anena ayathāvat iti niyamena yathāvat na iti uktam bhavati yogena iti upāya balena iti alpa artha pratīti nirāsāya tat vākya antareṇa vyācaṣṭe vaiṣṇavaḥ iti

original: anena yogena yuktyeti pūritaṃ bhavati | dhṛtiśced vyabhicāraśūnyaivāto'vyabhicāriṇyeti viśiṣyāsyā eva kimucyata ityata āha || vihiteti || na
analyzed: anena yogena yuktyā iti pūritam bhavati dhṛtiḥ ced vyabhicāra śūnyā evā atovyabhicāriṇyā iti viśiṣya asyāḥ eva kim ucyate iti atas āha vihitā iti na

original: cātrāvyabhicāritvamaskhalitatvamiti bhāvaḥ | yayā svapnamityuktamātraṃ yayā na muñcati sā tāmasīti pratītinirāsāyāha || svapnamiti || sarvaniṣiddhaṃ bhagavad‌dveṣādi | bhagavad‌dveṣādeḥ vṛddhāniṣiddhatvena tāmasatvāt tadviṣayadhṛterapi tāmasatvamiti bhāvaḥ | vṛddhaniṣiddhatve'pi kutastāmasatvamityata āha || taditi ||
analyzed: ca atra avyabhicāri tvam askhalita tvam iti bhāvaḥ yayā svapnam iti ukta mātram yayā na muñcati sā tāmasī iti pratīti nirāsāya āha svapnam iti sarva niṣiddham bhagavat dveṣa ādi bhagavat dveṣa ādeḥ vṛddha aniṣiddha tvena tāmasa tvāt tad viṣaya dhṛteḥ api tāmasa tvam iti bhāvaḥ vṛddha niṣiddha tve api kutas tāmasa tvam iti atas āha tat iti

original: nanu bhagavad‌dveṣādeḥ kaiścana vṛddhairvihitatvāt kathaṃ tanninditatvamityata āha || mahātmāna iti || ye bhagavad‌dveṣādividhāyakā na te vṛddhāḥ, kintu bhagavantaṃ bhajanta eva | tathoktatvādityarthaḥ || 35 -36 ||
