original: kṣatriyādūnāḥ brāhmaguṇāḥ śamādayo yasyāsau tathoktaḥ | tato vaiśyāt | śuśrūṣuḥ śuśrūpājīvanaḥ | neyaṃ niyatiryuktā | śūdarasyāpyadhikaguṇatvadarśanādityata āha || adhikāścediti || brāhmaṇādiriti || brāhmaṇasamaśamādiguṇa ityādi draṣṭavyam | śūdra evetyupalakṣaṇam | tattatsamaguṇo'sāviti jñatavyam |
analyzed: kṣatriyāt ūnāḥ brāhma guṇāḥ śama ādayaḥ yasya asau tathā uktaḥ tatas vaiśyāt śuśrūṣuḥ śuśrūpā jīvanaḥ na iyam niyatiḥ yuktā śūdarasya api adhika guṇa tva darśanāt iti atas āha adhikāḥ ced iti brāhmaṇa ādiḥ iti brāhmaṇa sama śama ādi guṇaḥ ityādi draṣṭavyam śūdraḥ eva iti upalakṣaṇam tad tad sama guṇaḥ usau iti jñatavyam

original: jātimanapekṣya guṇamātreṇa kathaṃ brāhmaṇatvādikalpanetyata āha || naro'pīti || yatheti śeṣaḥ | evaṃ pramāṇāntareṇa kṣatriyādiṣvapi śamādyanuvṛttirastītyuktvā vākyaśeṣabalenāpyetadupapādayati || svakarmaṇeti || atra sarveṣāṃ bhagavadabhyarcanamevocyate, na tu śamādikamityata āha || na hīti ||
analyzed: jātim an apekṣya guṇa mātreṇa katham brāhmaṇa tva ādi kalpanā iti atas āha naraḥ upi iti yathā iti śeṣaḥ evam pramāṇa antareṇa kṣatriya ādiṣu api śama ādi anuvṛttiḥ asti iti uktvā vākyaśeṣa balena api etat upapādayati sva karmaṇā iti atra sarveṣām bhagavat abhyarcanam eva ucyate na tu śama ādikam iti atas āha na hi iti

original: yadā sarveṣāṃ bhagavadabhyarcanamevocyate, tadā śamādikamuktameva | tadvinā'bhito'rcanasyaivāyogāditi bhāvaḥ | tatkuta ityata āha || samyagiti || samyagarcanaṃ hyabhito'rcanaṃ ca śamādibhirarcanamevetyarthaḥ | śamādikaṃ vinā'pi sādhanasampūrtyā'rcanamātramatra vivakṣaitaṃ kiṃ na syādityata āha || na ceti ||
analyzed: yadā sarveṣām bhagavat abhyarcanam eva ucyate tadā śama ādikam uktam eva tat vinā abhitas ūrcanasya eva ayogāt iti bhāvaḥ tat kutas iti atas āha samyak iti samyak arcanam hi abhitas ūrcanam ca śama ādibhiḥ arcanam eva iti arthaḥ śama ādikam vinā api sādhana sampūrtyā arcana mātram atra vivakṣā etam kim na syāt iti atas āha na ca iti

original: śamādibhirarcanamevātrābhyarcanaṃ vivakṣitam | na tu śamādikaṃ vinā'nyat | etadabhyarcanasya mokṣaulatvaśravaṇāt | śamādyabhāve tadayogāditi bhāvaḥ | upakramabalena kṣatriyādiṣu brāhmaṇadhramānuvṛttirjñāyata ityāha || yajñeti || śamādyabhāve kuto mokṣābhāva ityata āha || śama iti || bhagavanniṣṭhādikaṃ hi śamādikaṃ nāma |
analyzed: śama ādibhiḥ arcanam eva atra abhyarcanam vivakṣitam na tu śama ādikam vinā anyat etad abhyarcanasya mokṣa aulatva śravaṇāt śama ādi abhāve tad ayogāt iti bhāvaḥ upakrama balena kṣatriya ādiṣu brāhmaṇa dhrama anuvṛttiḥ jñāyate iti āha yajña iti śama ādi abhāve kutas mokṣa abhāvaḥ iti atas āha śamaḥ iti bhagavat niṣṭhā ādikam hi śama ādikam nāma

original: bhagavanniṣṭhādyabhāve ca mokṣābhāvaḥ suprasiddha iti bhāvaḥ | niṣedhābhāvācca kṣatriyādiṣu śamādyaṅgīkāryamityāha || na ceti || niṣedhaśca bhavaṃstaddharmakathaṃnasthala eva bhavatīti tattaddharmeṣvatyuktam | ito'pi kṣatriyādiṣu śamādyaṅgīkāryamityāha || yuktā hīti || tulādhāro vaiśyaḥ | ādipadena daṇḍadhārādiśūdrasaṅgrahaḥ |
analyzed: bhagavat niṣṭhā ādi abhāve ca mokṣa abhāvaḥ su prasiddhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ niṣedha abhāvāt ca kṣatriya ādiṣu śama ādi aṅgīkāryam iti āha na ca iti niṣedhaḥ ca bhavan tad dharma kathaṃna sthale eva bhavati iti tat tad dharmeṣu ati uktam itas pi kṣatriya ādiṣu śama ādi aṅgīkāryam iti āha yuktāḥ hi iti tulādhāraḥ vaiśyaḥ ādi padena daṇḍadhāra ādi śūdra saṅgrahaḥ

original: hīti bhāratādiprasiddhiṃ sūcayati | evaṃ cet svaparadharamavivekaḥ kathamityata āha || ata iti || uktanyāyenānyeṣāṃ sādhāraṇatvādityarthaḥ | evaṃ kṛṣyādayo vaiṣyasya jīvanārtham | śūśrūṣā śūdrasya | yājanaṃ jīvanārthamadhyāpanaṃ pratigrahaśca viprasyeti draṣṭavyam | paradharmānāha || tau yeti ||
analyzed: hi iti bhārata ādi prasiddhim sūcayati evam ced sva para dharam avivekaḥ katham iti atas āha atas iti ukta nyāyena anyeṣām sādhāraṇa tvāt iti arthaḥ evam kṛṣi ādayaḥ vaiṣyasya jīvana artham śūśrūṣā śūdrasya yājanam jīvana artham adhyāpanam pratigrahaḥ ca viprasya iti draṣṭavyam para dharmān āha tau yā iti

original: śamādīnāṃ sāthāraṇatve'pi kṣatriyasya śauryādayaḥ sarve'pi viśeṣadharmāḥ kiṃ na syuḥ brāhmaṇasyādhyāpanādimātraṃ, śūdrasya śuśrūṣāmāteraṃ ca svadharmaḥ kiṃ na syāt? ityatasteṣāṃ sādhāraṇyaṃ pramāṇena darśayati || śauryamiti || etena kṣatriye śauryādyuktirādhikyaviṣayeti coktaṃ bhavati | satāmadhyāpanaṃ ca śuśrūṣeti sambandhaḥ |
analyzed: śama ādīnām sāthāraṇa tve api kṣatriyasya śaurya ādayaḥ sarve api viśeṣa dharmāḥ kim na syuḥ brāhmaṇasya adhyāpana ādi mātram śūdrasya ca svadharmaḥ kim na syāt iti atas teṣām sādhāraṇyam pramāṇena darśayati śauryam iti etena kṣatriye śaurya ādi uktiḥ ādhikya viṣayā iti ca uktam bhavati satām adhyāpanam ca śuśrūṣā iti sambandhaḥ

original: śūdrasyādhyāpanaṃ vinā kimuktaṃ bhavatītyata āha || tasmāditi || śuśrūṣāyāḥ sarvadharmatvādityarthaḥ | satāmiti sambaddhyate | śauryādīnāṃ sādhāraṇatve kṣatriyādīnāṃ ke viśeṣaguṇā ityata āha || eta iti || sādhāraṇatayoktebhyo'nye yuddhe'palāyanaiśvaryādaya ityarthaḥ | naisargikā asādhāraṇāḥ |
analyzed: śūdrasya adhyāpanam vinā kim uktam bhavati iti atas āha tasmāt iti śuśrūṣāyāḥ sarva dharma tvāt iti arthaḥ satām iti sambaddhyate śaurya ādīnām sādhāraṇa tve kṣatriya ādīnām ke viśeṣa guṇāḥ iti atas āha ete iti sādhāraṇa tayā uktebhyaḥ nye yuddhe palāyana aiśvarya ādayaḥ iti arthaḥ naisargikāḥ asādhāraṇāḥ

original: kimete puṃsāmasādhāraṇā eva dharmā niyatyā bhavantītyata āha || syāditi || eteṣāmasādhāraṇatvādavaśyānuṣṭheyatvamiti ca nāśaṅ‌kanīyamityāha || balāditi || yathā brāhmaṇasya jīvanārthaṃ yājanamityādi | evamasādhāraṇyenātmīyatvābhāve'pi tyājyatvaṃ ca na mantavyamityāha || anisarga iti || yathā brāhmaṇasya jīvanārthamadhyāpanamityādi |
analyzed: kim ete puṃsām asādhāraṇāḥ eva dharmāḥ niyatyā bhavanti iti atas āha syāt iti eteṣām asādhāraṇa tvāt avaśya anuṣṭheya tvam iti ca na āśaṅkanīyam iti āha balāt iti yathā brāhmaṇasya jīvana artham yājanam ityādi evam asādhāraṇyena ātmīya tva abhāve pi tyājya tvam ca na mantavyam iti āha anisargaḥ iti yathā brāhmaṇasya jīvana artham adhyāpanam ityādi

original: uktasyāpavādamāha || yājaneti || asvābhāvikāḥ śubhā api sādhāraṇā eva vardhanīyāḥ | na tu viprādyasādhāraṇā yājanādaya ityarthaḥ | śauryādīnāmasādhāraṇatvoktyā yuddhe'palāyanamaiśvaryaṃ ca kṣatriyasya viśeṣadharmāvityuktam || tasyāpavādamāha || apalāyanamiti || viprakṣatrārthamiti viśeṣoktyā sāmānyataḥ kṣatriyasyaiva siddhyati |
analyzed: uktasya apavādam āha yājana iti asvābhāvikāḥ śubhāḥ api sādhāraṇāḥ eva vardhanīyāḥ na tu vipra ādi asādhāraṇāḥ yājana ādayaḥ iti arthaḥ śaurya ādīnām asādhāraṇa tva uktyā yuddhe palāyanam aiśvaryam ca kṣatriyasya viśeṣa dharmau iti uktam tasya apavādam āha apalāyanam iti vipra kṣatra artham iti viśeṣa uktyā sāmānyatas kṣatriyasya eva siddhi ati

original: tato noktavirodhaḥ |
analyzed: tatas na ukta virodhaḥ

original: yathā kṣatriyaikadharmatayoktaṃ yuddhe'palāyanaṃ kāraṇaviśeṣādanyeṣāmapi syāttathaivaiśvaryamapyanyadharmaḥ syāt kim? ityataḥ tatsvarūpanirūpaṇapūrvakaṃ tasya kṣatriyetareṣvavṛttiṃ pramāṇena darśayati || prasahyeti || prasahya vittaharaṇādi keṣāmityataḥ tadvadanūnakāryaḥ kṣatriyetarairityasya vyāvartyamāha || sarva iti ||
analyzed: yathā kṣatriya eka dharma tayā uktam yuddhe palāyanam kāraṇa viśeṣāt anyeṣām api syāt tathā eva aiśvaryam api anya dharmaḥ syāt kim iti atas tad svarūpa nirūpaṇa pūrvakam tasya kṣatriya itareṣu avṛttim pramāṇena darśayati prasahya iti prasahya vitta haraṇa ādi keṣām iti atas tadvat anūna kāryaḥ kṣatriya itaraiḥ iti asya vyāvartyam āha sarve iti

original: tarhi kiṃ brāhmaṇādibhirvidharmiṇāṃ śāsanameva na kāryamityata āha || aṅgādīti || śiṣyo nāma kīdṛśa ityata āha || śiṣyaśceti || tarhi putrādīnāmaśāsanaprasaṅga ityata āha || putreti || anisargaśiṣyasvarūpaṃ taditi bhāvaḥ | na kevalaṃ brāhmaṇādeyaiḥ śiṣyā eva śāsyāḥ kintu gurvādayo'pītyāha || gurava iti || śikṣaṇīyeṣu bhāveṣviti ||
analyzed: tarhi kim brāhmaṇa ādibhiḥ vidharmiṇām śāsanam eva na kāryam iti atas āha aṅga ādi iti śiṣyaḥ nāma kīdṛśaḥ iti atas āha śiṣyaḥ ca iti tarhi putra ādīnām aśāsana prasaṅgaḥ iti atas āha putra iti anisarga śiṣya svarūpam tat iti bhāvaḥ na kevalam brāhmaṇa ādeyaiḥ śiṣyāḥ eva śāsyāḥ kintu guru ādayaḥ api iti āha guravaḥ iti śikṣaṇīyeṣu bhāveṣu iti

original: śikṣaṇīyārthaviṣaya ityarthaḥ | na kevalaṃ gurvādaya eva śāsyāḥ kintvajñātā apītyāha || pāpamiti || atra sarvatra aṅgādyahānikṛddaṇḍaḥ śiṣyeṣu guravaśca deśakālānusārata iti viśeṣoktyā kṣatriyādviśeṣo draṣṭavyaḥ | pāpaṃ caranto vāraṇīyā ityuktam | yadi svottamavirodhākhyaṃ mahāpāpaṃ kuryustarhi kiṃ kāryamityata āha || taditi ||
analyzed: śikṣaṇīya artha viṣayaḥ iti arthaḥ na kevalam guru ādayaḥ eva śāsyāḥ kintu ajñātāḥ api iti āha pāpam iti atra sarvatra aṅga ādi ahānikṛt daṇḍaḥ śiṣyeṣu guravaḥ ca deśa kāla anusārataḥ iti viśeṣa uktyā kṣatriyāt viśeṣaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ pāpam carantaḥ vāraṇīyāḥ iti uktam yadi sva uttama virodha ākhyam mahā pāpam kuryuḥ tarhi kim kāryam iti atas āha tat iti

original: kiṃ sahasā tyājyā evetyata āha || yatheti || svottamaviroddhāro gurvādayaḥ kiṃ sarvathā tyājyā evetyata āha || viṣṇāviti || tacchikṣāprakāramāha || śikṣayanniti || viṣṇau paramabhaktaḥ svottamavirodhetarapāpamācarati cet kiṃ kāryamityata āha || mahānta iti ||
analyzed: kim sahasā tyājyāḥ eva iti atas āha yathā iti sva uttama viroddhāraḥ guru ādayaḥ kim sarvathā tyājyāḥ eva iti atas āha viṣṇau iti tad śikṣā prakāram āha śikṣayan iti viṣṇau parama bhaktaḥ sva uttama virodha itara pāpam ācarati ced kim kāryam iti atas āha mahāntaḥ iti

original: prasaṅgādviprādīnām āpaddhakmān smṛtyā darśayati || āpatsviti || kṣātriyasya vipradharmācaraṇe viśeṣamāha || kṣatriya iti || bhikṣetarahiraṇyādipratigrāhī syādityarthaḥ | śaudraṃ tu dharmamācarediti sambaddhyate | na śūdrastu viprakṣatriyayordharmamācaredityuktam | tarhyāpatsu tena ko dharma āśrayaṇīya ityata āha || śūdra iti ||
analyzed: prasaṅgāt vipra ādīnām āpad hakmān smṛtyā darśayati āpatsu iti kṣātriyasya vipra dharma ācaraṇe viśeṣam āha kṣatriyaḥ iti bhikṣā itara hiraṇya ādi pratigrāhī syāt iti arthaḥ śaudram tu dharmam ācaret iti sambaddhyate na śūdraḥ tu vipra kṣatriyayoḥ dharmam ācaret iti uktam tarhi āpatsu tena kaḥ dharmaḥ āśrayaṇīyaḥ iti atas āha śūdraḥ iti

original: śūdrasya vaiśyadharmatve viśeṣamāha || śūdra iti || vedākṣarādiśravaṇādimān na bhavedtyarthaḥ | kṣatriyo brāhmamāpatsu, tadāpatsu viśāṃ dharmamācaredityuktam | tato'pyāpadi kiṃ kāryamityata āha || atyāpadīti || viprakṣatriyeṣu śūdradharmaṃ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ carannityarthaḥ | na kevalaṃ kṣatriyaḥ śūdradharmaṃ caran na dupyatītyeva, kiṃ tarhītyata āha ||
analyzed: śūdrasya vaiśya dharma tve viśeṣam āha śūdraḥ iti veda akṣara ādi śravaṇa ādimān na bhavet iti arthaḥ kṣatriyaḥ brāhmam āpatsu tad āpatsu viśām dharmam ācaret iti uktam tatas upi āpadi kim kāryam iti atas āha atyāpadi iti vipra kṣatriyeṣu śūdra dharmam śuśrūṣaṇam caran iti arthaḥ na kevalam kṣatriyaḥ śūdra dharmam caran na dupyati iti eva kim tarhi ityatas āha

original: yeṣviti || yadi kṣatriyasya svadharmakṛtāvāpado bhavanti tarhi tasya sānubandhāt svamino balādhikye'pi dharmārthaṃ tamanabhibhūya yeṣu karmasu niyuktaḥ svaminā'pi yācyaḥ syānna tu svayaṃ yācitā | tāni śaudrāṇyapi karmāṇyarthādyarthaṃ sevamānasya viprādidharmopajīvanādipi varo dharmo bhavatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: yeṣu iti yadi kṣatriyasya svadharma kṛtau āpadaḥ bhavanti tarhi tasya sa anubandhāt svaminaḥ bala ādhikye api dharma artham tam an abhibhūya yeṣu karmasu niyuktaḥ svaminā api yācyaḥ syāt na tu svayam yācitā tāni śaudrāṇi api karmāṇi artha ādi artham sevamānasya vipra ādi dharma upajīvanāt ipi varaḥ dharmaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ

original: tatra svāmyanabhibhavādapi svāminā yācyatvaṃ viśeṣeṇa dharmakāraṇamityāha || prabhuṇeti || vipradharmādyāśrayaṇe paropajīvanābhāvāt śūdradharme dadbhāvāt kathaṃ sānubandhāt prabhorbalādhikyādau satyapi tato'sya varatvamityata āha || bāhvoriti || sarvasya tadīyatvānna paropajīvanamiti bhāvaḥ || 48 ||
analyzed: tatra svāmi anabhibhavāt api svāminā yācya tvam viśeṣeṇa dharma kāraṇam iti āha prabhuṇā iti vipra dharma ādi āśrayaṇe para upajīvana abhāvāt śūdra dharme katham sa anubandhāt prabhoḥ bala ādhikya ādau sati api tatas sya vara tvam iti atas āha bāhvoḥ iti sarvasya tadīya tvāt na para upajīvanam iti bhāvaḥ

original: 'sve sve karmaṇyabhirataḥ saṃsiddhiṃ labhate ' ityuktasyaiva itthambhāvāntaramucyate -- 'asakta ' iti | tatra naiṣkarmyasiddhipadasya mokṣārthatvapratītinirāsāyārthamāha || naiṣkarmyeti || sarvapadamaprārabdhaviṣayam || 49 ||
analyzed: sve sve karmaṇi abhirataḥ saṃsiddhim labhate iti uktasya eva ittham bhāva antaram ucyate asaktaḥ iti tatra naiṣkarmya siddhi padasya mokṣa artha tva pratīti nirāsāya artham āha naiṣkarmya iti sarva padam aprārabdha viṣayam

original: asaktetyādinā naiṣkarmyasiddhisādhanavivaraṇapratijñāpūrvakaṃ tadanantaraphalamucyate -- 'siddhiṃ ' iti | tatra naiṣkarmyasiddhyanantaraṃ ca yenopāyena paraṃbrahmāpnoti taṃ prakāraṃ nibodhetyanyathāpratītinirāsāyāha || vakṣyamāṇeti ||
analyzed: asakta ityādinā naiṣkarmya siddhi sādhana vivaraṇa pratijñā pūrvakam tad anantara phalam ucyate siddhim iti tatra naiṣkarmya siddhi anantaram ca yena upāyena param brahma āpnoti tam prakāram nibodha iti anyathā pratīti nirāsāya āha vakṣyamāṇa iti

original: atra yathā yena vakṣyamāṇaprakāreṇa vartamāno neṣkarmyasiddhiṃ prāpto bhūtvā mahālakṣmīṃ prāpnoti taṃ prakāraṃ nibodhetyevocyate | na tu naiṣkarmyasiddhyanantaraṃ parabrahmaprāptisādhanaṃ nibodhetyarthaḥ | brahmaśabdasya lakṣmīvācakatvameva kuta ityata āha || mameti || atra brahmapadena parabrahmaiva kiṃ na syādityata āha || brahmeti ||
analyzed: atra yathā yena vakṣyamāṇa prakāreṇa vartamānaḥ neṣkarmya siddhim prāptaḥ bhūtvā mahā lakṣmīm prāpnoti tam prakāram nibodha iti eva ucyate na tu naiṣkarmya siddhi anantaram para brahma prāpti sādhanam nibodha iti arthaḥ brahma śabdasya lakṣmī vācaka tvam eva kutas iti atas āha mama iti atra brahma padena para brahma eva kim na syāt iti atas āha brahma iti

original: etadbrahmaprāptyanantaramapi parabrahmaiva kiṃ na syādityata āha || brahmeti || etadbrahmaprāptyanantaramapi bhaktyādilāśravaṇāt lakṣmītattvamevedaṃ, na tu paraṃ brahmetyarthaḥ | bhavedetadyadi naiṣkarmyasiddhiṃ prāptasya lakṣmīprāptyanantaramapi bhaktyādilābho'sti, na tu parabrahmaprāptyanantaramiti siddhyati | tadeva kuta ityata āha ||
analyzed: etad brahma prāpti anantaram api para brahma eva kim na syāt iti atas āha brahma iti etad brahma prāpti anantaram api bhakti ādi lā śravaṇāt lakṣmī tattvam eva idam na tu param brahma iti arthaḥ bhavet etat yadi naiṣkarmya siddhim prāptasya lakṣmī prāpti anantaram api bhakti ādi lābhaḥ usti na tu para brahma prāpti anantaram iti siddhi ati tat eva kutas iti atas āha

original: sarveti || pāpapadam aprārabdhāniṣṭakarmaparam | nanvaparokṣajñānino hi naiṣkarmyasiddhiḥ | tatkathaṃ tadanantaramapi jñānādilābhaḥ? tathātve muktāvāpi tatprasaṅgādityata āha || aparokṣeti || purā dehatyāgāt | aparokṣajñānānantaramapi jñānādivṛddhirbhavedeva | na cātiprasaṅgaḥ | pramāṇānuguṇena muktau tadabhāvopapatteriti bhāvaḥ || 50 -52 ||

original: tataḥ prāgeva tajjñasya bhagavataḥ tadbodhanoparamo yukta iti bhāvaḥ || 73 -78 ||

original: atha samāpitagrantho'yaṃ bhagavānācāryaḥ svapratipāditaprakārameva vāsudevaṃ namati || nama iti || svasvarūpaparijñānasyāpi kaivalyādyakhilapuruṣārthahetutvāt svakṛtāṃ granthanirmāṇarūpaparicaryāṃ keśave samarpayan tadāha || yasyeti || atha tameva harimādaraviśeṣāt punaḥ stauti || niḥśeṣeti || bhūtirmahālakṣmīḥ |
analyzed: atha samāpita granthaḥ ayam bhagavān ācāryaḥ sva pratipādita prakāram eva vāsudevam namati namaḥ iti sva svarūpa parijñānasya api kaivalya ādi akhila puruṣa artha hetu tvāt sva kṛtām grantha nirmāṇa rūpa paricaryām keśave samarpayan tat āha yasya iti atha tam eva harim ādara viśeṣāt punar stauti niḥśeṣā iti bhūtiḥ mahā lakṣmīḥ

original: śrīmadānandatīrthāryahṛdayāmalamandiraḥ |
analyzed: śrīmat ānandatīrtha ārya hṛdaya amala mandiraḥ

original: indirāramaṇaḥ prītiṃ yātu dīnadayāparaḥ ||
